English: Farmers are urged to prioritize safe agrochemical usage as Kenya hosts the World Farmers' Organisation General Assembly.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanakumbushwa kuzingatia matumizi salama ya kemikali za kilimo wakati Kenya ikihudumia Mkutano Mkuu wa Shirika la Wakulima Duniani.
Ekegusii: Abakuli batosere omogori bw'ogenda gesia bw'ogenda buya bw'ekegero naki bwasibori weke umwaki wa World Farmers' Organisation.
Dholuo: Dala marach yong’ni kuom thuolo buo ma jochwe gi ne nyaka keto buo ma ooyo kendo Kenya owuonye World Farmers' Organisation General Assembly.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxa lagu boorinayaa inay mudnaanta siiyaan isticmaalka sunta beerta ee ammaanka leh, maadaama Keenya ay martigelinayso Shirweynaha Guud ee Ururka Beeraleyda Adduunka.

English: Trucks ferrying top-dressing fertilizer are now arriving at the Eldoret Depot of the National Cereals and Produce Board. Farmers are encouraged to collect their supplies.
Kiswahili: Masafa yanayosafirisha mbolea ya kuongeza mavuno sasa yanawasili katika Ghala la Eldoret la Bodi ya Taifa ya Nafaka na Mazao. Wakulima wanahimizwa kuchukua vifaa vyao.
Ekegusii: Matika agwanana oria okora buya bwakonyang'ana oria buye bwanyama bwanja buya bu fei na Eldoret ya National Cereals and Produce Board. Abagorie baogekire okuigana oria buya bwabo.
Dholuo: Magari maher koro oyum oting' ka piny Eldoret kuom National Cereals and Produce Board. Jokanya no nyaka kony ng'ato mago.
Somali: Baabuurta qaada bacriminta sare ayaa hadda imaanaya keydka Eldoret ee Guddiga Qaranka ee Hadhuudhka iyo Miraha. Farming ayaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay soo qaataan sahaydooda.

English: Farmers in Wajir are invited to participate in the Ksh. 5 billion Livestock Investment Drive launched by President Ruto.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa Wajir wanakaribishwa kushiriki katika Mpango wa Uwekezaji wa Mifugo wa Ksh. bilioni 5 ulioanzishwa na Rais Ruto.
Ekegusii: Abagere bu Wajir batarikire kugana mu Ksh. 5 billion Livestock Investment Drive amogotere President Ruto.
Dholuo: Wamoro e Wajir to nying' gima to yudhi kanyiengi Ksh. 5 billion magi mo kwayo mar Nyasaye Ruto.
Somali: Beeralayda Wajir waxaa lagu casuumay inay ka qayb qaataan ololaha maalgelinta xoolaha oo ah Ksh. 5 bilyan oo uu soo bandhigay Madaxweyne Ruto.

English: Farmers are encouraged to participate in the sugarcane ethanol initiative to help lower fuel prices and boost the sugar sector.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahimizwa kushiriki katika mpango wa etanoli wa miwa ili kusaidia kupunguza bei ya mafuta na kuimarisha sekta ya sukari.
Ekegusii: Abagaba batemerewe kuhakanya mulashi wa ethanol ya miwa kugira akore bajua ng'ana buya na bushande bw'ekisukari.
Dholuo: Ng'eno mamoko konyo gi kita kuom sugarcane ethanol initiative dla goyo mar namba mar fuel ma gin manokoro gi sugar sector.
Somali: Dhalinyarada waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay ka qaybqaataan mashruuca ethanol-ka sonkorta si loo yareeyo qiimaha shidaalka iyo kor loogu qaado qaybta sonkorta.

English: A Ksh. 34.4 billion program has been launched to enhance climate resilience, food security, and sustainable livelihoods. Stakeholders in agriculture are encouraged to participate.
Kiswahili: Mpango wa Ksh. bilioni 34.4 umeanzishwa ili kuimarisha ustahimilivu wa hali ya hewa, usalama wa chakula, na maisha endelevu. Washiriki katika sekta ya kilimo wanahimizwa kushiriki.
Ekegusii: Programu ya Ksh. 34.4 bilioni imeanzishwa kuimarisha ustahimilivu wa hali ya hewa, usalama wa chakula, na maisha endelevu. Wadau katika kilimo wanahimizwa kushiriki.
Dholuo: Dhuong' Ksh. 34.4 bilioni nyasach nyaka jowuoth malong'o, iwacho e yo ng'ato, gima nigi piero, kod mga teko makare. Jotare chiegni e yo tsa e nyale.
Somali: Barnaamij dhan Ksh. 34.4 bilyan ayaa la bilaabay si loo xoojiyo adkeysiga cimilada, amniga cunnada, iyo nolol waarta. Sidoo kale, daneeyayaasha beeraha waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay ka qeybqaataan.

English: The 12th Agritec Africa Conference will be held at KICC. Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders are encouraged to participate.
Kiswahili: Mkutano wa 12 wa Agritec Africa utafanyika KICC. Wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo wanahimizwa kushiriki.
Ekegusii: Itong’ango 12 ya Agritec Africa ichaitwaki na KICC. Abagikiri na abarwaki b’amasoko buinane baria bataraka buya.
Dholuo: Chiemo 12th Agritec Africa Conference nyi gima yaye KICC. Babichni ne lweny mar shamba magi e koni kanyono ni wobed kuom joma mang'ere.
Somali: Shirka 12-aad ee Agritec Africa waxaa lagu qaban doonaa KICC. Beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beerta waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay ka qaybqaataan.

English: The 4th National Kalro Open Research Week and 20th Annual Ruiru Coffee Fair is now open. Farmers and stakeholders in the coffee industry are encouraged to participate.
Kiswahili: Siku ya 4 ya Utafiti wa Taifa wa Kalro na Maonyesho ya Kahawa ya Ruiru ya Kila Mwaka ya 20 yamefunguliwa sasa. Wakulima na wadau katika sekta ya kahawa wanahimizwa kushiriki.
Ekegusii: Naki za Nane Kaliro Open Research Week na Naki ya Nyakabingo ya Akarangu Ruiru ya 20, zikari kianchani. Abagurukire na abachokere bonyoro baretore batesebene.
Dholuo: Katsanda kuom Chan Piny 4, National Kalro Open Research Week, e tin mokuongo. Wuon-gi gi jomoko e kisumu mag Ruiru gi nyaka chike.
Somali: Tartanka 4-aad ee Qaranka ee Kalro iyo 20-aad ee Sanadlaha Ruiru Coffee Fair ayaa hadda furan. Beeralayda iyo daneeyayaasha warshadaha kafee ayaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay ka qaybgalaan.

English: Farmers in Garissa are encouraged to utilize the Bulla Cadey Irrigation Scheme to enhance agricultural productivity.
Kiswahili: Wakulima Garissa wanahimizwa kutumia Mpango wa Umwagiliaji wa Bulla Cadey ili kuboresha uzalishaji wa kilimo.
Ekegusii: Abagere baki Garissa mugakire buya Bulla Cadey Irrigation Scheme buya omogaka bwiira.
Dholuo: Mokoro e Garissa bang' gi Bulla Cadey Irrigation Scheme ka giyer gi tich mar udhi.
Somali: Beeraleyda Garissa waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay isticmaalaan Qorshaha Jilitaanka Bulla Cadey si kor loogu qaado waxsoosaarka beeraha.

English: The High Court has dismissed a petition against the Nzoia Sugar lease, allowing West Kenya Sugar to proceed with its Ksh 5.7 billion investment.
Kiswahili: Mahakama Kuu imetupa ombi dhidi ya mkataba wa Nzoia Sugar, ikiruhusu West Kenya Sugar kuendelea na uwekezaji wa Ksh bilioni 5.7.
Ekegusii: Omosioro ogendete ogwaki omokiri omokiamokiririe naki ya Nzoia Sugar, gaki oregisiri West Kenya Sugar okore stringa ye Ksh 5.7 billion.
Dholuo: Chakre gi High Court eyo ni petition ma nyal ni Nzoia Sugar lease, kendo osethgi West Kenya Sugar nigi konyo kanyo machiemo Ksh 5.7 billion.
Somali: Maxkamadda Sare ayaa diidday codsi ka dhan ah kirada Nzoia Sugar, iyadoo oggolaatay West Kenya Sugar inay sii wado maalgelinteeda oo ah Ksh 5.7 bilyan.

English: The Kenya Sugar Board announces that no sugar factories have been sold; they are only leased. Stakeholders should verify their contracts accordingly.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Sukari ya Kenya inatangaza kwamba hakuna viwanda vya sukari vilivyouzwa; vinapangishwa tu. Wadau wanapaswa kuthibitisha mikataba yao ipasavyo.
Ekegusii: Naki Kenya Sugar Board ekerere osibori buya, ore berire buya bwenga; orere buya bosiaki. Abachama batorore omotereri ba ibokireri bwosi.
Dholuo: Kenya Sugar Board oving' ni kendo sugar factories to kod nyalo yichal; nyaka to otimo ka gi leasa. Wanyalo joma oketh bende nyalo weche gi chon.
Somali: Hay'adda Sonkorta Kenya waxay ku dhawaaqaysaa in aan la iibin wax warshado sonkor ah; kaliya waa la kiraystay. Qaybaha daneynaya waa inay xaqiijiyaan heshiisyadooda sida ku habboon.

English: The Kenyan government has partnered with Pula Advisors to offer an innovative insurance program aimed at boosting climate resilience for smallholder farmers.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Kenya imefungamana na Pula Advisors kutoa mpango wa bima wa kisasa unaolenga kuimarisha uhimili wa hali ya hewa kwa wakulima wadogo.
Ekegusii: Abagere baki Kenya batarire ne Pula Advisors omokigo omogori bwakorori buya bwaki oshie ikari ya buya bwaki orenda bukiing'ana buna chiang'ana buya bwaki abakereri.
Dholuo: Waganga wa Kenya anachok piny gi Pula Advisors nyaka tedi program mokuongo mauruok kuom jingo duto ma ombogo nyaka in-gi kakrindo yienyo ka gima odhi gi momuno.
Somali: Dowladda Kenya ayaa la shaqeyneysa Pula Advisors si ay u soo bandhigto barnaamij caymis cusub oo loogu talagalay in kor loogu qaado adkeysiga cimilada ee beeraleyda yaryar.

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders are encouraged to participate in new opportunities under the Bottom-Up Economic Transformation Agenda (BETA) for agricultural reforms and sugar sector revitalization.
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo wanahimizwa kushiriki katika fursa mpya chini ya Mpango wa Mabadiliko ya Uchumi wa Chini kuelekea Juu (BETA) kwa ajili ya marekebisho ya kilimo na uhuishaji wa sekta ya sukari.
Ekegusii: Abagabire batyire naki bw'a nyang'iri bategere abakereri b'achire bw'ekomi  ekoroketi naki Bottom-Up Economic Transformation Agenda (BETA) bw'ekore naki osibori bw'ekibori.
Dholuo: Nakiema kuom farmers ni stakeholders mar agribusiness gir e konyo nyalo chak kendo mar Bottom-Up Economic Transformation Agenda (BETA) kuom sekta mar kager ni kwe.
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beeraha waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay ka qaybqaataan fursadaha cusub ee ka hooseeya Ajandaha Isbeddelka Dhaqaalaha (BETA) si loogu sameeyo isbedel ku saabsan beeraha iyo dib u noolaynta waaxda sonkorta.

English: A partnership has been formed to address climate challenges in East African agriculture. Farmers are encouraged to stay informed about upcoming initiatives and resources.
Kiswahili: Mshikamano umeundwa kukabiliana na changamoto za hali ya hewa katika kilimo cha Afrika Mashariki. Wakulima wanahimizwa kubaki na habari kuhusu mipango na rasilimali zitakazo kuja.
Ekegusii: Abakire buya bwakorekeria buya buya naki angete naki osisi mirere ebire buya moke mu isi ya mashamba ya Afurika y'Ababuraru. Abashamba barigwa bamenyane nibwaki bwanye bige na matokari amakire.
Dholuo: Kaka marfondo oseth giro marach e golo maruo e Afrika Mashariki. Abaluhya ng'eyo ka joma osetho ng'ato kewe gima obiro chutho gi gigo mag piny.
Somali: Wada shaqeyn ayaa la sameeyay si wax looga qabto caqabadaha cimilada ee wax soo saarka beeraha Bariga Afrika. Beeralayda waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay si fiican u socdaan barnaamijyada iyo ilooyinka soo socda.

English: The government has waived packaging taxes to support the tea sector. Farmers are encouraged to take advantage of this initiative.
Kiswahili: Serikali imeondoa ushuru wa ufungashaji ili kusaidia sekta ya chai. Wakulima wanahimizwa kutumia fursa hii.
Ekegusii: Abakinyari bategereje omogendi mwakire okwiitire amang'anya abakiende bware. Abagondo batariri nyasa okuigenya okegia oria.
Dholuo: Oganda osetiyo abich mar packaging ok nyal bende masindo sekta mar ti. Piny ma oting' konyo cham gi konyo mar uwe.
Somali: Dowladda waxay ka cafisay canshuuraha baakadka si ay u taageerto qaybta shaaha. Beeralayda waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay ka faa'iidaystaan fursadan.

English: The World Bank is collaborating with the Ministry of Agriculture to advance the Digital Agriculture Roadmap. Stay informed for updates on program opportunities.
Kiswahili: Benki ya Dunia inashirikiana na Wizara ya Kilimo kuendeleza Ramani ya Kidijitali ya Kilimo. Fuata taarifa za fursa za mpango huu.
Ekegusii: Osomeka Ikoranyane otore na Kanyange ka Abagereka buya buya bw'ibire. Naki'ora bwakire buya bw'ebyokoranye.
Dholuo: World Bank oning' chunyi gi Ministry of Agriculture, ma okinyi Digital Agriculture Roadmap. Chwero ng'ato gi ndalo kuom bura mar program.
Somali: Bangiga Adduunka ayaa ka shaqeynaya Wasaaradda Beeraha si loo horumariyo Qorshaha Dijitalka ah ee Beeraha. La soco wixii cusbooneysiin ah fursadaha barnaamijka.

English: There is ongoing collaboration between the PS for Agriculture and the World Bank Group regarding Kenya's Digital Agriculture Roadmap. Stay informed for upcoming initiatives.
Kiswahili: Kuna ushirikiano unaoendelea kati ya PS wa Kilimo na Kundi la Benki ya Dunia kuhusu Ramani ya Kidijitali ya Kilimo ya Kenya. Endelea kufuatilia mipango ijayo.
Ekegusii: Abakire buya bwaki bune okorania na PS wa Agriculture na World Bank Group bwaki buya bwaki buya Kenya's Digital Agriculture Roadmap. Naki minto buya bwaki buya.
Dholuo: Ber tich mar kaurach e PS moko ne Agriculture gi World Bank Group kuom Kenya's Digital Agriculture Roadmap. Ngi tiende kendo wachoni maber e tich.
Somali: Waxa jira iskaashi socda oo u dhexeeya PS ee Beeraha iyo Kooxda Bangiga Adduunka oo ku saabsan Qorshaha Dijitaal ah ee Beeraha ee Kenya. La soco mashaariicda soo socda.

English: The Rockefeller Foundation is partnering with Kenya to enhance food security and promote agricultural innovation. Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders should stay updated on new initiatives.
Kiswahili: Shirika la Rockefeller linashirikiana na Kenya kuboresha usalama wa chakula na kuendeleza ubunifu wa kilimo. Wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo wanapaswa kubaki na ufahamu wa mipango mipya.
Ekegusii: Ibanda ya Rockefeller iria na Kenya buya omogori bw'ogekere buya na omokirigo bw'amagari. Abagere n'abashindori b'egikora buya nyakiari iwane naki oria genda.
Dholuo: Rockefeller Foundation nigi timo gi Kenya kuom nyalo dalo oganda mar chakre mi tichni nyando. Maber ma chiegni gi ma-chakre kuom micho dongo ne ok nyal wuokne gi nyasaye.
Somali: Hay'adda Rockefeller waxay la shaqaynaysaa Kenya si kor loogu qaado amniga cunnada iyo in la dhiirrigeliyo hal-abuurka beeraha. Beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha agribusiness-ka waa inay si joogto ah ula socdaan Hindisayaasha cusub.

English: Farmers are assured of uninterrupted fertilizer supply from the Thika NCPB Depot.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahakikishiwa usambazaji wa mbolea bila kukatika kutoka Ghala la NCPB Thika.
Ekegusii: Abagasi bosiere bwakokere obwakore bweng'ente bw'abakire buya go Thika NCPB Depot.
Dholuo: Dala magweya adhi eyo machielo yore gi fertilizer kubva Thika NCPB Depot.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa la xaqiijiyay in ay heli doonaan bacriminta aan hakad lahayn oo ka imanaysa Degaanka Thika ee NCPB.

English: There are ongoing assessments in Kenya's tea sector. Stakeholders in the tea industry are encouraged to stay informed about developments and implement any necessary adjustments to improve productivity.
Kiswahili: Kuna tathmini zinaendelea katika sekta ya chai ya Kenya. Wadau katika sekta ya chai wanahimizwa kubaki na habari kuhusu maendeleo na kufanya marekebisho yoyote muhimu ili kuboresha uzalishaji.
Ekegusii: Naki naki jaore chimboko ching’enda omogaka bwakire buya bwetechibori. Abakoresa buya bwakire naboka bwakire bwyoborere buya kwechera ibwakire omokigori bwetechibori.
Dholuo: E nigi duong' mar gi kanyo ka weche matut akati Kenya. Lwaki duto mar tea to nyisowe konyo to kanyal agwendi kod togi ngima e yie kende midwaro motegno.
Somali: Waxa socda qiimeyn ku saabsan qeybta shaaha ee Kenya. Qaybaha ka tirsan warshadaha shaaha waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay la socdaan horumarka oo ay qaadaan isbeddelada lagama maarmaanka ah si kor loogu qaado wax soo saarka.

English: The export ban on macadamia remains in effect. Farmers are advised to stay updated on any future changes regarding this policy.
Kiswahili: Marufuku ya kusafirisha macadamia inaendelea kutekelezwa. Wakulima wanashauriwa kufuatilia mabadiliko yoyote kuhusu sera hii.
Ekegusii: Omoisho bw'omogori wa macadamia naki naki. Abakung'ana batarorwe no bw'oshure okobori bw'oshoka omogori ino.
Dholuo: Kadh nyaka ohinga kuom macadamia osebedo gi piny. Wuod ng'ato to, gichako gi loso kadi goyo kuom ng'ato chalo ma odhi nindo.
Somali: Bannaanada dhoofinta macadamia waxay sii socotaa. Beeraleyda waxaa lagu talinayaa inay la socdaan isbeddelada mustaqbalka ee siyaasaddan.

English: The 8th Africa Agric Expo 2025 is officially open at KICC. Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders are encouraged to attend and explore opportunities.
Kiswahili: Maonyesho ya 8 ya Kilimo Afrika 2025 rasmi yamefunguliwa katika KICC. Wakulima na wadau wa biashara za kilimo wanahimizwa kuhudhuria na kuchunguza fursa.
Ekegusii: Emotigori Osotiriri 8 ya Bantu 2025 ikinyekagwa buya KICC. Abanyagachi na abashandisi b’inyaibori barasagwa kuja na gaki ogendete.
Dholuo: Africa Agric Expo 2025 8th ni open rasmi ku KICC. Kachuko mar muduon gi jingo duto ne okinyi ku duto kendo gi thok nyadhi.
Somali: Bandhigga 8-aad ee Beeraha Afrika 2025 waxaa si rasmi ah loogu furay KICC. Beeralayda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beeraha waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay ka soo qayb galaan una baadigoobaan fursadaha.

English: There are new agricultural partnerships under discussion that may benefit Kenyan farmers. Stay informed about developments and opportunities related to these initiatives.
Kiswahili: Kuna ushirikiano mpya wa kilimo unaozungumziwa ambao unaweza kuwanufaisha wakulima wa Kenya. Fuata maendeleo na fursa zinazohusiana na mipango hii.
Ekegusii: Makiaganyia atigi ekerori omokire buya ahaki emokiri nakiye. Tiga na mwaki magetenda buya na kemezere buya kobwakinyang'ore.
Dholuo: Osecho kaka ma nyinga pwodhi kanyge goyo manyiso mar Kenyani. Wacho e yo mar neno gi ng'ato ma gi konyo e miti mar kaka.
Somali: Waxaa jira iskaashiyo cusub oo dhinaca beeraha ah oo la falanqeynayo kuwaas oo faa'iido u yeelan kara beeralayda Kenyan. La soco horumarka iyo fursadaha la xiriira hawlahaan.

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders in the tea sector are encouraged to engage with Dr. Kipronoh Ronoh to discuss strategies for strengthening the sector and boosting earnings.
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo katika sekta ya chai wanahimizwa kuzungumza na Dk. Kipronoh Ronoh ili kujadili mikakati ya kuimarisha sekta hiyo na kuongeza mapato.
Ekegusii: Abachara na abashmoseri bateguru boti na badi bochete bingi bakenyore okiro nandi Dr. Kipronoh Ronoh buya obokire bulimbo bwaki na buya ogethe bingi.
Dholuo: Nigi chano ka owuon gi ondo mar tea, omoka kanyo ka ung'eyo Dr. Kipronoh Ronoh kaka uwacho ng'ato mar piny kod ng'ato ma ok wacho e dwe mar tea gi to nyaka itiyogo.
Somali: Beeralayda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beeraha ee qeybta shaaha waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay la xiriiraan Dr. Kipronoh Ronoh si ay uga wada hadlaan xeeladaha lagu xoojinayo qeybta iyo kordhinta dakhliga.

English: No actionable information available.
Kiswahili: Hakuna taarifa inayoweza kutekelezwa.
Ekegusii: Amakire abwaki na buya.
Dholuo: Osebedo ni oyang' ka imiyo weche ma osekelo.
Somali: Macluumaad wax kala qabta ma jiro.

English: Kenya is set to enhance cotton production and the textile industry. Farmers and stakeholders should prepare for upcoming initiatives.
Kiswahili: Kenya inaandaa kuboresha uzalishaji wa pamba na sekta ya nguo. Wakulima na wadau wanapaswa kujiandaa kwa mipango ijayo.
Ekegusii: Kenya ikirongo omokebura ibori naki omokoya. Abakinyekenye na abaragani bakenye banye bakanunuka oria naki omokebura buse.
Dholuo: Kenya ogend erhore piny ma oketi cotton eyo mag ndal. Chik kanyalo ohinga gi jemborene kuom nyalo ir mang'eyo.
Somali: Kenya waxay qorsheynaysaa inay kordhiso soo saarista suufka iyo warshadaha dharka. Beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha waa inay iska diyaariyaan hawlaha soo socda.

English: Farmers in Kericho: The Principal Secretary of Agriculture visited the Tebesonik Tea Factory and Charera Water Project to address your concerns and promote sustainable development.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa Kericho: Katibu Mkuu wa Kilimo alitembelea Kiwanda cha Chai cha Tebesonik na Mradi wa Maji wa Charera ili kujadili matatizo yenu na kukuza maendeleo endelevu.
Ekegusii: Abaki bobi Kericho: Obwaki bw’Atuma bw’Endere buya buwaki omokiri w'Omogaka ya Tebesonik na Omokiri wa Charera buya bosi tookwa buse ugwaki naye buya mwaki buse kisibori naki.
Dholuo: Ng'ato mar farm Kericho: Principal Secretary ma Okayo lweny gika teb kaban gi Charera Water Project kuom chiegni ang'wen mag jokoe gi inyal pwodhi.
Somali: Farmerska Kericho: Xoghayaha Guud ee Beeraha ayaa booqday Warshadda Tee ee Tebesonik iyo Mashruuca Biyaha Charera si uu uga jawaabo welwelkiinna iyo inuu dhiirrigeliyo horumar joogto ah.

English: Farmers in Naivasha are advised to check the NCPB store for updates on the fertilizer subsidy distribution.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa Naivasha wanashauriwa kuangalia ghala la NCPB kwa taarifa za usambazaji wa ruzuku ya mbolea.
Ekegusii: Abarutani baki Naivasha bataragane naki oria obokire bisiogia buya bwaki buri NCPB buya bwaki obwatigiri bwokutirihanga.
Dholuo: Oding’gi ma ojogo e Naivasha konyo kuot NCPB store kuom uwacho maler e moko ma piny e vomo mar fertilizers.
Somali: Beeraleyda Naivasha waxaa lagu talinayaa inay hubsadaan dukaanka NCPB si ay u helaan warar ku saabsan qaybinta deeqda bacrinta.

English: The sugar sector is a vital economic pillar and source of livelihood for millions in western Kenya.
Kiswahili: Sekta ya sukari ni nguzo muhimu ya uchumi na chanzo cha maisha kwa mamilioni katika magharibi mwa Kenya.
Ekegusii: Sekta ya sukari ni nguzo muhimu ya uchumi na chanzo cha riziki kwa mamilioni magharibi mwa Kenya.
Dholuo: Seche magi ni tayo moko ma okinyi e piny, kendo ni nyingʼni duto mar buoya kuom wach mar mila e Kenya ma mangʼich.
Somali: Sektorada sonkorta waa tiir dhaqaale muhiim ah iyo isha nololeed ee malaayiin dadka ah galbeedka Kenya.

English: Farmers in Uasin Gishu are encouraged to participate in National Farmers' Day celebrations aimed at highlighting agricultural transformation.
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika Uasin Gishu wanahimizwa kushiriki katika maadhimisho ya Siku ya Wakulima wa Kitaifa yanayolenga kuonyesha mabadiliko katika kilimo.
Ekegusii: Abagere baki Uasin Gishu baria batarora omokigo bw'echiire bw'Abagere b'anga omogori buseke obwakuri bwakujonga buseke bori omogorori.
Dholuo: Obi-gi gima an gi Uasin Gishu wan giywono kanyakla to kod nyaka uting' ka iduogo madirgi mang'ongo mar winjruok.
Somali: Farmers-ka Uasin Gishu waxaa lagu boorinayaa in ay ka qayb galaan dabaaldegga Maalinta Beeralayda Qaranka si loo muujiyo isbeddelka beeraha.

English: The Narok and Bomet Counties Agripreneurs Model initiative is now available under NAVCDP. Interested agripreneurs should take note and participate starting December 18, 2024.
Kiswahili: Mradi wa Wajasiriamali wa Kilimo wa Kaunti za Narok na Bomet sasa upatikana chini ya NAVCDP. Wajasiriamali wa kilimo wanaovutiwa wanapaswa kuzingatia na kushiriki kuanzia tarehe 18 Desemba 2024.
Ekegusii: Omoibo ya Narok na Bomet ichakatigana naki agri-prenuers ku NAVCDP. Abakire agri-prenuers bwerere bonyaki na bosi ogeto ogi December 18, 2024.
Dholuo: Ng'ano mar Narok gi Bomet Counties Agri-entrepreneurs Model ohinga nyakuhisi malong' go NAVCDP. Agri-entrepreneurs ma en ne ng'eyo nilda ka olal ka gima timo madhigo otieno, ng'weny dhok e nyisecha 18, 2024.
Somali: Hannaanka Agripreneurs ee Gobolka Narok iyo Bomet ayaa hadda laga heli karaa NAVCDP. Agripreneurs-ka daneynaya waa in ay xusaan oo ay ka qeyb qaataan laga bilaabo Diseembar 18, 2024.

English: The 2025 Long Rains National Fertilizer Subsidy Programme is now launched; farmers are encouraged to apply for subsidies at NCPB GPC Depot, Nairobi.
Kiswahili: Mpango wa Msaada wa Mbolea wa Mvua ndefu wa Kitaifa wa mwaka 2025 umeanzishwa; wakulima wanahimizwa kuomba msaada katika Kituo cha NCPB GPC, Nairobi.
Ekegusii: Programu ya 2025 ya Misaada ya Mbolea ya Mvua Ndefu sasa imeanza; wakulima wanahimizwa kuomba misaada katika NCPB GPC Depot, Nairobi.
Dholuo: Dhiang' tich 2025 kaka nene weche mar Long Rains National Fertilizer Subsidy Programme oleyo; joge ong'eyo bende kanyakre gi subsidies e NCPB GPC Depot, Nairobi.
Somali: Barnaamijka Subsidy-ga Bacrinta Ciidda Gu'ga Dheer ee Qaranka ee 2025 ayaa la bilaabay; beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay dalbadaan deeqaha NCPB GPC Depot, Nairobi.

English: 1 million bags of subsidized fertilizers are now available for farmers. Please visit your local agricultural office to obtain your supply starting December 18, 2024.
Kiswahili: Mifuko milioni 1 ya mbolea iliyopunguzwa bei sasa inapatikana kwa wakulima. Tafadhali tembelea ofisi yako ya kilimo ya karibu ili kupata usambazaji wako kuanzia Desemba 18, 2024.
Ekegusii: Maki 1 milioni ekeria chichieri kyabere buya buya bwakirere ogende. Naki ogwaki omokirori buya bwaki ba choka Maki 18, 2024.
Dholuo: Piga 1 million kuom mkogoro duto wacho. Konyo ji thokye kuom oher gima to, ka ogend owuon e odhiambo nikech 18, Juma 2024.
Somali: 1 milyan oo bac ah oo bacriminta la taageeray ayaa hadda diyaar u ah beeralayda. Fadlan booqo xafiiskaaga reer gaareed si aad u hesho sahaydaada laga bilaabo 18-ka Diseembar 2024.

English: The Kimalel Goat Auction will take place on December 17, 2024, to support the livestock sector. Farmers are encouraged to participate.
Kiswahili: Mauctioni ya Mbuzi ya Kimalel itafanyika tarehe 17 Desemba 2024, kusaidia sekta ya mifugo. Wakulima wanahimizwa kushiriki.
Ekegusii: Ong'ogoti bw'Kimalel bwatabere na December 17, 2024, buya buya ochung'ere omogoti. Abarima bareke batigere omokanya.
Dholuo: Kimalel Goat Auction bende owinji kuom Disemba 17, 2024, kuom nyalo chuth mang'ich. Wuothi bende gikony gi weche.
Somali: Tartanka Ariga Kimalel wuxuu dhacayaa 17ka Diseembar, 2024, si loo taageero qaybta xoolaha. Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay ka qeybqaataan.

English: The National Agricultural Investment Plan is undergoing a review to align with global and national priorities. Stay informed for updates on how this may affect your agricultural activities.
Kiswahili: Mpango wa Kitaalamu wa Uwekezaji wa Kilimo unafanyiwa mapitio ili kuendana na vipaumbele vya kimataifa na kitaifa. Kuwa na habari za hivi punde kuhusu jinsi hii inaweza kuathiri shughuli zako za kilimo.
Ekegusii: Ekirobo cha boke boki buya bwogoreka ekieere buya buse nekhwaki bwaki ijiikire magoti egesia na boke. Naki buya bwagogorie buya bwakire oria ohia itabaki buya ogwari.
Dholuo: Plani mar Iting' Nyalani kanyakla to niyudo kach konyo gi piny ne piny. Koro uyie gi ng'eyo ma ok gima ineno modhiere kanyakla.
Somali: Qorshaha Maalgashiga Beeraha Qaranka ayaa la daawanayaa si loo waafajiyo mudnaanta caalamiga ah iyo tan qaranka. La soco wararka ku saabsan sida tani u saameyn karto hawlahaaga beeraha.

English: A groundbreaking ceremony for sustainable farming, education, and environmental restoration has been held in Murang'a. Farmers are encouraged to engage with local initiatives.
Kiswahili: Tukio la kuweka msingi wa kilimo endelevu, elimu, na urejeleaji wa mazingira limefanyika Murang'a. Wakulima wanahimizwa kushiriki katika miradi ya ndani.
Ekegusii: Ekegusii ekererangi ye soga yire, buya, naki enyorokire bwaki ibomire oria Murang'a. Abakire banoibsikire kuikire hamwe ne naki jia buya.
Dholuo: Kore mar yore gi chike ma okonyo farming, waduong’ and otieno mar piny nyaka abirir kwe Murang'a. Wuonruok mag farming nyaka wuoyi gi joma orefu.
Somali: Munaasibad dhismo ah oo ku saabsan beero waara, waxbarasho, iyo soo kabashada deegaanka ayaa ka dhacday Murang'a. Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay ka qaybqaataan mashaariicda deegaanka.

English: County leaders and stakeholders should prepare for upcoming discussions on agricultural advancement with the World Bank. Stay informed for details on participation opportunities.
Kiswahili: Viongozi wa kaunti na wadau wanapaswa kujiandaa kwa mjadala unaokuja kuhusu maendeleo ya kilimo na Benki ya Dunia. Endelea kuwa na taarifa kuhusu fursa za ushiriki.
Ekegusii: Abaki boti na abaki naki naki naki nyasa neza buya bware bwereksiri bwetabukire na World Bank. Naki kuria na mwaki buya buya bwetabukire.
Dholuo: Owino nyaka yore gi dhako manokelo kod wawer yonyo kanyalo kayie ka World Bank. Wachir gi yore e yo mar anyway kod gi ng'ato mar chalo.
Somali: Hoggaamiyeyaasha gobolka iyo danaynayaashu waa inay isu diyaariyaan wada-hadallo ku saabsan horumarinta beeraleyda oo la galayo Bangiga Adduunka. La soco faahfaahinta fursadaha ka qaybgalka.

English: Farmers and stakeholders are invited to engage in discussions on significant coffee reforms on December 6, 2024.
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wadau wanakaribishwa kushiriki katika majadiliano kuhusu mabadiliko makubwa ya kahawa tarehe 6 Desemba, 2024.
Ekegusii: Abagabi naki omokireri bategereje omokiri ogenda omokiri ekebinde buseme buseme ka buseme na December 6, 2024.
Dholuo: Anyang' gi akinyi bang' kendo nyathini mago ka jodak ne ohinga kendo igweno kende eseru ok wiri, 6 juma, 2024.
Somali: Farmers iyo daneeyayaal waxaa lagu casuumay inay ka qayb qaataan doodaha ku saabsan isbeddelada muhiimka ah ee bunka 6-deeda Diseembar, 2024.

English: Farmers are urged to remain vigilant and report any sightings of migratory pests or desert locusts to local agricultural authorities immediately.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahamasishwa kubaki makini na kuripoti mtu yeyote atakayekutana na wadudu wahamaji au nzige wa jangwani kwa mamlaka za kilimo za eneo mara moja.
Ekegusii: Abagere bano batarire nogusomeka buya, naki naki batarire okogotiga obokiri bwomogori bosi bu masiga bu aremo kioi omogori.
Dholuo: Dhi buo mar farmers konyo chike ma nyalo iweyo kendo nitie choro yore miyo piny gi dhako mar okonyo to agok ng'ato kata lwendi ni gati misango mar buor maber.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay feejigeen oo ay si degdeg ah ugu warbixiyaan aragtiyada cayayaanka guur-guura ama cawska lamadegaanka madaxda ugu sarreeya ee deegaanka.

English: The Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development has launched the Farmer Registration Report 2023. Farmers are encouraged to access the report for vital information.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo imezindua Ripoti ya Usajili wa Wakulima ya mwaka 2023. Wakulima wanahimiziwa kufikia ripoti hiyo kwa taarifa muhimu.
Ekegusii: Ekiabera chakaranga naki nyamacheke omokiri ogenda omokinyere 2023. Abakiri bariga nyamacheke kwendachere obwaki bwaki.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development omiye Farmer Registration Report 2023. Okwach gi wach kuom kanyo mag report manejo buo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha ayaa soo bandhigtay Warbixinta Diiwaangelinta Beeraleyda 2023. Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay helaan warbixinta si ay u helaan macluumaad muhiim ah.

English: No actionable information for farmers or agribusiness stakeholders is present in this article.
Kiswahili: Makala hii haina taarifa yoyote inayoweza kutekelezwa kwa wakulima au wahusika wa biashara ya kilimo.
Ekegusii: Abagisii na abashokire bikwakire omogaka, obwakire buya bwaki bwere nyasa buya.
Dholuo: Kakaber ni cham kod mar kanyruok e gima ng'ato oter e piny.
Somali: Maqaalkani ma zawarayo macluumaad waxqabad ah oo ku saabsan beeralayda ama daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beeraha.

English: Kenyan farmers are encouraged to engage in partnerships that strengthen the agricultural sector. For details, contact your local agricultural office.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa Kenya wanahimizwa kujiunga katika ushirikiano unaoimarisha sekta ya kilimo. Kwa maelezo zaidi, wasiliana na ofisi yako ya kilimo ya eneo.
Ekegusii: Abagiri b'aki Kenya barakirwa kweng'ana mu masonga abatekerete ageng'ene emihoya. Kogotwomokire, naki mwakire omokiriganya bwaki b'amasonga bwaki.
Dholuo: Abagik kanyalo kuom joma oseremo nyaka nyaloch gi joma opear gi konyruok mar boset. Kwach nyasaye ka oduogo higa, nangi e nyaka ma ok nyal.
Somali: Farmers-ka Kenya waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay la shuraakoodaan si ay u xoojiyaan beeraleyda. Faahfaahin, la xiriir xafiiskaaga beeraha ee deegaanka.

English: Youth interested in agribusiness can participate in the TEJATI initiative aimed at transforming agricultural ecosystems through technology and innovation. Sign up by November 29, 2024.
Kiswahili: Vijana wanaovutiwa na biashara ya kilimo wanaweza kushiriki katika mpango wa TEJATI unaolenga kubadilisha mifumo ya kilimo kupitia teknolojia na uvumbuzi. Jiandikishe kabla ya Novemba 29, 2024.
Ekegusii: Abagere abane mAsa na agribusiness bataria kukiragiane mu TEJATI initiative ikorera ku buya bw’obushonga obw’osi bwiomoka mu buya bw’akaranga. Naki omokire buya buya hatari Oktoba 29, 2024.
Dholuo: Nyang'udzo gi agribusiness n'en ginyalo pako kuom TEJATI, mokwongo kanyakla chiegni min niego ma itimo e tiego mag joma. Sawa chuth gi November 29, 2024.
Somali: Dhallinyarada xiisaynaysa ganacsiga beeraha waxay ka qeyb qaadan karaan mashruuca TEJATI oo loogu talagalay in lagu beddelo nidaamka beeraleyda iyada oo la adeegsanayo tiknoolojiyad iyo hal-abuur. Isdiiwaangeli ka hor 29-ka Novembar 2024.

English: Caritas Nairobi has unveiled its Strategic Plan for 2024 to enhance agricultural empowerment. Stakeholders in agriculture are encouraged to engage with this initiative.
Kiswahili: Caritas Nairobi imezindua Mpango wake wa Kistratejia wa mwaka 2024 wa kuimarisha uwezo wa kilimo. Wadau katika kilimo wanahimizwa kushiriki katika mpango huu.
Ekegusii: Caritas Nairobi omokere buya buya bwakirori bwokiraki bwa 2024 kugira ngo bwerere omogoti. Abakire ba buya bwakirori baragwirane kugana ini.
Dholuo: Caritas Nairobi abed gi chalo mar 2024 mokuongo ndalo duto kuom ng'ato mar dak. Okwongo gi pinyruok kanyim piny oseyudo ma ok nyal jiedi kuom chalo manjeno.
Somali: Caritas Nairobi waxay soo bandhigtay Qorshaha Istiraatiijiga ah ee 2024 si kor loogu qaado awoodsiinta beeralayda. Xubnaha ka shaqeeya beerta waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay ka qaybqaataan hindisahan.

English: The Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development has launched the National Agroecology Strategy for Food Systems Transformation. All stakeholders are encouraged to familiarize themselves with the strategy.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo imezindua Mkakati wa Kitaifa wa Agroekolojia kwa ajili ya Mabadiliko ya Mfumo wa Chakula. Wadau wote wanahimizwa kujifunza kuhusu mkakati huu.
Ekegusii: Obwaki bw’Engorane na Kuorere Bwaki bw’Emokore bwatombokire Bwakuborere bw’Etenge Bwakuborere. Abakire b’isi nyang’ori bae kwenying'ana na bwaki bu.
Dholuo: Wang'ni wa Ugenya Kodhi e Dholuo nochuno National Agroecology Strategy mar Ndalo kendo Kondo mar Kachieng'. Nyarwa ni dhokeyo mokwongo ma en yieng' ka bende wadhore kalo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha ayaa soo bandhigtay Istaraatiijiyadda Qaranka ee Agroecology si loo beddelo Nidaamka Cuntada. Dhamaan kuwa ka qayb qaadanaya waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay isbarbar dhigaan istaraatiijiyadda.

English: Farmers are urged to access certified and quality seeds to revitalize the agriculture sector. Check with local agricultural offices for availability and support.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanashawishiwa kupata mbegu zilizosajiliwa na za ubora ili kuhuisha sekta ya kilimo. Angalia ofisi za kilimo za eneo lako kwa upatikanaji na msaada.
Ekegusii: Abagikere bano baki, babwatani baria biaje bwa mbega ebwa naki naki buya kwatokera ekikura. Naki buya bware bwakire buya bware bwagikere bano bwakire!
Dholuo: Waduong’ to owuok kanyakla kuom seed ma twak kendo mego gi chalo. Chieng' e yo maber mar abok ma waduong' timo.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay helaan abuur tayo leh oo la xaqiijiyey si ay dib ugu furaan beeraha. La xiriir xafiisyada beeraha ee deegaanka si aad u hubiso helitaanka iyo taageero.

English: Farmers are encouraged to take advantage of subsidized fertilizer and high-quality seeds to boost production.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahimizwa kuchangamkia mbolea iliyorahisishwa na mbegu za hali ya juu ili kuongeza uzalishaji.
Ekegusii: Abakire bakorere onyonka oborwe bwokwikore okoyabaki busibozole bwabiri na ebiswaki bwaki naki kosiire omoshonchori.
Dholuo: Bangi e yo ng'weyo ma otond dik kanyakore mag fertilizer oyiero gi ng'ere ma oting' nindo miyo okelo kita.
Somali: Beerayaasha waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay ka faa'idaystaan bacriminta la socota hoos u dhaca qiimaha iyo abuur tayo sare leh si ay u kordhiyaan wax soo saarkooda.

English: The Kenya Agricultural Management Information System (KIAMIS) is being scaled up for a digitized and transparent agricultural sector. Stay informed on updates and usage.
Kiswahili: Mfumo wa Habari wa Usimamizi wa Kilimo Kenya (KIAMIS) unapanuliwa kwa sekta ya kilimo yenye dijitali na uwazi. Endelea kupata taarifa kuhusu masasisho na matumizi.
Ekegusii: Sistemia Ekitambu ya Makiere (KIAMIS) inarengwa kwa ajili ya sekta ya ekibare ebyegorori uye ebikorebwa. Tiga nibwaki bwokere busekeri naki.
Dholuo: Kenya Agricultural Management Information System (KIAMIS) en gitimre kwa wendo mar dhok mar kaide kod wach kanyaluo. Chiwruok kuom mabor gi nyalo.
Somali: Nidaamka Maareynta Macluumaadka Beeraha ee Kenya (KIAMIS) ayaa lagu ballaarinayaa inuu noqdo mid dijital ah oo hufan. La soco wararka iyo isticmaalka.

English: The Chemelil Sugar Strategic Plan 2023-2027 has been launched to transform the sugar industry. Stakeholders should review the plan for future opportunities and participation.
Kiswahili: Mpango Mkakati wa Tumbaku wa Chemelil 2023-2027 umenezwa ili kubadili sekta ya sukari. Wadau wanapaswa kukagua mpango huu kwa ajili ya fursa na ushiriki wa siku zijazo.
Ekegusii: Ekiroire buya bwa Chemelil Sugar 2023-2027 kirebu bwakinyabwa bwakiere buya bwakansungonere. Abatireri kianagane bwere kumakinyora buya buiki bikogorere na kugendera.
Dholuo: Chemelil Sugar Strategic Plan 2023-2027 en ka tindo nyalo chuth kanyakla. Odhiechieng’ ok nyal olal plan no chido kianyore kendo chike.
Somali: Qorshaha Istiraatiijiga Sonkorta Chemelil 2023-2027 ayaa la bilaabay si loo beddelo warshadaha sonkorta. Xuquuqda lahae yaashu waa inay dib u eegaan qorshaha si ay fursado mustaqbalka iyo ka qaybqaadasho u helaan.

English: The government is supporting the sugar sector transformation to enhance value addition and increase production. Stakeholders are encouraged to engage in these initiatives.
Kiswahili: Serikali inasaidia mabadiliko ya sekta ya sukari ili kuongeza thamani na kuongeza uzalishaji. Wadau wanahimizwa kushiriki katika mipango hii.
Ekegusii: Omosarato oria ogokire omotere buya bwaki abantugari bialama omokogoti bwaki omotendeti bwakwendo. Abakire baisireri bosi nyanagire mu nyanage ino.
Dholuo: Uradi wacho ni government iyudo nyaka yudi sugar sector ng'eyo to yore piny kanyim dawo kanyakla. Lwakni e yo ng'ato nyaka kanyo tuo kinyon.
Somali: Dowladda waxay taageertaa isbeddelka qaybta sonkorta si loo kordhiyo qiimaha iyo wax soo saarka. Dhamaan daneeyayaasha waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay ka qayb qaataan hawlahan.

English: The government is enhancing support for the tea sector by focusing on value addition and quality production. Farmers are encouraged to adopt these practices for better profitability.
Kiswahili: Serikali inaongeza msaada kwa sekta ya chai kwa kuzingatia kuongeza thamani na uzalishaji wa ubora. Wakulima wanahimizwa kupokea taratibu hizi ili kupata faida bora.
Ekegusii: Abakinyegeri bageka bwaki bwokigenia obwakiroro buya bwong'era era buya bwong'era obwakirori. Ababere babwakirie bukera obwakirori bwabokinya bwori bushuru.
Dholuo: Waxareni omoka gi ndong' ng'ato mar tea jomoko e piny marayo ojiro kelo duto gi chunyi ma g'yieng'. Asembe odhi nyiso ndalo timo jia ma odhi bedo bende gi chako gima wacho.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay xoojineysaa taagerada sector-ka shaaha iyada oo diiradda la saarayo kordhinta qiimaha iyo soo saarista tayada leh. Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa in ay qaataan hababkan si ay u helaan faa’iido wanaagsan.

English: The Avocado Society of Kenya is working with the government to address industry challenges; all avocado farmers are encouraged to engage for support and solutions.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Avocado cha Kenya kinafanya kazi na serikali kuleta suluhisho kwa changamoto za sekta; wakulima wote wa avokado wanahimizwa kujihusisha kwa msaada na suluhisho.
Ekegusii: Abakire b'Obwakire bwa Avocado ya Kenya babanye na gisiiriri kujakana kunsango za buse. Abakire b'Avocado boni bategerejere bategana kube koroma naki nyamaki.
Dholuo: Avocado Society of Kenya ne okel manyien kuom government nyaka otiek ng'anyo mar aboro; dhakar machalabi duto nosewe kanyakla kata ng'ama wacho.
Somali: Ururka Avocado ee Kenya wuxuu la shaqeynayaa dowladda si loo xalliyo caqabadaha warshadaha; dhammaan beeraleyda avokado waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay ka qaybqaataan si ay u helaan taageero iyo xalal.

English: No actionable content available.
Kiswahili: Hakuna maudhui yanayoweza kutekelezwa.
Ekegusii: Amakire gota ogenda!
Dholuo: Mokinyi dede.
Somali: Ma jiraan macluumaad waxqabad ah oo la heli karo.

English: The EU and Kenya are collaborating to enhance sustainable agriculture driven by youth. Stay tuned for upcoming programs and opportunities to engage in this initiative.
Kiswahili: EU na Kenya wanashirikiana kuboresha kilimo endelevu kinachof driven na vijana. Fuata habari za mipango na fursa za kujihusisha na juhudi hii.
Ekegusii: EU na Kenya bagia naki omogori bw'ekirori bw'ogusubira bwakabonyi. Naki oria ekeresi bw'ekigana no bw'ong'ere bw'ogekere.
Dholuo: EU ne Kenya ng'iyo timo en gi mondo ng'ato mar konyo chiyieri mage. Nying' ni ng'ato ma ok nyal gichano ka gikere kendo gima gichayo.
Somali: EU iyo Kenya waxay iskaashanayaan si loo xoojiyo beeraha waara ee ay hogaaminayaan dhalinyarada. La soco barnaamijyada iyo fursadaha soo socda si aad uga qayb qaadato dadaalkan.

English: The 12th STAK Congress has opened, focusing on the seed industry's vital role in Kenya's food security. Stakeholders in agriculture are encouraged to participate and engage in discussions.
Kiswahili: Kongamano la 12 la STAK limefunguliwa, likilenga jukumu muhimu la sekta ya mbegu katika usalama wa chakula nchini Kenya. Washiriki katika kilimo wanahimizwa kushiriki na kujadili.
Ekegusii: Kongasi ya 12 ya STAK yakiangania, ikyogania bwire bweng'ende ya mbegu mu oborere bwakabere mu Kenya. Ogotang'ania obosi bwa oborere baria nakiibori bopusikire na babirire buja.
Dholuo: Congress 12 e STAK ogend, ng'weny nyiso ka joma ni jodiere nyaka nyiso piny mar dho'tonu mang'eny e Kenya. Joma jochopo e dho'k awacho ka omako kendo ongo ni bende piny.
Somali: Shirka 12aad ee STAK ayaa furmay, waxaana diiradda la saarayaa doorka muhiimka ah ee warshadaha abuurka ee amniga cuntada Soomaaliya. Dan-yayaasha ka shaqeeya beeraha waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay ka qaybqaataan oo ay ka qeyb galaan doodaha.

English: The Sugar Bill has been signed to revitalize Kenya's sugar industry; farmers and stakeholders should stay informed on upcoming regulations and opportunities.
Kiswahili: Muswada wa Sukari umesainiwa ili kuhuisha sekta ya sukari nchini Kenya; wakulima na wadau wanapaswa kubaki na habari kuhusu kanuni na fursa zinazokuja.
Ekegusii: Ekechori ya Sukari emahoya omokireri buya buya ogokire buya kisukari ki Kenya; akorera na abaki bano ogerere bakore bakenye oroginyani na emarereno.
Dholuo: Shuga Bill oigi e yo kuom gima e chiegni shuga Kenya; wuon nodhiang' gi dhok mar yieng' to chunyruok e wiru gi jopo mar cham.
Somali: Sharciga sonkorta waxaa la saxiixay si loo soo nooleeyo warshadaha sonkorta Kenya; beeralayda iyo daneeyayaasha waa inay la socdaan xeerarka iyo fursadaha soo socda.

English: The government is advancing the dairy industry transformation under the BETA Plan. Milk processors are urged to align with the strategic goals outlined.
Kiswahili: Serikali inaendeleza mabadiliko ya sekta ya maziwa kwa mpango wa BETA. Washughulikia maziwa wanahimizwa kuafikiana na malengo ya kimkakati yaliyoelezwa.
Ekegusii: Abaneri bataraki bw'ebiruga bu gona omogogoro mw'ekinyango BETA. Abakora emilomo bakenye batoro banyo bw'ibwirane by'ekinyang'ani.
Dholuo: Moko mar gof والج lehibe mia yiero manok e BETA Plan. Kachadi mag milk bende giwe tich mar tich miyo ne.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay horumarineysaa isbeddelka warshadaha caanaha iyadoo la adeegsanayo Qorshaha BETA. Qandaraaslayaashu waxay ku boorinayaan inay la jaanqaadaan himilooyinka istiraatiijiyadeed ee la tilmaamay.

English: The Intergovernmental Agriculture Forum is convening to drive strategic resolutions for agricultural sector transformation. Stakeholders are encouraged to participate and contribute.
Kiswahili: Mkutano wa Mkutano wa Kilimo wa Serikali za Mitaa unafanyika ili kuleta maazimio ya kimkakati kwa mabadiliko ya sekta ya kilimo. Wadhamini wanahimizwa kushiriki na kuchangia.
Ekegusii: Forum ya Intergovernmental Agriculture inachoreri kukwete emokire bw'ekirama bw'ogotore osibori omokiri. Abanakireri babere omokire na batarire.
Dholuo: Intergovernmental Agriculture Forum enwang' to gin lemo mar nyiso e yore mag ohinga mar agri. Kanyakore duto ochung' gi weche kod kony.
Somali: Shirwayga Dowladaha iyo Beeraleyda ayaa la qabanayaa si loo hagaajiyo go'aanada istiraatiijiga ah ee isbadalka beeraha. Dhamaan daneeyayaasha waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay ka qeybqaataan oo ay wax ku biiriyaan.

English: National and County Governments are enhancing collaboration for food security and agricultural growth. Stay informed on upcoming initiatives and support available for your farming activities.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Taifa na Mikoa zinaongeza ushirikiano kwa ajili ya usalama wa chakula na ukuaji wa kilimo. Kuwa na ufahamu kuhusu mipango inayokuja na msaada unaopatikana kwa shughuli zako za kilimo.
Ekegusii: Abaganga b'ekaranga bwa Roko ne County bano nyaki nyansia omorima na ebushori. Kiongere buya buromaki nabwakinyai bwerejere buya bujogoti bwaki bwi omogorori.
Dholuo: Keny lori kendo ni lweny ma gweng' mag oketo mar joma okel mar jachien kendo chiwalo. Tidi ni, dwond gi piny ma ok wand joma lokonyo kendo gi dwondiyo ma ng'eyo.
Somali: Dowladaha Qaranka iyo Gobolka waxay kor u qaadayaan wada shaqeyn ku aaddan amniga cuntada iyo koritaanka beeraha. La soco tallaabooyinka cusub iyo taageerada la heli karo ee hawlahaaga beereed.

English: Farmers are advised to stay updated on the Fertilizer Subsidy Program and Food Security Preparedness Plan. Further details will be provided soon.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanashauriwa kubaki na taarifa kuhusu Mpango wa Msaada wa Mbolea na Mpango wa Kujiandaa kwa Usalama wa Chakula. Maelezo zaidi yatasambazwa hivi karibuni.
Ekegusii: Abakere baori nyasa egere omokireri Bwaki bwa Boriga na Oria bwaki bwokemere. Abakoru ba chire buya buokire.
Dholuo: Ng'ato maruok adhi nyaka gitim komado gi Fertilizer Subsidy Program kod Food Security Preparedness Plan. Wanyalo yudo nind gi ng'ama oting'o.
Somali: Farmers waxaa lagu talinayaa inay la socoto Barnaamijka Kaalmada Bacriminta iyo Qorshaha Diyaarinta Amaanka Cuntada. Faahfaahin dheeri ah waxaa la bixin doonaa goor dhow.

English: Kenyan farmers are encouraged to engage with the Kenya-Denmark partnership to improve food safety and agricultural development.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa Kenya wanahimizwa kushirikiana na ushirikiano wa Kenya-Denmark kuboresha usalama wa chakula na maendeleo ya kilimo.
Ekegusii: Abagikibo b’Kenya barakirwa kugana na ubianano bw’Kenya na Denmark kwa ajili ya kubwisha emokirigori na obwakire bw’ oboragori.
Dholuo: Kanyanya mar Kenya an mondo nigi chieng' kuom Kenya-Denmark partnership mondo obed gi tich mar piny ne gi sawi nyaka kanyakla.
Somali: Farmers-ka Kenya waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay ka qayb qaataan iskaashiga Kenya-Denmark si loo hagaajiyo amniga cuntada iyo horumarinta beeraha.

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders are encouraged to utilize extension services to enhance agricultural transformation.
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo wanahimizwa kutumia huduma za ugani ili kuboresha mabadiliko ya kilimo.
Ekegusii: Abagaboi naki abakiibori ba emunyaki batorera aibori nyakibori bwebwaki bu emisbane.
Dholuo: Jok ma thok and agribusiness nyasaye nyal timo e kinde ka owinyo e yo mwandu duto maber.
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo saamileyaasha agribusiness-ka waxaa la dhiirigelinayaa inay ka faa'iidaystaan adeegyada kordhinta si ay u horumariyaan beddelka beeraha.

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders are encouraged to explore new export opportunities as CS Dr. Andrew Karanja meets with AMCHAM Kenya to enhance U.S.-Kenya agricultural collaboration.
Kiswahili: Wakulima na washikadau wa kilimo wanahimizwa kuchunguza fursa mpya za uuzaji nje wakati Waziri Dr. Andrew Karanja akikutana na AMCHAM Kenya ili kuimarisha ushirikiano wa kilimo kati ya Marekani na Kenya.
Ekegusii: Abakora mirongo na abashikire shombo bayokonje gutegana naki vyokurema bisaraki, nyabwa CS Dr. Andrew Karanja agachora hamwe na AMCHAM Kenya kugira bakirize ubunyankore bw'ubworozi pakati pa U.S. na Kenya.
Dholuo: Bonde e kelo kuom wuoth moro mar eksport katare, ma CS Dr. Andrew Karanja otere ni AMCHAM Kenya nokel wadh! ang'wen joni gi U.S.-Kenya matimre mag buoi.
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beera ayaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa in ay baaraan fursadaha cusub ee dhoofinta maadaama CS Dr. Andrew Karanja uu la kulmayo AMCHAM Kenya si loo xoojiyo wada-shaqeynta beeraha ee U.S. iyo Kenya.

English: Farmers in Isiolo and Meru Counties are invited to participate in the Kenya Vision 2030 4th Medium Term Plan (MTP IV) dissemination Baraza on June 3, 2024.
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika Kaunti za Isiolo na Meru wanakaribishwa kushiriki katika Baraza la kueneza Mpango wa Kati wa Kenya 2030 (MTP IV) tarehe 3 Juni 2024.
Ekegusii: Abashande baki Isiolo na Meru batakire omogenda kosiya Kenya Vision 2030 4th Medium Term Plan (MTP IV) buraza omokinyanjo June 3, 2024.
Dholuo: Ong'anyo mondo ubiro kanyasa kanyieng' ndalo 4th Medium Term Plan (MTP IV) ku Kenya Vision 2030 nyaka 3/6/2024 e Isiolo kod Meru Counties.
Somali: Farmers ka tirsan degmooyinka Isiolo iyo Meru waxaa lagu casuumay inay ka qaybqaataan Baraza faafinta Qorshaha Dhexe ee 4aad (MTP IV) ee Kenya Vision 2030 oo noqon doonta 3da Juun, 2024.

English: Farmers are urged to prioritize soil health to improve agricultural productivity.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahimizwa kuweka kipaumbele kwenye afya ya udongo ili kuboresha uzalishaji wa kilimo.
Ekegusii: Abakiru baragwanire okwishisha obwakiri bw’akiwaki buya bwanaki bw’ogenda.
Dholuo: Chieng' ma ji gi to joma oheru kuom rangi yathu to golo chwe mag joma chweyo.
Somali: Beeralayda waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay mudnaanta siiyaan caafimaadka ciidda si kor loogu qaado waxsoosaarka beeraha.

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders are encouraged to engage with the Agri-Preneurs Extension Model as discussed in the recent consultative workshop.
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo wanahimizwa kushirikiana na Mfano wa Upanuzi wa Agri-Preneurs kama ilivyojadiliwa katika semina ya ushirikiano hivi karibuni.
Ekegusii: Abakera n'ashamba n'ashamabari baretagwa boro bwete nigo oria boki n'Adama-Preneurs Extension Model, gucokire omokiri naki oria bori obamongana.
Dholuo: Ng'ato machogi gi oganda mar agri-penuroi no nyal gung' nyaka en chayo kendo bich gi nede mar waku, ka ginyalo wacho e ng'ato mar seche.
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beera waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay ka qeybqaataan Qaabka Faafinta Agri-Preneurs sida looga hadlay aqoon-is-weydaarsigii dhawaan la qabtay.

English: The Kenyan Fertilizer and Soil Health delegates forum is taking place at KALRO, Nairobi, on April 24, 2024. Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders are encouraged to attend.
Kiswahili: Kikao cha wawakilishi wa Mbolea na Afya ya Ardhi ya Kenya kinafanyika KALRO, Nairobi, tarehe 24 Aprili 2024. Wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo wanahimizwa kuhudhuria.
Ekegusii: Abasomi b’ekibari na omotagari bwaki ne bwegwaki bw’omuema bw’ekononi na obwakirenda boka bwenyemera kabe KALRO, Nairobi, naki Abatano 24, 2024. Abakokire n’abashandi b’omokisii bamenyere gukwenda.
Dholuo: Wang'ongo ma oganda gi banga kuon gi Soil Health e KALRO, Nairobi, kuom aprilu 24, 2024. Abor ni chiegni mag ng'ato konyo gi piny.
Somali: Kulanka wakiillada Bacriminta iyo Caafimaadka Dhulka ee Kenya wuxuu ka dhacaya KALRO, Nairobi, 24ka April 2024. Beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beerta waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay ka soo qeyb galaan.

English: Fertilizer e-vouchers for the Long Rain Season are now being distributed. Farmers are encouraged to collect their vouchers promptly to ensure timely access to fertilizers.
Kiswahili: Vikaratasi vya e-vyuketi vya mbolea kwa Msimu wa Mvua Ndefu sasa vinatolewa. Wakulima wanah encouraged kuchukua vikaratasi vyao haraka ili kuhakikisha upatikanaji wa mbolea kwa wakati.
Ekegusii: E-voucher za mbolea za msimu wa mvua mrefu zinaagizwa sasa. Wakulima wanashauriwa kuchukua voucheri zao haraka ili wapate mbolea kwa wakati.
Dholuo: E-vouchers ma fertilizer nangenyi e mwakano ma Long Rain nyaka gwal. Jodong' ne ng'iyo nani kuom chalo e voucherna chuth kata neok gi fertilizer tich.
Somali: E-vaucherada bacriminta ee Xilliga Roobaadka Dheer ayaa hadda la qaybinaayaa. Beeralayda waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay si degdeg ah u soo qaataan vaucheradooda si ay u helaan bacriminta waqtigeeda.

English: The Government has launched the Safe Milk Kenya Campaign to boost growth and competitiveness in the dairy sector. Farmers are encouraged to participate for improved standards.
Kiswahili: Serikali imeanzisha Kampeni ya Maziwa Salama Kenya ili kukuza ukuaji na ushindani katika sekta ya maziwa. Wakulima wanahimizwa kushiriki ili kuboresha viwango.
Ekegusii: Ogorogori bw'akiire bosi bw'ekegena buya bounyorera bwiire buya Mwaki rogo na boke bw'ogenda na mimerere yonka. Abagikono barigo banyorere nyanya bubaka bw'ekegena.
Dholuo: Wuodho mar Giwekno oromo Safe Milk Kenya ka okel duto gi mbaka kendo to kelo chido mar dhogi. Banj koro ginyalo ma oket koro mago.
Somali: Dowladda ayaa bilaabay Ololaha Caanaha Badbaado Kenya si kor loogu qaado kobaca iyo tartanka qeybta caanaha. Beeraleyda ayaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay ka qayb qaataan si loo hagaajiyo heerarka.

English: Hungary has established a demo farm in Kirinyaga County to showcase Hungarian agricultural technology. Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders are encouraged to visit and learn.
Kiswahili: Hungaria imeanzisha shamba la maonyesho katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga kuonyesha teknolojia ya kilimo ya Kihungari. Wakulima na washikadau wa biashara ya kilimo wanahimizwa kutembelea na kujifunza.
Ekegusii: Hungary iabere oria buya na Kirinyaga County buya buya bwaki bwaki bwaki bwaki bwaki bwaki. Abakere na abashanzirieri bamakere bakanigana na bakanoga.
Dholuo: Hungary a gikonyo demo farm e Kirinyaga County kuom nyIso ma Hungarian. Abor gi k'opwoyo ochako ni omiyo owuor kendo wacho!
Somali: Hungary waxay sameysay beero tijaabo ah oo ku yaal Gobolka Kirinyaga si ay u muujiso teknolojiyadda beeraha ee Hungary. Beeralayda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beeraha waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay booqdaan oo wax bartaan.

English: Farmers in Meru County can now access a new mobile grain dryer, receive sunflower seeds, and utilize the newly inaugurated aflatoxin testing lab for enhanced agricultural support.
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika Kaunti ya Meru sasa wanaweza kupata kiyoyozi kipya cha nafaka cha simu, kupokea mbegu za alizeti, na kutumia maabara mpya ya kupima aflatoksini kwa ajili ya msaada bora wa kilimo.
Ekegusii: Abakire bu Meru bashobora kugana ikibaragabaga gishasha gikoreshwa mu kutonora ibihingwa, kwakira imbuto za sunflawa, no gukoresha labo y'ubuheruka gushingwa igamije gusuzuma aflatoxini mu gufasha mu buhinzi.
Dholuo: Mokinyi ku Meru County nigi chako mobile grain dryer nyaka, nigi tekedhi sunflower seeds, to nochako aflatoxin testing lab nyaka ka ongeyo goyo mar ugoyo.
Somali: Farmers-ka ku sugan Meru County hadda waxay heli karaan qalab cusub oo lipi ah, waxayna qaadan karaan abuur sunflower, sidoo kale waxay ka faa'iidaysan karaan laboratory cusub oo baarista aflatoxin si kor loogu qaado taageerada beeraha.

English: The government is providing solar mobile grain dryers and subsidized fertilizer to enhance agriculture and food security. Farmers are encouraged to take advantage of these resources.
Kiswahili: Serikali inatoa dryers za nafaka za jua za kubebeka na mbolea yenye ruzuku ili kuboresha kilimo na usalama wa chakula. Wakulima wanasisitizwa kuitumia manufaa haya.
Ekegusii: Abaki baki oria omogore bweka amani motigori ekirinagire omogori nabaki bakebaki omokirori omokiri mosi. Abaki basibori oria shibabere omokiri piri.
Dholuo: Government ikwongo joma nyaka gusa ma-enyore, kendo ng'wono timbe johanyalo maok joki ji dhoru kendo dwondwaro. Joma nyaka jatich kuom ywenjore ni piny.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay bixisay qalab qorrax ka shaqeeya oo loogu talagalay qallajinta diridka, iyo bacriminta qiimo dhimman si kor loogu qaado beeraha iyo amniga cuntada. Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay ka faa'iidaystaan kheyraadkan.

English: A duty waiver for sugar, rice, and maize imports is under consideration. Affected stakeholders should monitor updates for further information and requirements.
Kiswahili: Msamaha wa ushuru kwa uagizaji wa sukari, mchele, na mahindi unachunguzwa. Wahusika wanapaswa kufuatilia taarifa za maungano na mahitaji zaidi.
Ekegusii: Omocha omokiriganie oria buya, ugali, naki omokiriganie okorori. Ababere bakiore bwiende bakesi omokanganya obwaki naki abwakirwe.
Dholuo: Kagundu mago kuom gi sugar, udi, mondo gi ng'wono ok oser. Joma oket to konyo nengo mane owinjore kod higa.
Somali: Dhaqqaajinta duty-ga macaamilka sonkorta, bariiska, iyo masagada waxaa la fiirinayaa. Xisbiyada ay dhibaatayso waa inay la socdaan wararka cusub iyo shuruudaha.

English: The Murang'a County government has launched a pilot digital system for the distribution of agricultural inputs. Farmers in the area are encouraged to participate.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Kaunti ya Murang'a imezindua mfumo wa kidijitali wa majaribio wa usambazaji wa vifaa vya kilimo. Wakulima katika eneo hilo wanahimizwa kushiriki.
Ekegusii: Omoige wa Murang'a wakiagurire system ya dijitali ya gukorire ekibori kiabere. Abakiri bakiireri batariri baate nyore bahi.
Dholuo: Gavana wa Murang'a County en gima mar pilota kuom nyisore mag digital kuom joma chiegni gi agolo. Jodongo mar eneo okind ogend gi law.
Somali: Dawladda degmada Murang'a waxay hirgelisay nidaam dijitaal ah oo tijaabo ah oo loogu talagalay qaybinta agabka beeraha. Beeralayda deegaanka ayaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay ka qaybqaataan.

English: Bungoma County is enhancing its agricultural sector; farmers are encouraged to participate in new initiatives for improved farming practices.
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Bungoma inaimarisha sekta yake ya kilimo; wakulima wanahimizwa kushiriki katika mipango mipya ya kuboresha mbinu za kilimo.
Ekegusii: Ekitutu ya Bungoma ikorenda kukwenda ogotigori; aboragani baragani bwaki bwaki bworenda okibwakirere mu ng'ato nyaki bwaki bwaki bworenda.
Dholuo: Bungoma County en obedo gi tich mar wach wuon; jarae duto en kawuono kuom konyo ng'ato gi tich maler.
Somali: Bungoma ayaa kor u qaadeysa qeybta beeraha; beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay ka qayb qaataan hindisayaasha cusub ee lagu hagaajinayo dhaqamada beeraleyda.

English: Young entrepreneurs in agriculture are facing barriers beyond just access to finance. Stakeholders are urged to provide targeted investment and support to help youth-led agribusinesses thrive.
Kiswahili: Wajasiriamali vijana katika kilimo wanakabiliwa na vikwazo zaidi ya upatikanaji wa fedha. Washiriki wanahimizwa kutoa uwekezaji na msaada wa malengo ili kusaidia biashara za kilimo zinazoongozwa na vijana kufanikiwa.
Ekegusii: Abari buya buya mwaki bosi bakananagwa omokiriri okogotire otagire buya. Abatendi bakenanga batarurane omokiriri bw’abe ne abaki sigana matega ogotire amakiri abaki bw’erekana.
Dholuo: Gi-yong’ ma itegno e bungu duto nyaka ng’ato obedo karuok ka nyiso duto kumira kuom pinje. Wuoyo e nigi wuoyo maler kuom gima nyaka yo gino dhok joma duto e bungu ma ok ni giwuok.
Somali: Dhalinyarada ganacsatada waxay la kulmayaan caqabado ka badan helitaanka maalgelin. Qaybaha kala duwan ayaa lagu boorinayaa inay bixiyaan maalgelin iyo taageero lagu gaarsiinayo ganacsiyada dhirta ee ay hoggaaminayaan dhalinyarada inay horumaraan.

English: Attention young farmers: Explore opportunities in coffee value addition and learn about processing methods and by-products. Engage with local coffee estates for hands-on experience today.
Kiswahili: Kumbuka wakulima vijana: Chunguza fursa katika kuongeza thamani ya kahawa na ujifunze kuhusu mbinu za usindikaji na bidhaa zinazotokana na kahawa. Shirikiana na mashamba ya kahawa ya eneo lako kwa uzoefu wa vitendo leo.
Ekegusii: Maki osisiyori abaki: Naki omokinyani buya mucheche ogiteka omodori naki omosekorera matigori. Ria omokinyani naki ekimokinyani abaki buya.
Dholuo: Naki chike, aboro: Tiyo oportuniti kuom kisumu kayongo kanyano, kendo ubed ni joma kuchoko kamano. Lonyo joma chalo coffee kuom chike mago tindo.
Somali: Dadka dhalinyarada ah ee beeraleyda: Sahamin fursadaha ku saabsan kordhinta qiimaha qaxwaha iyo baro hababka hawlgalka iyo alaabooyinka ka dhalan kara. La xiriiro beero qaxwe oo maxalli ah si aad u hesho khibrad gacmeed maanta.

English: Women in Nandi County can now participate in the 'Kahawa na Mama' coffee initiative, gaining ownership of coffee trees, training, and market access. Join self-help groups to benefit.
Kiswahili: Wanawake katika Kaunti ya Nandi sasa wanaweza kushiriki katika mradi wa kahawa wa 'Kahawa na Mama', wakipata umiliki wa miti ya kahawa, mafunzo, na ufikiaji wa soko. Jiunge na vikundi vya kusaidiana ili kufaidika.
Ekegusii: Abaki bwakolire Nandi County bano banga bware buya bwabwanaka 'Kahawa na Mama', bosi bakanakire ekibere bwakohire mwaki, bwokire obokire, na bwaki bwokire buya. Kiamanire mu ng'endo daki bwokire.
Dholuo: Ng'ato manondo e Nandi County nikech ok en e 'Kahawa na Mama' ngo’ng’ang’a, manok jopiny gi mukwongo mar kawi, chako, gi dhako ne mondo ochieng’. Kanyakore ni ok bende onge ji jomonge ng’ato manondo.
Somali: Haweenka Gobolka Nandi hadda waxay ka qayb qaadan karaan mashruuca 'Kahawa na Mama', iyagoo helaya lahaansho geedaha qaxwada, tababar, iyo fursad suuqa. Ku soo biir kooxaha is-caawinta si aad faa’iido u hesho.

English: Kenyan and Ethiopian flower producers are collaborating to enhance their market position and comply with stricter European regulations. Stakeholders are encouraged to engage in this partnership.
Kiswahili: Watu wanaozalisha maua hapa Kenya na Ethiopia wanashirikiana kuboresha nafasi zao sokoni na kuzingatia kanuni ngumu za Ulaya. Washirika wanahimizwa kushiriki katika ushirikiano huu.
Ekegusii: Abarekeborai baki imeri na abarekeborai baki Ethiopia baria baganania buya buya baki bwatiri bosi na kubere bosi buya bwati mwandori buya aberekanyi bosi. Abakinyaki bategere ogokire buya mwandori iyi.
Dholuo: Wageni mago mar Kenya to mar Ethiopia ranyisna kuom nyime mag wedhigi to giginjre kode mar dho Ujaluo. Wang' adiera keto chandruok kendo owinjre kod maler mar ng'ato.
Somali: Soosaarayaasha ubax ee Kenya iyo Itoobiya ayaa iska kaashanaya si kor loogu qaado booskooda suuqeed iyo inay u hogaansamaan shuruuc adag oo Yurub ah. Xubnaha daneeyayaasha waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay ka qaybqaataan iskaashigan.

English: Avenews offers innovative financing solutions for agri SMEs without requiring traditional collateral. Interested businesses should explore their services to access funding.
Kiswahili: Avenews inatoa suluhu za kifedha bunifu kwa SMEs za kilimo bila kuhitaji dhamana za jadi. Biashara zinazovutiwa zinapaswa kuchunguza huduma zao ili kupata ufadhili.
Ekegusii: Avenews ekorogori oria nyasa nyaki naki omokiri ya agri SMEs kobere oria oborosokire emorori. Abakire buya bosi nyaki koboka bwakire bwake oria etarabu.
Dholuo: Avenews en gi mizo ahinya mar agri SMEs to nyalo kuom konyo mar mager. Makanisi oyie ka ginyalo wobou kuom kanyal.
Somali: Avenews waxay bixisaa xalka maaliyadeed ee hal-abuurka ah ee loogu talagalay ganacsiyada yaryar ee agri iyadoo aan loo baahnayn dammaanad caadi ah. Ganacsiyada raba inay ogaadaan adeeggooda waa inay baadhan fursadahooda si ay u helaan maalgelin.

English: Elgon Kenya and SMACHS Foundation have established a model farm and vertical gardens at Nyanjega School to support 4K Clubs, promoting agribusiness among young students.
Kiswahili: Elgon Kenya na SMACHS Foundation wameshauri shamba la mfano na bustani za wima katika Shule ya Nyanjega ili kusaidia Klabu za 4K, kukuza biashara ya kilimo miongoni mwa wanafunzi vijana.
Ekegusii: Elgon Kenya na SMACHS Foundation bwereka oria bw'ende baigire bulunda na maguta abwakiriria e Nyanjega School bw'ogusibori 4K Clubs, bw'ogoroja buse buagri business kiong'aki babokire.
Dholuo: Elgon Kenya kod SMACHS Foundation ne owaseraga farm modok tarab ni vertical gardens e Nyanjega School, kuom chandruok 4K Clubs, nyaka tindo agribusiness ma okinyiere.
Somali: Elgon Kenya iyo SMACHS Foundation waxay dhiseen farmo tusaale ah iyo beero toosan oo ku yaal Dugsiga Nyanjega si ay u taageeraan 4K Clubs, oo kor u qaadaya ganacsiga dhirta ee ardayda yar.

English: Agricultural stakeholders are encouraged to pursue an all-inclusive agri-financing system to better support smallholder farmers and women producers.
Kiswahili: Washiriki wa kilimo wanahimizwa kufuata mfumo wa ufadhili wa kilimo unaojumuisha ili kusaidia wazalishaji wadogo na wanawake wakulima kwa ufanisi zaidi.
Ekegusii: Abagene badi chache omosubaranya bagesang'ana omotete bw'ekigosi bwakubeka buya omogaka abarondori ne abaki bung'endo.
Dholuo: Abel maler gi jodak agik kuom nyalo nyal ng'eyo agri-finanzi ma ok nyalo yore maler ka ketho chiegni mane uyiero ma walosi gi joma ndung'.
Somali: Halyeyda beeraha waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay raadiyaan nidaam dhammaan dhaxal-gal ah oo maaliyadeed si ay si fiican u taageeraan beeraleyda yaryar iyo haweenka soo saara.

English: Farmers in Nyeri County can access certified hybrid sunflower and castor seeds through contract farming with Mukurwe-ini Oil Enterprises. Sign a three-month contract for sunflowers or six-month for castor.
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nyeri wanaweza kupata mbegu za alizeti na mbegu za castor zilizothibitishwa kupitia kilimo cha mkataba na Mukurwe-ini Oil Enterprises. Sign mkataba wa miezi mitatu kwa alizeti au miezi sita kwa castor.
Ekegusii: Abakire mu Nyeri bakanagana okonang'ana eng'ere na nkeke y'eng'anda na Mukurwe-ini Oil Enterprises. Moterere akamara ka nyang'ori atatu khana eng'ere kana kharua atano khana nkeke.
Dholuo: Okwachieng' naki Nyeri wuodhi karuondi jochieng' mar hybrid sunflower gi castor ng'ato e yo ng'ato e contract farming gi Mukurwe-ini Oil Enterprises. Sani chon mag thom mwakung' abich mar sunflowers en tin yuu ma nyaka adhi e ochung' maber, to kata mar castor en nene yuu ahinya.
Somali: Beeriyayaasha gobolka Nyeri waxay heli karaan abuurayal qadka hibridka ah ee qorraxda iyo castor oo la xaqiijiyay iyada oo loo marayo farming heshiis ah oo lala galayo Mukurwe-ini Oil Enterprises. Saxiix heshiis saddex bilood ah oo loogu talagalay qorraxda ama lix bilood ah oo loogu talagalay castor.

English: Youth are encouraged to utilize online platforms to acquire skills for effective agribusiness. Take action now to empower yourself in the agricultural sector!
Kiswahili: Vijana wanahimizwa kutumia majukwaa mtandaoni kupata ujuzi kwa ajili ya biashara ya kilimo yenye ufanisi. Chukua hatua sasa kuwawezesha wewe mwenyewe katika sekta ya kilimo!
Ekegusii: Abaki bategana gukorere interneti mwakiere buya buya buno bwemaki muberebire. Nika utemere oremoka omokirima!
Dholuo: Noroogni oniembogo nyaka ginyalo winjruok online kuom weche ma oket gi agwata. Goiny nyaka timbe okonyi chik kuom jowete!
Somali: Dhallinyarada waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay isticmaalaan baraha onleenka si ay u helaan xirfadaha ganacsiga beeraha. Qaado tallaabo hadda si aad naftaada ugu awood siiso qeybta beeraha!

English: Agribusiness stakeholders are invited to join the Inclusive Agribusiness Club to collaborate on strengthening inclusivity and sustainability in the sector.
Kiswahili: Wajibu wa sekta ya kilimo wanakaribishwa kujiunga na Klabu ya Kilimo Jumuishi ili kushirikiana katika kuimarisha ujumuishaji na uendelevu katika sekta hii.
Ekegusii: Abakora mu agribusiness boragane bogana kwerekana mu Inclusive Agribusiness Club kugira boranane mu gukomeyakirira inclusivity na sustainability mu kanga.
Dholuo: Abal gi agwanda mar agribusiness waneno kuom inyalo konyo kanyal rabuon e club mar Inclusive Agribusiness kanyenya bende oketh konyo to yor e nongo.
Somali: Dhalinyarada ganacsiga beeraha ayaa lagu martiqaaday inay ku soo biiraan Naadiga Ganacsiga Beeraha ee Is-dhexgalka si ay uga shaqeeyaan xoojinta ka qaybgalka iyo waaraanta waaxda.

English: Onion farmers are encouraged to establish a consistent planting schedule to ensure a steady income and supply throughout the year. Aim for high yields of 20 to 40 tons per acre for better profitability.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa vitunguu wanahimizwa kuanzisha ratiba thabiti ya kupanda ili kuhakikisha kipato na usambazaji mzuri mwaka mzima. Lengo ni kupata mavuno makubwa ya tani 20 hadi 40 kwa eka kwa faida bora.
Ekegusii: Abakinyi b'amarongi bariga batarire omokiriri ogokire omosiikhire okuteganya omokiriri omogendi naki bw'ogaki bakesoona ore koshere. Kiamani nibokire omogendi bw'inene bwa 20 na 40 tons k'ogee bwanjiga omobokiri.
Dholuo: Ng'ato gi wach g'apolo meyo g'oyo g'ok marach reto nyaka piny kapok kuom cung' duto. Nyasaye kuom kendo kendo yieng' gi 20 to 40 ton ma nyal nyaka weche makin.
Somali: Beeraleyda basaliga ayaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay dejistaan jadwal beero oo joogto ah si loo hubiyo dakhli iyo sahay joogto ah throughout sanadka. Ujeedku waa in la gaaro wax soo saar sare oo ah 20 ilaa 40 tan halkii acre si loo helo faa'iido fiican.

English: KENAFF and iCRA are offering agribusiness training to farmers across Kenya. Interested farmers should contact KENAFF for details on how to participate.
Kiswahili: KENAFF na iCRA wanatoa mafunzo ya biashara ya kilimo kwa wakulima kote Kenya. Wakulima waliovutiwa wanapaswa kuwasiliana na KENAFF kwa maelezo zaidi kuhusu jinsi ya kushiriki.
Ekegusii: KENAFF na iCRA boki omokirori buya buya buya amang'era. Abakiri bosi bataria, burokore KENAFF forekeri omokirori.
Dholuo: KENAFF na iCRA nyaka pa agribusiness training mar winkoni chike Kenya. Winkoni ma ineno golo KENAFF kuom dholuo kuom ni wacho ka waki.
Somali: KENAFF iyo iCRA waxay bixiyaan tababar ku saabsan ganacsiga beeraha oo loogu talagalay beeraleyda guud ahaan Kenya. Beeraleyda daneynaya waa inay la xiriiraan KENAFF si ay u helaan faahfaahin ku saabsan sida loogu soo biiri karo.

English: Farmers planning to grow onions on an acre should prepare a nursery of 9 beds, each 50m long, to accommodate 375,000 seeds. Ensure seedlings are graded and ready for transplanting.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanaopanga kulima vitunguu kwenye ekari wanapaswa kuandaa sehemu ya miche yenye vitanda 9, kila kimoja kikiwa na urefu wa mita 50, ili kuweka mbegu 375,000. Hakikisha miche inagawiwa na iko tayari kuhamishwa.
Ekegusii: Abagaburi banogoti bwaki onyo babwakiera oria burori bware 9, bwakabere 50m kebwaki, bwogenda buya 375,000 omosi. Ng'endo omokoyaki bwere omosi bwanegana naki gizogotana.
Dholuo: Bura ma okinyi kuom gima okonyo to okonyo mii inachiena, chako ng'ato ni uyud gima okonyo ni nyakwal 9, te kanyo 50m, gima chako keth 375,000 mana. Konyo ni ng'ato ma ng'ato nyaka chom chalo ni ok iting'o.
Somali: Beeraleyda damacsan inay basasha beeraan hal acar, waa inay diyaar gareeyaan dhir nursery ah oo leh 9 sariirood, mid walba dhererkiisu yahay 50m, si ay u qaadaan 375,000 abuur. Hubi in dhirta la kala saaray oo diyaarka u ah in la guuriyo.

English: Farmers are encouraged to explore onion cultivation due to high demand, with an estimated annual consumption of 365 million kgs in Kenya. Consider growing bulb onions to benefit from this lucrative market.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanakumbushwa kuangazia kilimo cha vitunguu kutokana na mahitaji makubwa, ambapo matumizi ya kila mwaka yanakadiriwa kuwa tani milioni 365 nchini Kenya. Fikiria kulima vitunguu vya bulbi ili kunufaika na soko hili lenye faida.
Ekegusii: Abagere batarakire bangenye okororere omokere ogokwerekeria, na bw'ogekia 365 mirong’  kgs ogotekeria nabw'Abakanya. Naki bagenye orokokere omokere buya ohoka bazakire omokere omogore ogoshi.
Dholuo: Jogwe makare ka gi wacho kuom kit konyo ma okinyi, ka gin piye kaka 365 million kgs chutho mwaka kanyo Kenya. Kachien chieng' bulbu konyo kuom gibango ma okinyi.
Somali: Beeralayda waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay sahamiyaan beerta basalka sababtoo ah baahida sare, iyadoo la qiyaasay in isticmaalka sanadlaha ah uu yahay 365 milyan kgs oo Kenya ah. Ka fiirso inaad beerto basal bulb si aad uga faa'iidaysato suuqan faa'iidada leh.

English: Bungoma County is enhancing its agricultural sector to benefit local farmers and stakeholders. Stay informed on new initiatives and support programs.
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Bungoma inaimarisha sekta ya kilimo ili kufaidisha wakulima na wadau wa ndani. Kuwa na taarifa kuhusu mipango mipya na programu za kusaidia.
Ekegusii: Omosibakire Bungoma otigana obwaki bwanogutikire buya bu endere buoragere. Kegasire abaki abantenye nakiiga abwere omokurerere.
Dholuo: Bungoma County nene ng'ato gi sekta mar nyuka kod mar magunga ma ok ginyalu ng'ato. Weche ng'ato ma otwe gi nyisou ma nyal yueyo.
Somali: Gobolka Bungoma wuxuu kor u qaadaya qaybta beeraha si uu uga faa'iidaysto beeralayda deegaanka iyo daneeyayaasha. La soco hawlgallada cusub iyo barnaamijyada taageerada.

English: The CGIAR Food Systems Accelerator has selected 10 agribusiness winners from East and Southern Africa, including 4 from Kenya. For more information on support opportunities, visit the CGIAR website.
Kiswahili: Mharakati wa Mfumo wa Chakula wa CGIAR umechagua washindi 10 wa biashara za kilimo kutoka Afrika Mashariki na Kusini, ikiwa ni pamoja na 4 kutoka Kenya. Kwa maelezo zaidi kuhusu fursa za msaada, tembelea tovuti ya CGIAR.
Ekegusii: CGIAR Food Systems Accelerator emokire 10 buya bwakibori bwasagano buya bwananana buja East na Southern Africa, na buya 4 buja Kenya. Naki ogotina bwaki kirekire bwosibori, endete oria CGIAR.
Dholuo: CGIAR Food Systems Accelerator owinjore 10 agribusiness wino e East kod Southern Africa, ka 4 ne ok Kenya. Kido gi bilgi piny e wacho mag kuom, konyru CGIAR website.
Somali: CGIAR Food Systems Accelerator waxay dooratay 10 guuleystayaal agribusiness ah oo ka socda Bariga iyo Koonfur Afrika, oo ay ku jiraan 4 ka socda Kenya. Wixii faahfaahin dheeraad ah ee fursadaha taageerida, booqo bogga CGIAR.

English: The 2023 AYuTe Africa Challenge Kenya winners have been announced, rewarding startups in agritech with cash grants; winners include Eco Bristo (Kshs 1 million) and Agritech Analytics (Kshs 400,000).
Kiswahili: Washindi wa 2023 AYuTe Africa Challenge Kenya wametangazwa, wakipata ruzuku za pesa kwa ajili ya startups katika sekta ya agritech; washindi ni Eco Bristo (milioni 1 Kshs) na Agritech Analytics (400,000 Kshs).
Ekegusii: Abatendekeri ba 2023 AYuTe Africa Challenge Kenya babwete buya, babwakire intang’ang’ana mu agritech na shilingi; abatendekeri ni Eco Bristo (Kshs 1 million) na Agritech Analytics (Kshs 400,000).
Dholuo: Winners ma 2023 AYuTe Africa Challenge Kenya ne okonyo, chalo oluor startup e agritech ka wacho koth ng'ato; jowinnyo ne Eco Bristo (Kshs 1 million) en Agritech Analytics (Kshs 400,000).
Somali: Ku dhawaaqidda guuleystayaasha tartanka AYuTe Africa 2023 ee Kenya ayaa la sameeyay, iyadoo abaalmarin lacageed la siiyay bilowga ah ee agabka beeraha; guuleystayaasha waxaa ka mid ah Eco Bristo (Kshs 1 milyan) iyo Agritech Analytics (Kshs 400,000).

English: Granot International Company has launched a 400-hectare avocado farm in Ndabibi, Naivasha, creating up to 2,000 job opportunities. Local farmers may explore partnership opportunities.
Kiswahili: Kampuni ya Granot International imeanzisha shamba la parachichi lenye hekari 400 huko Ndabibi, Naivasha, na kuunda nafasi za ajira hadi 2,000. Wakulima wa eneo wanaweza kuchunguza fursa za ushirikiano.
Ekegusii: Granot International Company omogenda 400-hectare orehani ya avokado ki Ndabibi, Naivasha, ekoro ogenda achire 2,000 oria. Aborina bosi ba naki batanie ekire buya.
Dholuo: Granot International Company ohip-ng'ato 400-hectare avocado farm e Ndabibi, Naivasha, mane owinjruok job 2,000. Abato mar Ndabibi bang' ongi kanyono joma magi kapo.
Somali: Shirkadda Granot International waxay daahfurtay beerta avokado oo 400-hektar ah oo ku taalla Ndabibi, Naivasha, abuurista ilaa 2,000 fursado shaqo. Beeraleyda deegaanka ayaa ka faa'iidaysan kara fursadaha iskaashiga.

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders are encouraged to explore herb and spice propagation, particularly thyme, for their high demand and immunity-boosting properties.
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo wanah encouraged kuchunguza uzalishaji wa mimea ya viungo na viherbeni, hasa thyme, kwa sababu ya mahitaji yake makubwa na uwezo wake wa kuongeza kinga.
Ekegusii: Abaki batarera na abaki bamenyere baisa bakenye bosi kori buya bwena, bonyekire ochukori oria covo, buya bonyakire oria bosi omokiri na bwaki bwosibori.
Dholuo: Owino gi wadhiang' manwano wacho ma Okonyo ng'ama odhi gi herb kod spice, kama thyme, kendo miyo gi nyaka marach kod nyimonyo.
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beeraha waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay daraaseeyaan taranka dhir udgoon iyo xawaash, gaar ahaan thyme, sababtoo ah baahideeda sare iyo awooddeeda kor u qaadista difaaca jirka.

English: Youth participating in the Building a Better Tomorrow (BBT) program in Tanzania are encouraged to expand their harvest distribution to meet consumer demands.
Kiswahili: Vijana wanaoshiriki katika programu ya Kujenga Kesho Bora (BBT) nchini Tanzania wanahimizwa kupanua usambazaji wa mavuno yao ili kukidhi mahitaji ya walaji.
Ekegusii: Abantubanti bari minto naki BBT igecherenchani Tanzania, boraganya naki baitangi bw'ogikora bw'eng'ero ya nyaki.
Dholuo: Nyang' piny gi nochuno e Building a Better Tomorrow (BBT) program e Tanzania, nyasa bura ka gichul goyo kanyakla e timo mar chike.
Somali: Dhalinyarada ka qaybgalaya barnaamijka Dhisidda Maalinta Fiican (BBT) ee Tanzania waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay ballaariyaan qaybinta dalagyada si ay u daboolaan baahida macaamiisha.

English: Discover the benefits of propolis, a natural product made by bees, known for its antibacterial properties. Farmers are encouraged to explore its uses in agribusiness.
Kiswahili: Gundua faida za propolis, bidhaa ya asili inayotengenezwa na nyuki, inayojulikana kwa sifa zake za antibakteria. Wakulima wanahimizwa kuchunguza matumizi yake katika biashara ya kilimo.
Ekegusii: Nakiere naki buya bwa propolis, oria buya bu mwaki, buya bwakiraka omokinyani ore obori bera. Abakire banekere omotenda bwaki bwakwe bwakirorere omoshamba.
Dholuo: Dhi ng'anyo mar proplis, chanjo mar bees, moko kuom yieng' mar antibacterial. Omena nicho kaka ng’ato mangevo piyo e agribusiness.
Somali: Ogow faa'iidooyinka propolis, oo ah shey dabiici ah oo ay sameeyaan shinnidda, kana caan ah sifooyinkiisa ka hortagga bakteeriyada. Beeralayda waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay sahamiyan isticmaalkeeda ganacsiga beeraha.

English: New investment guidelines for youth in agrifood systems have been launched. Stakeholders are encouraged to develop youth-focused investment programs using these guidelines.
Kiswahili: Mwongozo mpya wa uwekezaji kwa vijana katika mifumo ya kilimo na chakula umekanetiwa. Washikadau wanahimizwa kuendeleza programu za uwekezaji zinazolenga vijana kwa kutumia mwongozo huu.
Ekegusii: Makiire matigere ekiorera omwana buya mu bisekendete bwa agri na food systems omaki. Abakaireri bataraga buya kubwakiire amatare ma omwana miri ya makiire aa.
Dholuo: Kwaya mar kanyalo bende nyal e yohisie ma nyaka wade seche ng'ato kuom agri-food. Okwakre mag chiw matek nyalo kuom nyasaye ni koro nyalo dwond gi kanyalo ma kwayoni.
