Somali: Hagida cusub ee maalgashiga dhallinyarada nidaamka agri-cuntada ayaa la soo saaray. Daneeyayaasha waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa in ay sameeyaan barnaamijyo maalgashi oo diiradda saaraya dhallinyarada iyaga oo adeegsanaya hagidaan.

English: Twiga Foods has been recognized by Time Magazine as one of the 100 Most Influential Companies globally for its innovative B2B e-commerce platform that connects food producers and retailers.
Kiswahili: Twiga Foods imetambuliwa na Jarida la Time kama moja ya Makampuni 100 ya Kihistoria duniani kwa jukwaa lake la biashara la mtandaoni la B2B linalounganisha wazalishaji wa chakula na wauzaji.
Ekegusii: Twiga Foods ekerubona na Time Magazine naki naki ikatano 100 ekerendo naki atigi egere naki naki B2B e-commerce platform egera aberejo buya naki abemioria.
Dholuo: Twiga Foods en gi dhi nyaka Time Magazine kadhi 100 ma okonyo nyaka kanyo duto e dunia, kata kelo mar B2B e-commerce ma inying’ chalo kager gi roho mar piny kodwa gi ji konyo.
Somali: Twiga Foods ayaa lagu aqoonsaday majalada Time sidii mid ka mid ah 100 shirkadood ee ugu saameynta badan caalamka iyada oo leh madal cusub oo B2B ah oo isku xirta soo saaraha cuntada iyo iibiyeyaasha.

English: Faulu Bank and USAID's KCDMS project will support 10,000 farmers with training on accessing loans and sustainable agriculture in 12 counties. Participate in this opportunity to enhance your farming.
Kiswahili: Benki ya Faulu na mradi wa KCDMS wa USAID itasaidia wakulima 10,000 kwa mafunzo ya kupata mikopo na kilimo endelevu katika kaunti 12. Shiriki katika fursa hii ili kuboresha kilimo chako.
Ekegusii: Faulu Bank na USAID's KCDMS project bosi omogori 10,000 bataraga naki orego chire na boki kubanogana na buya. Naki nokarokire omogori ino obokibori bw'echi.
Dholuo: Faulu Bank gi projakti KCDMS mar USAID bende bende chako ma 10,000 akambi gi masomo kuom Pesa mokwongo kod chike mar kanyruok e 12 county. Naki e yo ma ok gi yore kanyruok.
Somali: Faulu Bank iyo mashruuca KCDMS ee USAID ayaa taageeri doona 10,000 beeralay iyada oo la siinayo tababar ku saabsan helitaanka deyn iyo caafimaadka dalagga 12 degmo. Ka qayb qaado fursadan si aad u horumariso beeraleydaada.

English: Farmers are urged to assess market conditions before planting crops, as market access and prices can significantly impact profitability.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahimizwa kutathmini hali ya soko kabla ya kupanda mazao, kwani upatikanaji wa soko na bei vinaweza kuathiri faida kwa kiwango kikubwa.
Ekegusii: Abafanyi buya naki naki buya babere bonyang'anya bwaki bwa masoko kera buya bosi bagenyane omokibori, kera bwaki bwabere buya bruya bweya buya naki ahenga ogerie.
Dholuo: Kang'ore dira joma oketo kanyakla kanyim piny mar piny ka g'iyebed joge, ni nyaka jowang' ni koro ma g'sonji konyo kachon itiyo jonego.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa loogu baaqay inay qiimeeyaan xaaladaha suuqaynta ka hor inta aysan dhigin dalagyada, maadaama helitaanka suuqa iyo qiimayaasha ay si weyn u saameyn karaan faa'iidada.

English: Farmers are encouraged to hire qualified irrigation technicians with proven experience for drip irrigation system installations to avoid costly issues.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahimizwa kuajiri wahandisi wa umwagiliaji waliokuwa na uzoefu wa kuthibitishwa kwa ajili ya usanikishaji wa mifumo ya umwagiliaji wa matone ili kuepuka matatizo ya gharama kubwa.
Ekegusii: Abarakirwe bataria bateganye ogendere je bwananeri mwaki oseria abaki bwokiri bologoti buya mwaki oborori omokinyekoni.
Dholuo: Gik ma joma okinyi wang'ni ni ng'ato togin, ka tigi gi joma irigeshin gi pengalaman makelo, to en gech mar drip irigeshin kuonde kuome konyo nadii mwandu.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay kiraystaan farsamo yaqaanno rigood ah oo khibrad leh si ay u rakibaan nidaamyada waraabka dhibcaha, si looga fogaado dhibaatooyin qaali ah.

English: Farmers are urged to assess and control key factors for successful farming, including land choice, preparation, fertilizer use, and crop husbandry practices.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahimizwa kutathmini na kudhibiti mambo muhimu kwa ufugaji wenye mafanikio, ikijumuisha uchaguzi wa ardhi, maandalizi, matumizi ya mbolea, na mbinu za kilimo.
Ekegusii: Abagabe bakiere kumenya na kugaragania emekireri ya ibanchani ya ogotire buya, okubera ne ekiburi, omomoe, omogorori, na oburere bw'obokore.
Dholuo: Nyar gi joma dongo gi golo e nying ma enyo to jii, kumaki mundo ilande, chalo, chogo, kendo joma oremo kwaya.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay qiimeeyaan oo ay xakameeyaan arrimaha muhiimka ah ee guul leh beeraleyda, oo ay ku jiraan doorashada dhulka, diyaarinta, isticmaalka bacriminta, iyo dhaqanka dalagga.

English: Dairy farmers are encouraged to utilize the FarmTrek animal identification and traceability platform to connect with veterinary officials, livestock authorities, and financial services.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa maziwa wanahimizwa kutumia jukwaa la utambuzi na ufuatiliaji wa mifugo la FarmTrek kuungana na maafisa wa mifugo, mamlaka za mifugo, na huduma za kifedha.
Ekegusii: Abakora ibirori b'amatongo baraburirwa gukoresha ikirango ca FarmTrek kugira bahuze n'abategetsi b'ubuvuzi, abategetsi b'amatongo, n'ibigo vy'imari.
Dholuo: Okwach mar gi gima ma wendo mar nyasaye owuon to golo FarmTrek chieng' madhi kwa gisechuru, maikore, kod nyasaye mar chike.
Somali: Farmers-ka caanaha ayaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa in ay isticmaalaan madal FarmTrek oo lagu aqoonsado xoolaha si ay ula xidhiidhaan khubarada xannaanada xoolaha, hay'adaha xoolaha, iyo adeegyada maaliyadeed.

English: The FAO's Junior Farmer Field and Life Schools (JFFLS) program offers agricultural and entrepreneurial training for youth in rural areas. Interested individuals should apply to enhance their skills and business potential.
Kiswahili: Programu ya Shule za Vijana Wakulima na Maisha (JFFLS) ya FAO inatoa mafunzo ya kilimo na ujasiriamali kwa vijana katika maeneo ya vijijini. Watu wanaovutiwa wanapaswa kuomba ili kuboresha ujuzi wao na uwezo wa kibiashara.
Ekegusii: Programu ya FAO ya JFFLS inatoa mafunzo ya kilimo na ujasiriamali kwa vijana wa maeneo ya mashinani. Watu waliovutiwa wanapaswa kuomba ili kuboresha ujuzi wao na uwezo wa biashara.
Dholuo: Program ma FAO, Junior Farmer Field and Life Schools (JFFLS), otimo gi chike ma ikanyogi kod kumar ekwung' ng'ato kadhi. Nindodo ma oting' ni owacho, nindeyo ihiga kuom bura.
Somali: Barnaamijka JFFLS ee FAO wuxuu bixiyaa tababaro beero iyo ganacsi oo loogu talagalay dhallinyarada ku nool deegaanka miyiga. Dadka xiiseynaya waa inay codsadaan si ay u horumariyaan xirfadahooda iyo fursadaha ganacsi.

English: Access to infrastructure is vital for boosting youth engagement in agriculture. Stakeholders should focus on improving infrastructure to create more agribusiness opportunities for young people.
Kiswahili: Upatikanaji wa miundombinu ni muhimu kwa kuimarisha ushiriki wa vijana katika kilimo. Wadau wanapaswa kuzingatia kuboresha miundombinu ili kuunda fursa zaidi za biashara za kilimo kwa vijana.
Ekegusii: Ekerenda naki egesang'ani ikirenda oria buya buya bwomi bwakire leki mwanya oremoborere oria okebwaki ogogoti. Abateganagori naki igwaki ikigere oria naki etong’ori ebikesichori bwokire ogogoti buya buya bwaki.
Dholuo: Wang'ni kuom infrastruktur nolweny e bedo mar yier e ng'ombe. Jotegno g'eyo chakre infrastruktur mondo onge ng'ato en yier mar agribusiness kuom chloro.
Somali: Helitaanka kaabayaasha waa muhiim si loo kordhiyo ka qaybgalka dhallinyarada ee beeraha. Danleyda waa in ay diiradda saaraan hagaajinta kaabayaasha si loo abuuro fursado ganacsi oo badan oo ku saabsan beeraleyda dhallinyarada.

English: The Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development has withdrawn 77 pesticide products. Farmers are advised to review their pesticide use immediately.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo imeondoa bidhaa 77 za kuua wadudu. Wakulima wanashauriwa kupitia matumizi yao ya dawa za kuua wadudu mara moja.
Ekegusii: Inyuaki ya Ekibere na Omocha oyaki ikireri 77 buya bwokigo. Abaki bakiibori buya bagera buya bwokigo bwakire.
Dholuo: Ministri mar Ugenzi e Dhiango kelo wand gende 77 ma ok nyalo golo. Wuodhi magi en nyalo kelo ngato chogo to golo kawuono.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha ayaa soo ceshatay 77 nooc oo sun ah. Beeraleyda waxaa lagu talinayaa inay sida ugu dhaqsaha badan dib u eegaan isticmaalka sunta ay isticmaalaan.

English: Farmers can now benefit from the government's decision to allow duty-free importation of 500,000 metric tonnes of animal feed.
Kiswahili: Wakulima sasa wanaweza kufaidika na uamuzi wa serikali wa kuruhusu kuagiza chakula cha mifugo bila ushuru cha tani 500,000.
Ekegusii: Abagima babwaki bw’ogere bw’ogoo omokiririo buya kaireri bw’ogendia obukereri bw’ensina 500,000 bwong’icha bw’ekiriba.
Dholuo: Luo chwe mago e yo wenge kany konyo ka buo dhok e chon kanyiedhi ka 500,000 metric tonnes mar giw.
Somali: Beeraleyda ayaa hadda ka faa'iidaysan karta go'aanka dowladda ee oggolaanaya soo dejinta khudradda xoolaha 500,000 tan oo aan canshuur lahayn.

English: Kenya has launched a National Horticulture Traceability System (NHTS), a digital platform to enhance tracking in the horticulture sector. All stakeholders are encouraged to register.
Kiswahili: Kenya imeanzisha Mfumo wa Taifa wa Kufuatilia Kilimo (NHTS), jukwaa la kidijitali ili kuboresha ufuatiliaji katika sekta ya kilimo cha matunda na mboga. Wadhamini wote wanahimizwa kujisajili.
Ekegusii: Kenya orekenye Nakiro Horticulture Traceability System (NHTS), ekikang'ani kye buya buya bwakire buya mu nakiro. Abakire bosi barekerere kwandikire.
Dholuo: Kenya en gi NHTS, sistem mar kanyandore mag horticulture, jaduong' mar nyaka weche chuth yiegi e sekta mar horticulture. Bende ogendini nyaka jogoo jende.
Somali: Kenya waxay soo bandhigtay Nidaamka Raadraaca Beeyada Qaranka (NHTS), oo ah madal dijital ah oo lagu xoojinayo raadinta qaybta beeyada. Dhammaan dhinacyada la xiriira waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay isdiiwaangeliyaan.

English: The Global Alliance for Improved Nutrition (GAIN) has launched a county-level initiative to improve agribusiness financing. Farmers are encouraged to participate to enhance their access to funding.
Kiswahili: Muungano wa Kidunia wa Kuboresha Lishe (GAIN) umeanzisha mpango wa ngazi ya kaunti kusaidia kuboresha ufadhili wa biashara ya kilimo. Wakulima wanahamasishwa kushiriki ili kuongeza upatikanaji wao wa fedha.
Ekegusii: Abanyaki Abagere omogori (GAIN) bamenyete omotere bwaki obwakire buye bwokebukire bwang'oka. Abakibori barikere ine barigane buya bungi bwakwerekia obwaki.
Dholuo: Global Alliance for Improved Nutrition (GAIN) medi ng'ato konyo yogo e thum kanyiri mar yore gi tich to onge yore gi agribusiness. Chik kanyiri ohinga omako yore ka yore to okel funding.
Somali: Iskaashatada Caalamiga ah ee Hagaajinta Nafaqada (GAIN) waxay bilowday mashruuc heer deegaan ah si loo horumariyo maalgelinta ganacsiga beeraha. Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay ka qayb qaataan si ay u kordhiyaan fursad ay ku helaan maalgelin.

English: Tomato prices in Kisumu County have surged due to heavy rains. Farmers and households should prepare for increased costs in their crop management and budgeting.
Kiswahili: Bei za nyanya katika Kaunti ya Kisumu zimepanda kutokana na mvua kubwa. Wakulima na nyumba zinapaswa kujiandaa kwa ongezeko la gharama katika usimamizi wa mazao na bajeti zao.
Ekegusii: Amakiri ya emetiba ekokire Kisumu County abogoria buya buya bwakire omogori. Abagori na abaki biongorani kuige oria eng'enda buya mosi na obwakire bwanabaki.
Dholuo: Pesa za tomati e Kisumu County dine okelo tinde mar pesa. Ng’eno gi maji e yo mwak, bende chiemo machogi e nyim mar piny mag crop management kod budgeting.
Somali: Qiimaha yaanyada ee Gobolka Kisumu ayaa korodhay sababo la xiriira roobab culus. Beeraleyda iyo qoysasku waa in ay isku diyaariyaan lacagaha badan ee ku baxaya maaraynta dalagyadooda iyo miisaaniyadooda.

English: Farmers are advised to always secure a legally-binding lease agreement before farming on leased land to avoid potential eviction and financial loss.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanashauriwa daima kupata mkataba wa kukodisha wa kisheria kabla ya kulima kwenye ardhi ya kukodishwa ili kuepuka kufukuzwa na hasara ya kifedha.
Ekegusii: Abagenga baria nababoki okuore igosi bwakire buya buse  bwaki buya buya buya buya buya buya buya bwaki buya bwakiganya buragwe.
Dholuo: Dendi to bura ni farmer bende ophrig ni anyuka cheng' mar lease kuom juma to kiwuok nyalo chalo ma niyienyore kod nyisgni mar jopiny.
Somali: Farmers waxaa lagu talinayaa inay mar walba helaan heshiis kirada sharci ah ka hor intaanay beereyn dhulka la kireystay si looga fogaado iclaaminta looga dhaqaaqo iyo khasaare dhaqaale.

English: Farmers in Nyeri County are encouraged to consider maize as fodder for dairy cows, as it has advantages over napier grass for silage making.
Kiswahili: Wakulima kutoka Kaunti ya Nyeri wanahimizwa kuzingatia mahindi kama malisho ya ng'ombe wa maziwa, kwani yana faida zaidi kuliko majani ya napier kwa ajili ya kutengeneza silage.
Ekegusii: Abagere b’abatandi ba Nyeri batarabaki batorore emigaana ng’abe okwenda, naki buya gakwa buya buya mwong’era naki ng’ombe otung’ono.
Dholuo: Abore e Nyeri County nyal chier maiz kama fodder mar ng'ombe, kare iweyo chiemo e nying' napier mar silage.
Somali: Farmers-ka Gobolka Nyeri waxaa la dhiirigelinayaa in ay tixgeliyaan masagada sida quudka loogu talagalay lo’da dhiigga, maadaama ay leedahay faa'iidooyin ka badan dhirta napier ee sameynta silajka.

English: Attention banana growers: Training on banana value addition is now available to enhance income opportunities and food security. Engage with established processing facilities in your area.
Kiswahili: Tangaza kwa wakulima wa ndizi: Mafunzo juu ya kuongeza thamani ya ndizi sasa yanapatikana kuboresha fursa za mapato na usalama wa chakula. Shirikiana na vituo vya usindikaji vilivyoanzishwa katika eneo lako.
Ekegusii: Abakung'anya bano: Itagwi buya bwakinya bwene buya bwa bano bwekatwaki buya bw'akiagano bw'ogotung'ana. Bwakiranye na buya bwa enyu bw'ekigenge bwokwigana.
Dholuo: Ngweche banana: Ojenjo mar joriyo kuom guche duto mar banana okonyo lwando moko e tich. Yudo gik ma nitie to chiemo gi joma oganda kendo jokwongo e ne.
Somali: Daryeelka beeralayda muuska: Tababbarka ku saabsan qiimaha dheeraadka ah ee muuska ayaa hadda la heli karaa si loo kordhiyo fursadaha dakhli iyo amniga cuntada. Ka qayb qaado xarumaha habaynta ee la xaqiijiyay ee deegaankaaga.

English: No actionable content related to Kenyan farmers or agribusiness stakeholders. The most useful fact: The world's most expensive sheep was sold for Kshs. 53 million at an auction in Scotland.
Kiswahili: Hakuna maudhui ya kutenda yanayohusiana na wakulima wa Kenya au wadau wa biashara ya kilimo. Ukweli muhimu: Mwana-kondoo mchakato wa gharama kubwa zaidi ulimwenguni uliuzwa kwa Kshs. milioni 53 katika mnada nchini Scotland.
Ekegusii: Omosagano buya bwetirire bwi Omogusii omoto oseria bwa Kshs. 53 mirongo ikiwairo bwetirire buya wagere Scotland.
Dholuo: Nya miyo siem na piny: mamboleo e ng'ato jodongo kawon gi Kshs. 53 million kanyo e auction e Scotland.
Somali: Ma jiraan wax macluumaad oo ficil ah oo la xiriira beeraleyda Soomaaliyeed ama daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beeraha. Xaqiiqda ugu waxtar badan: idaha ugu qaali ah adduunka ayaa lagu iibiyay Kshs. 53 milyan xalayda ka dhacday Iskaaarta.

English: Young farmers in Tanzania can enhance crop productivity through better access to ICT and research-extension services. Seek out local programs that facilitate these technologies.
Kiswahili: Makulima vijana nchini Tanzania wanaweza kuongeza uzalishaji wa mazao kupitia upatikanaji bora wa ICT na huduma za utafiti na upanuzi. Tafuteni programu za kibinadamu za karibu zinazosaidia teknolojia hizi.
Ekegusii: Abakina bwakirugendo mu Tanzania bakenyore okuhonya obwakirori bwamaboga bosi boki na butinani bwetechogeti na obwakirori bw’aborenzi. Nengia na maarifa abekinyanani echikora obwaki.
Dholuo: Ong'ere makelo konyo ng'ato mag nawuor ni jitungu chalo konyo jiwegi jomoko. Chiech ni ng'ato makoi jonti mag liwogi ma gi teknoloji.
Somali: Dhallinyarada beeralayda ee Tanzania waxay kordhin karaan wax-soosaarka dalagyada iyagoo helaya adeegyada ICT iyo cilmi-baarista. Raadi barnaamijyada maxalliga ah ee fududeeya teknoolojiyadan.

English: The Ministry of Agriculture is partnering with KCB Foundation to enhance youth agribusiness training programs. Interested participants should follow updates for collaboration opportunities.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo inashirikiana na KCB Foundation kuboresha programu za mafunzo ya biashara za kilimo kwa vijana. Washiriki wenye nia wanapaswa kufuatilia taarifa kwa fursa za ushirikiano.
Ekegusii: Obwakabere bw'Abakonyori bw'ekigwendo kye KCB Foundation buyaorere busebuye buseke bw'ekibiga bw'ekeganya neza. Abakire babo bwong'enda bronka batarukirieka kubisomeka kwi buseyabo bw'ekibiga.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture ne KCB Foundation ng'eyo mar yore kanyo ma yathuru yoth. Koro kawi, gi kwe koro gima okinyi mag yore.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha ayaa la shaqaynaysa KCB Foundation si kor loogu qaado barnaamijyada tababarka ganacsiga beeraha ee dhallinyarada. Ka qaybgalayaasha daneynaya waa inay raacaan wararka si ay u helaan fursado iskaashi.

English: Farmers are urged to take immediate action against the False Coddling Moth (FCM) to prevent export rejections to the EU. Increased checks may result in up to 50% of rose consignments being inspected.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanasisitizwa kuchukua hatua mara moja dhidi ya Nzizi wa Kuning'inia Feki (FCM) ili kuzuia kukataliwa kwa bidhaa za usafirishaji kwenda EU. Kaguzi zinazoongezeka zinaweza kupelekea hadi asilimia 50 ya mizigo ya rose kukaguliwa.
Ekegusii: Ababaki batariri kuchere bw'echoroko bw'ogekorere Omosoko Wekinyi (FCM) kugira ngo batadabukerete abende b’Euro. Abakire egere bweng'oma ekire buya 50% bw'abaragwi ba rose batarogetegana.
Dholuo: Chicoh ng'ama oseth jodongo ng'ato adiera konyo gi False Coddling Moth (FCM) negi timo neno kuom nyaka ng'ato bedo gi pueyo mar EU. Tich madhiko tich ulonyo nyaka onge 50% mar ruma maok koro rinyis.
Somali: Boonka waxaa lagu boorinayaa in ay si degdeg ah uga falceliyaan Kaalmada Bayoolajiga Qariibka (FCM) si ay uga hortagaan in loo diido dhoofinta EU. Kordhinta baaritaannada waxay keeni kartaa in ilaa 50% khudaarta ruuska la baaro.

English: Farmers are encouraged to transition to using commercial pig feed for improved returns in pig farming. Consider modern practices for better results in your pig farming operations.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahamasishwa kubadili matumizi ya chakula cha nguruwe cha kibiashara kwa faida bora katika ufugaji nguruwe. Fikiria mbinu za kisasa kupata matokeo mazuri katika shughuli zako za ufugaji nguruwe.
Ekegusii: Abagere ya buya baria bategena buya buya bwamachira buya baki bwakaniro bwabwere omogorie buya buya bwokogoria. Tairakire andori ikirori oria bategene baki bwabwere bwogosagania.
Dholuo: Gik mang'ere nyaka yong' gi komereshon pig feed kuom bende ng'ato ka wende. Tiyogi konyo duto mar yien gi ng'ato ma ok nyaka sing'iyo.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa la dhiirigelinayaa inay ka guuraan isticmaalka quudinta doofaarka ganacsiga si ay u helaan dakhli wanaagsan oo ka timaadda beeraleyda doofaarka. Ka fiirso dhaqamada casriga ah si aad natiijooyin fiican uga hesho hawshaada beeraleyda doofaarka.

English: Agribusinesses in Kenya can access funding through the partnership between USAID's Kenya Investment Mechanism and Vital Capital, aimed at unlocking $400 million in investments.
Kiswahili: Biashara za kilimo nchini Kenya zinaweza kupata ufadhili kupitia ushirikiano kati ya Kenya Investment Mechanism ya USAID na Vital Capital, ukilenga kufungua uwekezaji wa dola milioni 400.
Ekegusii: Abagiri b’ekibusiness b’aki Kenya baria bakenyega omokirori bw'ona na USAID’s Kenya Investment Mechanism na Vital Capital, bwe bunoka okwakirona $400 mirioni mu bibango.
Dholuo: Agribiznisi e Kenya nyalo wacho ng’wech kanyiri e en mar USAID's Kenya Investment Mechanism gi Vital Capital, mar bedo kuom nyalo golo $400 million e sigend.
Somali: Ganacsiyada beeraha ee Kenya waxay heli karaan maalgelin iyadoo la kaashanayo iskaashiga u dhexeeya USAID's Kenya Investment Mechanism iyo Vital Capital, kaasoo lagu bartilmaameedsanayo in la furo $400 milyan oo maalgelin ah.

English: The AgriBiz programme has selected 200 start-ups and early-stage agribusinesses for support. Eligible agribusinesses should apply for future opportunities to benefit from the Kshs. 22.2 billion funding.
Kiswahili: Programu ya AgriBiz imeteua kampuni 200 za mwanzo na biashara za kilimo za awali kwa msaada. Biashara zinazoendana na vigezo zinapaswa kuomba fursa za baadaye ili kunufaika na ufadhili wa Kshs. bilioni 22.2.
Ekegusii: Pogramu ya AgriBiz yachere 200 start-ups na biashara za ugali ziri mpo na mirinjia. Biashara ziri mpogori za ugali zigegere kuhenya kuja nijia ikogoko kiera ya Kshs. 22.2 billion.
Dholuo: Program ya AgriBiz omedi 200 start-ups gi agribusiness ma e kanyo mar wakanyi. Agribusiness mar kanyo gargi to oting' gi nyim mar otiyo kuom Kshs. 22.2 billion.
Somali: Barnaamijka AgriBiz wuxuu doortay 200 shirkadood oo cusub iyo ganacsiyo beeraha bilow ah si ay u helaan taageero. Shirkadaha beeraha ee xaqa u leh waa inay codsadaan fursadaha mustaqbalka si ay uga faa'iidaystaan maalgelinta Kshs. 22.2 bilyan.

English: Ndaro-ini coffee farmers have earned Kshs. 115 per kg by selling directly to Trabocca. Farmers are encouraged to explore direct marketing avenues for better profits.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa kahawa wa Ndaro-ini wamepata Kshs. 115 kwa kila kg kwa kuuza moja kwa moja kwa Trabocca. Wakulima wanakumbushwa kuchunguza njia za masoko ya moja kwa moja ili kupata faida zaidi.
Ekegusii: Abakoro ba Ndaro-ini babwaki Kshs. 115 kigochoki bazia buho buige bu Trabocca. Abakoro barianyire kubwaki njia ya buho buige buero bu nyasa.
Dholuo: Farmers ma Ndaro-ini ongi Kshs. 115 kwa kg ka nyis omera to Trabocca. Wabiro yore ka ineno dho marketing ma oketo ni imedhi buo.
Somali: Beeralayda bunka Ndaro-ini waxay ka heleen Kshs. 115 kiiloskiiba iyagoo si toos ah ugu iibinaya Trabocca. Beeralayda waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay baaran fursadaha suuqgeynta tooska ah si ay u helaan faa’iidooyin wanaagsan.

English: Farmers are urged to thoroughly vet buyers before entering contract farming agreements to avoid losses from untrustworthy buyers. Always confirm buyer commitments and stipulations in writing.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanashauriwa kuangalia kwa makini wanunuzi kabla ya kuingia katika mikataba ya kilimo, ili kuepuka hasara kutokana na wanunuzi wasioaminika. Kiongozi daima thibitisha ahadi na masharti ya wanunuzi kwa maandiko.
Ekegusii: Abaki batarerete buya bionekere igihe banchere buya batarakera buya bosi bwaki buya buya bujamu. Naki bobwakire ba buya buya bwaki nibokire oge.
Dholuo: Waganga dhok to nikech nyaka inyo gi buye mbere odhi nyaka inwendo kaabiro gi kontrak farming, ng'ato to buye marach. Nakiere nyaka wacho buye ma golo gi konyo mopogore.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa in ay si taxaddar leh u baaran iibiyayaasha ka hor inta aysan galin heshiisyo beereed si looga fogaado khasaare ka yimaada iibiyaal aan la aamini karin. Had iyo jeer xaqiiji ballanqaadyada iyo shuruudaha iibiyaasha qoraal ahaan.

English: Farmers and agribusinesses should prepare for increased onion imports from Tanzania as border trade activities resume between Kenya and Tanzania.
Kiswahili: Wakulima na biashara za kilimo wanapaswa kujiandaa kwa kuongezeka kwa uagizaji wa vitunguu kutoka Tanzania wakati biashara mpakani inaporejea kati ya Kenya na Tanzania.
Ekegusii: Abagikere na abategi bakiita bataragwa buya buya bwang'wenkire bwi ng'wenkire buya buya bwananga Tanzania ko ing'oto ya ng'wenkire ikomanje hagati ya Kenya na Tanzania.
Dholuo: Adhi kologi katach kuom ong'ere okonyo ka lweni e moko e Tanzania, ka bende odi ng'ato ma asia ni kolo mar lweny okonyo mar Kenya gi Tanzania.
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo ganacsatada beeraha waa inay is diyaarisiyaan soo dejinta basasha oo kordhay laga bilaabo Tansaaniya maadaama ganacsiga xuduudda dib u bilaabmo u dhexeeya Kenya iyo Tansaaniya.

English: Nyeri County is privatizing its fish processing plant to enhance youth employment in fisheries. Youth groups interested in aquaculture can access training and support for business development.
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Nyeri inapunguza umiliki wa kiwanda chake cha kuchakata samaki ili kuboresha ajira kwa vijana katika sekta ya uvuvi. Vikundi vya vijana vinavyovutiwa na ufugaji wa samaki vinaweza kupata mafunzo na msaada wa maendeleo ya biashara.
Ekegusii: Makiori ya Nyeri omokorere omogusii motigare ore omong’ere buya bwaki omokiri omokire. Abaki abokinyire bware buya bwi ganogori bwaki bwanakire naki matega ore bwaki.
Dholuo: Nyeri County nyal gi privatiser kaka oketi joma ng'ato nene kuom nyithindo. Jomoko nyithindo ma oket gi aquaculture nyal wakonyo thum to gite dikk go.
Somali: Gobolka Nyeri wuxuu ka shaqaynayaa in uu gaarigo iskaashi dhigo warshadda kalluumeysiga si loo kordhiyo fursadaha shaqo ee dhallinyarada kalluumeysiga. Kooxo dhallinyaro ah oo xiiseynaya aquaculture waxay heli karaan tababar iyo taageero horumarinta ganacsiga.

English: The Aquaculture Business Development Programme (ABDP) is now active, providing support for fish farming. Fish farmers and stakeholders are encouraged to engage with their local implementing counties.
Kiswahili: Programu ya Kuendeleza Biashara za Ufugaji Samaki (ABDP) sasa imeanza, ikitoa msaada kwa ufugaji wa samaki. Wafugaji wa samaki na wadau wanahimizwa kushirikiana na kaunti zao za utekelezaji.
Ekegusii: Programmbe ya Ekigari Ekibere (ABDP) yaki naki, ikogekonanga oborere bwaki. Abagari b’ibori na abakiibori batorori bagenjeka bakania bagaki omokirorai bosi bakenye.
Dholuo: Program Ma Ndalo Enchero Bende (ABDP) e lage, nyal kuom chonde mag gima. Chonde mang'wech kod jopiny nyal gin mawuok kuom ng'ato mar joma e piny koro marach.
Somali: Barnaamijka Horumarinta Ganacsiga Kalluunka (ABDP) hadda waa firfircoon, wuxuuna taageero u siinayaa kalluumeysiga. Kalluumeysatooyinka iyo daneeyayaasha waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay la shaqeeyaan dowladaha hoose ee deegaanka.

English: Maasai women are producing probiotic yoghurt in Ololulung'a, Narok County. Interested stakeholders can explore collaboration opportunities with the cooperative.
Kiswahili: Wanawake wa Kimasai wanatengeneza mtindi wa probiotic katika Ololulung'a, Kaunti ya Narok. Wadhamini wanaovutiwa wanaweza kuchunguza nafasi za ushirikiano na ushirika.
Ekegusii: Abakungwa b'amaasai bataragoya kaoyogurt y'ogomboki mu Ololulung'a, Narok. Abatebuke babaki bwogusomogore bakanoraga maherere buzanogoya keraige omokubandi.
Dholuo: Ababola maziwa probiotic e Ololulung'a, Narok County. Igo mar achiegni giyech kelo ng'ama ka ohinga owinjo gotieno.
Somali: Haweenka Maasai waxay soo saarayaan yogurt probiotic ah oo ku yaal Ololulung'a, Gobolka Narok. Xubnaha daneeya waxay baaran karaan fursadaha iskaashi ee iskaashiga.

English: Women and youth interested in starting or expanding agribusiness can apply for the AgriBiz Programme until May 22, 2020. Visit www.kenyacic.org for guidelines and application details.
Kiswahili: Wanawake na vijana wanaopenda kuanzisha au kupanua biashara ya kilimo wanaweza kuomba Mpango wa AgriBiz hadi tarehe 22 Mei 2020. Tembelea www.kenyacic.org kwa mwongozo na maelezo ya maombi.
Ekegusii: Abwakire na baki abakiire buya buya bw'egiragano, mosi bibori bwaki, bwakire kuduga buya buya bw'AgriBiz Programi ng'ende May 22, 2020. Genda www.kenyacic.org omokang'ana naki naki za kuduga.
Dholuo: Ng'ato ka abagere gi joma misharuru, to eyo mokwongo ruoth AgriBiz kendo okubed gi japo okel kendo chalo kendo toe May 22, 2020. Kony ng'ato tino www.kenyacic.org chalo kendo chike kod kony.
Somali: Haweenka iyo dhallinyarada xiisaynaya inay bilaabaan ama ballaariyaan ganacsiga beeraheeda waxay codsan karaan Barnaamijka AgriBiz illaa 22ka Maajo, 2020. Booqo www.kenyacic.org si aad u hesho tilmaamaha iyo faahfaahinta codsiga.

English: Youth groups in Nyeri County are encouraged to apply for government funding to support agribusiness initiatives like banana value addition.
Kiswahili: Vikundi vya vijana katika Kaunti ya Nyeri vinahimizwa kuomba ufadhili wa serikali kusaidia miradi ya biashara ya kilimo kama vile ongezeko la thamani ya ndizi.
Ekegusii: Abakire bakiijokire mu Nyeri batoria kudiha omogori buse na bobi bwerere omotigori omogori buse okere ogwete.
Dholuo: Bende, ng'eto maber mar youth e Nyeri County nyisuok gi to nyingi e chon mar gof kuom agribusiness weche, kama nyadhi moro nyamre.
Somali: Dhalinyarada ka socda Gobolka Nyeri waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay codsadaan maalgelin dowladeed si ay u taageeraan dadaallada agribishinka sida kordhinta waxtarka mooska.

English: IFAD has invested US$9 million into the Agri-Business Capital Fund to support small-scale farmers and rural enterprises. Eligible farmers and agribusinesses are encouraged to explore this funding opportunity.
Kiswahili: IFAD imewekeza dola za Marekani milioni 9 katika Mfuko wa Mitaji ya Kilimo kusaidia wakulima wadogo na biashara za vijijini. Wakulima na biashara za kilimo wenye sifa wanahimizwa kuchunguza fursa hii ya ufadhili.
Ekegusii: IFAD yaingire $9 milioni mu Agri-Business Capital Fund kuganya abaki beesani na buya bwaki. Abaki beesani na buya bwaki bakenyanya kwiga omogwaki ng'enda.
Dholuo: IFAD abed gi US$9 million maduong' ku Agri-Business Capital Fund gi chuny agro kama temnegi manieyo e bwati. Juma kagi mang'ere gi agri-business en bende konyruok kuom tichni manieyo.
Somali: IFAD waxay ku maalgelisay $9 milyan oo doolar Sanduuqa Maalgelinta Xirfadaha Beeraha si ay u taageeraan beeraleyda yaryar iyo ganacsiyada miyiga. Beeraleyda iyo ganacsiyada beeraha ee xaqa u leh waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay baaraan fursadan maalgelin.

English: Farmers are advised to consider professional seedling raising services to ensure healthy seedlings and optimize transplanting conditions. For best results, assess local service availability.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanashauriwa kufikiria huduma za kitaaluma za kulea miche ili kuhakikisha miche yenye afya na kuboresha masharti ya upandaji. Kwa matokeo bora, angalia upatikanaji wa huduma za hapa.
Ekegusii: Abakire ba naki bakuragane na buya bwakababa mu enkiaro buya bwakababa bwaki roko buya bwakababa bwaki bwakea. Omo burori, tuka mire omokire omoka omokiri.
Dholuo: Kare wadu marach, jothum toho gin noki madhi to konyo kendo to konyo gi kech maduong'. Ka ikar, nyalo ringo wach kata samaki kare ji sekelo.
Somali: Farmers-ka waxaa lagu talinayaa inay tixgeliyaan adeegyada xirfadeed ee koritaanka dhirta si loo hubiyo dhir caafimaad qaba iyo in la optimized tuurista. Si aad u hesho natiijooyinka ugu wanaagsan, qiimee helitaanka adeegyada maxalliga ah.

English: Farmers in Kitale are invited to explore seedling propagation opportunities to recover from financial losses in agriculture. Take action to diversify your agribusiness today.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa Kitale wanakaribishwa kuchunguza fursa za uzalishaji wa miche ili kurejea kwenye hali ya kifedha baada ya hasara katika kilimo. Chukua hatua sasa kubadilisha biashara yako ya kilimo.
Ekegusii: Abarima baki Kitale batarorere okogoya bwaki buya bwaki buya bwaki buya nibirihise bwaki bwaki bwaki buya mugango. Kinyarenda tororererere kinyaki chaki chakuru omogenda baki naki.
Dholuo: Gik Maundu e Kitale timo kamano ma okwonyo e yo ring' gibuok matindo yo nyaka maber kuom timing' kuom bura. Konyo kamano nyaka ng'ato e buwasabi gi yo ring' ma oriyo nyaka imigo.
Somali: Faarminayaasha Kitale waxaa lagu martiqaaday in ay baaraan fursadaha koritaanka dhirta si ay uga soo kabtaan khasaaraha dhaqaale ee beeralayda. Qaadashada tallaabo si aad u baahiso ganacsigaaga beeralayda maanta.

English: Farmers are urged to explore certified potato seed production as there is a current shortage in the market. Consider becoming a seed producer to enhance your potato farming.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanashauriwa kuchunguza uzalishaji wa mbegu za viazi zilizothibitishwa kwani kuna uhaba sokoni kwa sasa. Fikiria kuwa mtayarisha mbegu ili kuboresha kilimo chako cha viazi.
Ekegusii: Abagabirori baragirwa gukoresha omogabe oria buya omotukonye buya naki oria buya ikirori. Irekeni gutigira omogabe buya omorori tucheke omokirori omokwere.
Dholuo: Nyasaye okelii kowe konyo nyasi magerika e yo mwakanyo ma chiek, maler ni kadi ka wecho nyasi kendo dudi. Niti ni okanyore kowe masinda ma konyo nyasi.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay ka fikiraan wax-soo-saarka abuurka baradho ee la xaqiijiyay maadaama suuqa uu hadda ka jiraa gaabis. Ka fikir inaad noqoto soo-saare abuur si kor loogu qaado beerto baradhadaada.

English: Farmers in dry areas are encouraged to explore dryland arrow roots, a resilient crop that requires minimal water. Contact Modern Tech Nurseries for planting materials.
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika maeneo kame wanahimizwa kuangazia viazi vya mwituni, mimea yenye nguvu inayohitaji maji machache. Wasiwasi wasiliana na Modern Tech Nurseries kwa vifaa vya kupanda.
Ekegusii: Abakurenyi bataragani babwaki bwekire bataragani bazwanire magi, bakorori buriri bwetebwetabaki bwebwaki. Naki bwegita na Modern Tech Nurseries bwetebwetabaki.
Dholuo: Wang' adhi e piny mago nyaka oyiye konyo piny magero, ng'we marach togi aoro chieng' ring' nyaka miyo. Konyo kamano na Modern Tech Nurseries kuom madhi.
Somali: Beeraleyda deegaanada qallalan ayaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay baaraan xididdada qadhaadh ee dhulka qallalan, oo ah dalag adkaysi leh oo u baahan biyo yar. La xiriir Modern Tech Nurseries si aad u hesho agab beeri.

English: Youth interested in agriculture can explore educational opportunities in hydroponics and farming technology. Consider enrolling in courses at local agricultural institutions.
Kiswahili: Vijana wanaovutiwa na kilimo wanaweza kufuatilia fursa za elimu katika hydroponics na teknolojia ya kilimo. Fikiria kujiandikisha katika kozi katika taasisi za kilimo za eneo lako.
Ekegusii: Abakire bakiiga boke baguya buya bang'ana bendi buya moke gi hydroponics na buya bwakiiga. Nyasa bwerega bosi bige buya buwaki bategana na boro bwakiiga bosi.
Dholuo: Ong'eyo bura mabor k'otiyo ka kendo kawuono nyadhi ka lwete, kata k'ere ng'ato k'olo chon. Yie uyier ka enge ngima k'otiyogo e gendo mar buge.
Somali: Dhallinyarada xiisaynaysa beeraha waxay baari karaan fursadaha waxbarasho ee hidroponics iyo tignoolajiyada beera. Tixgeli inaad diiwaangeliso koorsooyin ka socda hay'adaha beeraha ee maxalliga ah.

English: The Nairobi Coffee Exchange auction occurs every Tuesday, open to the public. Coffee is traded in 50kg bags, with current prices available for interested stakeholders.
Kiswahili: Hujumuika ya Nairobi Coffee Exchange hufanyika kila Jumanne, ikifunguliwa kwa umma. Kahawa inauzwa katika mifuko ya kilo 50, na bei za sasa zinapatikana kwa wadau wenye hamu.
Ekegusii: Omosora Nairobi Coffee Exchange ogotekeria oria Nyabere, omong'anya lyakiri. Kofi igoterekeria mu ngi 50kg, na omong'anya oga naki oboka oria bw'ogiraki.
Dholuo: Nairobi Coffee Exchange ochik e yo masaa duka ariyo, joma oketo. Kofi ochalre kagi 50kg, chenro mar kiek gi dhak mang’ere moyiero.
Somali: Dhaqdhaqaaqa iibka Kafeega ee Nairobi wuxuu dhacaa Talaadada kasta, furanna waa dadweynaha. Kafeega waxaa lagu iibinayaa boorsooyin 50kg ah, qiimihiisana waa la heli karaa dadka daneynaya.

English: The African Association for Vertical Farming (AAVF) has launched its Kenya Chapter to support farmers interested in vertical farming. Join to enhance agricultural practices and improve food security.
Kiswahili: Shirikisho la Afrika la Kilimo cha Wima (AAVF) limetangaza kufungua Sura yake ya Kenya kusaidia wakulima wanaovutiwa na kilimo cha wima. Jiunge ili kuboresha mbinu za kilimo na kuongeza usalama wa chakula.
Ekegusii: Ishindano ry'abo bakorera mu mawe ya AAVF rwakaranga rumboka rwy'Abakiria w'ekegusii okunyora abegeki batarerere batania na baturire buya. Naki omoka no bw'ogomokiriana bw'ogokiringia.
Dholuo: Nyasaye Maber e Buoyogi Africa (AAVF) en beri e neno mar Kenya kuom thuolo kanyal kanyogi mar buo. Ngi ng’ato gi tich koth kanyal kanyogi to ng’ama to weche e piny.
Somali: Ururka Afrikada ee Beeralayda Dhulka Jooga (AAVF) ayaa furay qeybtiisa Kenya si uu u taageero beeralayda danaynaya beerashada dhulka jooga. Ku biir si aad u horumariso hababka beeraha iyo sugnaanta cuntada.

English: Farmers interested in the cashew nut value chain can benefit from new opportunities as the Ministry of Agriculture, Animal Industry, and Fisheries partners with Uganda Cashewnut and Trees Limited.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanaovutiwa na mnyororo wa thamani wa karanga wanaweza kupata fursa mpya wakati Wizara ya Kilimo, Mifugo na Uvuvi ikishirikiana na Uganda Cashewnut and Trees Limited.
Ekegusii: Abarimu bakiaki bw'oguo bakekenye bwanani bw'akiuga bw'akatutu bakireng'ane na bw'ekirori buria bw'Abaganga b'Omokiriri, Obw'Okuguru, na Obotubati b'Obokoni bang'ana na Uganda Cashewnut and Trees Limited.
Dholuo: Aboro magi, koro jochuok mar cashew nut wang' e yong' miyo opogore nyaka oter joma in kata Ministry of Agriculture, Animal Industry, and Fisheries kod Uganda Cashewnut and Trees Limited.
Somali: Farmerska xiiseynaya silsiladda qiimaha qareenada ayaa ka faa'ideysan kara fursado cusub iyadoo Wasaaradda Beeraha, Warshadaha Xoolaha, iyo Kalluumaysiga ay iska kaashanayso Uganda Cashewnut and Trees Limited.

English: Turkana County has introduced market days: Kakuma on Tuesdays, Lodwar on Thursdays, and Lokichar/Lokiriama on Saturdays to enhance market access and trade.
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Turkana imeanzisha siku za masoko: Kakuma Jumatatu, Lodwar Alhamisi, na Lokichar/Lokiriama Jumamosi ili kuboresha upatikanaji wa masoko na biashara.
Ekegusii: Egere Kanyanchabo ya Turkana omokire emiori ya masoko: Kakuma omokire eMogongo, Lodwar omokire eSaba, na Lokichar/Lokiriama omokire eMande.
Dholuo: Turkana County en ginyal da jotiyogo: Kakuma nyaka kuonde, Lodwar nyaka ruoth, gi Lokichar/Lokiriama nyaka wende kuek gi jomakaka ma oketi owak.
Somali: Degaanka Turkana ayaa soo bandhigay maalmaha suuqyada: Kakuma Salaasada, Lodwar Khamiista, iyo Lokichar/Lokiriama Sabtida si loo hagaajiyo helitaanka suuqyada iyo ganacsiga.

English: Farmers are encouraged to utilize the Digifarm mobile platform offered by the Kenya Livestock Producers Association for enhanced agricultural practices.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahimizwa kutumia jukwaa la simu la Digifarm lililotolewa na Chama cha Wazalishaji wa Mifugo Kenya kwa ajili ya kuboresha mbinu za kilimo.
Ekegusii: Abagari baria batorera gukoresha Digifarm mobile platform yatiroto naki Kenya Livestock Producers Association kubariga buya bwebire buseke.
Dholuo: Okwach maber, manomiyo chuny e Digifarm mobile platform ka en Kenya Livestock Producers Association nyaka oriyo chalo mar nyasaye.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay isticmaalaan madal mobile ah oo loo yaqaan Digifarm, taasoo ay bixiso Ururka Soo saaraha Xoolaha Kenya si loo hagaajiyo dhaqanka beeraha.

English: The Nakuru County Government has provided the Markilanjo Bee Keepers Cooperative with beehives and equipment to enhance honey production. Cooperative members are encouraged to utilize these resources for increased production and processing.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Kaunti ya Nakuru imepatia Ushirikiano wa Wenye Nyuki wa Markilanjo nyuki na vifaa ili kuboresha uzalishaji wa asali. Wanachama wa ushirikiano wanahimizwa kutumia rasilimali hizi kuongeza uzalishaji na usindikaji.
Ekegusii: Ogochani bw'ekegori bwakinyang'ani buya bwasikiria Omokireri Ogoti wa Markilanjo na ekikori ebwakire oserori oyo ogwomokire. Abakire b'ekikori bataruri bw'ogwenda buya bwaniani na obwenge.
Dholuo: Liwruok mar Nakuru County atweyo Markilanjo Bee Keepers Cooperative beehives kod chuma chuny maithel gi udi mar honey. Kachaku monyalo e chiegni piny mane oting'o miyo ginyalo ng'ato gi ndal.
Somali: Dowladda Gobolka Nakuru waxay siisay Iskaashatada Beekeepers ee Markilanjo qaadooyinka dhalaanka ah iyo qalab si kor loogu qaado soosaarka malabka. Xubnaha iskaashatada waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay ka faa'iidaystaan kheyraadkan si loo kordhiyo soosaarka iyo habaynta.

English: Farmers are encouraged to adopt the newly commercialized Aliciana Barley variety from East African Breweries for higher yields and increased resistance to water lodging.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahimizwa kup adopta aina mpya ya shayiri ya Aliciana kutoka East African Breweries ili kupata mavuno makubwa na upinzani bora dhidi ya kuzama kwenye maji.
Ekegusii: Abere ba atigana bwang'ori bwaki Aliciana Barley bu Easte African Breweries buya bwege obwakirori bwaki bwakire na omokiriri buya bugei buya.
Dholuo: Dala bende dhi chopo lweny choko Aliciana Barley kwach East African Breweries kuom wango makalo moye ok nyaka bura weche kendo nyalo ruwore to wando.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay qaataan nooca cusub ee Aliciana Barley oo ka yimid East African Breweries si ay u helaan wax soo saar sare iyo adkaysi sare oo ka dhanka ah biyaha ku dhaca.

English: Poultry breeders are losing significant profits due to cheap day-old chick imports. Stakeholders should assess market conditions to adapt their breeding plans accordingly.
Kiswahili: Wafugaji wa kuku wanakosa faida kubwa kutokana na uagizaji wa vifaranga vya siku moja kwa bei nafuu. Wadau wanapaswa kutathmini hali ya soko ili kubinafsisha mipango yao ya ufugaji.
Ekegusii: Abaki bataka baki kora oborere bente baira nakiokore bwaki bwaki bwaki bwaki. Abasomokiri batarera bataria, bategenyi nakiokore oborere baki.
Dholuo: Brejieng' mar poultry nyaka golo profit moro e ndalo koluwore tich lare mag day-old chick. Winyalo chuny konyo yath ma okelo kolo nyaka gibed tuoche duto matek.
Somali: Tarankayaasha digaaga waxay lumiyeen faa'iidooyin badan sababo la xiriira iibka raqiiska ah ee ukun cusub. Dhamaan danaystayaasha waa inay qiimeeyaan xaaladaha suuqa si ay ula qabsadaan qorshayaasha tarankooda.

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders can visit Therapeutic Foods Limited in Murang'a County for insights on organic farming and value addition.
Kiswahili: Wakulima na washiriki wa biashara za kilimo wanaweza kutembelea Therapeutic Foods Limited katika Kaunti ya Murang'a kwa maelezo kuhusu kilimo hai na kuongeza thamani.
Ekegusii: Abakung’eri na abakerere bendo bakenyinya Therapeutic Foods Limited bu Murang'a County omokinyanire omogeya omokirigori nakiiri bw'ogokora.
Dholuo: Ng'ato ma joma tekniyo koka e ng'aluok mondo wala thum mar kadhiyo kendo onjogi pa Therapeutic Foods Limited e Murang'a County.
Somali: Beeralayda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beeraha waxay booqan karaan Therapeutic Foods Limited ee Gobolka Murang'a si ay u helaan fikrado ku saabsan beerta dabiiciga ah iyo kordhinta qiimaha.

English: Agriculture in South Sudan is going digital. Farmers can access training videos on groundnut harvesting and maize row planting from local extension staff.
Kiswahili: Kilimo nchini Sudani Kusini kinaenda kidijitali. Wakulima wanaweza kupata video za mafunzo juu ya kuvuna karanga na kupanda mahindi kutoka kwa wafanyakazi wa uwekezaji wa eneo hilo.
Ekegusii: Ekegusii mo South Sudan ibwaki mooko. Abakore bambarigwa mabaki ku siasa ekigori ky'ubingo bwomaki na ekigori ky'okugumbetia busembaggwa bwi bweha abanto ba bukirigani.
Dholuo: Luo chuth kuom South Sudan ochi. Wuon duochno osebedo nyaka wacho miyo mondo oser ng'ato ma nigi kanyas gi nyaka obwete kuom ji mag ndakus.
Somali: Beerashada Koonfur Sudan waxay noqonaysaa mid dijitaal ah. Beeralaydu waxay heli karaan fiidiyowyada tababarka ee ku saabsan goosashada lowska dhulka iyo geedka masagada oo ka yimaada shaqaalaha kordhinta deegaanka.

English: Dairy farmers in Nairobi are successfully using modern methods, such as zero grazing and feed from urban byproducts. Explore local resources and connect with other farmers for best practices.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa maziwa Nairobi wanatumia kwa mafanikio mbinu za kisasa kama ufugaji bila malisho na chakula kutoka kwa bidhaa za mijini. Tafuta rasilimali za hapa na ungana na wakulima wengine kwa mbinu bora.
Ekegusii: Abagabe b'ibensagani b'i Nairobi baria usingere omokiri bw'enge, bweenya zero grazing na emokiri buya omokiriganye b'ibyinjorogoto. Ria omokiri buya bwenge na bwendare buya banye b'ibensagani b'omogoti bw'enge.
Dholuo: Waganga masiga e Nairobi nigi tich mogik, kaka zero grazing kod chogo mai kendo gite mokuongo. Konyo kadhomo magi ma nyalo te gi waganga abiro nyaka chayo.
Somali: Davidka lo'da ee Nairobi waxay si guul leh u adeegsanayaan habab casri ah, sida xoolo laga dhoofiyaa iyo cunto ka timaadda wax-soo-saarka magaalooyinka. Ka baaro ilaha maxalliga ah oo la xidhiidh beeraley kale si aad u hesho hababka ugu wanaagsan.

English: Farmers in Embu are encouraged to explore value addition opportunities for mangoes to reduce waste—consider joining local processing groups for support and training.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa Emabu wanahimizwa kuchunguza fursa za kuongeza thamani ya maembe ili kupunguza taka—fikiria kujiunga na vikundi vya usindikaji vya eneo hilo kwa msaada na mafunzo.
Ekegusii: Abakora uhoro ku Embu barakiriwe kutoranya nzira zokenyera umusaruro wa mangoo, kugira ngo bavuge ivu. Fanyanani na magroup egendani ekikorera oria, omokiri n'ekihande.
Dholuo: Abere mag farmer e Embu to owuon goyo kelo valo mag mango me otho wate—yien ni owachok koro kuonde mar pondo maler kod walo.
Somali: Beeralayda Embu waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa in ay baaraan fursadaha lagu kordhinayo qiimaha mangooyinka si loo yareeyo qashinka — tixgeli inaad ku biirto kooxaha maxalliga ah ee habaynta si aad u hesho taageero iyo tababar.

English: Farmers are encouraged to explore dairy goat farming; Robert Macharia reports high demand for goat milk and offers to connect other farmers with potential clients.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahimizwa kuangazia ufugaji wa mbuzi wa maziwa; Robert Macharia anaripoti kuwa na mahitaji makubwa ya maziwa ya mbuzi na anatoa huduma ya kuunganisha wakulima wengine na wateja wanaoweza kuwa nao.
Ekegusii: Abarori baria bagenyegarie omokere buya; Robert Macharia egosetania orokore buya buye na akang'anya abarori abaki bori bosianga bengine bwiye.
Dholuo: Abore miyo gibed gi ji nyuka matek kendo; Robert Macharia ni yiengo kendo otimo ja-milimani e kaka joma ineno mar nyuka matek.
Somali: Beeraleyda ayaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay sahamiso beerta adhiga kaas oo keena caano; Robert Macharia ayaa soo sheegay dalabka sarreeya ee caanaha adhiga wuxuuna bixinayaa xiriir beeraleyda kale oo leh macamiil suurtagal ah.

English: Kenyan farmers are encouraged to participate in the EU-funded Market Access Upgrade Programme (MARKUP) to enhance agricultural exports and meet international standards.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa Kenya wanahimizwa kushiriki katika Programu ya Kuboresha Upatikanaji wa Soko (MARKUP) inayofadhiliwa na EU ili kuboresha mauzo ya kilimo na kukidhi viwango vya kimataifa.
Ekegusii: Abakirorai b'Kenya baragororeke kujia mu pogramu ya EU eshiosere omokireri bw'e (MARKUP) ngo banoore omokireri bori b'egisi na babonere eng'enda ya mwakina.
Dholuo: Mab farmer ODM Kenya nyasaye ka wacho ka omiyiemu gi EU ma en gi chii kuting' mar Marketing Access Upgrade Programme (MARKUP) to nyal ngeyo shok maisha mar nyaka.
Somali: Marsadkan cusub ee loogu talagalay kor u qaadida helitaanka suuqyada (MARKUP) waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa beeraleyda Kenyan inay ka qaybqaataan si ay kor ugu qaadaan dhoofinta beero iyo inay la kulmaan heerarka caalamiga ah.

English: Young people are encouraged to explore various platforms for agribusiness opportunities to overcome financial barriers. Take action to secure your future in agriculture today.
Kiswahili: Vijana wanahimizwa kufungua njia kupitia majukwaa mbalimbali ya fursa za biashara ya kilimo ili kushinda vizuizi vya kifedha. Chukua hatua ili kuhakikisha kwamba una mustakabali mzuri katika kilimo leo.
Ekegusii: Abagororia bataraneki nyaki buya kuboranga naki mekwaniora ekibere ya agribusiness buo mwetuganko omokiri. Rekeria amafaranga yoti bw’ogecha omotere bwokiri.
Dholuo: Juok makmana nigi mag'iny kuom chiegni e piny en piny gi chandruok mar agribusiness kuom to onge mag nyiso. Naki kadhi to ne ng'ama ohero e piny mar agrikulture nige.
Somali: Dhallinyarada waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay sahamiyaan madal kala duwan oo fursadaha ganacsiga beeraha si ay uga gudbaan caqabadaha dhaqaale. Qaado tallaabo si aad u xaqiijiso mustaqbalkaaga beeraha maanta.

English: The Association of Kenya Mango Traders (AKMT) represents local mango stakeholders and supports farmers in accessing markets. Join now to enhance your participation in the mango value chain.
Kiswahili: Shirikisho la Wafanyabiashara wa Mankuku Kenya (AKMT) linawakilisha wadau wa kawaida wa mankuku na linaunga mkono wakulima katika kupata masoko. Jiunge sasa kuongeza ushiriki wako katika mingada ya mankuku.
Ekegusii: Umuryango wa Abakora na Abakora Odongo (AKMT) wakiiteire abataka bagenzi b’injiri n’abatetezi mu kurerera abashamba b’ijongori mu gushika ku masoko. Bwire mwegereke k’ukoreye ikirwanisha mu gucashe ow’ijongori.
Dholuo: Japuonj ni Nyasaye Mango Kenya (AKMT) en joma nyalo chodo mango e odiema gi joma yude konyo kuonde. Konyo e kendo to ngeyo gi ngo mar mango.
Somali: Ururka Ganacsatada Mangalada Kenya (AKMT) wuxuu matalaa daneeyayaasha mangada deegaanka wuxuuna taageeraa beeralayda si ay u helaan suuqyo. Ku soo biir hadda si aad u kordhiso ka qayb qaadashadaada silsiladda qiimaha mangada.

English: Farmers in Bungoma County: Participate in the new agricultural initiatives introduced by the county government to strengthen the sector. Stay informed for updates.
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika Kaunti ya Bungoma: Shiriki katika mipango mipya ya kilimo iliyozinduliwa na serikali ya kaunti ili kuimarisha sekta. Kuwa na habari za kisasa.
Ekegusii: Abageng'ani baki Bungoma: Kiana mu naki yaki asagano abatechandani baki akisi a bwaki baki ogendani. Bwakire buineni bucheuri.
Dholuo: Ng’ato mar farmers e Bungoma: Nyalang' kod nyiso mar agri-culture ma okel e ofisi mar county to wacho ng'ato mar sekta. Tieno konyi ng'ato kod oluw.
Somali: Beeralayda Gobolka Bungoma: Ka qaybqaata hindisayaasha cusub ee dowlad deegaanka oo lagu xoojinayo beerta. La soco warar cusub.

English: Youth in Njabini, Kinangop sub-county can explore opportunities in capsicum farming through the Nyandarua County Youth Empowerment Programme. Support and training are available.
Kiswahili: Vijana katika Njabini, kata ya Kinangop wanaweza kuchunguza fursa za kilimo cha pilipili kupitia Mpango wa Uwezeshaji Vijana wa Kaunti ya Nyandarua. Msaada na mafunzo yanapatikana.
Ekegusii: Abagitanga mu Njabini, sub-county ya Kinangop, baria obirire omogaka buseke bwabaka mu omogori busege bwayo bwo Nyandarua County Youth Empowerment Programme. Ria buria neiti naki.
Dholuo: Makar Bantu e Njabini, sub-county ya Kinangop, nyaka ng'eyo ma optimi e capsicum farming kuom Nyandarua County Youth Empowerment Programme. Bedoni gi inuwere kod nyim.
Somali: Dhalinyarada ku sugan Njabini, degmada Kinangop waxay fursado ka heli karaan beerta capsicumka iyada oo loo marayo Barnaamijka Kaalmada Dhalinyarada ee Nyandarua. Taageero iyo tababar ayaa la heli karaa.

English: Farmers are urged to verify seed authenticity by scratching the label of purchased seed and sending the code via SMS to 1393 for confirmation. The SMS service is free of charge.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanashauriwa kuthibitisha ukweli wa mbegu kwa kupiga rangi lebo ya mbegu walizonunua na kutuma kodii kupitia SMS kwenda 1393 kwa uthibitisho. Huduma ya SMS ni bure.
Ekegusii: Abarakua boki bobaki busebu bwendo nabaki konyorori busebu bwaregaki konyaki bworaganja naki bwere bashibe SMS konyaki 1393 busebu bwogoteki. Bwire SMS busebu bwokiri pwe.
Dholuo: Gima ji ther ma ok oting'o kod dholuo gi siret ma oheraki, kendo itie nyaka konyo code gi SMS ku 1393 biro golo. SMS service ni nengo.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay hubiyaan saxnaanta abuurka iyagoo xoqaya sumadda abuurka la iibsaday oo diraya koodhka SMS ahaan 1393 si loo xaqiijiyo. Adeegga SMS-ka waa bilaash.

English: Dairy farmers in Nakuru County are encouraged to join cooperatives for better milk prices. The County Government supports the formation of the Nakuru County Dairy Cooperatives Union.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa maziwa katika Kaunti ya Nakuru wanahimizwa kujiunga na vyama vya ushirika ili kupata bei bora za maziwa. Serikali ya Kaunti inaunga mkono kuundwa kwa Umoja wa Vyama vya Ushirika wa Maziwa wa Kaunti ya Nakuru.
Ekegusii: Abakire na emokiriri mu Nakuru batirire bakesi bende buya bano bwaki bwakwiragia emikisi. Obwakire bw'Enyasa buya buya bwakaboka kumanya bano bwaki bwaki bwaki emobandi ya Nakuru.
Dholuo: Dairy farmers e Nakuru County nigi to join kawech mor ng’ato eyo kanyalre buya mar perek. Chuo mar County wuok to gima otoo dech kaka Nakuru County Dairy Cooperatives Union.
Somali: Farmers-ka caanaha ee Gobolka Nakuru waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay ku biiraan iskaashatooyinka si ay u helaan qiimaha caanaha oo ka wanaagsan. Dowladda Gobolka waxay taageertaa samaynta Iskaashatada Caanaha ee Gobolka Nakuru.

English: Kenyan farmers will have the opportunity to export specialty tea to China, potentially up to 5 million kilos annually, valued at Ksh. 7 billion, beginning this year.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa Kenya watapata fursa ya kusafirisha chai maalum kwenda China, ikitarajiwa kufikia kilo milioni 5 kwa mwaka, ikiwa na thamani ya Ksh. bilioni 7, kuanzia mwaka huu.
Ekegusii: Abageng'ana baki Kenya boki omokiriri obwaki bwaki kinyai buya Burkina, boki minto naki 5 million kilo buya muguruma, buya kanyaga Ksh. 7 billion, omokiriri bwaki omogogori buya.
Dholuo: Ababruok Kenya nyalo bedo na thok kuom oknyo tea mag mbaka gi China, kata up to 5 milioni kilo kidi konyo nyaka, nyalo maki Ksh. 7 billion, manok reri chuo.
Somali: Farmers-ka Kenyan waxay fursad u heli doonaan inay dhoofsadaan shaah khaas ah oo la geeyo Shiinaha, ilaa 5 milyan oo kilo sanadkiiba, qiimahoodu yahay Ksh. 7 bilyan, laga bilaabo sanadkan.

English: Farmers are advised to invest in their own baling machines or collaborate with others to avoid delays and high costs in hay production.
Kiswahili: Makulima wanakumbushwa kuwekeza katika mashine zao za kubandika au kushirikiana na wengine ili kuepuka ucheleweshaji na gharama kubwa katika uzalishaji wa majani.
Ekegusii: Abakiri bano batari bosi bwogekore baisari bwakire buiyaki bwakikore buya na bende bategere buya bwokomore buya ogotegere ogokiri na bwaki.
Dholuo: Dala marach ni dhieyo kuom jowong' kwayo to jopiny chalo, kata nogwe magi, mondo ne owach dhok adek kuom wendo kendo piny machien ma en gi kwayo.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagu talinayaa inay maalgashadaan mashiinnadooda balinta ama ay wada shaqeeyaan si ay uga fogaadaan dib u dhaca iyo kharashyada badan ee soo saarista xoolaha.

English: Over 200 start-ups and early stage agribusiness enterprises have been selected for support in an agribusiness programme focused on women and youth.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya kampuni 200 za mwanzo na biashara za kilimo za awali zimechaguliwa kusaidiwa katika mpango wa kilimo unaolenga wanawake na vijana.
Ekegusii: Abakire baki 200 baisa bosi naki batisibori bake bui bwakuboroni bwebisia bwi atenge naki abaki.
Dholuo: Kagoodo 200 chiegni gi maler ma itieka e agribusiness kendo nyinge giko ma orek bende par.
Somali: In ka badan 200 shirkadood iyo ganacsiyo hore oo ku saabsan beeraha ayaa la doortay si ay u helaan taageero barnaamijka ganacsiga beeraha oo diiradda saaraya haweenka iyo dhallinyarada.

English: Banana poultry breeders in Kenya are facing significant losses due to cheap day-old chick imports. Stakeholders are urged to assess their operations and adapt accordingly.
Kiswahili: wapanda kuku wa ndizi nchini Kenya wanakumbana na hasara kubwa kutokana na uagizaji wa vifaranga wa siku moja bei nafuu. Wadau wanakaribishwa kutathmini shughuli zao na kubadilisha ipasavyo.
Ekegusii: Abere bakarukuri banzana oria batorera mu Kenya baria naki ya gaki omokore buambo bwaru. Abatabukire bosi baribere chire boro bature okomogori naki.
Dholuo: Abato ng'ato donjo e Kenya en kaimor mar abich buya, kata obok gima aoro. Wajeng' ne ok nyis gi owang'ni gi joma chalo owang'ni.
Somali: Dhalinyarada digaaga ee Kenya ayaa wajahaya khasaare weyn sababa la xiriira keenooyinka raga ah ee qiimaha yaraaday. Walxaha ku lug leh ayaa lagu boorinayaa inay qiimeeyaan howlahooda oo ay isu waafajiyaan si ku habboon.

English: Farmers are encouraged to consider dairy goat farming as a sustainable option for smallholder agriculture due to their low space requirements and high nutritional value of milk.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanatakiwa kufikiria ufugaji wa mbuzi wa maziwa kama chaguo endelevu kwa kilimo kidogo kutokana na mahitaji yao madogo ya nafasi na thamani kubwa ya lishe ya maziwa.
Ekegusii: Abagere baisekarie okuogocha orokurenda emarunda yaki nyanga orokinyangia iria abogenda ore ekogebori buya omogaka omokinyanga na enka.
Dholuo: Matiro moko wacho kuom ng'ama waundhogi ka ng'ama ng'ato mar mboch kony. Nitiwogo e yo mar joma udhi, kendo neno maber e yiero mar mukare.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay tixgeliyaan beeraleyda idaha caanaha sidii ikhtiyaar waara oo loogu talagalay beeraleyda yaryar sababtoo ah baahida hoose ee booska iyo qiimaha nafaqada sare ee caanaha.

English: Farmers planting Hass avocado seedlings should follow these steps: space seedlings 6-10 meters apart, dig 2x2 feet holes, mix top soil, manure, and DAP fertilizer, and water in dry weather.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanaopanda miche ya avocado ya Hass wanapaswa kufuata hatua hizi: pandisha miche kwa umbali wa mita 6-10, chimba mashimo ya futi 2x2, changanya udongo wa juu, samadi, na mbolea ya DAP, na pandisha maji wakati wa mvua kidogo.
Ekegusii: Abari buya! Abashuri bano chaki buya bosane buono: igana imbiri 6-10 metara naki, emenye 2x2 feet, onekire okokinyasa oboroti, emosi, na DAP, na nyae buya naki obwamasia.
Dholuo: Bonde uyiegi Hass avocado kanyo, chako iwachni: chandruok 6-10 mita nyaka, tiyo dodo 2x2 kaki, pok aondo masanga madongo, chuni, moti DAP, kendo nigo piny ka ing'eyo.
Somali: Beeralaydu waxay reer fiican in ay raacaan talaabooyinkan marka ay beeraan geedaha Hass avocado: kala fogee geedaha 6-10 mitir, qod 2x2 feet xabbo, isku qas ciidda sare, qashinka, iyo bacda DAP, iyo biyo siinta xilliga aan roobka da'in.

English: Farmers in Nakuru are invited to participate in the revival of the pyrethrum sector. The county government has invested Kshs 70 million to provide clean planting material.
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika Nakuru wanakaribishwa kushiriki katika ufuatiliaji wa sekta ya pyrethrum. Serikali ya kaunti imewekeza Kshs milioni 70 kutoa vifaa safi vya kupanda.
Ekegusii: Abakiru baki Nakuru bairaki nyasa ekereri ya pyrethrum. Obwaki bw’ogusii buhinji bwakaboka Kshs 70 mironji goha omogokire ogukwenda.
Dholuo: Wuoth kachok mag Nakuru nakiwogi kuom golo mar pyrethrum. Ogingo mar county osetim Kshs 70 million kuom golo ma oting' ni.
Somali: Beeraleyda Nakuru waxaa lagu martiqaaday inay ka qayb qaataan dib-u-soo-noqoshada qeybta pyrethrum. Dowlada degmada waxay maalgelisay Kshs 70 milyan si loo siiyo agab dhir nadiif ah.

English: New regulations for seven crops will be released in the next two months, followed by 16 crops in four to five months. Farmers are advised to stay informed and comply with upcoming guidelines.
Kiswahili: Kanuni mpya za mazao saba zitatolewa katika miezi miwili ijayo, zikifuatwa na mazao 16 baada ya miezi nne hadi mitano. Wakulima wanashauriwa kujifunza na kuzingatia mwongozo utakaotolewa.
Ekegusii: Amatenda mayaki forora mirongo ibo sigana mwaki mwandori, na atenda 16 oigorisibori mugetene inono 4 ku 5 mwaki. Abarimaki baragwanire buya na batesane na amatekenyaki abogori.
Dholuo: Reguleta mpya e yochwech mag Nyasaye, kendo okanyang' gi mapile mar crops moko ochiko gi mwakiyogo abich, kendo 16 crop kendo okanyal gi mwakiyogo abich ka 4 to 5. Abor gi lwedo kuom joma nigi kony tich kendo omiya gi tih ranyisi.
Somali: Shuruuc cusub oo ku saabsan toddoba dalag ayaa la soo saari doonaa muddo laba bilood gudaheed, ka dibna 16 dalag ayaa la soo saari doona afar ilaa shan bilood kadib. Beeraleyda waxaa lagu talinayaa inay war hayaan oo ay raacaan tilmaamaha soo socda.

English: The National Government is reviving the pyrethrum industry, aiming to increase planting acreage from 6,000 to 18,000 hectares by next year. Farmers are encouraged to expand their cultivation.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Kitaifa inarejesha sekta ya pyrethrum, ikilenga kuongeza eneo la upandaji kutoka hekta 6,000 hadi 18,000 ifikapo mwaka ujao. Wakulima wanahimizwa kupanua kilimo chao.
Ekegusii: Omosh zosibori ogogetitanga buya bwakire buya, kisokinyire buya bwakire buria 6,000 buya bwabaki 18,000 hekta buya oigana. Abaki tokereri buya kwetire bosi bwabo.
Dholuo: Kanyanya Chang'ni oyweyo ka pyrethrum, chiwokyore tinda mar chiewo kendo tindo kaka 6,000 kuom 18,000 hectares kanyakore chuo. Waduong' ni itindo kuom chiewo chalo.
Somali: Dowladda Qaranka waxay dib u soo celinaysaa warshadaha pyrethrum, iyadoo hedefeysa in ay kordhiso aagga dhirta laga beerto laga 6,000 ha ilaa 18,000 ha sanadka soo socda. Beeralayda waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa in ay ballaariyaan beertooda.

English: Achieve maize yields of over 50 bags per acre by using certified seeds, adjusting spacing, and providing adequate nutrition to plants.
Kiswahili: Fikia mavuno ya mahindi ya zaidi ya mifuko 50 kwa ekari kwa kutumia mbegu zilizothibitishwa, kurekebisha nafasi, na kutoa lishe bora kwa mimea.
Ekegusii: Bwakire emosi ya ekegero ebiri omokere omokoretani abwaki 50 kering’otere rieri kendo omokirigana ensenda, omokwenyu omotaki, na ogere ogendori omokuboka emosi.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo chipo e kindu 50 magi kendo kar godo ng'ato kendo jochung' gi kwong' e yo maber, wachon gi neno magu.
Somali: Hel dalagyada qumbaha oo ka badan 50 boorar halkii acre adigoo isticmaalaya abuur shahaado leh, hagaajinaya fogaanta, iyo bixinta nafaqo ku filan dhirta.

English: Nyandarua County will enforce new potato regulations. All stakeholders must engage in sensitization, register farmers, and form implementation committees immediately.
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Nyandarua itatekeleza kanuni mpya za viazi. Wadau wote wanapaswa kushiriki katika uhamasishaji, kusajili wakulima, na kuunda kamati za utekelezaji mara moja.
Ekegusii: Kaunti ya Nyandarua ikore omokiri buya busibori bw'endi. Bwakire bosi bang'anya buya, bategere buya boberane, bategere bakuri orugendo bw'ogorogani buya.
Dholuo: Nyandarua County nyal jomokore kuom iwuon mar panya mokuwa. Waduong' gi waduong' mana to watekna e ndwarore, kony panya gi lweny, kendo wathore nyaka piny mar joge golo.
Somali: Gobolka Nyandarua wuxuu dhaqan galin doonaa sharciyo cusub oo ku saabsan baradhada. Dhamaan daneeyayaasha waa in ay ka qayb qaataan wacyigelin, diiwaan geliyaan beeraleyda, oo sameeyaan kuman isku howlayn sida ugu dhaqsaha badan.

English: Nakuru County has begun enforcing the Potato regulations. All stakeholders in the potato sub-sector must comply with these new rules immediately.
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Nakuru imeanza kutekeleza sheria za viazi. Wadau wote katika sekta ya viazi lazima watii sheria hizi mpya mara moja.
Ekegusii: Nakuru Nkiende yaki otire omokireri omogega. Abaki babo botioga naki ogenda bendo batoshio bwendere naki omokireri oseria.
Dholuo: Nakuru Kanyakla oyieng' kuom wadhigi chiegni. Jotendo nyaka mach ni iwere ikwongo gi ng'ato kuom ochiko mar chiegni.
Somali: Degmada Nakuru waxay bilaabeen inay dhaqan geliyaan xeerarka Baradhada. Dhamaan daneeyayaasha qaybta baradhada waa inay si degdeg ah u raacaaan xeerarkan cusub.

English: Farmers are advised to implement a regular fungicide spray program to protect crops from diseases. Choose between protectant fungicides for preventive measures or curative ones once diseases are spotted.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanashauriwa kufuata mpango wa kawaida wa kupulizia fungicide ili kulinda mazao dhidi ya magonjwa. Chagua kati ya fungicides za kinga kwa hatua za kuzuia au zile za tiba mara magonjwa yanapogundulika.
Ekegusii: Abakire bakiigwa banga omogoti buya bwokora bionchani buya bobiige buya bangenyaki. Gendete bwogotire bwokora buya bunyarire buya menya omokiri bwakiiyaki.
Dholuo: Ng'ato konyi ma gima nyuata konyo piny kuom fungicide to ogend jano dholu gi duong' mar koth. Nyar e yo konyo fungicides ma iyudhi gi gichwere piny kata fungicides ma iwacho kata gichwero lokruok.
Somali: Beerleeyda waxaa lagu talinayaa inay hirgeliyaan barnaamij joogto ah oo cayayaanka ka hortaga ah si ay u ilaaliyaan dalagyadooda cudurrada. Dooro fungicides-ka ka hortaga ah tallaabooyin ka hortag ah ama kuwa daaweynta ah marka cudurrada la arko.

English: The Ministry of Agriculture plans to hire 3,000 youth extension workers to improve support for farmers. Stay informed about recruitment updates and training opportunities.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo ina mpango wa kuajiri wafanyakazi vijana 3,000 wa uendelezaji ili kuboresha msaada kwa wakulima. Fuata habari kuhusu masasisho ya kuajiri na fursa za mafunzo.
Ekegusii: Bwakire bwa Ekilimo bwebore bosi 3,000 emonyaki ya gikiere gooru bwetegere buya bategere batarikire. Bwakire obokira obwakireri bwakiire na bosi bwebatane bwakinyabaki.
Dholuo: Ministriy o Nyuka o Nyasaye oket gi 3,000 yoto yieny kuom piny ma okel help kuom farmers. Nind gi joma ni okinyi nyaka wach kuom recruitment kod training.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha waxay qorsheyneysaa in ay shaqaaleyso 3,000 dhalinyaro ka shaqeeya adeegga kor u qaadista si loo hagaajiyo taageerada beeralayda. La soco wararka shaqaaleynta iyo fursadaha tababarka.

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders are advised to test their grains and nuts for aflatoxins regularly to prevent health risks and ensure food safety.
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo wanashauriwa kupima nafaka na karanga zao kwa aflatoxins mara kwa mara ili kuzuia hatari za kiafya na kuhakikisha usalama wa chakula.
Ekegusii: Abanyabuchuma naki abaki bwakiyonde bataraki bakesi babori buya na buya bwakabaki omogori ogw’airani buya.
Dholuo: Waduong’ mar kanyag’ gi joma chike ma ok lare bende owachni piny mang’anyo gi onjo gi jia gi aketh ki aflatoxins chuno manok to ok gin pogo mar nongo.
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga waraabka waxaa lagu talinayaa inay si joogto ah u tijaabiyaan badarka iyo qudaarta aflatoxins si loo xakameeyo khataraha caafimaad iyo in la hubiyo badbaadada cuntada.

English: Farmers are urged to follow the "4 Rs" for safe pesticide use: the Right chemical, at the Right time, in the Right manner, to prevent health risks.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahimizwa kufuata "4 Rs" za matumizi salama ya vidudu: Kemikali sahihi, wakati sahihi, kwa njia sahihi, ili kuzuia hatari za kiafya.
Ekegusii: Abakung'ana batoragire gukorera "4 Rs" buya bwiri bwokoreha ibirori: ibirori bioria, omogori emosi, mu naki, kugena buya buorishe abaki ba bwaki.
Dholuo: Ngiya mar farmers ka othe "4 Rs" kuom pesa miyo: chamo ching' ma oting'o, kamano kendo mwach nyaka, kuom idhi to wach ginge duto ma nyaka.
Somali: Farmers-ka waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay raacaan "4 Rs" si badbaado leh loogu isticmaalo sunta cayayaanka: kiimikaadka saxda ah, waqtiga saxda ah, qaabka saxda ah, si looga hortago khataraha caafimaad.

English: The National Agri-Food Systems Investment Plan (NASIP) 2026-2030 has been launched, aiming to invest KSh1.081 trillion in agriculture. Stakeholders should align their projects with this comprehensive framework.
Kiswahili: Mpango wa Uwekezaji wa Mifumo ya Kilimo na Chakula wa Kitaifa (NASIP) 2026-2030 umezinduliwa, ukilenga kuwekeza KSh1.081 trilioni katika kilimo. Wadau wanapaswa kuoanisha miradi yao na mfumo huu mkubwa.
Ekegusii: Etebaki buya bwa National Agri-Food Systems Investment Plan (NASIP) 2026-2030 bwakiore, bwakiomania KSh1.081 trillion mu ng’abeja. Abakeki banatire bachi jende buya bwebwaki hia buya bwakiore.
Dholuo: Dala ni National Agri-Food Systems Investment Plan (NASIP) 2026-2030e yath nyalo waki, oima kuom timo KSh1.081 trillion e agri. Omi marach moloyo nyal golo projekto dindo kanyoni udi manjo.
Somali: Qorshaha Maalgashiga Nidaamyada Agri-Food Qaranka (NASIP) 2026-2030 ayaa la bilaabay, iyadoo la doonayo in lagu maalgashado KSh1.081 trillion oo dhanka beeraha ah. Qaybaha danaynaya waa in ay la jaanqaadaan mashaariicdooda qorshahan ballaaran.

English: The National Horticulture Traceability System (NHTS) has been launched to improve export compliance and market access for horticultural produce. Farmers and exporters must register and utilize this digital platform for traceability.
Kiswahili: Mfumo wa Ufuatiliaji wa Kilimo wa Kitaifa (NHTS) umeanzishwa ili kuboresha ufuataji wa viwango vya usafirishaji na upatikanaji wa soko kwa mazao ya kilimo. Wakulima na wauzaji wanapaswa kujisajili na kutumia jukwaa hili la kidijitali kwa ajili ya ufuatiliaji.
Ekegusii: Obori bwa National Horticulture Traceability System (NHTS) bwakiere buya bwokore buya ore enyakira na buya bwomogori bwaki omoka mboga. Abarembere na abashweri bakiagane na buya bwereke bwomogori buno bwokore enyakira.
Dholuo: National Horticulture Traceability System (NHTS) idhi ka gin owang' chalo ki jomokalo konyo kendo dala ng'ato. Jowi kendo jomokalo nyalach kuom register kendo udi kendo konyo dang' ma e tichkuom.
Somali: Nidaamka Raad-raaca Beerta Qaranka (NHTS) ayaa la bilaabay si loo hagaajiyo u hoggaansanaanta dhoofinta iyo marin u helka suuqa ee wax soo saarka beerta. Beeraleyda iyo dhoofiyeyaasha waa inay diiwaangeliyaan oo isticmaalaan madal digital ah oo loogu talagalay raad-raaca.

English: Farmers and agribusinesses are encouraged to engage with KNCCI and KALRO to access and commercialize agricultural innovations that can boost productivity and income.
Kiswahili: Wakulima na biashara za kilimo wanahimizwa kujihusisha na KNCCI na KALRO ili kupata na kufanyia biashara uvumbuzi wa kilimo ambao unaweza kuongeza uzalishaji na kipato.
Ekegusii: Abagere kire naki naki abereekire na KNCCI na KALRO buya nyakidori bw'egama bw'enyasa buya bwendegia omogori naki omokiri.
Dholuo: Dhi ng'eyo gi farmers kaka KALRO kod KNCCI, kendo olok ginyalo higa e gige mar jachien, ma ok oyier e kanyal ni bende inyal uye.
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo ganacsatada beeraheeda waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay la xiriiraan KNCCI iyo KALRO si ay u helaan isla markaana u ganacsadaan hal-abuurka beeraha ee kordhin kara wax soo saarka iyo dakhliga.

English: Kenya aims to increase coffee production to 150,000 metric tonnes by 2028, encouraging farmers to participate in reforms and investments to enhance their earnings and market access.
Kiswahili: Kenya inakusudia kuongeza uzalishaji wa kahawa kufikia tani 150,000 ifikapo mwaka 2028, ikihimiza wakulima kushiriki katika marekebisho na uwekezaji ili kuboresha mapato yao na kufikia masoko.
Ekegusii: Kenya oikire ekigere kiro 150,000 metric tonnes mogwendete 2028, obori bwaki baisekera bwenyigori omokiriri buya bwanokire ne ikigori.
Dholuo: Kenya ng'ato e git kofi to 150,000 metric tonnes kendo 2028, ochung' ni nyasach abich nyakwayi ka en chworo gi tich kendo ka en maran buya kuom okwayo gi gi.
Somali: Kenya waxay qorsheyneysaa in la kordhiyo soo saarista qaxwaha ilaa 150,000 tonnin mitir ah sanadka 2028, iyadoo la dhiirrigelinayo beeraleyda inay ka qeybqaataan isbeddellada iyo maalgelinta si ay u kordhiyaan dakhligooda iyo helitaanka suuqyada.

English: Over 1,000 cotton farmers in Yatta Sub-County have received pesticides and modern sprayers to enhance cotton production. Farmers should utilize these resources to improve yields and manage pests effectively.
Kiswahili: Wakulima zaidi ya 1,000 wa pamba katika Kaunti ndogo ya Yatta wametumiwa viuatilifu na vinu vya kisasa vya kunyunyizia ili kuboresha uzalishaji wa pamba. Wakulima wanapaswa kutumia rasilimali hizi ili kuboresha mavuno na kudhibiti wadudu kwa ufanisi.
Ekegusii: Abakireri 1,000 banye cotton mu Yatta Sub-County bakanirie pesticides na sprayers za kisasa kugira kuti batongore emochuko ya cotton. Abakireri babwane bakoresere n'ibi birekire okworora emochuko na oboteza emishene.
Dholuo: Kaka 1,000, buwongo mar cotton e Yatta Sub-County, wate walukieni pesticides gi sprayer mos mar nyithindo kendo mawech cotton. Buwongo nyaka golo kituo nyaka owach yie kendo yo nyithindo e ng'ato.
Somali: In ka badan 1,000 beeraleyda dhogorta ah ee Yatta Sub-County ayaa helay kiimikooyinka cayayaanka iyo qalabka casriga ah ee buufinta si ay u xoojiyaan soo saarka dhogorta. Beeraleydu waa in ay ka faa'iideystaan kheyraadkan si ay u horumariyaan wax soo saarkooda iyo inay si hufan u maareeyaan cayayaanka.

English: The 4K Club program is actively nurturing young agricultural professionals in Kenya. Schools are encouraged to participate and foster innovative farming skills among students.
Kiswahili: Mpango wa Klabu ya 4K unawasaidia Vijana Wakulima nchini Kenya. Shule zinahimizwa kushiriki na kukuza ujuzi wa kilimo bunifu kati ya wanafunzi.
Ekegusii: Omosako 4K uchi omoshang'ana bwakire buya bwakere indambi bwakimari buya mu Kenya. Mashule naki omokang'ana buya ke oseria omokang'ana omokire omonigo bwakimari.
Dholuo: Program mar 4K Club en gima en jomoko e nyasaya rombore kwomgi e Kenya. Tich kwayo to gai chalo kod nindo mar maliya dudi e buni.
Somali: Barnaamijka 4K Club wuxuu si firfircoon u korinayaa xirfadlayaal dhallinyaro oo ku saabsan beeraha Kenya. Dugsiyada waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay ka qayb qaataan oo ay kobciyaan xirfadaha cusub ee beerta ee ardayda.

English: Kenya is implementing the National Agroecology Strategy for Food System Transformation (2024–2033). Stakeholders are urged to strengthen monitoring systems for sustainable results.
Kiswahili: Kenya inaendeleza Mkakati wa Kitaifa wa Agrokolojia kwa Mabadiliko ya Mfumo wa Chakula (2024–2033). Wadau wanahimizwa kuimarisha mifumo ya ufuatiliaji kwa matokeo endelevu.
Ekegusii: Kenya iria inigere omokere ogwaki na Ng’eno ya Agroecology buya oseroketie buya bwa hoje (2024–2033). Abakire batigani omoganga bwaki bwokere bwaki obwakwenda obwakiruri.
Dholuo: Kenya en pi kanyo ma Nyasae Agrokolojia kuom Piny Piny donge (2024–2033). Wanj Kachang' nyaka nyalere  mbaka mar analwa maler.
Somali: Kenya waxay hirgelinaysaa Istaraatijiyadda Qaranka ee Agroecology si loogu beddelo Nidaamka Cuntada (2024–2033). Qaybaha daneeya waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay xoojiyan nidaamyada kormeerka si loo gaaro natiijooyin waara.

English: Farmers are encouraged to participate in the upcoming initiatives aimed at boosting crop production, with a target of 2,118,000 tons in the 2026/2027 agricultural year.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahimizwa kushiriki katika mipango ijayo yenye lengo la kuboresha uzalishaji wa mazao, ikiwa na lengo la kufikia tani 2,118,000 katika mwaka wa kilimo wa 2026/2027.
Ekegusii: Abakire bakiibori kuingira mu mikere yora chireka omogere ogushwakiha omokirigori, na naki naki ofe 2,118,000 ton atiri emokirigori ya 2026/2027.
Dholuo: Lwaki okonyo ng'ato ka kite ma pi okoyogi tek mar duong' kanyakla, ka tije 2,118,000 tons e mwaka mar piny kwach 2026/2027.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa in ay ka qayb qaataan hawlaha soo socda ee lagu xoojinayo wax-soosaarka dalagga, iyadoo la hiigsanayo 2,118,000 tan sanadka beeraleyda 2026/2027.

English: Farmers and cooperative leaders are urged to report corruption and malpractice in cooperatives to the new specialized police desks being established by the Tanzanian government.
Kiswahili: Wakulima na viongozi wa ushirika wanahimizwa kuripoti ufisadi na tabia mbaya katika ushirika kwa mifuko mipya ya polisi maalum inayoundwa na serikali ya Tanzania.
Ekegusii: Abakiri naki ogendo za ng'eno batarerete inyaraga naki omokanga bw'ogwabo buinori bw'eng'eno moke bwa Tanzaniya buse gerwa.
Dholuo: Ang'weny gi jokonyo mag cooperatives obedo ni kuom golo nyaka weche machiegni koro wakwong' kelo chiegni mar gang' chiegni mang'eni kuom serikali mar Tanzanian.
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo hogaamiyeyaasha iskaashatada ayaa la farayaa in ay soo sheegaan musuqmaasuqa iyo dhaqamada xun ee ka jira iskaashatada, markii la bilaabayo xafiisyada booliska khaaska ah ee cusub ee dowlada Tanzania.

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders in Kiambu, Machakos, Nakuru, Nyandarua, Nairobi, and Mombasa are encouraged to engage in public participation regarding food taxes affecting their operations.
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo katika Kiambu, Machakos, Nakuru, Nyandarua, Nairobi, na Mombasa wanahimizwa kushiriki katika ushirikiano wa umma kuhusu ushuru wa chakula unaoathiri shughuli zao.
Ekegusii: Abagenge na abainya bategeneza buya mu Kiambu, Machakos, Nakuru, Nyandarua, Nairobi, na Mombasa batigana kusang'anira ekirori y'ekitengo ku buya bwang'ana batisekana.
Dholuo: Wuon ngeche kod jodong’ ma okinyi e Kiambu, Machakos, Nakuru, Nyandarua, Nairobi, kendo Mombasa bende wakwayo konyo jochung' kendo jowhoya kuom bura mar chako ma wanyal e buji ng'ato.
Somali: Beeralayda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beeraha ee Kiambu, Machakos, Nakuru, Nyandarua, Nairobi, iyo Mombasa waxaa la horyaacinayaa inay ka qeybqaataan ka qeybgal bulsho oo ku aaddan canshuuraha cuntada ee saameynaya howlahooda.

English: Kenya aims for a 125% growth in the pig value chain by 2030. Farmers and investors are encouraged to explore opportunities in this rapidly growing sector.
Kiswahili: Kenya inalenga kukua kwa asilimia 125 katika mnyororo wa thamani wa nguruwe ifikapo mwaka wa 2030. Wakulima na wawekezaji wanahimizwa kuchunguza fursa katika sekta hii inayoendelea haraka.
Ekegusii: Abantu b'Kenya bateganya gukorera 125% okwikire omogero ginene omogendezi w'ihigo oregere 2030. Abakire n'abagenga b'amasikeri bagekire okogenda omokang'ana ogona bw'ekirori kyegire.
Dholuo: Kenya iwacho ni itimo 125% mar bunge ma piga buo mane 2030. Abambo ni pacho ma nyaka kuon yore maler e asango ma en piny.
Somali: Kenya waxay ku hawlan tahay korodhka 125% ee silsiladda qiimaha doofaarka ilaa sanadka 2030. Beeralayda iyo maal-gashadayaasha waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay baaraan fursadaha ku jira qaybtaan si xawli ah u kobcaysa.

English: The Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) is conducting a crackdown on unlicensed macadamia dealers across 14 counties. All traders must register and obtain licenses to avoid legal action.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) inaendesha operesheni dhidi ya wauzaji wa macadamia wasiokuwa na leseni katika kaunti 14. Wote wanataka biashara wanapaswa kujisajili na kupata leseni ili kuepuka hatua za kisheria.
Ekegusii: Abanturi b'Abwaki na Abaria (AFA) baki naki obwaki naki abashang'ani baria b'ekurire buya bw'ageno bw'ere 14. Abanturi nyansia naki baburori buya naki babakibori oburori to bamenyezikire.
Dholuo: Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) owinjo sudhruo e kinde 14 manyien kod macadamia mogik. Nyasaye weng’ni nigi joma ineno nyaka irek e licenz. Kuom wanyalo niw kilu koro mar ahinya.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cunnada (AFA) waxay wadaysaa baaritaan ku saabsan ganacsatada macadamia ee aan lahayn shati 14 degmo. Dhammaan ganacsatada waa in ay isdiiwaangeliyaan oo ay helaan shati si ay uga fogaadaan tallaabo sharciyeed.

English: The Somalia Agriculture Sector Coordination Mechanism has been launched to enhance agricultural production and food security. Stakeholders are encouraged to engage with the new platform for collaboration.
Kiswahili: Mfumo wa Uratibu wa Sekta ya Kilimo cha Somalia umeanzishwa ili kuboresha uzalishaji wa kilimo na usalama wa chakula. Wanahisa wanahimizwa kushiriki na jukwaa jipya la ushirikiano.
