Ekegusii: Bwakire bw'ogokore buya bw'Ang’ana bwa Somalia bw'otangihire gukomotera ogokore na emonyonyi. Abatsena barakarani buya bwanikire mw'onyonga ogokore bw'ogokore buya.
Dholuo: Nekore mag piny Somalia, ma okel koda chako gi ciny. Koro tinye joma thok nyiso to ang'wen kwayo e koda manyien gi ji maber.
Somali: Habka Isuduwidda Beeraha Soomaaliya ayaa la bilaabay si loo xoojiyo wax-soosaarka beeraha iyo amniga cunto. Akhyaar ayaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay ka qeyb galaan madashan cusub ee iskaashiga.

English: The Ethiopian Institute of Agricultural Research has released ten improved seed varieties to boost crop yields for maize, wheat, barley, potato, and coffee. Farmers are encouraged to adopt these seeds for better productivity.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Utafiti wa Kilimo ya Ethiopia imetoa aina kumi za mbegu zilizoboreshwa ili kuongeza mavuno ya mahindi, ngano, shayiri, viazi, na kahawa. Wakulima wanahimizwa kupokea mbegu hizi kwa ajili ya uzalishaji bora.
Ekegusii: Isheng’ero ya Ugani ya Ethiopia emetiegene oria naki bwakire buya buya mwaki buya, ang’ana, oria, ugoro na kahawa. Abagikuri bagikangire ekiende oria buya buya buya.
Dholuo: Ethiopian Institute of Agricultural Research omed gi ten ma piny gini ang'wen goyo kidh piny manie maiz, weeti, baji, kanyaboli, kendo kawe. Abiro ng'wech kaka njanga gini maduong' ng'wonye.
Somali: Machadka Cilmi-baarista Beeraha Itoobiya wuxuu soo saaray toban nooc oo abuur wanaagsan ah si kor loogu qaado dalagga masarada, burka, barley, kaarootada, iyo qaxwaha. Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay qaatan abuurkaas si loo helo wax-soo-saar fiican.

English: The Animal Identification and Traceability Bill (ANITRAC) will launch fully next month, enhancing animal health management and market access for farmers. Prepare for the transition to digital tagging.
Kiswahili: Muswada wa Utambuzi na Ufuatiliaji wa Mifugo (ANITRAC) utaanzishwa rasmi mwezi ujao, kuboresha usimamizi wa afya ya mifugo na upatikanaji wa soko kwa wakulima. Jiandikishe kwa kutumia alama za kidijitali.
Ekegusii: Shule ya Maonyesho ya Wanyama na Uchambuzi (ANITRAC) itaanza rasmi mwezi ujao, ikiboreshia afya ya wanyama na upatikanaji wa soko kwa wakulima. Jiandae kwa mabadiliko ya alama za kidijitali.
Dholuo: Billi mar Nying' ruoth gi jago (ANITRAC) en ga tugruok kanyo maber mwandu, okel kendo idhi ji ma jago. Nyar jaluo to nying' digital.
Somali: Sharciyada Aqoonsiga iyo Raadka Xoolaha (ANITRAC) ayaa si buuxda u bilaaban doona bisha soo socota, korodhsanaya maaraynta caafimaadka xoolaha iyo helitaanka suuqyada ee beeralayda. Isku diyaarso u guurista calaamadaynta dijitaalka ah.

English: Farmers are urged to increase productivity by extending working hours and adopting technology to improve yields. Embrace innovative practices for better food security and market access.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahimizwa kuongeza uzalishaji kwa kupanua masaa ya kazi na kutumia teknolojia kuboresha mavuno. Kubali mbinu bunifu kwa ajili ya usalama wa chakula na upatikanaji wa soko bora.
Ekegusii: Abakire bakiibori bakurire omokiri buya bu na omokiri bwebi na baisarane na teknoloji buya bende nakiobe. Bakiibori bakenyere omokiri buya omurimi bwende gakiogi bwanano.
Dholuo: Abana gik mama kwayo nyiri piny mar ng'ama gi timo tich manok, kendo bur ariyo kod tich maler, nyaka onge gondo. Timo tich joma sibe duto kendo joma yore gi somo mar mirongo.
Somali: Warshadaha waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay kordhiyaan waxsoosaarka iyadoo la ballaadhinayo saacadaha shaqada iyo qaadashada teknoolojiyada si kor loogu qaado dalagga. Qaado habab cusub si loo helo ammaan cunto iyo fursado suuq.

English: The avocado harvesting season for export starts April 2, 2026. Exporters must apply for packhouse inspection at least three days before shipment and submit HPMA lists by March 30, 2026.
Kiswahili: Msimu wa kuvuna parachichi kwa ajili ya kuuza nje unaanza tarehe 2 Aprili, 2026. Wauzaji nje wanapaswa kuomba ukaguzi wa pakiti angalau siku tatu kabla ya kusafirishwa na kuwasilisha orodha za HPMA kabla ya tarehe 30 Machi, 2026.
Ekegusii: Ekiro cheng'ene cheng'ige magendo ekitoka 2, 2026. Abagendisi nogokinya buya buya bwa pakuhanda edesabaki buya buya tiga ogenderi na naki HPMA bwakore naki 30, 2026.
Dholuo: Wang'ni marach owuon gi Avocado kuom jabingo odong' lemu on April 2, 2026. Joguny bende nyaka to gogo ni gin kanyo pakhausu gi boni joma to okendi katimo jal. Nyonyo listru HPMA duto nyaka timbe koro March 30, 2026.
Somali: Xilliga goosashada avokado ee dhoofinta waxay bilaabmaysaa Abriil 2, 2026. Dhoofiyayaashu waa inay codsadaan kormeerka baakadaha ugu yaraan saddex maalmood ka hor rarka iyo soo gudbiyaan liisaska HPMA ka hor Maarso 30, 2026.

English: Farmers are encouraged to grow oilseed crops like soybean and sunflower to reduce dependence on imported edible oils. For support and resources, contact your local agricultural office.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahimizwa kulima mazao ya mafuta kama soya na alizeti ili kupunguza utegemezi wa mafuta ya kula yaliyoagizwa. Kwa msaada na rasilimali, wasiliana na ofisi yako ya kilimo ya eneo.
Ekegusii: Abarimokeri baraki bakiorere emeteri ya mafuta ng'okitogori na siboya na matungulu buya, oreta getamaki okomori matsindo migenanire omotwaki agokiri amina. Nyaki bosi na ekereere, bwanakira banyaki bw'ogwaki buya.
Dholuo: Ng'ato nyaka konyo mbewu ma oilseed, to winjo soybean gi sunflower, ok nyal konyo jomoko ma itigo edible oils. Oduogo gi chalo, niyie kanyere kuom ofisi mar dongo maber.
Somali: Beeralaydu waxay dhiirrigelinayaan inay beeraan dalagyada saliidda sida soya iyo qorraxda si loo yareeyo ku tiirsanaanta saliidaha la soo dhoofiyo. Haddii aad u baahan tahay taageero iyo agab, la xiriir xafiiskaaga beeraha ee deegaanka.

English: The Coffee Act 2023 has been enacted, establishing the Coffee Board of Kenya as the primary regulator for the coffee sector. All stakeholders should familiarize themselves with the new structure and regulations.
Kiswahili: Sheria ya Kahawa ya 2023 imepitishwa, ikiweka Bodi ya Kahawa ya Kenya kama mdhibiti mkuu wa sekta ya kahawa. Wadau wote wanapaswa kufahamu muundo na kanuni mpya.
Ekegusii: Shughuli ya Kofi 2023 imetekelezwa, ikianzisha Bodi ya Kofi ya Kenya kama msimamizi mkuu wa sekta ya kofi. Wajukumi wote wanapaswa kujijaribu na muundo na kanuni mpya.
Dholuo: Shule Mawe 2023 owang' ni, ooper kama owonji ma no efwe chuth Mwalo ka Kenya kuom nyiri. Ng'ato ni ng'ato en bende to kodhi e yo ma nyaka gi tich gi kiye.
Somali: Sharciga Qaxwaha 2023 ayaa la meel mariyay, isagoo asaasaya Golaha Qaxwaha ee Kenya sida hay'adda ugu weyn ee maamula qeybta qaxwaha. Dhamaan daneeyayaasha waa in ay isku bartaan qaab-dhismeedka cusub iyo sharciyada.

English: Stakeholders in Ecological Organic Agriculture are invited to utilize 100 acres of land allocated in Dodoma for organic farming activities.
Kiswahili: Wadau katika Kilimo Organic cha Kiekolojia wanakaribishwa kutumia ekari 100 za ardhi zilizotengwa katika Dodoma kwa shughuli za kilimo organik.
Ekegusii: Ababere ba Ecological Organic Agriculture baria bwanaraki 100 acres ebuya buya bwaki Dodoma buya omogori bwaki.
Dholuo: Dina manyien gi joduma maler mar Ecological Organic Agriculture ma oketho to yogo 100 acres mar tugo e Dodoma kuom dhano mar organic farming.
Somali: Dhammaan daneeyayaasha Beeraha Ekoolojiga Organic-ka waxaa lagu casuumay inay ka faa’iideystaan 100 acari oo dhul ah oo loogu talagalay wax-soo-saarka dabiiciga ah ee Dodoma.

English: Farmers engaged in ecological organic agriculture are encouraged to collaborate with the government for better support and funding to achieve sustainable farming and enhance food security.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanaojihusisha na kilimo cha kikaboni wanahamasishwa kushirikiana na serikali ili kupata msaada mzuri na ufadhili ili kufikia kilimo endelevu na kuboresha usalama wa chakula.
Ekegusii: Abarimanyi bakiingana n'anjira ya ekogorori ndogo banyakiibasi bategere buya na obwaki bwanane bw'ogore buya n'ekero ebiore omokiri n'ensokoti.
Dholuo: Owino yo gongo duto gi buo e lwetgi, nyasaye manok gi ganuok ma nyasaye timo neno kuom buo, kata omiyo gima yeng'i oko e hoore malo.
Somali: Beeralayda ku hawlan beeraha deegaanka ee organikada ah waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay la shaqeeyaan dowladda si ay u helaan taageero iyo maalgelin wanaagsan si ay u gaaraan beero waara oo korodhsada amniga cuntada.

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders are invited to the KALRO Fourth Annual Open Week and Exhibition to explore new agricultural technologies and innovations that enhance productivity.
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo wanakaribishwa katika Wiki ya Nne ya Kila Mwaka ya KALRO na Maonyesho ili kuchunguza teknolojia na uvumbuzi mpya wa kilimo wanaosaidia kuongeza uzalishaji.
Ekegusii: Ababere na abashandi b’ogwenenge barakurikiri omokiri omogenda emonyoria n’okuberenia eKALRO gucheke getakemo n’ogwisori buya oboragania omokiri ogokigira.
Dholuo: Jogi dungo kod dithuor sechego omiyo nyisol ku KALRO kuom isango piny ma 4 mar oywak gi kany alando mag chutho duto kod joma osikore, wacho kendo masindo chayo mag lalruok.
Somali: Beeralayda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beeraha ayaa lagu casuumay Toddobaadka Furan ee Afaraad ee KALRO iyo bandhigga si ay u baaraan teknoolojiyada cusub ee beeraha iyo hal-abuurka kordhiya wax soo saarka.

English: Farmers, livestock keepers, and fishermen in Tanzania can expect lower production costs and higher incomes under the 2050 Master Plan. Stay informed on how to participate in this initiative.
Kiswahili: Wakulima, wafugaji, na wavuvi nchini Tanzania wanaweza kutarajia gharama za uzalishaji kuwa chini na mapato ya juu chini ya Mpango Mkuu wa 2050. Kuwa na habari za jinsi ya kushiriki katika juhudi hii.
Ekegusii: Abakora, abaki-chainai, na abaki-nya in Tanzania mbere bakireri nyakong'anyaki jia ibesibori na nakieng'ani zanki zeraki. Nakiorekianyaki omokirori bwogori gutera manguya omokiri ino.
Dholuo: Walimu, jochandruok, gi jokibond, ma Tanzani, nyalo chako odhiambo kadhi gi riek moro mondo otingo ketho gi tin. Naki onge nyingni ma okinyi kuom ini initiative.
Somali: Beeralayda, xoolo dhaqatada, iyo kalluumaysatada Tanzania waxay filayaan kharashyo soo saar oo hooseeya iyo dakhli sare oo ka dhasha Qorshaha Masterka 2050. La soco sida aad uga qeyb qaadan karto hindisahan.

English: Farmers in West Pokot County can now access the newly launched Agripreneur Extension Program aimed at modernizing agricultural advisory services and enhancing productivity. Engage with local extension officers for support.
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika Kaunti ya West Pokot sasa wanaweza kupata Programu ya Upanuzi wa Agripreneur iliyozinduliwa hivi karibuni inayolenga kuboresha huduma za ushauri wa kilimo na kuongeza uzalishaji. Wasiliana na maafisa wa upanuzi wa ndani kwa msaada.
Ekegusii: Abakere ba West Pokot baria bwere na ibere naki nyasa ya Agripreneur Extension Program egia enyancha obwakire bwemoka bukhore bunyandika omogori. Naki bategere naki abanyamaki bende baria bageraniani.
Dholuo: Ng'ato mar Wuod Pokot nyaka riyo mar Agripreneur Extension Program nyaka remo mar konyo maler mari-gi kuom tich mar konyo ne owuon. Nyi piny gi joduogo ma onge duto.
Somali: Beeraleyda degmada West Pokot hadda waxay heli karaan barnaamijka cusub ee Agripreneur Extension Program oo loogu talagalay in lagu casriyeeyo adeegyada talo-bixinta beeraha iyo kordhinta wax-soo-saarka. La xidhiidh saraakiisha deegaanka si aad u hesho taageero.

English: District Commissioners and Agricultural officials in Arusha, Kilimanjaro, Manyara, and Tanga regions must identify areas for productive agriculture, livestock, and fisheries.
Kiswahili: Kamishna wa Wilaya na maafisa wa kilimo katika maeneo ya Arusha, Kilimanjaro, Manyara, na Tanga wanapaswa kubaini maeneo ya kilimo chenye tija, ufugaji wa mifugo, na uvuvi.
Ekegusii: Abakuri b'amisari naki abashure bu Agikurora mu migitani ya Arusha, Kilimanjaro, Manyara na Tanga batarire ebuya bu bwaki bw'ogende, eng'ombe, naki siba.
Dholuo: Jokulu e District e Arusha, Kilimanjaro, Manyara, gi Tanga duto nyal golo tin ma ohero e higa mar gima e piny, ng'ato, gi kitgoyo.
Somali: Komishanada Degmada iyo xubnaha Beeraha ee gobolka Arusha, Kilimanjaro, Manyara, iyo Tanga waa in ay aqoonsadaan meelaha wax soo saarka beeralayda, xoolaha, iyo kalluumeysiga.

English: Investment and skills integration are crucial for unlocking Africa's agrifood potential. Stakeholders are urged to engage in reforms and seek financing solutions to address existing challenges.
Kiswahili: Uwekezaji na uunganisho wa ujuzi ni muhimu kwa kufungua uwezo wa kilimo na chakula barani Afrika. Washirika wanahimizwa kushiriki katika mabadiliko na kutafuta suluhu za ufadhili ili kushughulikia changamoto zilizopo.
Ekegusii: Kugana na gutenda ekinyanya ni ng'enda ya mwabere ya gusora omokanya bwete bw'Afrika. Abakire batarera obwakire batarere bujige buja obwakire buya ore na orokire bujare.
Dholuo: Inwestimenti kod joma gima chako ni rwach dhok duto ka inyal tek kanyo mawero mar agrifood e Africa. Joma nyaka kik yat kanyo nyaluor kod iwach ni ng'ato mago ni kama ichung' goyo.
Somali: Maalgashiga iyo is-dhexgalka xirfadaha ayaa muhiim u ah furitaanka awoodda cunto-maaneynta Afrika. dhammaan daneeyayaasha ayaa lagu boorinayaa inay ka qaybqaataan dib-u-heshiisyo iyo inay raadiyaan xalal maalgelin si loo xalliyo caqabadaha jira.

English: The government has distributed three million bags of fertilizer at KSh 2,500 per bag to support seven million farmers in preparation for the upcoming long rains.
Kiswahili: Serikali imepeleka mifuko milioni tatu ya mbolea kwa KSh 2,500 kwa mfuko kusaidia wakulima milioni saba kujitayarisha kwa mvua kubwa zinazokuja.
Ekegusii: Obwaki bwakorete omokireri biri misa itatu ya ivagara na KSh 2,500 buya obokireri bwabwenanga buya buya bwi abane omorori batarakire omokiri ogwakana bosi.
Dholuo: Gavana odisore bag 3 million ma fertilizer e KSh 2,500 kanyere bag kuom ngima ngatach ohinga 7 million pacho nochi.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay qaybisay saddex milyan oo bac oo bacriminta ah oo qiimahoodu yahay KSh 2,500 bacdii si ay u taageerto todoba milyan oo beeralay ah oo diyaar garow ugu jiro roobabka dheer ee soo socda.

English: Marga Farmers' Cooperative Society is recommended for deregistration due to fraudulent activities. Coffee farmers in Murang'a County should stay informed about potential impacts on their operations.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Ushirika wa Wakulima wa Marga kinapendekezwa kufutwa kutokana na shughuli za udanganyifu. Wakulima wa kahawa katika Kaunti ya Murang'a wanapaswa kubaki wakiwa na habari kuhusu athari zinazoweza kutokea kwa shughuli zao.
Ekegusii: Marga Farmers' Cooperative Society nakiendo okagoreka bwakire buya bwakore buya. Abakora emikonde mu Murang'a County bagwete obokire biongozi bwachire mwokire buya bwaki.
Dholuo: Marga Farmers' Cooperative Society wan kony koro ginyalo tich gi tich mar ng'ado. Abaki ma ohinga kofi e Murang'a County peer ka wacha dede ng'ama ochako kanyal mar jodiko.
Somali: Ururka Iskaashatada Beeralayda Marga ayaa lagu talinayaa in laga diiwaan gashado sababo la xiriira wax isdabamarin ah. Beeraleyda kafee ee Gobolka Murang'a waa in ay ka war hayaan saameynta suurtagalka ah ee ay ku yeelan karto hawlgalkooda.

English: The implementation of the CMA Coffee Exchange (Fees) Regulations, 2024, is suspended for six months. Farmers and stakeholders are urged to participate in consultations during this period.
Kiswahili: Utekelezaji wa Kanuni za Malipo za Mabadilishano ya Kahawa za CMA, 2024, umesimamishwa kwa muda wa miezi sita. Wakulima na wadau wanakumbushwa kushiriki katika mashauriano wakati huu.
Ekegusii: Kunyasa kwa CMA Coffee Exchange (Fees) Regulations, 2024, kuyabaki kwang’ama mwaki nane. Abaki na abaki benga bosi bwaki chimbia buse bwebwaki mwaki ino.
Dholuo: Ng'at mar CMA Coffee Exchange (Fees) Regulations, 2024, omiyo nyalo ginyiso mokuongo six. Waluo mar farmers kod michiwo tinde giye ekuom eto trong' diana.
Somali: Soo-rogidda Sharciga Kharashaadka Sarrifka Kafeega ee CMA (Canshuuraha), 2024, ayaa la hakiyay muddo lix bilood ah. Beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay ka qayb qaataan wadatashiyada muddadan.

English: KALRO and FAO are developing a new strategy to boost livestock trade in Eastern Africa. Stakeholders in Kenya, Somalia, Tanzania, and Uganda are encouraged to enhance biosafety and traceability systems.
Kiswahili: KALRO na FAO wanaandaa mkakati mpya wa kuongeza biashara ya mifugo katika Afrika Mashariki. Washikadau nchini Kenya, Somalia, Tanzania, na Uganda wanahimizwa kuboresha mifumo ya usalama wa kibaolojia na ufuatiliaji.
Ekegusii: KALRO na FAO boro buya omogogoti orenge otere buya ikereri bujonjogi mu Kisii. Abakire boraganja mu Kenya, Somalia, Tanzania, na Uganda borogoya buya naki koje na buya okore.
Dholuo: KALRO kod FAO ne ok nyaka mwakanyo nyakach ma oketo choko ma nyaka timo ng'ato e Homeland Africa. Wuoyo ma en e Kenya, Somalia, Tanzania, kod Uganda ne omiyo okonyo nyaka tewuok mar biosafety kod traceability.
Somali: KALRO iyo FAO waxay horumarinayaan istiraatiijiyad cusub si kor loogu qaado ganacsiga xoolaha Bariga Afrika. Dadka danaynaya ee ka socda Kenya, Soomaaliya, Tanzania, iyo Uganda waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay xoojiyaan nidaamka badbaadada noolaha iyo raadraaca.

English: Beginning November 2023, workshops will be held in Busia, Malaba, and Namanga to train border officers on detecting illegal pesticides. All stakeholders in agriculture are encouraged to participate.
Kiswahili: Kuanzia Novemba 2023, semina zitaandaliwa mjini Busia, Malaba, na Namanga kutoa mafunzo kwa maafisa wa mipakani juu ya kugundua pesticides haramu. Wadau wote katika sekta ya kilimo wanahimizwa kushiriki.
Ekegusii: Eka November 2023, workshop zitaishani Busia, Malaba, na Namanga mo getaki abenshi bikonyari bosi ekibori obokiriri oboejemo. Abamanya abaki bosi omogaberi batarwanire omokiro.
Dholuo: Bende kuom November 2023, walogore magi e Busia, Malaba, na Namanga oketi goyo piny ngima mag jowinjo kuom joma ng'eyo e dala. Gino ng'wech mara e piny ngima ohere gi nango.
Somali: Lagu qaban doono aqoon-is-weydaarsiyo magaalada Busia, Malaba, iyo Namanga laga bilaabo Noofambar 2023 si loo tababbaro saraakiisha xuduudaha ee ogaanshaha jeermiska sharci-darrada ah. Dhamaan daneeyayaasha beeralayda waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay ka qeyb qaataan.

English: Farmers can now save, share, and exchange indigenous seeds without fear of criminal penalties. This ruling supports traditional farming practices vital for food security and livelihoods.
Kiswahili: Wakulima sasa wanaweza kuhifadhi, kushiriki, na kubadilishana mbegu za asili bila hofu ya adhabu za jinai. Uamuzi huu unaunga mkono njia za kifiashara za jadi zinazohitajika kwa usalama wa chakula na maisha.
Ekegusii: Abagikoni baretang'ire okuigana, ogwendete, na ogwenzire emere ya asibwa naki ogere eno naki ogore oremoka. Omerenda ino emonyere okiretu bwogenda busebu bwemere na obogirori.
Dholuo: Mano maber! Waruon gin chike, buo, kapok ni tije mar seed mar wanga, wang'ni ng'ama en kama ochom mar e gingo. Ruling yiwruok mar jaramogi mar kanyango nyasi kuom lweny kendo jodong' e lweti.
Somali: Beeraleydu hadda way ku kaydsan karaan, wadaagi karaan, oo badali karaan abuurka asalka ah iyada oo aan laga baqayn cunaqabateyn dambi. Go’aankan wuxuu taageerayaa hababka dhaqameed ee beeraleyda oo muhiim u ah amniga cuntada iyo nolol-maalmeedka.

English: Taita Taveta County has endorsed a private developer to modernize the Bachuma Livestock Quarantine Station, enabling better access to international livestock markets.
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Taita Taveta imeidhinisha mwekezaji wa kibinafsi kuboresha Kituo cha Kujitenga cha Mifugo cha Bachuma, kuruhusu ufikivu mzuri zaidi kwa masoko ya kimataifa ya mifugo.
Ekegusii: Kaunti ya Taita Taveta imetambua mwekezaji binafsi kuendesha kisasa Kituo cha Kiwango cha Mifugo cha Bachuma, ikimuwezesha upatikanaji bora kwenye masoko ya kimataifa ya mifugo.
Dholuo: Kaunti Taita Taveta oigo chiemo developer ma ok nyal modhi chier Bachuma Livestock Quarantine Station, nyak e yo konyruok e yie mar nyisruok machal.
Somali: Degmada Taita Taveta waxay taageertay horumariyaha gaarka ah si loo casriyeeyo Xarunta Quarantine-ka Xoolaha ee Bachuma, taas oo fududaynaysa helitaanka suuqyada xoolaha caalamiga ah.

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders in Kenya's livestock sector are encouraged to engage in market coordination and investment opportunities to enhance competitiveness and boost exports.
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo katika sekta ya mifugo nchini Kenya wanahimizwa kujihusisha katika uratibu wa masoko na fursa za uwekezaji ili kuongeza ushindani na kuimarisha usafirishaji wa bidhaa za nje.
Ekegusii: Abagere na abashambani baki Kenya mu inyuokire y'amatunda baria baeng'ang'ana mu kuria naki nyang'anya na emokigori mabe na boki buoka omokiri bwokinyia na kuboka biji.
Dholuo: Jok maber manok gi lweny kanyaluo e Kenya ne okanyiny ei chalo mar lweny manok. Koro owinj gichako mar lweny, kendo okonyo chalo chaluok ma okonji.
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga xoolaha ee Kenya waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay ka qeyb qaataan isku xirka suuqyada iyo fursadaha maalgelinta si loo kordhiyo tartanka iyo loo xoojiyo dhoofinta.

English: Kenyan coffee farmers are encouraged to participate in the Coffee Revitalization Program to benefit from reforms and support aimed at increasing production and exports.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa kahawa Kenya wanahimizwa kushiriki katika Mpango wa Kuimarisha Kahawa ili kufaidika na mabadiliko na msaada unaolenga kuongeza uzalishaji na usafirishaji.
Ekegusii: Abagiri b’ekibunguo bana nyakizi buya kukang'ana mu Ekorokoti ya Kawa kwekugabana na miungano eyabaramakiye okwang'ana okubong'anya ekabuni na ekoreshi.
Dholuo: Ababoli kawe mar Kenya en nyal duto ka ochok ki Coffee Revitalization Program, mondo en ng'ato gi chike buo to nyal chiel e kendo yo keth nyithindo gi kachien gi maler.
Somali: Farmers-ka bunka ee Kenya waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay ka qaybqaataan Barnaamijka Dib-u-habaynta Bunkasta si ay uga faa'iidaystaan dib-u-habaynta iyo taageerada loo qorsheeyey si kor loogu qaado waxsoosaarka iyo dhoofinta.

English: Kenya is drafting a National Marine Spatial Plan to guide sustainable ocean resource use and promote the Blue Economy; completion is expected by June 2026.
Kiswahili: Kenya inatunga Mpango wa Kitaifa wa Nafasi za Baharini ili kuongoza matumizi endelevu ya rasilimali za baharini na kukuza Uchumi wa Buluu; kukamilika kunatarajiwa kufanyika ifikapo Juni 2026.
Ekegusii: Kenya ikorania Onyiso buya buya bw'ekigori chire buya chire bw'okusomeka bw'ogokire na korera Blue Economy; kondere eya ogechogori juwa 2026.
Dholuo: Kenya en gi gikwang' ma-National Marine Spatial Plan kuom chiegni mag ng'ae kata gin bende ohinga Blue Economy; kata mabor gikonyo kendo nigi kuome ji nyaka June 2026.
Somali: Kenya waxay diyaarinaysaa Qorshaha Qaranka ee Badaha si ay u hageyso isticmaalka kheyraadka badaha si waara iyo kor loogu qaado Dhaqaalaha Buluug; dhammaadka waxa la filayaa inuu dhammaystirmo bisha Juun 2026.

English: Smallholder tea farmers are urged to stay informed about this year's bonus payments, which have been affected by external market conditions.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wadogo wa chai wanahimizwa kubaki na taarifa kuhusu malipo ya ziada ya mwaka huu, ambayo yameathiriwa na hali ya soko la nje.
Ekegusii: Abagari batega tea baria bagarire bano ore bakiizire kwororera mbere ya bonus bano bw’ene, bwerekane buya nibwaki ibaraki buya bw’ene buye.
Dholuo: Owuon magi nyasaye ka gi joma tich koro duto mar dipo puonjore, ma ok oting'ore kendo adhiok gi kasetori kuom tich mago.
Somali: Farmers-yada shaaha yar yar waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay wargeliyaan lacagaha abaalmarinta sanadkan, kuwaas oo saameynaya xaaladaha suuqa dibadda.

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders are encouraged to embrace unified agricultural extension services as discussed in the National Agricultural Extension Conference held on September 16-17, 2025.
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wadau wa biashara za kilimo wanahamasishwa kukubali huduma za upanuzi wa kilimo zilizounganishwa kama ilivyojadiliwa katika Kongamano la Kitaifa la Upanuzi wa Kilimo lililofanyika tarehe 16-17 Septemba, 2025.
Ekegusii: Abagere na abashibori bakiiba basagire eng'anya y'aborogori ku naki bw'ogotagorokire mu Naki ya Mwamogorokire ya Abagere buya bwong'ogotiena 16-17, 2025.
Dholuo: Dala gi joma tich agri e nyaka itwalo mondo bende gieyo kech e wacho mar kony kanyakla ma en neno e Ndogo mar Kony Kanyakla, mabor e September 16-17, 2025.
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beera waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay qaataan adeegyada isku dhafan ee korontada beeraha sida lagu falanqeeyay Shirweynaha Qaranka ee Korontada Beeraha oo la qabtay 16-17 Sebtembar, 2025.

English: Ethiopia has launched the second phase of its Agricultural Commercialization Clusters Program to support smallholder farmers. Farmers should engage with the program to improve productivity and market access.
Kiswahili: Ethiopia imeanzisha hatua ya pili ya Mpango wa Vikundi vya Biashara za Kilimo kusaidia wakulima wadogo. Wakulima wanapaswa kushiriki katika mpango huu ili kuboresha uzalishaji na upatikanaji wa soko.
Ekegusii: Ethiopia igebogorie echekenyanga ya kabiri ya Programu ya Kukoroganya Kihanda kka Wakulima abato. Wakulima basorane n’iyoyu programa kugira ng’ohorere obukorino na nangezi y’okohora.
Dholuo: Ethiopia omedh nyaka oseyore moloyo ma timo e Agri-Cultural Commercialization Clusters Program kuom timo ndalo gi joma neno. Joma neno nyaka omak gi program ma okonygi mag timo golo gi neno.
Somali: Itoobiya waxay bilawday marxaladihii labaad ee Barnaamijka Guryo Ganacsi ee Beeraha si ay u taageerto beeraleyda yaryar. Beeraleydu waa inay ka qaybqaataan barnaamijkan si ay u hagaajiyaan wax-soo-saarka iyo helitaanka suuqyada.

English: Private sector stakeholders are encouraged to invest in agricultural value chains and cooperatives under the $300 million Tanzania Food Systems Resilience Program.
Kiswahili: Wadau wa sekta binafsi wanahimizwa kuwekeza katika minara ya thamani ya kilimo na ushirika chini ya Mpango wa Uthabiti wa Mifumo ya Chakula wa Tanzania wa dola milioni 300.
Ekegusii: Abakire b’amasoko batarenda bakenyeria enyinyo mu migoyori y’egikoni n’amasoko matigana munsi ya $300 miriyoni Tanzania Food Systems Resilience Program.
Dholuo: Tichni gi buya ma ok nyisi ni nyimgo chiegni gi tich e piny Tanzania Food Systems Resilience Program, ma nyereka $300 million.
Somali: Waxaa lagu boorinayaa qaybaha gaarka ah inay maalgashadaan silsiladaha qiimaha beeraha iyo iskaashatada iyada oo lagu jirto Barnaamijka Iyada oo lagu Taageerayo Nidaamyada Cuntada Tanzania oo qiimahiisu yahay $300 milyan.

English: Tanzania's Agriculture Development Fund is now available to finance strategic agricultural projects. Farmers and agribusinesses are encouraged to apply for support in infrastructure, inputs, and subsidies.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Maendeleo ya Kilimo wa Tanzania sasa upo tayari kufadhili miradi ya kimkakati ya kilimo. Wakulima na biashara za kilimo wanah encouraged kuomba msaada kwa ajili ya miundombinu, vifaa, na ruzuku.
Ekegusii: Ekafundisi ya Inkaanga ya Tanzania ikareriire okokora mirongo yeng'ana. Abakiri baki chimbire buya na abakora inyakanga babiriwe kogeza okusabikireki abwaki, emetenge, na obwakiri.
Dholuo: Chin kanyal gi fund mar Agriculture Development e Tanzania ohinga kuom kanyas mar strategik. Bantu mar shamba ni agri-business wacho ni oting' konyu gi ng'ato ni infrastruktur, inputs, gi subsidies.
Somali: Fondo Dhaqaalaha Horumarinta Beeraha ee Tanzania hadda waa la heli karaa si loo maalgaliyo mashaariicda beeraha istaraatiijiga ah. Beeralayda iyo ganacsiyada beeraha waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay codsadaan taageero dhismaha, agabka, iyo kaalmada.

English: Young Kenyan agricultural professionals can apply for a Master's degree in Resource Utilization and Plant Protection at China Agricultural University through KeFAAS. Apply now!
Kiswahili: Vijana wataalamu wa kilimo nchini Kenya wanaweza kuomba digrii ya Uzamili katika Matumizi ya Rasilimali na Ulinzi wa Mimea katika Chuo cha Kilimo cha China kupitia KeFAAS. Omba sasa!
Ekegusii: Abakiri abaki na bw'ogori b'ekibere b'ekasi ba Kenia bakanidiga kw'ori bw'ehiga bw'oguo bw'ekirori na bw'odida bu China Agricultural University kubwan'g'osio bwa KeFAAS. Onyaki mwakire!
Dholuo: Kikuyu gima ng'ato mar jothurwa magi kuom nanga kuom Master's degree konyo Resource Utilization kod Plant Protection e China Agricultural University ma ke nyalo timo kuom KeFAAS. Timo nigi!
Somali: Dhallinyarada xirfadlayaasha beeraha ee Kiinya waxay codsan karaan shahaadada Masterka ee Isticmaalka Kheyraadka iyo Ilaalinta Dhirta ee Jaamacadda Beeraha ee Shiinaha iyada oo loo marayo KeFAAS. Hada codso!

English: The government is distributing 2,810 Galana goats in Samburu County to improve livestock breeds. Farmers are urged to allow extension officers to vaccinate their animals during the upcoming mass vaccination exercise.
Kiswahili: Serikali inagawa mbuzi 2,810 wa Galana katika Kaunti ya Samburu kuboresha mifugo. Wakulima wanakumbushwa kuwa ruhusu maafisa wa ugani kuwapatia chanjo wanyama wao wakati wa zoezi la chanjo kwa wingi lijalo.
Ekegusii: Abagere ba serikali banochana 2,810 ebiwori bi Galana mu Samburu County buya boki chimbundu. Ababere batiri biberia bamisekere bumakiri bategotere bikwenda bosi bwenyabaki bware buya.
Dholuo: Gavernoma nitie kuthe 2,810 Galana ng’ombe e Samburu County kuom nyieno mar ng’ombe. Waduong’ kata piny wacho ni ne okeli dhak gima nyalo konyi kuom mudho mabor e odhiambo mar thok mang’ongo.
Somali: Dowladda waxay faafinaysaa 2,810 ari Galana ah oo ku yaal Gobolka Samburu si kor loogu qaado noocyada xoolaha. Ficil ahaan, beeraleyda waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay fasaxaan shaqaalaha kordhinta inay tallaalaan xoolahooda intii lagu jiro hawsha tallaalka ballaaran ee soo socota.

English: Farmers are urged to report any suspected sale or distribution of fake seeds to the Tanzania Official Seed Certification Institute (TOSCI) or the Prevention and Combating of Corruption Bureau (PCCB).
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahimizwa kuripoti mauzo au usambazaji wowote wa mbegu feki kwa Taasisi ya Sertifikesheni ya Mbegu Tanzania (TOSCI) au Ofisi ya Kuzuia na Kupambana na Rushwa (PCCB).
Ekegusii: Abakiro bakiire baberere chintire chire bw'aki murubori bw'enge bwere oria bw'ogusenga oria bw'aki bwere bobi bw'ora bwasiri bw'osetekete oria bw'aki bwere bw'otò nakiye bw'ogenge bwi'na TOSCI nakiye PCCB.
Dholuo: Okwero ma oket e yo ng'ayo mar kanyo kendo joo nigi gi ng'ato ka oting' konyo mar dholuo to ji Tanzania Official Seed Certification Institute (TOSCI) ma kendo Prevention and Combating of Corruption Bureau (PCCB).
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagula talinayaa inay soo wargeliyaan iibinta ama qaybinta abuur been abuur ah ee ay shaki ka qabaan hay'adda Shahaadada Abuurka Tanzania (TOSCI) ama Xafiiska Ka Hortagga iyo La Dagaallanka Corruption (PCCB).

English: Duty-free rice imports are now limited to 250,000 tonnes, with a new import deadline of October 31, 2025. Stakeholders should plan accordingly.
Kiswahili: Uagizaji wa mchele bila kodi sasa umepungukiwa hadi tani 250,000, na tarehe mpya ya mwisho ya kuagiza ni tarehe 31 Oktoba 2025. Wadau wanapaswa kupanga ipasavyo.
Ekegusii: Omosagano bwaki bw’abiiga bwakire buya bw’amatanirika 250,000, na oria bw’abiiga eke naki ya mwaki wa Oktoba 31, 2025. Abakora waki batoshere.
Dholuo: Mizeng' ni rice obet ng'wer 250,000 tonnes, kendo konyu obet manok ni Okotber 31, 2025. Jowang' ni nyalo wiyogo chiegni.
Somali: Iibka bariiska bilaashka ah hadda waxaa lagu xaddiday 250,000 tan, iyadoo waqtiga cusub ee iibka uu yahay 31ka Oktoobar, 2025. Qaybaha danaynaya waa inay qorsheeyaan sida ku habboon.

English: Farmers in Rift Valley and Western regions are encouraged to diversify by growing coffee alongside maize to enhance household income while ensuring food security.
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika maeneo ya Rift Valley na Magharibi wanahimizwa kubadilisha shughuli zao kwa kulea kahawa pamoja na mahindi ili kuongeza mapato ya kaya na kuhakikisha usalama wa chakula.
Ekegusii: Abarebu naki Rift Valley na maeneo maekorere ba nyuma bakenya buya buseka omogari bwaki ng'ende naki ughore naki omogendi bwaki okariri omong'ina.
Dholuo: Abet gi kawuono e Rift Valley kod Western, nogenda kuom nying' adhi mbaka, ka tich duong' gi ugenyi maiko manade dhako ka oting'o konyo.
Somali: Beeraleyda Gobolka Rift Valley iyo Galbeedka waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay kala duwanaadaan iyagoo beeranaya bunka iyo dhajis si ay kor ugu qaadaan dakhliga gurigooda isla markaana ay hubiyaan amniga cuntada.

English: The COMESA Competition Commission is intensifying oversight in agriculture and food markets for 2024 to ensure competitive practices and consumer welfare. Stakeholders are encouraged to engage with the Commission's findings.
Kiswahili: Tafiti ya Tume ya Ushindani ya COMESA inaimarisha ufuatiliaji katika kilimo na masoko ya chakula mwaka 2024 ili kuhakikisha kuna ushindani mzuri na ustawi wa watumiaji. Washikadau wanahimizwa kushiriki katika matokeo ya Tume.
Ekegusii: Komisheni ya Ushindani ya COMESA inaongeza ukaguzi katika sekta ya kilimo na masoko ya chakula mwaka wa 2024 ili kuhakikisha mwenendo wa ushindani na ustawi wa watumiaji. Wadau wanahimizwa kuhusika na matokeo ya Komisheni.
Dholuo: COMESA Competition Commission nyal mar teko duto e nyathi gi lum mar e ogrong’ kendo idhi ma nyakayo kanyir 2024, kido mar nyaka ji ma okinyi kendo poge duto. Ji nyalo pas nyiso chiemo duto ma nyisung’ e Commission.
Somali: Guddiga Tartanka COMESA wuxuu xoojiyey kormeerka gudaha beeraha iyo suuqyada cuntada sanadka 2024 si loo hubiyo dhaqamada tartanka iyo danta macaamiisha. Dhamaan dhinacyada la xiriira ayaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay la xiriiraan natiijooyinka Guddiga.

English: Marsabit County pastoralists can now access support for smallholder fish farming as a climate adaptation strategy. Contact the county's fisheries directorate for more information.
Kiswahili: Wafugaji wa kaunti ya Marsabit sasa wanaweza kupata msaada wa ufugaji samaki wa wakulima wadogo kama mkakati wa kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya tabianchi. Wasiliana na idara ya uvuvi ya kaunti kwa maelezo zaidi.
Ekegusii: Abakorishe bakiire ba Marsabit baria naweka buya bwenge buya bwomogire buya bwokonyera mbwela. Bwakioria buya bwakori buya boti bwokeri buya boke.
Dholuo: Jowi Marsabit nyisera mag joma chwe mang'ere gi ng'ato ma oketach pe ng'weny konyo jodongo masabo. Bwakni gi jomoko mar luoro mar jowi ka ng'eyo.
Somali: Ra'yidka xoolo-dhaqatada ee Gobolka Marsabit hadda waxay heli karaan taageero ku saabsan beeralayda kalluunka yar sida istiraatiijiyad loogu qabsanayo isbeddelka cimilada. La xidhiidh xafiiska kalluumeysiga ee degmada wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah.

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders are reminded that a geo-mapping initiative for coffee farms is underway to meet EU Deforestation Regulation requirements. Completion is expected in two months.
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wadau wa kilimo wanakumbushwa kuhusu mpango wa ramani za kijiografia wa mashamba ya kahawa unaoendelea kutekelezwa ili kutimiza mahitaji ya Kanuni za Kuondoa Misitu za EU. Kumalizika kunatarajiwa ndani ya miezi miwili.
Ekegusii: Abakireti nakiogenda bategereje n'ekigendo ky'ekigabano ekikuru omokireri gwa coffee kiremiire, kugeka mikongoi y'ekidagire andiri y'EU. Ekitokio kiring'ane bwerebwe ikibiri.
Dholuo: Okwany pe tiyo kanyakla uwoya duto k’otieng’ gi lweny ng’ato mar lweny-ng’eyo k’onyi gi EU Deforestation Regulation. Omore nyaka yowe e ndalo abiriyo.
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beera waxaa lagu xasuusinayaa in hawlgal khariidadeyn dhuleed oo loogu talagalay beero kafee uu socdo si loo waafajiyo shuruudaha Xeerka Dhoofinta EU. Waxay la filayaan in la dhammeeyo laba bilood oo gudaheed.

English: The Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA) has set new minimum prices for wheat for the 2025/2026 season. Millers must purchase local wheat in proportion to their import quotas.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) imeweka bei mpya za chini za ngano kwa msimu wa 2025/2026. Wanaokoboa lazima wakanunue ngano ya ndani kwa uwiano wa vikomo vyao vya uagizaji.
Ekegusii: Abagachori b'Abantu n'Enyanya (AFA) bakwete mena bosi bosi bwa busasu bw'echibere cha 2025/2026. Abashoreri bategana kung'ana busasu bw'ekegusii aha burokore bwabo.
Dholuo: Akae gi Chenje Dala (AFA) oluoch gi tere maber makamoro ng’ato kendo makwongo mar ugi 2025/2026. Wajol mollo wacho kawuono piny maler kendo jochak joma ohingo, gima omer riek.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntada (AFA) waxay dejisay qiimo cusub oo ugu yaraan ah sonkorta xilliga 2025/2026. Mashiinleyda waa inay iibsadaan sonkor maxalli ah oo u dhiganta qaybaha ay ka haystaan.

English: Kenyan farmers are encouraged to participate in the new rice seed development initiative in partnership with South Korea, aimed at boosting local production to meet rising demand.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa Kenya wanahimizwa kushiriki katika mpango mpya wa ukuzaji wa mbegu za mchele kwa ushirikiano na Korea Kusini, unaokusudia kuongeza uzalishaji wa ndani ili kukidhi ongezeko la mahitaji.
Ekegusii: Abagari b'aki Kenya barorere gusoma murimi omogori ogwakire waki enikere na South Korea, ogwakore okugogocha omotogori ogwakire omokiri.
Dholuo: Olok Kanya gin mwal gi ni wawinjore kod kuoro mar rice, mwakinyi kendo gi South Korea, kuom nend gi yweyo kendo gite konyo tere kuom bed gi gi kwete.
Somali: Beeraleyda Kenya ayaa lagu boorinayaa inay ka qaybqaataan dadaalka cusub ee koritaanka abuurka shaadiin, oo ah iskaashi lala sameeyay Korea Koonfureed, si loo xoojiyo soo saarista maxalliga ah ee lagu daboolayo dalabka korodhay.

English: Farmers are encouraged to continue improving agricultural output to support food security. Enhanced financial governance in cooperatives is critical for maximizing exports.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanashauriwa kuendelea kuboresha uzalishaji wa kilimo ili kusaidia usalama wa chakula. Usimamizi mzuri wa fedha katika vyama vya ushirika ni muhimu ili kuongeza mauzo nje.
Ekegusii: Abagere bategere inyasa ubere obwakore bujengeka buya busibori okwigana omogusii. Omogore bori obwakireri mu bikononi bwakirete cha kera okwigana omokiri.
Dholuo: Nakiwowe pod nyalo gamo kelo mar kanyadhumo to ok gi jo mwakali. Karanja ma ok ayie ong'ere ni ng'ato konyi gi ng'ato amam e cooperatives piny to gima en chuth ng'ato gi chuth.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay sii wadaan korodhka wax soo saarka si loo taageero amniga cuntada. Maareynta maaliyadeed ee lagu xoojiyo iskaashatada ayaa muhiim u ah kordhinta dhoofinta.

English: The Kenyan government will distribute 500 million coffee seedlings to farmers this year. Primary coffee cooperatives must submit proposals for the types of seedlings needed.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Kenya itasambaza miche milioni 500 ya kahawa kwa wakulima mwaka huu. Ushirikiano wa kahawa wa msingi lazima uwasilishe mapendekezo ya aina za miche inayohitajika.
Ekegusii: Abana bayo eshoka y’ogusii baire 500 miriyoni ya mbiru ya kahawa kumakiri egeserano ino. Abakoperetivienyi ya kahawa batakire omotendi bende bwanaki mbiru eziretenye.
Dholuo: Bunde ma Kenya owinjigo 500 million epuonj ohala gi joma wacho jaker. Jomoko ma oseth epuonj ohala dhako nyaka nyal tikni proposal ma okabich aoriongi.
Somali: Dowladda Kenyan waxay faafin doontaa 500 milyan oo geed iyo beer qaxwo ah sanadkan. Ururada aasaasiga ah ee qaxwada waa inay soo gudbiyaan soo-jeedimo noocyada dhirta loo baahan yahay.

English: The government is piloting an Animal Identification and Traceability System (ANTITRAC) to improve livestock management. Expect nationwide rollout soon; ensure your animals are registered.
Kiswahili: Serikali inaanzisha mfumo wa Utambuzi na Ufuatiliaji wa Mifugo (ANTITRAC) kuboresha usimamizi wa wanyama. Tarajia kuanzishwa kwa kitaifa hivi karibuni; hakikisha mifugo yako imeandikishwa.
Ekegusii: Oria ogenda omosibiri ekiga na Omosera Ochire (ANTITRAC) okubwenuya oboreri bwenge. Naki buya bwakire omogenda, omokore buya buora bwendo bwanga naki.
Dholuo: Jungo okonyo tich mag kit duto ka tichni ng'ato mar Animal Identification and Traceability System (ANTITRAC) kuwe tichogo manieka ma ng'ombe. Tichno yieng' mar piny; tiyo nyiso ng'ombe dako.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay tijaabinaysaa Nidaamka Aqoonsiga iyo Raadiyaha Xoolaha (ANTITRAC) si loo hagaajiyo maaraynta xoolaha. Sug in la hirgeliyo guud ahaan dalka dhawaan; hubi in xoolahaaga la diiwaangeliyo.

English: Farmers are urged to cease the use of hazardous pesticides that harm food safety and the ecosystem as the government phases out these products. Ensure compliance with the ban to protect consumer health.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanashauriwa kuacha matumizi ya viuatilifu hatari vinavyohatarisha usalama wa chakula na mfumo ikolojia kwani serikali inaondoa bidhaa hizi. Hakikisha unafuata amri hii kulinda afya ya watumiaji.
Ekegusii: Abakiri baisang'ana boko omokireri bwiire buse wege na bienyisia obwakorechire abwaki obwakire bwaki buse burokorere bwigere. Naki mwakiigena ogendaki obwakire buse bobwaki bwobaangi.
Dholuo: Omuoyo wadhiyo kendo riyo ka chak moloyo ni gisebedo kendo gima giyudo marondruok. Wathogruok ka chier gima olero mamoko bende piny maruok.
Somali: Farmers waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay joojiyaan isticmaalka sunta waxyeellada leh ee khatar gelinaysa badbaadada cuntada iyo deegaanka maadaama dowladda ay ka saarayso alaabtan. Hubi inaad u hoggaansanto mamnuuca si aad u ilaaliso caafimaadka macaamiisha.

English: Farmers in Uganda are advised to note the recent decline in coffee prices: Robusta (FAQ) now at UGX 10,000-11,000, Kiboko at UGX 5,000-5,500, and Arabica at UGX 14,000-15,000. Adjust your sales accordingly.
Kiswahili: Wakulima nchini Uganda wanashauriwa kufahamu kushuka kwa bei za kahawa: Robusta (FAQ) sasa iko kati ya UGX 10,000-11,000, Kiboko kati ya UGX 5,000-5,500, na Arabica kati ya UGX 14,000-15,000. Badilisha mauzo yako ipasavyo.
Ekegusii: Abana ba mirima e Uganda baria na naki akiriani amang'ana matire emokiri oria: Robusta (FAQ) ekire naki UGX 10,000-11,000, Kiboko ekire naki UGX 5,000-5,500, naki Arabica ekire naki UGX 14,000-15,000. Nokenye emetegere oria.
Dholuo: Wamochi ku Uganda wabiro bende ng'weyo gichal ginyalo weng'ere nolweny ku coffee: Robusta (FAQ) ekan gi UGX 10,000-11,000, Kiboko gi UGX 5,000-5,500, to Arabica gi UGX 14,000-15,000. Kanyo ng'eyo mar kendo ikwong' kendo riek gi yieny.
Somali: Farmers-ka Uganda waxaa lagu talinayaa inay maskaxda ku hayaan hoos u dhaca dhawaan ee qiimaha bunka: Robusta (FAQ) hadda waa UGX 10,000-11,000, Kiboko waa UGX 5,000-5,500, iyo Arabica waa UGX 14,000-15,000. U samee isbeddelada iibkaaga sidaas oo kale.

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders are encouraged to engage in discussions on eliminating non-tariff barriers in horticulture to enhance regional trade.
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo wanahamasishwa kujihusisha katika majadiliano ya kuondoa vizuizi visivyo vya forodha katika kilimo cha bustani ili kuboresha biashara ndani ya mkoa.
Ekegusii: Abakire naki omokirigi bosi bagana omogenda mu naki obubwaki buwaki bujire bwakinyanye bwokuboneka mu buwaki bwabere burokiriri bwokunyenga.
Dholuo: Ologi mag oloyi gi dhakubo mar kaur maler adhi nyuol eyo kuom nyimre.
Somali: Beeralayda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beerta waxaa lagu baraarujinayaa inay ka qayb qaataan doodaha lagu baabi’inayo caqabadaha aan cashuurta ahayn ee ku saabsan beero dhirta si loo xoojiyo ganacsiga gobolka.

English: Households in East and Southern Africa are experiencing persistent high cooking oil prices due to market concentration and weak competition regulation. Stakeholders are advised to monitor market conditions and advocate for improved regulatory frameworks.
Kiswahili: Familia katika Afrika Mashariki na Kusini wanakabiliwa na bei za juu za mafuta ya kupikia kutokana na mkusanyiko wa soko na udhibiti dhaifu wa mashindano. Wadau wanashauriwa kufuatilia hali ya soko na kutetea maboresho katika mifumo ya udhibiti.
Ekegusii: Abakire buesi bwa East na Southern Africa banochenje bwakiri bwenge busemia bwanyandago kubwaki bw'ekiyaki cyangwa buseyo. Ababere batang'ane buseye bw'ekiyaki na bukarungi bw'ene na kisekia.
Dholuo: Gem ka East na Southern Africa golo marach kanyo duto ma iyien ganda gididi gi dako nene. Ngi'gi koro kaka nyisawa ganda gi dako maler.
Somali: Qoysaska Bariga iyo Koonfur Afrika waxay la kulmayaan qiimo sarre oo joogto ah oo ah saliidda cunada sababtuna tahay uruurinta suuqyada iyo xeerarka tartanka oo zaaw. Waxay talo bixinaysaa in daneeyayaasha ay la socdaan xaaladaha suuqyada oo ay u doodaan horumarin xeerarka.

English: All cooperative societies must file their annual returns by June 30, 2025, to avoid deregistration. Compliance is mandatory as per the Cooperative Societies Act.
Kiswahili: Jamii zote za ushirika lazima ziwasilishe ripoti zao za mwaka kabla ya tarehe 30 Juni 2025 ili kuzuia kuondolewa. Utii ni wa lazima kulingana na Sheria ya Jamii za Ushirika.
Ekegusii: Makiagene ekirago naki agendere naki omokigo bwa June 30, 2025, ntarimi დაიწყეღ. Kugendete nibwaki mu Eshirika za Abagendo.
Dholuo: Ng'ato nyalo ochung' ng'ato wath kamano nyiso mar piny chuo ndalo moro, to kit nyalo chimbe kelo ka konyo. Konyo ni yande e Chunyi motegno ma Cooperative Societies Act.
Somali: Dhammaan ururada iskaashatada waa inay soo gudbiyaan warbixinahooda sanadlaha ah kahor bisha Juun 30, 2025, si looga fogaado ka diiwaangelinta. U hoggaansanaanta waxay waajib tahay sida ku cad Xeerka Ururada Iskaashatada.

English: All farmers and dealers in Irish potatoes must package their produce in 50-kilogram bags as per the Irish Potato Regulations 2019. Violators face fines up to KShs 500,000 or imprisonment.
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wafanyabiashara wote wa viazi vya Ireland wanatakiwa kufunga mazao yao katika mifuko ya kilogramu 50 kulingana na Kanuni za Viazi vya Ireland 2019. Wanaoenda kinyume wanakabiliwa na faini ya hadi KShs 500,000 au kifungo.
Ekegusii: Abakora mu oria buya bwa Irish potatoes naki abashang'ani ba ogenda nyorokinyega oria banga 50-kilogram eshang'ani bategetete buya bwa Irish Potato Regulations 2019. Abaki naki bakora biwaki babuikire bwakire buya naki bainego bosi bwakire KShs 500,000 naki bangechokire.
Dholuo: Gik mang'eny motegno kendo jomoko mane okonyre e joma irish potatoes nyalo timo tindi kendo e 50-kilogram bags maler ka oting'o ni ma Irish Potato Regulations 2019. Jomoko ma oket gigo chutho ka nyalo tinde buol KShs 500,000 manok kendo kwe.
Somali: Dhammaan beeraleyda iyo ganacsatada baradhada Iiri ayaa waajib ah inay ku xiraan alaabtooda boorsooyin miisaankoodu yahay 50 kiilogaraam sida ku xusan Sharciga Baradhada Iiri ee 2019. Kuwooda ka baxsan sharciga waxay wajihi doonaan ganaaxyo gaadhaya KShs 500,000 ama xabsi.

English: Kenyan youth can gain international farm experience by applying for the Seasonal Workers Scheme (SWS) in the UK. Interested individuals should contact the Kenya School of Agriculture for details.
Kiswahili: Vijana wa Kenya wanaweza kupata uzoefu wa kimataifa wa kilimo kwa kuomba Mpango wa Wafanyakazi wa Msimu (SWS) nchini Uingereza. Wale wanaovutiwa wanapaswa kuwasiliana na Shule ya Kilimo ya Kenya kwa maelezo zaidi.
Ekegusii: Abagere bakiogenda bano buya bokuwa na obokire bwakirombo mu nsi ya UK naki bwakiabere buya obokanganya ku Seasonal Workers Scheme (SWS). Abakire buya batoria baisekere ku Kenya School of Agriculture buya bagirire amakomokiri.
Dholuo: Nyoung' Kenya neno ongi wiyogo gi pacho mar kambi duto ka wawinjore kadhiyo Seasonal Workers Scheme (SWS) e UK. K'oriyo ka in gi chike, nitie konyo ku Kenya School of Agriculture kuom dipo.
Somali: Dhalinyarada Kenya waxay ka heli karaan khibrad caalami ah xagga beerta iyagoo codsanaya Barnaamijka Shaqaalaha Xilliga (SWS) ee UK. Qof kasta oo danaynaya waa inuu la xiriiro Dugsiga Beeraha ee Kenya si uu u helo faahfaahin.

English: The COMESA region is working to harmonize seed laws to improve access to quality seeds for smallholder farmers. Stay informed about upcoming regulations that may affect your farming practices.
Kiswahili: Regionu ya COMESA inaendelea kufanya kazi kuunganisha sheria za mbegu ili kuboresha ufikiaji wa mbegu bora kwa wakulima wadogo. Kuwa na habari kuhusu kanuni zitakazokuja ambazo zinaweza kuathiri mazoea yako ya kilimo.
Ekegusii: Ekibiri cha COMESA kitaria gusere burokore bwaki bwa mbegu omobsurori chinyang'ania okogikere abaki badi bwege. Emokere omogendele okorora ng'enda bwakire bwaki bwaki bwokore bwokogega.
Dholuo: Komoya COMESA nyaka wachar mar seed kuom chalo ma okinyi nyaka inogi mwandu koding'gi meyo gi kendo mbaka giwa chalo magi to omenyo. Nango dhok e yo ma okinyi no naneno to otony ni mago.
Somali: Gobolka COMESA wuxuu ka shaqeynayaa in uu mideeyo sharciyada abuurka si loo hagaajiyo helitaanka abuur tayo leh oo ay isticmaalaan beeraleyda yaryar. La soco xeerarka soo socda ee saameyn kara dhaqamadaada beeraleyda.

English: Egerton University is revitalizing 4K Clubs in ten schools in Njoro Sub-County, offering training in sustainable agriculture for students and school administrators.
Kiswahili: Chuo Kikuu cha Egerton kinafufua Klabu za 4K katika shule kumi katika Kaunti Ndogo ya Njoro, kikiwapa mafunzo kuhusu kilimo endelevu wanafunzi na wasimamizi wa shule.
Ekegusii: Egerton University oria 4K Clubs bwakire burokore buya nchechumi buya mu kosi 10 bwaki Njoro Sub-County, nakiabaki itekeri mu oria buya ogenda naki oria buya.
Dholuo: Egerton University en gi kit chalo 4K ma e yo konyo ma dhok muma e sukulu kendo ni Njoro Sub-County, oyieyo wende e ng'wech mar chako mar lweni kendo ma jaber gi sukulu.
Somali: Jaamacadda Egerton waxay dib u soo nooleynaysaa Naadiyada 4K ee toban dugsiyo oo ku yaal Njoro Sub-County, iyadoo bixineysa tababaro ku saabsan beeraha waara ardayda iyo maamulayaasha dugsiyada.

English: The FINAS 2025 Conference on sustainable agri-food financing will take place at KICC, Nairobi from May 20-22, 2025. All stakeholders in agriculture are encouraged to participate.
Kiswahili: Konferensi ya FINAS 2025 kuhusu ufadhili wa kilimo na chakula endelevu itafanyika KICC, Nairobi kuanzia Mei 20-22, 2025. Wadau wote katika sekta ya kilimo wanahamizika kushiriki.
Ekegusii: Conference ya FINAS 2025 kuzigana na ufadhili wa mazao ya kilimo itafanyika KICC, Nairobi kuanzia Mei 20-22, 2025. Wote wenye uzito katika kilimo wanahimizwa kujihusisha.
Dholuo: Konferensi FINAS 2025 ma okawgi kuom gin konyo ma nyalo pingo gi piny ma dhok-gi ni bura machien nyaka nyibni KICC, Nairobi, kuom May 20-22, 2025. Ng’ato gi gambe mane owuon kuom gin masomo no nyal nyal.
Somali: Shirka FINAS 2025 ee ku saabsan maal-galinta cuntada waarta wuxuu ka dhici doonaa KICC, Nairobi laga bilaabo May 20-22, 2025. Dhammaan daneeyayaasha beeraha waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay ka qeyb qaataan.

English: Saccos in Kenya have reached KSh1.8 trillion in total assets, ensuring members' funds are safe. Members are encouraged to continue leveraging cooperative financial services.
Kiswahili: Saccos nchini Kenya zimefikia KSh1.8 trilioni katika mali jumla, kuhakikisha fedha za wanachama ziko salama. Wanachama wanahimizwa kuendelea kutumia huduma za kifedha za ushirika.
Ekegusii: Saccos mu Kenya zikiria KSh1.8 trillion mu assets, bw'ogori buya bu ikinyore entarire y'abo. Abamwaki barakiire kwong'oreza huduma dya mali dya cooperativ.
Dholuo: Saccos e Kenya nyalo gin KSh1.8 trillion e dhano duto, kuonge tich mag jowadgi. Jowadgi nyalo ndege kuonde oda mar chieg mar bangu.
Somali: Saccos-ka Kenya ayaa gaadhay KSh1.8 trillion hantidooda guud, taasoo hubineysa in lacagta xubnaha ay ammaan tahay. Xubnaha waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay sii wataan ka faa'iidaysiga adeegyada maaliyadda iskaashatada.

English: Farmers are encouraged to participate in initiatives aimed at boosting rice production in Kenya to attain self-sufficiency. Engage with local agricultural programs for support and resources.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanah encouraged kushiriki katika miradi iliyoaimiwa kuongeza uzalishaji wa mchele nchini Kenya ili kufikiwa kujitosheleza. Ushirikiane na mipango ya kilimo ya eneo lako kwa msaada na rasilimali.
Ekegusii: Abagari bakenyete kweng'ana matuga agatwakiire kuongezesia kachienyanga kirokoroto mu Kenya kugira okirere omogoya. Nakiire buya na mashiramo g'ekiragano chire na mugango.
Dholuo: Chiegni ng'ato nyaka koter ndalo mar risi kuom Kenya kanyakre kaka nyaka kawuono. Kanyoni gi duka mag nyakazi ma en kuom nyaka chalo.
Somali: Beeralayda waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay ka qaybqaataan mashaariic lagu xoojinayo wax-soosaarka hadhuudhka ee Kenya si loo gaadho madaxbannaani. La xiriir barnaamijyada deegaanka ee beeraleyda si aad u hesho taageero iyo agab.

English: Mozambique's new e-Phyto system is now operational for agricultural exporters, streamlining phytosanitary certifications. Use the platform for faster processing and compliance with global trade standards.
Kiswahili: Mfumo mpya wa e-Phyto wa Msumbiji sasa unafanya kazi kwa wauzaji wa kilimo, ukiimarisha uthibitisho wa afya za mimea. Tumieni jukwaa hili kwa usindikaji wa haraka na kufuata viwango vya biashara vya kimataifa.
Ekegusii: E-Phyto ya Mozambique ni ya kazi sasa kwa abogire buya, iketire obatabasire bw'abiandu. Ria omogoti uyu oria ore akireri na oria ikibuki omosi na obwakire bw'osi.
Dholuo: E-Phyto system nyaka e tich Mozambique ng'iyo amata e piny ma okonyo, nyal chiwo nyithindo mar phytosanitary. Konyo orwaki en gi pus gi ng'ato mar buo madong' kendo ber mana mag tic.
Somali: Nidaamka cusub ee e-Phyto ee Mozambique ayaa hadda shaqeynaya oo loo isticmaali karaa dhoofiyeyaasha beeraha, isagoo fududeynaya shahaadooyinka caafimaadka dhirta. Isticmaal madal si aad u hesho habraac degdeg ah oo waafaqsan heerarka ganacsiga caalamiga ah.

English: All 142 tea factories in Kenya will soon be allowed to sell directly to international buyers, boosting earnings for tea farmers. Stay informed for further details on implementation.
Kiswahili: Kiwanda zote 142 za chai nchini Kenya hivi karibuni zitaruhusiwa kuuza moja kwa moja kwa wanunuzi wa kimataifa, kuongeza mapato kwa wakulima wa chai. Fuata habari zaidi kuhusu utekelezaji.
Ekegusii: Maki 142 mashine ya chai buya Kenya matego ogetenge kuigoja bori na bitana binyashinge, naki diseke buga moshamba wa chai. Naki obori buya mwaki bwiitho buya bwesihanu.
Dholuo: Nyaru bende 142 teefat na Kenya bende owinjire kuom itiyo joma oting'o to joma magweno, konyelo makelo kwom joma teefarmer. Teko hinyu kuom idhi bende.
Somali: Dhammaan 142 warshadaha shaaha ee Kenya ayaa dhawaan loo oggolaan doonaa inay si toos ah uga iibiyaan iibsadayaasha caalamiga ah, taasoo kor u qaadi doonta dakhliyada beeralayda shaaha. La soco faahfaahin dheeri ah oo ku saabsan hirgelinta.

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders are encouraged to advocate for data governance policies that prioritize collective benefit for African agriculture to enhance innovation and resilience.
Kiswahili: Wakulima na washikadau wa biashara ya kilimo wanahimizwa kuunga mkono sera za usimamizi wa data zinazolenga manufaa ya pamoja kwa kilimo barani Afrika ili kuimarisha ubunifu na uhimilivu.
Ekegusii: Abakinyi naki abashonchani batoragwa okunyora mweng'eri oriri okwigana whana oria buya buya omokiri buya ba Africa buya ikiragania nokubarakana.
Dholuo: Maberek ne wachamo ma agribusiness ok nyal duok gi data governance policies ma ok wacho e ng'ato e gima onywolo jaramogi mar Afirika kendo ok nyal chutho nyamre gi joma e yo.
Somali: Kililmaha iyo daneeyayaasha agribusiness-ka waxaa la dhiirrigelinayaa inay taageeraan siyaasadaha maareynta xogta ee mudnaanta siinaya faa'iidada wadajirka ah ee beeraha Afrika si kor loogu qaado hal-abuurka iyo adkaysiga.

English: Farmers are encouraged to participate in the government's initiative providing Kshs 500 million for the distribution of 20 million high-yielding coffee seedlings to coffee-growing regions.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahimizwa kushiriki katika mpango wa serikali unaotoa Kshs 500 milioni kwa usambazaji wa miche 20 milioni ya kahawa yenye mazao bora kwa maeneo yanayokua kahawa.
Ekegusii: Abagorio batarire guciria omogendi wa buya wa serikali ogotenda Kshs 500 million okoborere 20 million buya bwa coffee bwabaki hali.
Dholuo: Gik mare kanyo ng'ato to omiyo bende ka kanyono yore konyo Kshs 500 million kuom lwak 20 million coffee seedlings ma okinyi.
Somali: F farmers-ka waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay ka qayb qaataan hindisaha dowladda oo bixiya Kshs 500 milyan si loo qaybiyo 20 milyan oo geed biyo badan dhalaalaya ah oo lagu beero aagagga kafeega.

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders: The Senate Committee on Agriculture recommends increased budget allocations to the Ministry of Agriculture to support the sector.
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo: Kamati ya Seneti kuhusu Kilimo inapendekeza ongezeko la fedha katika bajeti kwa Wizara ya Kilimo kusaidia sekta hiyo.
Ekegusii: Abagorie naki abaterere b’egosyoka: Komiti ya Senate ku Gosi, isaba bwasi bwokane bw’oku Bwakire bw’egosi okwongeza bwanjega bu Ministry of Agriculture kugira buoneko bw’egosi.
Dholuo: Ng’ato kod ng’ato gibaki: Kachoge wa Senate ma Okano onyo kwang'ni ogendiyo maber ku Ministry of Agriculture kuchwanyono ng’ato.
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha beeraleyda: Guddiga Aqalka Sare ee Beeraha ayaa ku talinaya in miisaaniyadda Wasaaradda Beeraha la kordhiyo si loo taageero waaxda.

English: The government has banned tea hawking and announced a Kshs 1 billion investment for a new value addition facility to enhance earnings for tea farmers.
Kiswahili: Serikali imepiga marufuku biashara ya kuuza chai na kutangaza uwekezaji wa Kshs 1 bilioni kwa ajili ya kituo kipya cha kuongeza thamani ili kuboresha mapato ya wakulima wa chai.
Ekegusii: Oborere bwaki bwaki ogwaki obwaki buya naki bekarera Kshs 1 bilioni mwaki oria oborere buya bujango bwaki bwakire nyansaraki buya.
Dholuo: Gavumenti orumo gwenyo tea e yo, kendo orumo ma Kshs 1 billion okonyo kuom chika chike mag ng'ato to nyalo yore bidhi ng'ato mag tea.
Somali: Dowladda ayaa mamnuucday iibinta shaaha waxaana lagu dhawaaqay maalgelin gaaraysa Kshs 1 bilyan si loo dhiso xarun cusub oo kordhin doonta dakhliga beeraleyda shaaha.

English: Kenya will host the Agri-Food Systems Financing Summit (FINAS 2025). Stakeholders in agriculture are encouraged to engage in discussions on securing innovative funding solutions.
Kiswahili: Kenya itakuwa mwenyeji wa Mkutano wa Fedha za Mifumo ya Kilimo na Chakula (FINAS 2025). Wadau katika sekta ya kilimo wanahimizwa kujihusisha katika majadiliano kuhusu kupata suluhu za kifedha za ubunifu.
Ekegusii: Kenya egekere Agri-Food Systems Financing Summit (FINAS 2025). Abaki baki mu myaka y’obi naki bateganire kuyeganyega ku Bwaki bujagano bwokogenda.
Dholuo: Kenya bayo kelo Agri-Food Systems Financing Summit (FINAS 2025). Jochieng' kuom chiegni bwere mokuongo kaka ng'ato otergi e nigi ma okonygi funding marach.
Somali: Kenya waxa ay martigelin doontaa Shirka Maaliyadda Nidaamyada Agri-Food (FINAS 2025). Xubnaha ku lugta leh beerta waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay ka qayb qaataan doodaha ku saabsan helitaanka xalal maaliyadeed oo cusub.

English: The government aims to reduce wheat imports by 17% by 2027 by increasing local production. Farmers are encouraged to utilize available support, including subsidized fertilizers and improved seeds.
Kiswahili: Serikali inakusudia kupunguza uagizaji wa ngano kwa 17% ifikapo mwaka 2027 kwa kuongeza uzalishaji wa ndani. Wakulima wanahimizwa kutumia msaada ulipo, ikijumuisha mbolea zilizopunguzwa bei na mbegu zilizoboreshwa.
Ekegusii: Abagere bakienda buya omokiriri 17% omosi 2027 nyang'eyo bokirori bwasabufu. Abakiri bakiendekere kumogogoro omoboka, bwakire omogoria bwakiende, na abogota bwakienda bwasagasi.
Dholuo: Chiga maro e yo kuom yore gi wheat miluoch nyaka 17% kendo 2027, kuom ng'ato manyalo yore chike. Abiro maruk kuke nopong'e, kendo chudo ma ng'ato nyalo yore gi wakore mag gie.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay beegsanaysaa in ay yareyso soo-dejinta Daataro 17% ilaa 2027 adigoo kordhinaya wax soo saarka maxalliga ah. Beeralayda waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa in ay ka faa'iidaystaan taageerada la heli karo, oo ay ku jiraan bacrimin hagar la'aan ah iyo abuurka la hagaajiyay.

English: Kenya aims to increase horticulture exports to Italy from 2% to 5%. Farmers should explore opportunities to participate in this growth, focusing on high-demand products like Hass avocados.
Kiswahili: Kenya inakusudia kuongeza mauzo ya mazao ya bustani kwenda Italia kutoka 2% hadi 5%. Wakulima wanapaswa kuchunguza fursa za kushiriki katika ukuaji huu, wakijikita kwenye bidhaa zinazohitajika sana kama parachichi ya Hass.
Ekegusii: Kenya ikwenda kuemokire ihaki z’amasango mikenya ku Italia ku 2% buya ku 5%. Abagere buya bataragire imirimo y’oguja mu okuhoro esanokire, buya bakirabire ahaki haina ekibori kengegi, nyanaka ebi avokado ya Hass.
Dholuo: Kenya omiyo owinjo to kodhi export mar horticulture mu Italy kuom 2% to 5%. Dala ng'ato bedo ka oting'o mag piny manomongo, kik joma osiri mar Hass avocados.
Somali: Kenya waxay ujeedadeedu tahay inay kor u qaaddo dhoofinta beeralayda ilaa Talyaaniga laga bilaabo 2% ilaa 5%. Beeralaydu waa inay baaran fursadaha ka qaybqaadashada koritaankaas, iyagoo diiradda saaraya alaabooyinka baahida weyn leh sida avokadooyinka Hass.

English: Millers must purchase locally grown wheat from farmers at Kshs. 5,300 for Grade 1 and Kshs. 5,200 for Grade 2. Farmers are encouraged to report any lower offers.
Kiswahili: Wachuuzi wanapaswa kununua ngano inayozalishwa nchini kutoka kwa wakulima kwa Kshs. 5,300 kwa Daraja la 1 na Kshs. 5,200 kwa Daraja la 2. Wakulima wanahimizwa kuripoti matoleo yoyote madogo.
Ekegusii: Abamiller bataria buya buya bw'ekishaba motere buya kera buya 5,300 Kshs oria naki Grade 1 na 5,200 Kshs oria naki Grade 2. Abagatiri bataria buya buya abw'ekirugendo buya bw'isiriganya bataria buya bialia ikiswaki.
Dholuo: Millers nyal tindo wech mar wuok kendo kuom farmers ka Kshs. 5,300 piny gi Grade 1, kendo Kshs. 5,200 piny gi Grade 2. Farmers nyal lwet mokuongo gi chuny mar mbaka.
Somali: Guddiga dhallinyarada waa in ay iibsadaan wax soo saarka sarreenka ee lagu beero gudaha iyagoo bixiya Kshs. 5,300 Grade 1 iyo Kshs. 5,200 Grade 2. Xoolo-dhaqatada waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay soo gudbiyaan wax kasta oo qiimo ka hooseeya.

English: Attention farmers and agribusiness stakeholders: Join efforts to strengthen women's participation in agriculture. Engage in training and advocacy programs to enhance access to resources and decision-making.
Kiswahili: Tujulishe wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo: Jiunge na juhudi za kuimarisha ushiriki wa wanawake katika kilimo. Shiriki katika mafunzo na programu za benevolence ili kuboresha upatikanaji wa rasilimali na kufanya maamuzi.
Ekegusii: Abakora bachi na abashishani bakiishonore: Naki ogenda okorere omokireri bwaki oreka omogori batariri mu busechi. Kiri omokoro na abawachi bakorere mwogekireri naki omoserera omokiri bwaki.
Dholuo: Naki ng’eyo marach gi wathogre: Kayo chike madhiang' konyi wende maber e kachochi. Piny ng'eyo e bura na jowang' chiemo to konyo kido mar moto.
Somali: Daryeel beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beeraha: Ka qayb qaado dadaallada lagu xoojinayo ka qaybgalka dumarka beeralayda. Ka qeyb gal tababaro iyo barnaamijyo u doodis ah si loo xoojiyo helitaanka agab iyo go'aan qaadasho.

English: Kenyan rose exporters must prepare for stricter EU pest management regulations effective April 26, 2025, due to the False Codling Moth threat. Ensure compliance to maintain market access.
Kiswahili: Wauzaji wa rose wa Kenya wanapaswa kujiandaa kwa kanuni kali za usimamizi wa wadudu za EU zitakazoanza kutumika tarehe 26 Aprili 2025, kutokana na tishio la Moth wa False Codling. Hakikisha unafuata kanuni ili kudumisha ufikiaji wa soko.
Ekegusii: Abangunyi b'ekanyaki baboria bende bare kenye omotio ogw'omuabayagire ebiere bikuore nyekarori bw'egori bw'Akogoti Butere bw'Okonyi, bogekora nyaki 26, 2025. Genda oborere n'echindori buya bwanebaki boere ndingo bwen'ogokinya.
Dholuo: Dhohi rose mar Kenya chalo nyaka iwacho maana maler e EU kuom giwacho mar pest managemet ka nyaka koda e mwak 26, 2025, dûru ka wachi mar False Codling Moth. Jibweny komi to yande gi ka joluwhich.
Somali: Dhoofiyayaasha rose-ka ee Kenya waa inay isu diyaariyaan xeerar adag oo cusub oo ku saabsan maareynta cayayaanka ee EU oo dhaqan galaya 26-ka Abriil, 2025, sababo la xiriira khatarta False Codling Moth. Hubso inaad u hogaansanto si aad u sii wadato helitaanka suuqa.

English: The Kenyan horticulture industry faces reduced international market share due to high production costs and logistics. Stakeholders are urged to seek innovative solutions to remain competitive.
Kiswahili: Sekta ya bustani nchini Kenya inakabiliwa na upungufu wa sehemu ya soko la kimataifa kutokana na gharama za juu za uzalishaji na usafirishaji. Wadau wanahimizwa kutafuta suluhisho bunifu ili kubaki na ushindani.
Ekegusii: Ekibondo ky'ogokire k'eKenya kigenyia obwakire bw'isi ikekigori bw'ensubo bwakirori buya buya nyamokiri na obwakire bw'ogokire. Bakirebaki bahakurire okumanya emoti bwanebwaki buya.
Dholuo: Inchi Kenya ewi tich kanyim mar horticulture kendo eyo ni kuom teregore mag pesa amangi kendo kar longre. Wuodhi gigni ogendini kuom chalo mar odhi e owuok kuom chalo mar nyisoe.
Somali: Warshadaha beertu ee Kenya waxay wajahayaan hoos u dhac ku yimaada saamiga suuqyada caalamiga ah sababo la xiriira kharashyada sare ee produksiga iyo gaadiidka. Dadka daneeya ayaa lagu boorinayaa inay raadiyaan xalal cusub si ay ugu tartamaan.

English: The African Union has adopted a 10-Year CAADP Strategy and Action Plan (2026-2035) to enhance agricultural transformation and food systems across Africa. Stakeholders should prepare for upcoming initiatives and reforms.
Kiswahili: Umoja wa Afrika umepitisha Mkakati na Mpango wa Kitendo wa CAADP wa Miaka 10 (2026-2035) kuboresha mabadiliko ya kilimo na mifumo ya chakula barani Afrika. Wadau wanapaswa kujiandaa kwa mipango na marekebisho yajayo.
Ekegusii: Ishoka rya Afurika riri mu nkiima ya 10-Year CAADP Strategy and Action Plan (2026-2035) ryakwereka mwendo omogenda omogorori na masano egana ubwaki mu Afurika. Baishoneri bakenye kugenyeka omotenda ogwokwijira nakiara.
Dholuo: African Union awacho ng'ato mar 10-Year CAADP Strategy and Action Plan (2026-2035) kuom nyinge mar jachula to joge e afrika. Kichwe kare joge chalo mar joma tich kendo joma sachiko.
Somali: Ururka Midowga Afrika ayaa qaatey Istaraatiijiyadda iyo Qorshaha Ficilka CAADP ee 10 sano (2026-2035) si loo xoojiyo isbeddelka beeraha iyo nidaamka cunnada ee Afrika. Saamileyda waa inay isu diyaariyaan fikradaha iyo dib-u-habeynta soo socota.

English: African governments are urged to invest in regional agricultural infrastructure and innovation to build resilient food systems in collaboration with international partners.
Kiswahili: Serikali za Afrika zinahimizwa kuwekeza katika miundombinu ya kilimo ya kikanda na uvumbuzi ili kujenga mifumo thabiti ya chakula kwa ushirikiano na washirika wa kimataifa.
Ekegusii: Abashuguli b’afrika baria biahwaki kuhiga ekirori ky’echere ch’achiosome na nyansonga muong’enyete oroketi bungere mu nyachenda ya bisi b’ogwendo.
Dholuo: Oheyo mar Africa ok nyal be yo chike mowinjruok kuom chitni mar dhok kama obed chike moro e yo kanyakla.
Somali: Dowladaha Afrika waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay maalgelin ku sameeyaan kaabayaasha beeraha gobolka iyo hal-abuurka si ay u dhistaan nidaamyada cuntada ee adkaysan kara iyaga oo la kaashanaya lammaanayaasha caalamiga ah.

English: Attention coffee farmers: The Nairobi Coffee Exchange is implementing new regulations affecting coffee sales. Ensure you are familiar with the Coffee General Regulations 2019 and the Capital Markets Coffee Exchange Regulations 2020.
Kiswahili: Taarifa kwa wakulima wa kahawa: Soko la Kahawa la Nairobi linaanzisha kanuni mpya zinazohusu mauzo ya kahawa. Hakikisha unajua kuhusu Kanuni za Kahawa za 2019 na Kanuni za Soko la Mitaji la Kahawa za 2020.
Ekegusii: Abagorogori b’ekahawa: Nairobi Coffee Exchange ikorere omogenda omokiri omokegani bw'oseki buseki bwa kahawa. Naki naki naki oegera orokere bwenye bw’ekihiga kia Kahawa 2019 na Capital Markets Coffee Exchange Regulations 2020.
Dholuo: Nyasaye jaluo gi: Nairobi Coffee Exchange oseti ng'ato maler kuom njia owang' ni ochak monego. Nyathina unyalo ng'eyo mar Coffee General Regulations 2019 kod Capital Markets Coffee Exchange Regulations 2020.
Somali: Digniinta beeraleyda qaxwaha: Suuqyada Qaxwaha Nairobi waxay hirgelineysaa xeerar cusub oo saameynaya iibka qaxwaha. Hubi inaad taqaan xeerarka Guud ee Qaxwaha 2019 iyo Xeerarka Suuqyada Maaliyadeed ee Qaxwaha 2020.

English: Farmers in Tanzania can now access subsidized fertilizer more easily, thanks to the new distribution vehicles introduced by the Tanzania Fertilizer Company.
Kiswahili: Wakulima nchini Tanzania sasa wanaweza kupata mbolea iliyo na ruzuku kwa urahisi zaidi, gracias a magari mapya ya usambazaji yaliyoanzishwa na Kampuni ya Mbolea ya Tanzania.
Ekegusii: Abakire bwakinyaki mu Tanzania bokire okogenda bwere nakiya, naki bware buya oreteke bwaki buya itikia obwakire bwogendani buya bwa Tanzania Fertilizer Company.
Dholuo: Jokulu gi Tanzania naki otieno tem amaru, bura gi tije mago nyaka, kendo wacho e yo mar tije mar Tanzania Fertilizer Company.
Somali: Beeraleyda Tanzania waxay hadda si fudud u heli karaan bacriminta la dhimay, kaddib markii Guddiga Bacriminta Tanzania uu soo kordhiyay gaadiidka qaybin cusub.

English: The Horticulture Council of Eastern Africa (HoCEA) has been established to tackle challenges in the horticulture sector. Stakeholders are encouraged to engage with the council for solutions.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Kilimo cha Bustani la Afrika Mashariki (HoCEA) limeanzishwa kukabiliana na changamoto katika sekta ya kilimo cha bustani. Washikadau wanahimizwa kuwasiliana na baraza kwa suluhisho.
Ekegusii: Abagori b’amatigori b’Emekiori ya Afrika (HoCEA) bataniorera kurokia obwaki mu gisiigani. Abaki banu bakorera bataraku omogori omokiri b’oshinani bwanake.
Dholuo: Horticulture Council of Eastern Africa (HoCEA) nochiko e yo chike mag horticulture. Wan gi tinde nyalo yore kendo iwuok e council no to nyasaye.
Somali: Guddiga Beerta Bariga Afrika (HoCEA) ayaa la aas aasay si loola tacaalo caqabadaha ka jira qeybta beerta. Dadka ku lugta leh waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay la xiriiraan guddiga si xal loogu helo.

English: Farmers in Uasin Gishu are encouraged to utilize the new warehouse receipt system to improve produce storage and market access.
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika Uasin Gishu wanahimizwa kutumia mfumo mpya wa risiti za ghala ili kuboresha uhifadhi wa mazao na ufikiaji wa soko.
Ekegusii: Abakoro baki Uasin Gishu baria omogori okore bwanogoti bwaki bwai bwanogoti ore abera bwaki naki omokiri bwaki bwanogori.
Dholuo: Aboro ma Uasin Gishu wiyere kuom weche maber ka ng'ato adoko nyaka timbe kende gi kelo mag produce e wacho mar nyalo.
Somali: Farmer-yaasha Uasin Gishu waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay isticmaalaan nidaamka rasiidka kaydka cusub si ay u hagaajiyaan kaydinta wax soo saarka iyo helitaanka suuq.

English: Zambian cotton farmers can now access the Harmonized Cotton Extension Manual, which provides standardized guidelines and practices to enhance productivity and sustainability.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa pamba nchini Zambia sasa wanaweza kupata Mwongozo wa Kupanua Pamba ulio Sawa, ambao unatoa miongozo na mbinu za kawaida za kuboresha uzalishaji na uendelevu.
Ekegusii: Abakire ba cotton ba Zambiya bangaabia omokirori ogwe Harmonized Cotton Extension Manual, ogwakiere obwakire naki naki buya bulia bwokora omokirori naki banzire.
Dholuo: Wang' ni ang'wen magi Zambian nyaka wacho mar Harmonized Cotton Extension Manual, mauch oter wacho ni chike mag timo kanyo kod thum.
Somali: Farmers-ka suufka ee Zambia hadda waxay heli karaan Buugga Tilmaamaha Isku-dhafan ee Suufka, kaas oo bixiya tilmaamo iyo habraac heerar ah si loo kordhiyo wax-soo-saarka iyo waaraanshaha.

English: The Sugar Act, 2024 is now active; it regulates the sugar industry and establishes the Kenya Sugar Board and Kenya Sugar Research and Training Institute. Transition processes for staff are in place.
Kiswahili: Sheria ya Sukari, 2024 sasa inafanya kazi; inasimamia sekta ya sukari na kuanzisha Bodi ya Sukari ya Kenya na Taasisi ya Utafiti na Mafunzo ya Sukari ya Kenya. Mchakato wa mpito kwa wafanyakazi umekwa tayari.
Ekegusii: Shughuli ya Sukari, 2024 ikwenda. Inasimamia sekta ya sukari na kuanzisha Bodi ya Sukari ya Kenya na Taasisi ya Utafiti na Mafunzo ya Sukari ya Kenya. Mchakato wa uhamaji wa wafanyakazi upo.
Dholuo: Kaa ya Sukari, 2024 omiye mondo oket; inabed yo chiegni sukari kendo inyal Kenya Sugar Board kod Kenya Sugar Research and Training Institute. Kanying' ka gi tich no ni tikore.
Somali: Sharciga Sukarada, 2024 ayaa hadda dhaqan gal ah; waxa uu nidaamiyaa warshadaha sonkorta waxaana uu aas-aasayaa Golaha Sukarada Kenya iyo Machadka Cilmi-baarista iyo Tababarka Sukarada Kenya. Habraacyada isbedelka shaqaalaha ayaa diyaar ah.

English: The government is committed to reforming the coffee sector through new policies and legislation. Stakeholders should stay informed about upcoming changes in governance and production initiatives.
Kiswahili: Serikali imejiandaa kuboresha sekta ya kahawa kupitia sera na sheria mpya. Wajitolea wanapaswa kubaki na habari kuhusu mabadiliko yatakayokuja katika utawala na mipango ya uzalishaji.
Ekegusii: Omosome oseria oria bunde bwokigori bwose omokigori. Omosome bwebanagaki ochaki ogenda oria omobori oro oseriani buya.
Dholuo: Chuo mar quaro gi lweny ni serikali iweyo kosi e piny gi ng'ato mar nyamaka. Makiw marceng' kode kethi gi jomoko ma okel gi chalo duto mag piny gi podo.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay ka go'an tahay in ay dib u habeyn ku sameyso qaybta kafee iyada oo la raacayo siyaasado iyo sharciyo cusub. Madaxda danaha leh waa in ay la socodsiiyaan isbedelada soo socda ee maamul iyo dhismaha.

English: Attention women in the livestock trade: Seek financial literacy training and customized advisory services to improve access to credit and resources. Expand your business and overcome gender-based barriers.
Kiswahili: Tafadhali wanawake katika biashara ya mifugo: Tafuteni mafunzo ya ufahamu wa kifedha na huduma za ushauri zilizobinafsishwa ili kuboresha upatikanaji wa mikopo na rasilimali. Panua biashara yenu na kushinda vikwazo vya kijinsia.
Ekegusii: Makiya omogombare buya abaki: Nakiere ogetari bwaki bwekirori nakiya omogong'eri buya buya bwaki buya bwogotirwe naki bwakire omokiriri naki amaki. Nakiere ogendete bwaki naki omorori buya bwaki bwombokire bwakere.
Dholuo: Pinyuru ng'wech gi walos: Wacho rabuon mar buok dongo e piny ma ineno, kendo yiengi chike mar chieg. Ng'eyo buok gi weche, kendo ginyalo timo malong' gi bari mar ng'ato wacho.
Somali: Dhammaan dumarka ka shaqeeya ganacsiga xoolaha: Raadi tababarka aqoonta maaliyadeed iyo adeegyo talo bixin oo habaysan si aad u hagaajisaan helitaanka amaahda iyo kheyraadka. Ballaarso ganacsigiina oo ka adkaada caqabadaha ku saleysan jinsiga.

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders are encouraged to invest in Africa, as Tanzania achieves 128% food self-sufficiency and begins exporting surplus.
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo wanahimizwa kuwekeza barani Afrika, kwani Tanzania imefikia asilimia 128 ya kujitoshereza kwa chakula na inaanza kuuza ziada.
Ekegusii: Abakire buya n'abashanga b'egira bamenyete kutora mu Afrika, buya Tanzania ikirukire 128% omogaka okwendo ogw'ekaria n'otokire owang'ene.
Dholuo: Kikundi magendo kod jodong' e dalusi keth, kendo jochik gi buok piny, ne Tanzania onyalo nui 128% e kople mag piny kendo odhi gi nyisogi.
Somali: Farmers iyo dadka kale ee ku lug leh ganacsiga beeraha waxaa lagula talinayaa in ay maalgashadaan Afrika, maadaama Tanzania ay gaartay 128% iskiil-cunsiyeyno oo ay bilaawday in ay dhoobato ka dhoobato dheeraadka ah.

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders are encouraged to assess and improve transportation systems to reduce food loss and minimize waste.
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo wanahimizwa kutathmini na kuboresha mifumo ya usafiri ili kupunguza upotevu wa chakula na kupunguza waste.
Ekegusii: Abagere na abashimari bakiibori bataraki bwakwete buya buya bwakiiga na bwakiibori kosi bwakiokera buya na bwakiikira bwakiomboti.
Dholuo: Bajaja kod bu chech ikwete timbe mar transport ka tigi koneso makelo mag nyasi kagi gi nyakwang' mar duto.
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo saamileyaasha ganacsiga beeraha waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay qiimeeyaan oo horumariyaan nidaamyada gaadiidka si loo yareeyo khasaaraha cuntada iyo loo xakameeyo qashinka.

English: Farmers and coffee producers are encouraged to engage with KEPROBA and AFA for support and training in expanding and diversifying coffee exports.
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wazalishaji wa kahawa wanahimizwa kuwasiliana na KEPROBA na AFA kwa msaada na mafunzo ya kutanua na diversifai mauzo ya kahawa.
Ekegusii: Abaguri hamwe na abakereria ikawa barashikwa kuhakanya na KEPROBA na AFA kugira bahwanyane na omogori buya naki naki mosi obwakubaga ichenga naki obukuirania bw’ikawa.
Dholuo: Ababi nigi kuom kuom KEPROBA mar AFA, obedi kuom konyo mag ng'ato kendo gi pier ariyo kuom wach buya gi oleko mar konyo gi piny.
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo soo saareyaasha kafee waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay la xiriiraan KEPROBA iyo AFA si ay u helaan taageero iyo tababar ku saabsan ballaarinta iyo kala duwanaanta dhoofinta kafee.

English: COMESA has finalized new Sanitary and Phytosanitary (SPS) regulations to improve trade in food and agricultural products among Member States. Stay informed on the upcoming approval process.
Kiswahili: COMESA imekamilisha kanuni mpya za Usanifu na Utafiti wa Mimea (SPS) kuboresha biashara ya chakula na mazao kati ya Nchi Wanachama. Kuwa na taarifa kuhusu mchakato wa idhini utakaofuatia.
Ekegusii: COMESA omoketete ogokore omogenda na Omoshikagano buya (SPS) oria atigire omogende buya mu buya bw’onyaki na bw’ogenda bwenyenye. Omochokere buya omokore oria osokire kutiringana.
Dholuo: COMESA omiye piny gi ng'ato mar Sanitary and Phytosanitary (SPS) ma okonyo konyo joma nyalowa gi chakre gi dhako among boma mamoko. Nindogi kuom ng'ato mar inyal me kech kuon konyo.
Somali: COMESA waxay dhammaystirtay xeerar cusub oo Sanitary and Phytosanitary (SPS) ah si loo hagaajiyo ganacsiga cuntooyinka iyo alaabada beeraaha ee Dowladaha Xubnaha. La soco habka ansixin ee soo socda.

English: The Comesa Competition Commission is taking measures to protect farmers from anti-competitive practices that arise from company mergers in the agriculture sector.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Ushindani ya COMESA inachukua hatua kuwalinda wakulima dhidi ya tabia zisizo za ushindani zinazotokana na muungano wa kampuni katika sekta ya kilimo.
Ekegusii: Komisheni ya Ushindani ya Comesa inachukua hatua kulinda wakulima kutokana na tabia zisizo za ushindani zinazotokea kutokana na muungano wa kampuni katika sekta ya kilimo.
Dholuo: Komishini ya Makiwongo ya COMESA nongo timo manyien gi jaluo mag konyo ng'ato mar konyo ni e chunya matendo ma konyo jaluo bende e sekta mar inyo.
Somali: Guddiga Tartanka Comesa waxay qaadayaa tallaabooyin si ay u ilaaliso beeraleyda ka hortagga dhaqanada aan tartanka ahayn ee ka dhasha is-dhexgalka shirkadaha ee qaybta agriculture-ka.

English: New members appointed to the Board of Directors of New Kenya Co-operative Creameries Limited are Ndemo Nyachae, Dr. Rawlynce Bett, Naisula Keko, and Sarah Keino, effective August 6, 2024.
