Kiswahili: Wajumbe wapya wamewekwa katika Bodi ya Wakurugenzi wa New Kenya Co-operative Creameries Limited ni Ndemo Nyachae, Dkt. Rawlynce Bett, Naisula Keko, na Sarah Keino, kuanzia Agosti 6, 2024.
Ekegusii: Abaki bantarenda bano naki boroya bosi bwaki New Kenya Co-operative Creameries Limited ni Ndemo Nyachae, Dr. Rawlynce Bett, Naisula Keko, na Sarah Keino, obwakire bw' August 6, 2024.
Dholuo: Nyang' awach koro kuom Board of Directors mar New Kenya Co-operative Creameries Limited ne Ndemo Nyachae, Dr. Rawlynce Bett, Naisula Keko, gi Sarah Keino, en gieny 6, 2024.
Somali: Xubno cusub ayaa loo magacaabay Golaha Maamulka ee New Kenya Co-operative Creameries Limited, kuwaas oo ah Ndemo Nyachae, Dr. Rawlynce Bett, Naisula Keko, iyo Sarah Keino, taas oo dhaqan galaysa 6-da Agoosto, 2024.

English: The nomination of Dr. Andrew Mwihia Karanja as Cabinet Secretary for the Ministry of Agriculture has been endorsed by various agricultural organizations.
Kiswahili: Uteuzi wa Dkt. Andrew Mwihia Karanja kama Waziri wa Wizara ya Kilimo umepokewa na mashirika mbalimbali ya kilimo.
Ekegusii: Ogotogetia Dr. Andrew Mwihia Karanja enyi Cabinet Secretary waki Ministry of Agriculture omokire buya oriarankio buya omogaka.
Dholuo: Nominations mar Dr. Andrew Mwihia Karanja ni dako okang' kanyakla mar Ministry of Agriculture kendo ng'ato manono mar joma agri.
Somali: Dr. Andrew Mwihia Karanja ayaa lagu taageeray in loo magacaabo Xoghayaha Golaha Wasiirada ee Wasaaradda Beeraha hay'ado beereed kala duwan.

English: Farmers are urged to properly dispose of empty pesticide containers to prevent health hazards. Participate in training sessions organized by aak-GROW for safe disposal methods.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahimizwa kutupa vizuri vyombo vya wadudu vilivyo tupu ili kuzuia hatari za kiafya. Shiriki katika mafunzo yanayopangwa na aak-GROW kuhusu mbinu salama za kutupa.
Ekegusii: Abakorei batoranigwa otwaki bware buya bukora obwakireri oburaganye buya bware buya tosha naki ogokora. Menwete mu masomo abainyi akaa-GROW abe iboya ibwaki bware buya.
Dholuo: Dala tede kuom manyien mar piny e konye gi kotek to ok dongo joma. Piny gi aak-GROW kuom timbe ma otumie manyien gi chike mar konye ohala.
Somali: Beeralayda waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay si sax ah u tuuraan weelasha sunta ah ee banaan si looga hortago khatar caafimaad. Ka qayb qaado tababarrada ay qabanqaabiso aak-GROW ee hababka amaaniga ah ee tuurista.

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders should note that Dr. Andrew Mwihia Karanja has been nominated as the new Cabinet Secretary for Agriculture and Livestock Development.
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wadau wa kilimo wanapaswa kutambua kuwa Dkt. Andrew Mwihia Karanja ameteuliwa kuwa Waziri Mpya wa Kilimo na Maendeleo ya Mifugo.
Ekegusii: Abakiri naki banlage baki kuboka, Dr. Andrew Mwihia Karanja naki ahaki anagwanire omokiri mukuru omokiri for Agriculture and Livestock Development.
Dholuo: Bendruok gi kwang' konyo, Dr. Andrew Mwihia Karanja en konyo mar jopiny ma okonyo e nyim tich mar Ngeyo gi Ndiri.
Somali: Dhalinyarada beeralayda iyo ganacsatada beeraha waxay ogaan doonaan in Dr. Andrew Mwihia Karanja loo magacaabay Xoghayaha cusub ee Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Horumarinta Xoolaha.

English: Narok County has provided 10 motorcycles to extension officers in designated wards to enhance agricultural services. Farmers in these areas will benefit from improved access to extension support.
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Narok imetoa pikipiki 10 kwa maafisa wa ugani katika maeneo maalum ili kuboresha huduma za kilimo. Wakulima katika maeneo haya watanufaika na upatikanaji bora wa msaada wa ugani.
Ekegusii: Narok County yakiogoria baiskeli 10 buokire buhenye muoragani bwakibori bwogikosi bosi bujakenye emoyonene y’obururi. Abagikosi bu buoragani bonyanaga bungi bujoge obwoiyaki bwi emoyonene bwokibori.
Dholuo: Narok County atiyo 10 maloch to ema nyal piny gi ochan makende e wadi mopriyo mokwongo kendo ineno pinje konyo mar kembar. Masinde e kende herebore nahin goyo konyo makende.
Somali: Degmada Narok waxay siisay 10 mootooyin shaqaalaha kordhinta ee ku xusan aagagga si loo xoojiyo adeegyada beeralayda. Beeralayda ku nool gobolladan ayaa ka faaiidaysan doona helitaanka taageero kordhin oo wanaagsan.

English: Farmers are encouraged to manage debts for inputs like fertilizer and pesticides responsibly to boost production and ensure timely repayments.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahimizwa kusimamia madeni ya pembejeo kama mbolea na dawa za kuua wadudu kwa njia ya uwajibikaji ili kuongeza uzalishaji na kuhakikisha malipo yanatolewa kwa wakati.
Ekegusii: Abaki bendi obaki nakiya bosi bw'ageraki na funguo buya buya, oria nakiya bosi bw'ageraki nakiya bosi bw'ereyaki, omogenda bw'osoko bw'aki.
Dholuo: Gik malo ka oganda miyo dhiego ka pod ng'ato ka joma koro kagi mwaka kuom piny to golo chako gi ng'ato marach.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay si masuuliyad leh u maareeyaan deymaha alaabada sida bacriminta iyo kiimikooyinka si ay kor ugu qaadaan soo saarista iyo in ay bixiyaan lacagaha waqtigooda.

English: Farmers are advised to stay informed on shifting agricultural market trends driven by emerging economies, particularly in oilseeds, as outlined in the OECD-FAO Agricultural Outlook 2024-2033 report.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanashauriwa kubaki wakijua mwenendo wa soko la kilimo unaobadilika unaosababishwa na uchumi mpya, hasa katika mbegu za mafuta, kama ilivyoelezwa katika ripoti ya OECD-FAO ya Mtazamo wa Kilimo 2024-2033.
Ekegusii: Abagenga batarere info buya kianoru buya bwakire bwakagendo bweng'enda buya bwabire buya, buya naki ogotamari, bwakire bwakiruri buya mu OECE-FAO Omoore bwabere 2024-2033.
Dholuo: Otero ni chira mar farmers kuom inyalo kanyo e yo nyaka piny kendo bura chwe mar shuga, piny kuom gi tek mari gi wendo, ka to bura mar OECD-FAO Agricultural Outlook 2024-2033.
Somali: Farmers waxay lagula talinayaa inay la socdaan isbedelada suuqa beeraha ee ka dhalanaya dhaqaalo cusub, gaar ahaan qodobbada saliidda, sida ku cad warbixinta OECD-FAO ee Aragtida Beeraha 2024-2033.

English: Farmers in Zambia are encouraged to adopt rotational grazing practices to boost livestock productivity by 20% and reduce mortality rates by 30%.
Kiswahili: Wakulima nchini Zambia wanahimizwa kukubali mbinu za malisho ya kuhamahama ili kuongeza uzalishaji wa mifugo kwa 20% na kupunguza viwango vya vifo kwa 30%.
Ekegusii: Abagani banozirwa mu Zambia bategerejeke okugaramia ebicheng'ere obwokakire mu kweteeria omanyire bweragire 20% nakiye omogonde bwarima 30%.
Dholuo: Gik ma farmi ku Zambia nyal timo chiro mar gi ng'ato e yo chayo mapan kendo timo kisuma ma okinyi e 20% kendo golo hia e 30%.
Somali: Beeraleyda Zambiya waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay qaataan dhaqanka lo’a si hab maamuus ah u daaqaan si ay u kordhiyaan wax soo saarka xoolaha 20% iyo inay yareeyaan heerarka dhimashada 30%.

English: Coffee farmers can now apply for debt waivers under the government's new program. Ensure your cooperative submits claims honestly to qualify for the Ksh 6.7 billion support across all coffee growing regions.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa kahawa sasa wanaweza kuomba msamaha wa deni chini ya mpango mpya wa serikali. Hakikisha ushirika wako unawasilisha madai kwa njia ya uaminifu ili kuweza kupata msaada wa Ksh 6.7 bilioni katika maeneo yote yanayolimwa kahawa.
Ekegusii: Abagabuli ba kahawa naki bakananga kutegana omokubwaki bwetiyori buoru. Naki buya bwogendo bwomokorori bwanyu bworeka kire naki bwiintang'ani karanya bwakubo Ksh 6.7 billion bweregu bosi bosi bwemokahawa.
Dholuo: Waweza ripoti duto gi kony kendo choko ni mama in oweri kendo kony gi shairi mana. Jochieng magi ni shauri orit ko ng'ato kendo an ng'ato ni kony kony kanyisi Ksh 6.7 bilioni duto kendo mawuok kuom nyaka yuech.
Somali: Farmers-ka bunka hadda waxay codsan karaan in lagu cafiyo deymahooda oo ka hooseeya barnaamijka cusub ee Dowladda. Hubi in iskaashatadaadu si daacad ah u gudbiso codsiyada si aad ugu qalanto taageerada Ksh 6.7 bilyan ee guud ahaan dhamaan gobollada bunta lagu beero.

English: Cooperative CEOs are encouraged to adopt digital operations and ethical practices to enhance resilience amidst competition. Take action now to strengthen your cooperative's growth.
Kiswahili: Madaraka ya ushirika yanahimizwa kuzingatia shughuli za kidijitali na maadili ili kuongeza uwezo wa kukabiliana na ushindani. Chukua hatua sasa ili kuimarisha ukuaji wa ushirika wako.
Ekegusii: Amasiko naki siganani boke bwaki bw'ogenda obwakore ebisa. Naki oria naki wandiki aise oboraga bw'amasiko bwakire.
Dholuo: Magigi CEO ma kuom jigo yie nyaka golo loch motegno kendo wach mar bedo chwech ligang'uru ma e kido wadh nyaka. Tiyo chako nyaka kitekwanyi kuom owango mar joma ching' gi.
Somali: Madaxda iskaashatada waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay qaataan howlgallada dijitaalka ah iyo habdhaqanka anshaxa si ay u xoojiyaan adkeysiga iyagoo la tartamaya. Ha ka waaboyin inaad talaabo qaaddo si aad u adkaysato koritaanka iskaashatadaada.

English: The Cooperatives Bill is expected to pass this year; stakeholders are encouraged to submit their views to the Parliamentary Committee of Trade and Cooperatives.
Kiswahili: Sheria ya Ushirikiano inatarajiwa kupitishwa mwaka huu; wadau wanahimizwa kuwasilisha maoni yao kwa Kamati ya Bunge ya Biashara na Ushirikiano.
Ekegusii: Ekibori ch’Omokireri kirema ikwenda kubwaki naki; abaki boti bware omosi abwaki oria bakanana bwaki ch’Omokireri na Busi.
Dholuo: Buku ma okonyo mar cooperatives nyalo pesa chieng'ono; watu dhi nyaka bende wawinjore yore bedo to Parliamentary Committee of Trade and Cooperatives.
Somali: Sharciga Iskaashatada waxaa la filayaa inuu ansaxayo sanadkan; dhinacyada la xiriira waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay soo diraan fikradahooda Guddiga Baarlamaanka ee Ganacsiga iyo Iskaashatada.

English: Farmers and tea producers are encouraged to develop a Kenyan tea brand to enhance market visibility and prices. Aim for at least 60% of exports to be processed and branded within 3-5 years.
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wazalishaji wa chai wanahamasishwa kuendeleza chapa ya chai ya Kenya ili kuimarisha uonekano wa soko na bei. Lengo ni kuhakikisha angalau 60% ya mauzo ya nje yanachakatwa na kuweka chapa ndani ya miaka 3-5.
Ekegusii: Abakire nakiisi baende kutoikanya ek-brand ya chai ya Kenya buya boki kwiwasake omokireri na omokometete. Nakiiranga oreka 60% njara zine buya boki dakore na kiree 3-5.
Dholuo: Owino gi maziwa mar kuon gi tunga weche ahinya kuom kanyal gi tea okel ka oser ni nde moiny. Samo ni oting'o ni 60% mar jiewo to be modhuro gi goding' kata bende 3-5 ng'ato.
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo soo saarayaasha shaaha waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay sameeyaan sumadda shaaha ee Kenya si loo kordhiyo muuqaalka suuqa iyo qiimaha. Ujeedadu waa in ugu yaraan 60% dhoofinta la farsameeyo lana sumadeyo 3-5 sano gudahood.

English: Farmers are encouraged to consider organic fertilizer as part of their agricultural practices, following its focus at the recent African Fertilizer and Soil Health Summit.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahimizwa kuzingatia mbolea za kikaboni kama sehemu ya mazoea yao ya kilimo, kufuatia mkutano wa hivi karibuni wa Afrika kuhusu Mbolea na Afya ya Udongo.
Ekegusii: Abaki banchari baisore kugendia osibori oria bw'ogenda buya buya baiso baki koreka mu bw'ogenda bw'abaki, nyanduri bw'ekekubo buya buya bw'Abafirika.
Dholuo: Chalo nyaka dhiye organic fertilizer ka wacho dhok mag chuo, e ng'ato ni owuon e konyo chalo mar African Fertilizer and Soil Health Summit.
Somali: Beeralaydu waxaa loo dhiirigelinayaa inay tixgaliyaan bacriminta dabiiciga ah qayb ka mid ah dhaqankooda beeraleyda, iyadoo la raacayo diiradda lagu saaray Shirkii dhowaan ee Bacriminta Afrika iyo Caafimaadka Carrada.

English: The Nairobi Declaration on Fertilizer and Soil Health has been endorsed; farmers should seek opportunities for partnership and investment in sustainable soil management as outlined in the new 10-year Action Plan.
Kiswahili: Tamko la Nairobi kuhusu Mbolea na Afya ya Ardhi limekubaliwa; wakulima wanapaswa kutafuta fursa za ushirikiano na uwekezaji katika usimamizi endelevu wa ardhi kama ilivyoainishwa katika Mpango wa Hatua wa miaka 10 mpya.
Ekegusii: Omosiri buya wa Nairobi buya ogwakiogo; abaki bateganire osero omogenda na obwaki bw'orore obwaki shoseri bw'ogweduka mu bwakiri bw'osibori ogosiikire mu buya buya obuorokire.
Dholuo: Nairobi Declaration e nyal mwandu gi fertilizer kod soil health; ng'ato omi piny owuon ni idhi kelo chandruok kuom partnership kod investment e koro kanyakla ma nyalu koro mwaka 10.
Somali: Bayaanka Nairobi ee ku saabsan Bacriminta iyo Caafimaadka Carrada ayaa la ansixiyay; beeralaydu waa inay raadiyaan fursadaha iskaashiga iyo maalgashiga maaraynta carrada waarta sida ku xusan Qorshaha Ficilka cusub ee 10-ka sano.

English: A new three-year project to strengthen the grain value chain across East Africa has been launched, targeting farmers and stakeholders in Uganda, Tanzania, and Kenya.
Kiswahili: Mradi mpya wa miaka mitatu wa kuimarisha minara ya thamani ya nafaka kote Afrika Mashariki umeanzishwa, ukilenga wakulima na wadau nchini Uganda, Tanzania, na Kenya.
Ekegusii: Projekiti nane ya mwakahati itatu ikororiere buya buya bwakinyasa bw'ibisambaa mu mashariki mwa Afrika yakioboriire, yakiibwaki abakiiri na ang'anya mu Uganda, Tanzania, naki Kenya.
Dholuo: Dhoho mar gondo motegno abich maok wach ni gin yaki ka maler giri, kanyamar tich, e East Africa, to ok nyaka kelo ng'ato kendo duto ma ok nyaka.
Somali: Mashruuc cusub oo seddex sano ah ayaa la bilaabay si loo xoojiyo silsiladda qiimaha dhirta beeraha ee Bariga Afrika, iyadoo diiradda la saarayo beeralayda iyo daneeyayaasha Uganda, Tanzania, iyo Kenya.

English: The FINAS 2024 conference on agricultural financing is ongoing; stakeholders are encouraged to engage and explore funding options for the agricultural sector.
Kiswahili: Konferensi ya FINAS 2024 kuhusu ufadhili wa kilimo inaendelea; wadau wanahimizwa kushiriki na kuchunguza chaguo za ufadhili kwa sekta ya kilimo.
Ekegusii: Konferensi ya FINAS 2024 ya kuigana na fedha z'ekabunwa iri buya; abaki boti bategere omobori noheria boki ya mwaki omokirori buya.
Dholuo: Konferensi FINAS 2024 e yo mar kuera ma tenge konyo; jomoko kanyal nyal konyo kendo otemo jago ma ok nyal ogend.
Somali: Shirweynaha FINAS 2024 ee maalgelinta beeraleyda ayaa socda; daneeyayaasha waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay ka qaybqaataan oo ay baaraan fursadaha maalgelin ee waaxda beerta.

English: Avocado harvesting for export opens on March 1, 2024. Exporters must apply for inspection at least three days prior to shipment and submit their supplier list by February 26, 2024.
Kiswahili: Ukorongo wa avokado kwa ajili ya usafirishaji utafunguliwa tarehe 1 Machi 2024. Wauzaji wanapaswa kuomba ukaguzi angalau siku tatu kabla ya kusafirisha na kuwasilisha orodha ya wasambazaji ifikapo tarehe 26 Februari 2024.
Ekegusii: Abagwokire avocado boireri busemeza omokoro omosi, 2024. Abagwokire banya kweri buori kwogere omokoro ogire omokoko ataki oria nakama moige, na buori bwendo migenye bwere kendire buya, 2024.
Dholuo: Okwak okar nyaluo mar avokado kuom konyo ji duto onge muma 1, 2024. Jikonyo mar konyo ji duto nigi tich mar nyis pe mokuongo thum ma tati kuom kanyo ni konyo jii gi yore. Wath nyaka romo chalo mag nyise ng'wenni kuom sabuni mar February 26, 2024.
Somali: Dheefshiidka avokado loogu tala galay dhoofinta wuxuu furm doonaa March 1, 2024. Dhoofiyayaashu waa inay dalbadaan kormeer ugu yaraan saddex maalmood ka hor rarista, sidoo kalena ay keenaan liiska bixiyeyaashooda ilaa February 26, 2024.

English: The 3rd ASARECA Council of Patron Ministers Meeting will take place on February 15th, 2024, at Safari Park Hotel, Nairobi.
Kiswahili: Kikao cha 3 cha Baraza la Mawaziri Walezi wa ASARECA kitat held on February 15, 2024, katika Hoteli ya Safari Park, Nairobi.
Ekegusii: Inki bw'ogekore buya 3 bw'ASARECA Council of Patron Ministers buya orokire omokero on February 15th, 2024, na Safari Park Hotel, Nairobi.
Dholuo: Oromo 3rd ASARECA Council of Patron Ministers owinjore ka teko ni February 15, 2024, e Safari Park Hotel, Nairobi.
Somali: Kulanka 3aad ee Golaha Wasirada ASARECA wuxuu dhici doonaa 15ka Febraayo, 2024, hoteelka Safari Park, Nairobi.

English: Starting March 1, New KCC will pay farmers Kshs 50 per litre of milk. Ensure you deliver your milk regularly to benefit from this program.
Kiswahili: Kuanzia Machi 1, New KCC itawalipa wakulima Kshs 50 kwa lita ya maziwa. Hakikisha unaleta maziwa yako mara kwa mara ili ufaidike na mpango huu.
Ekegusii: Omocho mwaki ogenda, New KCC ikogenda kutanga aborori Kshs 50 naki litre ya eng'ombe. Maki oria gakiogenda omokirori bw'ogende oriang'ende omogabuki omoka.
Dholuo: K начиная Mach 1, New KCC otimo farmers Kshs 50 ku litre mar ugeny. Nyar chalo ni ok nyal dro no ugeny en ni to gnigi chako.
Somali: Laga bilaabo Maarso 1, New KCC waxay bixin doontaa Kshs 50 halkii litir oo caano ah. Hubi inaad si joogto ah u keento caanahaaga si aad uga faa’iidaysato barnaamijkan.

English: Horticulture exporters in Kajiado and Meru are facing double taxation. Stakeholders are urged to report these taxation issues to the government for resolution.
Kiswahili: Wafanyabiashara wa kilimo cha bustani katika Kajiado na Meru wanakabiliwa na ukaguzi wa mara mbili. Washikadau wanahimizwa kuripoti matatizo haya ya ukaguzi serikalini ili kupatiwa ufumbuzi.
Ekegusii: Abagwatori b'intore naki Kajiado na Meru baria batarerire mu oria burori bwakirengero. Ababere batongoria ku ibwaki naki bwanaki bwaki besi oigori buya.
Dholuo: Kachiiro mar Horticulture e Kajiado gi Meru neno ni theyo kadondi. Wasekwayo en wath nyaka atimre kachiiro manoma to government me gima thomre.
Somali: Dhoofiyeyaasha beeraleyda ee Kajiado iyo Meru waxay wajahayaan canshuur laba jeer ah. Waxaa la farayaa daneeyayaasha inay arrimahan canshuuraha u soo gudbiyaan dowladda si xal loo helo.

English: Farmers are encouraged to engage in the production of palm oil, sunflower, and soya to reduce reliance on edible oil imports. Your participation is vital for achieving self-sufficiency in edible oils.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahimizwa kushiriki katika uzalishaji wa mafuta ya ya mturungi, alizeti, na soya ili kupunguza utegemezi wa uagizaji wa mafuta ya kula. Ushiriki wako ni muhimu kwa kufikia kujitosheleza katika mafuta ya kula.
Ekegusii: Abagikire baabere kujengana emokendo ya palm oil, sunflower, na soya kugira ngo bategeneze emokendo ikireka okuboukiya emokendo ya mafuta akirenge. Obote bwenu buyega emang'ana kugana kwagire nyaki mwaki emokendo.
Dholuo: Ng'wechni kuom ne od hiere piny gi palm oil, sunflower, na soya, kari dhi nyaka unyise lweny mogik. Konyruok gi chalo kanyimore bura duto ma ok oting' owinjruok ma piny.
Somali: Farmers-ka waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay ka qayb qaataan soo saarista saliidda timirta, qorraxda, iyo soya si loo yareeyo ku tiirsanaanta saliidda la keeno. Ka qayb qaadashadaadu waa muhiim si loo gaaro isku filnaansho ku saabsan saliidda la cuni karo.

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders are urged to focus on improving soil health as part of the Kenya Food Systems and Land Use Action Plan 2024-2030.
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo wanashauriwa kuzingatia kuboresha afya ya udongo kama sehemu ya Mpango wa Vitendo wa Mifumo ya Chakula na Matumizi ya Ardhi wa Kenya 2024-2030.
Ekegusii: Abagikuyu n’abagabukora miriambo barakerekeriania okoboragania omogenda bwaki k’okwenda otende 2024-2030.
Dholuo: Nanga gi owuon mar farmers to agribusiness stakeholders, chalo pod ithiegoro gi ber mar udongo, nyaka itimo kwom Kenya Food Systems kod Land Use Action Plan 2024-2030.
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha agribusiness-ka waxaa lagu booriyay inay diiradda saaraan hagaajinta caafimaadka ciidda qayb ka ah Qorshaha Ficilada Nidaamyada Cuntada iyo Isticmaalka Dhulka ee Kenya 2024-2030.

English: The government will establish a milk price-stabilizing fund through New KCC, with Kshs. 3 billion allocated to manage excess milk and stabilize prices.
Kiswahili: Serikali itaunda mfuko wa kuweka bei ya maziwa sawa kupitia New KCC, ambapo shilingi bilioni 3 zitatengwa kusimamia ziada ya maziwa na kuimarisha bei.
Ekegusii: Abagere buya bigenjore bwaki bwakinyaka ore bwang’ere bori na New KCC, naki Kshs. 3 billion buya buya bwaki bwakabere nyanya mbekere na bwakinyaka bwaki.
Dholuo: Govt. en gi fund ma okel namba mamil na New KCC, ka Kshs. 3 billion oger gi ni gitimo mamil ma oketieka gi kuom namba mamil.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay dhisi doontaa fund ka habaynaya qiimaha caanaha oo ay fulin doonto New KCC, iyadoo Kshs. 3 bilyan loo qoondeeyey in lagu maareeyo caanaha xad-dhaafka ah iyo in la xasilinayo qiimaha.

English: The government has written off Kshs. 117 billion in debts for public sugar mills, providing support for farmer and salary arrears through a 90-day payment plan.
Kiswahili: Serikali imefuta deni la Kshs. bilioni 117 kwa mashambani ya sukari ya umma, ikitoa msaada kwa wakulima na malimbikizo ya mishahara kupitia mpango wa malipo wa siku 90.
Ekegusii: Abagere buya batania Kshs. 117 billion mu buya bwaki bw’amasabo, batarorere omogotani na ogouchari buseke mu nenga 90.
Dholuo: Gavumenti oyie Kshs. 117 billion kuom chogo ma okonyo joma nyandieni, mane otimore joma ng'ato gi dhako kanyakla kuom piny mar 90.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay ka cafisay Kshs. 117 bilyan deyn ah warshadaha sonkorta ee dadweynaha, iyada oo taageero siisay beeraleyda iyo mushaar la'aan iyada oo loo marayo qorshe lacag bixin ah oo 90 maalmood ah.

English: No permits will be issued for importing wheat or maize. Local farmers are encouraged to sell their produce at fair prices. Farmers can use NCPB driers for maize at Ksh 50 per bag to reduce post-harvest losses.
Kiswahili: Hakuna vibali vitakavyotolewa kuagiza ngano au mahindi. Wakulima wa ndani wanahimizwa kuuza mazao yao kwa bei nzuri. Wakulima wanaweza kutumia mikanika ya NCPB kukausha mahindi kwa Ksh 50 kwa gunia ili kupunguza hasara za baada ya mavuno.
Ekegusii: Ong'endo nyasa buya oria okunda omogogoa kana ng'oria. Abagereka bakiema nyasa bakanogorire oria ba igomboki buya. Abagereka bakiema canya NCPB driers buya oria okusa Ksh 50 omosi buya omogogoa okogoma eng'wonia.
Dholuo: Nakiwou ni gire nyaka kagi teko mar uwete wheat kata maize. Manoko oseti gi mwalimu kar keto ber mag produce gi pinje. Midwogo oseti nyiso NCPB driers madhiere ma maize ka Ksh 50 mara bag to oketho piny-gi.
Somali: Looma bixin doono rukhsadaha lagu soo dejinayo mudh iyo galley. Beeraleyda maxalliga ah waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay iibiyaan wax-soo-saarkooda iyadoo qiimo cadaalad ah. Beeraleydu waxay isticmaali karaan qalabka NCPB ee ka qalajinaya galleyda Ksh 50 bacda si loo yareeyo khasaaraha ka dhasha goosashada.

English: All sugar millers must cease cane poaching immediately to combat the sugar shortage; failure to comply may involve police action.
Kiswahili: Wakandarasi wote wa sukari lazima wakomeshe kuiba miwa mara moja ili kushughulikia uhaba wa sukari; kutoshiriki kunaweza kusababisha hatua za polisi.
Ekegusii: Abagere b'ekisukari bochinge bategere cane poaching omokire buya buya toshokire oria; kutarokire bwana omokire ikerane naki.
Dholuo: Ng'ato ng'ato miyo sugar millers nyalo kwach kata cane poaching marach e maar. Kaka ng'ato otimo ne gol, maaru ni to gichiw, ginyal kuom joma gichung' e police.
Somali: Dhammaan warshadaha sonkorta waa inay si degdeg ah u joojiyaan xatooyada canabka si loo xaliyay yaraanta sonkorta; haddii aan la raacin, waxaa jiri kara tallaabooyin boolis.

English: Busia farmers have received 17 tonnes of Bt cotton seeds and fertilizer from the National government to revive cotton production. Utilize these resources for better yields and income.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa Busia wamepokea tani 17 za mbegu za pamba za Bt na mbolea kutoka kwa serikali ya kitaifa ili kuhuisha uzalishaji wa pamba. Tumia raslimali hizi kwa mavuno bora na mapato.
Ekegusii: Abarimu baki Busia bagetere emani 17 ya matiga ya Bt cotton na emani yaki fertilizer buya buya oseria boki. Nyarori bosi bosi ekogwenye omokiri na obwakire.
Dholuo: Farmer e Busia abiro 17 tonnes ma Bt cotton seeds kod fertilizer wuod National government, ei ogend kendo owinj kod cotton. Jiyac mar bisa mogik ken piny kendo okel.
Somali: Farmaajiyayaasha Busia waxay heleen 17 tun oo abuurka cotton Bt ah iyo bacriminta dowladda qaran si loo soo nooleeyo wax soo saarka cotton. Ka faa’iidayso agabkan si aad u hesho dalag wanaagsan iyo dakhli.

English: Frameworks to support coffee subsector reforms will be ready by the end of the year. Farmers and stakeholders are encouraged to prepare for upcoming changes and improvements.
Kiswahili: Mifumo ya kusaidia marekebisho ya sekta ya kahawa itakuwa tayari kabla ya mwishoni mwa mwaka. Wakulima na wadau wanahimizwa kujitayarisha kwa mabadiliko na maboresho yanayokuja.
Ekegusii: Naki ikirori naki buya bwakire bwakire omokati buse morenge buya bwaki. Bogezi naki abogenda boriano baragati omokinyanire kosi naki bosi.
Dholuo: Maweche mane en e plung' mar coffee oketo ni ng'ama orumo chike gi bw'iring' konyo e piny. Buru mar adhiongo gi jopiny no wuok to ok inywolo e piny.
Somali: Qaab-dhismeedyada taageeraya isbedelka qeybta kafee ayaa la filayaa inay diyaar noqdaan dhammaadka sanadka. Beeralayda iyo daneeyayaasha waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay diyaar garoobaan isbedelada iyo horumarka soo socda.

English: Two hundred ten Kenyan trainees have been selected for the 2023 Mashav Agricultural Training Program in Israel, focusing on practical skills in agriculture.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi mia mbili na kumi wa Kenya wamechaguliwa kwa ajili ya Programu ya Mafunzo ya Kilimo ya Mashav ya mwaka 2023 nchini Israel, wakilenga ujuzi wa vitendo katika kilimo.
Ekegusii: Bwakire abaki 210 ba Kenya bakiokire omogoti boosibori bw'amasomo g'ogenda 2023 Mashav mu Israel, bakiibori omokirori omokisumo mu buya.
Dholuo: Laki abiriyo na higa manyien gi bende kwach kanyakla maitung' 2023 Mashav Agricultural Training Program e Israel, ma wacho maler e kanyakla mar dhou.
Somali: Laba boqol iyo toban tababare Kenya ah ayaa la doortay barnaamijka Tababarka Beeraha Mashav ee Israel 2023, oo diiradda saaraya xirfadaha practicalka ah ee beeraha.

English: The Ministry of Agriculture has launched a pilot control operation using bio-grade pesticides to manage the invasive apple snail population in Mwea. Farmers in the area should monitor application guidelines for effective control.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo imeanzisha operesheni ya jaribio ya kudhibiti matumizi ya dawa za kuua wadudu zenye kiwango cha bio ili kudhibiti idadi ya konokono wa waapulo katika Mwea. Wakulima katika eneo hilo wanapaswa kufuatilia miongozo ya matumizi kwa kudhibiti kwa ufanisi.
Ekegusii: Omoige buya bw’Omokireri bw’Etoreka buya ore agorire ekikangacho bw’abi bio-grade obwakiri okuganya omogango ogwakiriri bwa apple snail mu Mwea. Ababere mu obori bano bataroni buya bamoja bw’orian mwanjira oria buya bria bw’oganya.
Dholuo: Ministir di Akwach abud ng'ato tếndi maler ma nyal golo bio-grade pesticides, ng'ato konyo chalo machu duto ma apple snail e Mwea. Wuodhi madhi n'gi yie to ikwong' to ber.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha ayaa bilowday hawlcontorool tijaabo ah oo isticmaaleysa kiimikooyin bey’adeed si ay ula tacaalaan tirada qashinka abaalmarinta ah ee ku faafay Mwea. Beeraleyda deegaanka waa in ay la socdaan tilmaamaha codsiga si ay u helaan xakameyn waxtar leh.

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders are encouraged to engage in the Bottom-Up Economic Transformation Agenda aimed at boosting agricultural productivity and addressing food security issues.
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo wanahimizwa kushiriki katika Mpango wa Mabadiliko ya Uchumi wa Chini Kuelekea Juu unaolenga kuongeza uzalishaji wa kilimo na kushughulikia masuala ya usalama wa chakula.
Ekegusii: Abakire na abashamaki b’ageri bateganire kumaranya mu Bottom-Up Economic Transformation Agenda butigire okwigwaniria osibori naki inki naki.
Dholuo: Waduoga ni joma nidi ma yo owadgi e Bottom-Up Economic Transformation Agenda nyaluok gi nyinge kony e pato mar nyamre duto bende okawonji kony mar nyamre.
Somali: Beeralayda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beeraha waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay ka qaybqaataan Ajendaha Isbeddelka Dhaqaalaha hooseeya si kor loogu qaado wax soo saarka beeraha iyo in wax laga qabto arrimaha amniga cuntada.

English: The Kenyan government is advocating for a review of the global funding system to better support Africa's agricultural needs. Stakeholders are urged to collaborate on this initiative.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Kenya inasisitiza kuwepo kwa mapitio ya mfumo wa ufadhili wa kimataifa ili kusaidia mahitaji ya kilimo barani Afrika. Wadau wanahimizwa kushirikiana katika iniciativa hii.
Ekegusii: Obwaki bwaki bwanatetere kwamwaki bwaki bwemwaki butuci bwetire bujenda buya buaba buongo bwake bu baibori bara. Abakire basagire mwena mwaki buangwenje.
Dholuo: Chuo cha Kenya en piny itim e katondo mar funding ma ok to kendo nyal yorego piny mar Afrika kuom joma dindo. Joma bende ginyalo timo mano.
Somali: Dowladda Kenya waxay ka shaqaynaysaa dib u eegis nidaamka maalgelinta caalamiga ah si loo taageero baahiyaha beeraha Afrika. Dewaalka waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay wada shaqeeyaan sidii ay u hirgeliyaan hindisahan.

English: Farmers are encouraged to attend plant clinics for expert advice on crop pest and disease management. Check with local agricultural extension services for clinic locations and schedules.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahimizwa kuhudhuria kliniki za mimea kwa ushauri wa kitaalamu kuhusu usimamizi wa wadudu na magonjwa ya mazao. Wasiliana na huduma za ugani za kilimo za eneo lako kwa taarifa za maeneo na ratiba za kliniki.
Ekegusii: Abagiri batoragwa kuja mashule okore moja mogendeti moshindi moshagari buye bwokinyando naki omogori. Naki kire buye emagana y'amasela y'abagiri bwokinyando batarohye.
Dholuo: Jokonyo g’inj kuom plant clinics gi golo chiegni ma okaw ngech gi piny. Teken gi agolo maber ma adwaro kuom klini gi nyinga kod joge mar shingruok.
Somali: Beeralaydu waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay ka qaybqaataan xarumaha dhirta si ay talo khabiiro ah uga helaan maaraynta cayayaanka iyo cudurrada dhirta. La xiriir adeegyada ballaarinta beeraha ee deegaankaaga si aad u ogaato meelaynta xarumaha iyo jadwalka.

English: A Ksh15.9 billion insurance project has been launched to support pastoralists in 21 ASAL counties. Pastoralists are encouraged to enroll in the program to mitigate climate change impacts.
Kiswahili: Mradi wa bima wa Ksh15.9 bilioni umeanzishwa kusaidia wachungaji katika kaunti 21 za ASAL. Wachungaji wanahimizwa kujiandikisha katika programu hii ili kupunguza athari za mabadiliko ya tabianchi.
Ekegusii: Omoshiro omokere Ksh15.9 billion ono omokere ore kiogori buya omokere bataragani mu 21 ASAL buya. Bataragani bakirukire kuji orangana mosi ogoteke omogiri omokere nhyaki.
Dholuo: Jumala Ksh15.9 billion mar lek chuny gima otimo kuom ng'ama ma okwanyo 21 ASAL. Ng'ama oyie chiegni to ne imiyogi muok ji machal.
Somali: Mashruuc caymis ah oo qiimihiisu yahay Ksh15.9 billion ayaa la bilaabay si loo taageero xoolo-dhaqatada 21 degmo oo ASAL ah. Xoolo-dhaqatada waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay ku biiraan barnaamijka si loo yareeyo saameynta isbeddelka cimilada.

English: The establishment of the Tea Research Foundation is currently delayed due to ongoing court cases related to the Tea Act of 2020. Stakeholders are encouraged to engage and resolve these disputes.
Kiswahili: Uanzishwaji wa Taasisi ya Utafiti wa Chai umekawia kutokana na kesi za mahakamani zinazohusiana na Sheria ya Chai ya 2020. Washiriki wanahimizwa kushiriki na kutatua migogoro hii.
Ekegusii: Ekiinjiramo chirema cha Tea Research Foundation kigurana na orembo buya buya naki egeta ogenda buya buya okorire Tea Act ya 2020. Abaki nyasa emoti obokireri na oborere abandi buya buya.
Dholuo: Kagundo mar Tea Research Foundation kare nyalo chako mar kanyo e ndalo, kendo jodong' meko to okonyalo konyore nyasaye gi Tea Act mar 2020. Bende jodong' en buoch nyalo timo giko kendo unyalu nyasaye.
Somali: Aasaaska Aasaaska Cilmi-baarista Shaaha ayaa haatan dib u dhaca sababo la xiriira kiisaska maxkamadeed ee ku saabsan Qaanuunka Shaaha ee 2020. Dadka daneynaya ayaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay ka qaybqaataan oo ay xaliyaan khilaafaadkaas.

English: The government will fully implement the Tea Act, 2020 to revive the tea sector and improve farmers' earnings. All stakeholders are invited to contribute to this reform process.
Kiswahili: Serikali itatekeleza kwa ukamilifu Sheria ya Chai ya mwaka 2020 ili kufufua sekta ya chai na kuboresha mapato ya wakulima. Wadau wote wanakaribishwa kuchangia katika mchakato huu wa mabadiliko.
Ekegusii: Abaga ikirango barachire teya ya Tea Act, 2020 buya bnaire omogori na buya bategana itokiri ya bataria. Bwakire bosi barikire ekegene ekiri buya buya.
Dholuo: Gavumenti oying' miyo Tea Act, 2020 to yudhi tea nyaka itimre okwetgi madhi. Gik mamoko nyalo wakinchi kanyono unyalo tere jochiwo mar reform manamwe.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay si buuxda u fulin doontaa Sharciga Shaaha, 2020 si dib loogu soo nooleeyo qaybta shaaha iyo kor loogu qaado dakhliga beeralayda. Dhamaan daneeyayaashu waa lagu casuumay in ay ka qayb qaataan habka isbeddelka.

English: Farmers are encouraged to engage in coffee marketing discussions to better understand pricing and ownership rights; stay informed and participate actively in cooperative decisions.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahimizwa kushiriki katika majadiliano ya masoko ya kahawa ili kuelewa vyema bei na haki za umiliki; kuwa na taarifa na kushiriki kwa aktiiv katika maamuzi ya ushirika.
Ekegusii: Abagikuyu barekeganye okongera abaki bakenye mu buya bw’amalenga koffee buya bwahaki omokireri na omorongo; barengane na babere bakire mu bwakire bw’amatiriri.
Dholuo: Ababurngi ok anyalo itwaro kuom magweny ma chogo coffee ka gikwongo chakruok gi dwondere; negiyi chiko e kàin jomako gichieng.
Somali: Beerleeyda waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay ka qaybqaataan wadahadalada suuqgeynta qaxwada si ay u fahmaan qiimaynta iyo xuquuqda lahaanshaha; la soco oo si firfircoon uga qeybqaado go'aanada iskaashatada.

English: All companies dealing in coffee must apply afresh for licenses by June 30, 2023, due to upcoming reforms. Ensure compliance with the relevant licensing authority.
Kiswahili: Kampuni zote zinazoshughulika na kahawa lazima zifanye maombi mapya ya leseni kabla ya tarehe 30 Juni 2023, kutokana na marekebisho yanayokuja. Hakikisha unafuata masharti ya mamlaka husika ya leseni.
Ekegusii: Abanye buya bwogeni bwoburori buya bwebire bwise bonyemo buya bingi bwogori bunajeganyagwa na mwaki wa 30, 2023, buya buya nakiha manenge munane.  Gosiere buya buya buya bwogetere buya benderia bonyemo.
Dholuo: Jaceng'ni onyuol mar kisi mokuon piny gima en coffee nyalo topuok gi licens mag ng'ato mar June 30, 2023, kendo jopuonjere ma okelre. Bewachimre kama ne karur Abiriyo ma otony.
Somali: Dhammaan shirkadaha ka shaqeeya qaxwaha waa in ay codsadaan liisam cusub ka hor June 30, 2023, sababo la xiriira dib-u-habeyn. Hubi in aad u hoggaansanto hay'adda bixisa liisanka.

English: Farmers are urged to unite against coffee cartels that are impacting returns; mobilization efforts are underway to address these challenges in the coffee value chain.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanasisitizwa kuungana dhidi ya magenge ya kahawa yanayoathiri mapato; juhudi za kuhamasisha zinafanywa ili kukabiliana na changamoto hizi katika mchaino wa thamani ya kahawa.
Ekegusii: Abakoro bategerejere buse baki naki bw'ekaheri buhabwa bw'ekibari kya kọfé, tugirè buse buhoya bwereka ebinyabogira bw'ekikomo ky'ekibari.
Dholuo: Ong'ere gi pany kode me kachola tiyo magu dogu e piny otieno; nyaka ne ok eng'ere kony koro gi ombulu duto e kachogo ma coffee.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagula talinayaa inay isugu yimaadaan ka dhanka ah cartels-ka qaxwaha ee saameynaya dakhligooda; dadaallada isugeynta ayaa socda si loo xalliyo caqabadaha ku jira silsiladda qiimaha qaxwaha.

English: Farmers in mango-producing counties are encouraged to adopt improved planting materials and enhance their skills to boost production and market access following the National Mango Conference.
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika kaunti zinazozalisha maembe wanahimizwa kutumia vifaa bora vya kupanda na kuboresha ujuzi wao ili kuongeza uzalishaji na upatikanaji wa soko kufuatia Mkutano wa Kitaifa wa Maembe.
Ekegusii: Ababere bange mango batarera baria bagorire bakanyokire buya nyamia na boki omokubwakire bwaki omogusi na nyakiema bataniane asubuta bwaning'ana bwe itekano ikaraga omoyote ogwaki.
Dholuo: Owino mag ng'ato makende gi mango nyaka nyal ka ng'ato osetho miyo hymo chunyu kendo konyo nindo bura kuom jaduong' kendo nyaka okanyo ing'weyo kendo ng'ato sa makalo.
Somali: Crop-dhaqatadu waxay ku dhiirigelinayaan in ay qaataan agab beereed oo la hagaajiyay iyo in ay kororsadaan xirfadahooda si ay u kordhiyaan waxsoosaarka iyo helitaanka suuqyada kadib Shirweynihii Qaranka ee Mango.

English: Farmers are encouraged to participate in training programs focused on growing French beans to enhance food security. Please seek local agricultural offices for training schedules and enrollment details.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahimizwa kushiriki katika programu za mafunzo kuhusu kuzalisha maharagwe ya Ufaransa ili kuboresha usalama wa chakula. Tafadhali tembelea ofisi za kilimo za eneo lako kwa ratiba za mafunzo na maelezo ya kujiandikisha.
Ekegusii: Ababere batirire kugana mu masomo gaki gakwenda konyanga ebihamba bigezebwako omong’era omokoro. Omosia ogendete mwekore ebiroto buya buya buisanene ne konyang’iria.
Dholuo: Ong'wech gima ohinga nyasaye eyo lokruok gi konyo kuonde kendo ok giek nyasi oboya. Konyi kanyeng' agolo ma eyo ma ohu chuo maler kendo dholuwa.
Somali: Farmereyaasha waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay ka qayb qaataan barnaamijyada tababarka ee diiradda saaraya koritaanka digirta Faransiiska si loo xoojiyo ammaanka cuntada. Fadlan la xiriir xafiisyada beeraha ee deegaanka si aad u hesho jadwalka tababarka iyo faahfaahinta isdiiwaangelinta.

English: Millers and grain importers granted duty waivers for maize and rice have 7 days to provide proof of importation or risk losing their licenses. No imports will be allowed after August 2023.
Kiswahili: Wazalishaji wa unga na waagizaji wa nafaka waliopatiwa msamaha wa forodha kwa mahindi na mchele wanatakiwa kutoa uthibitisho wa uagizaji ndani ya siku 7 au hatarini kupoteza leseni zao. Hakuna uagizaji utakaoruhusiwa baada ya Agosti 2023.
Ekegusii: Abakunya na abahinga bataragani obwakisyo buoru bwetendire buoru bwa egesagane bujara nyanja naki buwiritiri 7 emogoti okwereka omokirigori waki na bwotirenda obukiisi bwake. Naki omogori ogwenyanja ogotemereraki after August 2023.
Dholuo: Milleka kod joma oknya dhou chuth gi ng’eyo dudi mar tho mar joma oknya nofwen kapo 7, kuom konyo chiegni ma inyal konyo dhakh. Niko nyaka inyal konyo chuth ka ng'ato ng'ato kanyad August 2023.
Somali: Miller-yada iyo soo-dejiyayaasha hadhuudhka oo helay hakad canshuur ah oo ku saabsan baasto iyo shadiid waxay leeyihiin 7 maalmood si ay u soo bandhigaan caddeyn soo dejin ah ama halis u yihiin in ay lumiyaan rukhsadahooda. Ma jiraan wax soo-dejin ah oo la oggolaan doono ka dib bishii Agoosto 2023.

English: The Kenya Food Systems Conference identified critical recommendations for enhancing the science-policy interface in agriculture. Stakeholders are encouraged to engage with proposed mechanisms for innovation.
Kiswahili: Konferensi ya Mifumo ya Chakula Kenya ilibaini mapendekezo muhimu ya kuimarisha mwingiliano wa sayansi na sera katika kilimo. Washikadau wanahimizwa kushiriki katika mekanika zilizopendekezwa za uvumbuzi.
Ekegusii: Omosira wa Kenya omokwenda omogusi bw'ogekiranya kuringana eng'onyegusa omokiri kebw'ogusikanya. Ababere baamogotere bakuraira bendi bawaire omokirigania bw'osibiri.
Dholuo: Konferense mar Kenya Food Systems oyiedi migo mar nuok ma wacho ongeyo obwaki mar science-policy e barch. Makiwogi en sauma kuom giyandik kuom ng’ato mar kiwuok.
Somali: Shirka Nidaamyada Cuntada ee Kenya ayaa soo bandhigay talooyin muhiim ah oo lagu xoojinayo isdhexgalka cilmiga iyo siyaasadda beeraha. Daneeyayaasha waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay ka qaybqaataan hababka cusub ee lagu soo jeediyay.

English: The government is constructing the Mwache Dam to provide water for irrigation, benefiting 1.6 million people in Kwale and Mombasa Counties. Completion is expected by August 2026.
Kiswahili: Serikali inajenga Kiwanda cha Mwache ili kutoa maji kwa umwagiliaji, ikinufaisha watu 1.6 milioni katika Kaunti za Kwale na Mombasa. Kumaliza kunatarajiwa kufanyika ifikapo Agosti 2026.
Ekegusii: Ong'anya ikuragania Mwache Dam buya omosagari kuti itorore omokireri, jotiire emogori 1.6 million abaki bwiikire Kwale na Mombasa. Ibwaki buya temanioria buya omokire August 2026.
Dholuo: Gamuoro ne okonyo Mwache Dam mag kuom chiengʼ, mokuongo 1.6 milioni penje e Kwale kod Mombasa. Weng' gi mijo ni otimore kendo ok oduogo e August 2026.
Somali: Dowladda waxay dhiseysaa Biyaha Mwache si loo siiyo biyo waraabinta, taasoo ka faa'iideysanaysa 1.6 milyan oo qof oo ku sugan Degmooyinka Kwale iyo Mombasa. Dhameystirka waxaa la filaayaa inuu dhaco bishii Agoosto 2026.

English: Farmers in Kenya are urged to adopt good agricultural practices to ensure safe food production. Stay informed on best practices and standards to boost market competitiveness.
Kiswahili: Wakulima nchini Kenya wanashauriwa kufuata mazoea bora ya kilimo ili kuhakikisha uzalishaji salama wa chakula. Baki na habari kuhusu mbinu bora na viwango ili kuimarisha ushindani sokoni.
Ekegusii: Ababere mu Kenya barakiire bategese buya bwa buya buya bota buya ka bwere umaki. Naki yenge ria buya omokireri naki abetune buya ubukiri bwaki bwonire buga.
Dholuo: Osiepe kanyakla e Kenya wanyal gichwach gi riyango maber managore ka otemo chakre mar duto. Wachal gi inyuol ma pwondi kendo kanyo ng'ato ni ohero e dho market.
Somali: Farmarada Kenya waxaa la farayaa inay qaataan dhaqamada wanaagsan ee beeraleyda si loo hubiyo in cunto ammaan ah la soo saaro. La soco dhaqamada ugu wanaagsan iyo heerarka si loo xoojiyo tartanka suuqa.

English: Locust-affected countries are encouraged to implement the recommended strategies for locust management and prevention discussed at the Desert Locust Control Committee meeting in Nairobi.
Kiswahili: Nchi zilizoathiriwa na nzige zinahimizwa kutekeleza mikakati inayopendekezwa ya usimamizi na kuzuia nzige iliyozungumziwa kwenye mkutano wa Kamati ya Kudhibiti Nzige wa Jangwa jijini Nairobi.
Ekegusii: Abantu abao bakenye're wekorori bamsabokire bamenyire emokiri eya mabehu naki bizira bionekere buya bwabeng'ana Bwakire Bwakirioria e Nairobi.
Dholuo: Mayanjore dholuo miyo timo ng'ato machiegni timbe to kony oting' ji mar lokust, kuom nyaka kinde ma koro ni e meeting mar Desert Locust Control Committee e Nairobi.
Somali: Dhulalka ay saameeyeen caarada waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay hirgeliyaan istaraatijiyadaha la talinayo ee maareynta iyo ka hortagga caarada oo lagaga hadlay shirweynaha Guddiga Xakameynta Caarada Caarada ee Nairobi.

English: The Kenyan government has developed the National Water and Sanitation Investment and Financing Plan (NAWASIP) for improving rural water and sanitation through infrastructure projects.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Kenya imeandaa Mpango wa Uwekezaji na fedha wa Maji na Usafi wa Mazingira wa Kitaifa (NAWASIP) kuboresha maji ya vijijini na usafi kupitia miradi ya miundombinu.
Ekegusii: Ongorori buya bwaki bw’oka Kenya buya buya bwakirana na plan ya Gichera na Nyaraki (NAWASIP) buya bwachoche buya bwakirori omokirori bwaki na nyaraki mwaki buya ogenda.
Dholuo: Gavamént mar Kenya onyiso National Water and Sanitation Investment and Financing Plan (NAWASIP) kugira kamano rwak iwuon ka gikwachoo gi manguo kod itho mar kit.
Somali: Dowladda Kenya waxay horumarisaa Qorshaha Maalgelinta iyo Maalgashiga Biyaha iyo Nadaafadda Qaranka (NAWASIP) si loo hagaajiyo biyaha iyo nadaafadda tuulooyinka iyadoo la adeegsanayo mashaariic kaabayaasha.

English: The Angololo dam project will supply water and irrigation to 270,000 people and benefit farmers in Busia and Bungoma counties in Kenya, and districts in Eastern Uganda.
Kiswahili: Mradi wa bwawa la Angololo utatoa maji na umwagiliaji kwa watu 270,000 na kunufaisha wakulima katika kaunti za Busia na Bungoma nchini Kenya, na wilaya za Mashariki mwa Uganda.
Ekegusii: Porojekiti ya Angololo itagetegana emanyisa na kwansiechia abaki 270,000 na ikarorere abaki ogenda mu Busia na Bungoma, Kenya, na masai mu Buganda ya mashariki.
Dholuo: Projekti mar Angololo didhi nengo ka omar dho piny kendo tiyo ng'ato 270,000. Bende otero dhok kaka miluongo mijo e Busia gi Bungoma, kendo ni diko e dhoot e Uganda mashariki.
Somali: Mashruuca damka Angololo wuxuu siin doonaa biyo iyo waraabin 270,000 qof wuxuuna caawin doonaa beeraleyda Gobeed iyo Bungoma ee Kenya, iyo degmooyinka Bariga Uganda.

English: 4.3 million registered farmers can now access subsidized fertilizer at KNTC and NCPB Stores for Kshs. 3500 per 50kg bag. Ensure you are digitally registered at Assistant Chief's offices to qualify.
Kiswahili: Wakulima milioni 4.3 waliojiandikisha sasa wanaweza kupata mbolea iliyopewa ruzuku katika maduka ya KNTC na NCPB kwa Kshs. 3500 kwa begi la 50kg. Hakikisha umejiandikisha kidijitali ofisini mwa Msaidizi Mkuu ili kuweza kufaidika.
Ekegusii: Abagabekeri 4.3 mirioni barore bokonye bwerusi bwanoka kusi mbokiri ya KNTC na NCPB bogosi bwaki Kshs. 3500 bwanoka 50kg. Naki nyakware digitali bwakurori kiwaki mu ofisi zabi Assistant Chief buana bwanio.
Dholuo: Wagadh 4.3 million ma ok nyaluo kare e konyo ka gani oher ka iberiek e KNTC to NCPB kuon Kshs. 3500 piny bag 50kg. Nomi iriyo chunyigi e ofisi ma Assistant Chief to ohinga.
Somali: 4.3 million beeralay ah ayaa hadda helaya bacriminta la deminayo ee KNTC iyo NCPB. Qiimaha waa Kshs. 3500 bacda 50kg ah. Hubi inaad si dijitaal ah iskooda diiwaan gelisay xafiisyada Kuxigeenka Maamulka si aad u xaqiijiso.

English: Farmers can access government subsidized fertilizer by dialing *707# to find their entitlements, choosing a nearby Agrovet shop, and paying Kshs. 3,500 via Mpesa.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanaweza kupata mbolea iliyofadhiliwa na serikali kwa kupiga *707# ili kujua haki zao, kuchagua duka la Agrovet karibu, na kulipa Kshs. 3,500 kupitia Mpesa.
Ekegusii: Ababere bangenyere omokireri buya bwa govana bae ifanya *707# buya bwa gaki, babonye agokinyaki Agroveta, bakanize Kshs. 3,500 kianyabandi Mpesa.
Dholuo: Maendeleo giii ka tich goyo duto dho Government, owuon kod *707# kuom weche mag mangima, nyisore dho Agrovet shop ma en chue, kuom nyiso Kshs. 3,500 gi Mpesa.
Somali: Beeraleydu waxay heli karaan bacriminta dowladda oo deyn ah iyagoo wacaya *707# si ay u ogaadaan xuquuqdooda, doorashana dukaanka Agrovet ee ugu dhow, kuna bixinaya Kshs. 3,500 habka Mpesa.

English: Farmers and stakeholders in the coffee sector should stay informed on upcoming changes as the Coffee Sector Implementation Committee will be led by the Deputy President to revitalize the industry.
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wadau katika sekta ya kahawa wanapaswa kubaki na habari kuhusu mabadiliko yanayokuja kwani Kamati ya Utekelezaji wa Sekta ya Kahawa itaongozwa na Makamu wa Rais ili kuhuisha sekta hii.
Ekegusii: Abagere na abaki bateke mu boro burori banele kugendera magero maagano amogadi ikwaga omokiri mwakiri, omokiri buya bwamagana nabwaki bwangania ebishi.
Dholuo: Ng'ato kanyakla gi jomoko mwanchie yogo ka dhi Kachieng' Kawa kuom bungu mochako. Jotigi cuwo gi Deputy President kaka okel gi kendo ngero yien.
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha qeybta kafeeha waa in ay la socdaan isbeddellada soo socda maadaama Gudiga Hirgelinta Qeybta Kafeega uu hoggaamin doono Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka si loo dib u soo nooleeyo warshadaha.

English: The Government is allocating Sh600 million to enhance fish farming and processing in Homa Bay. Farmers in the region are encouraged to participate in this initiative to increase their earnings.
Kiswahili: Serikali inaweka Sh600 milioni kuboresha ufugaji wa samaki na usindikaji katika Homa Bay. Wakulima katika eneo hili wanahimizwa kushiriki katika mpango huu ili kuongeza mapato yao.
Ekegusii: Ong'anya oseria Obwaki bw'egesa Sh600 mirioni kosi omokere ogwiani na omonyanga na Homa Bay. Aborori b'egesa b'ibwaki b'ekonyera buya omokang'ana kosi odiri bw'ogikiri.
Dholuo: Government en tich Sh600 million kuom chalo bwak jaluo kod wach chalo e Homa Bay. Jaluo mag piny ondiki konyo chwe moloyo kendo chuni kochwa kendo oter kanyo.
Somali: Dowladda ayaa u qoondeysay Sh600 milyan si kor loogu qaado beeralayda kalluunka iyo habaynta Homa Bay. Beeraleyda gobolka ayaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay ka qeybqaataan mashruucan si ay u kordhiyaan dakhliga ay helaan.

English: Counties selected for the pilot program on mainstreaming land use planning in County Integrated Development Plans include Elgeyo Marakwet, Vihiga, Narok, and Makueni.
Kiswahili: Kaunti zilizo chaguliwa kwa mpango wa majaribio wa kuingiza mipango ya matumizi ya ardhi katika Mipango ya Maendeleo ya Kaunti ni pamoja na Elgeyo Marakwet, Vihiga, Narok, na Makueni.
Ekegusii: Makiirira agewaki naki naki oe naki shio ohenche chirebaki naki na bwaki buliyo bwaki buligi bwaki chirebaki ogenda Obweni Elgeyo Marakwet, Vihiga, Narok, na Makueni.
Dholuo: Kaunti di gi piny ni gi chuny masira mar kuong' gi ch planning mar thim land e County Integrated Development Plans bed ni Elgeyo Marakwet, Vihiga, Narok, to Makueni.
Somali: Gobollada lagu doortay barnaamijka tijaabada ah ee ku saleysan qorsheynta isticmaalka dhulka ee Qorshayaasha Horumarinta Isku-dhafan ee Gobolka waxaa ka mid ah Elgeyo Marakwet, Vihiga, Narok, iyo Makueni.

English: Trans Nzoia County is receiving technical assistance from GIZ to develop its County Climate Change Act. Stakeholders are encouraged to participate in the review process to enhance climate resilience.
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia inapata msaada wa kiufundi kutoka GIZ ili kuandaa Sheria ya Mabadiliko ya Tabianchi ya Kaunti. Wadau wanahimizwa kushiriki katika mchakato wa ukaguzi ili kuboresha uhimili wa hali ya hewa.
Ekegusii: Trans Nzoia Nyaigena egonchere omogaka gi GIZ buya buya bwokinyangu bwogose buya ekotaki yabo. Abaki bakiibori baria batorore oborere buya bwachire boke bokioma omogaka.
Dholuo: Trans Nzoia County en geto nyaka gik mamoko kuom GIZ ji to giyot gi County Climate Change Act. Jogundi no ng'eyo kuom konyo mar yien nyaka ginyalo bende kuom idhuro mar yien.
Somali: Degmada Trans Nzoia waxay helaysaa caawimaad farsamo oo ka socota GIZ si ay u horumariso Sharciga Isbedelka Cimilada ee degmada. Dhamaan daneeyayaasha waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay ka qayb qaataan dib u eegista si loo xoojiyo adkeysiga cimilada.

English: The Kenyan government is training personnel to register farmers nationwide. All farmers are encouraged to participate to receive support through the subsidy program.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Kenya inawapa mafunzo wafanyakazi wa kuwasajili wakulima nchini kote. Wakulima wote wanahimizwa kushiriki ili wapate msaada kupitia mpango wa sub hivi.
Ekegusii: Omoigosi bwakire bw’akiita buya buria bwanaraki buya buya buigana bakira bosi. Abakira bosi barokire bungi bweng'ena buya bwokigane mwokiri buya bwakiita.
Dholuo: Oganda Kenya oting'o juri koro to konyo ma nyaka maag kanyakla. Kanyakla wane owa chieng' kuom nyaka-nomere kod joma konyo.
Somali: Dowladda Kenya ayaa tababareysa shaqaale si ay u diiwaan galiyaan beeralayda dalka oo dhan. Dhammaan beeralayda waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay ka qayb qaataan si ay u helaan taageero barnaamijka gargaarka.

English: The Galana/Kulalu National Food Security Project will focus on producing maize on 10,000 acres starting in February. Further preparations for an additional 10,000 acres will begin within 6 months.
Kiswahili: Mradi wa Usalama wa Chakula wa Galana/Kulalu utaangazia uzalishaji wa mahindi kwenye ekari 10,000 kuanzia Februari. Maandalizi zaidi ya ekari 10,000 zingine yataanza ndani ya miezi 6.
Ekegusii: Ongorori buya bwa Galana/Kulalu buya bw’otere magwakire buya bibori obwaki 10,000 muagachi bw’iga bwechigoti. Kibokire kendo kionge bw’otere obwaki 10,000 tochi bwaya mu 6 buya.
Dholuo: Galana/Kulalu National Food Security Project owinjore kaka ɓer koci maiz e 10,000 acres manie kutoka February. Kido maber kuom ngima 10,000 acres okwini kwayo kendo oting' six months.
Somali: Mashruuca Galana/Kulalu ee Amniga Cuntada Qaranka wuxuu diiradda saari doonaa soo saarista masagada 10,000 oo acra bisha Febraayo. Diyaarinta 10,000 oo acra oo dheeraad ah waxay bilaaban doontaa 6 bilood gudahood.

English: The Ministry of Agriculture and the Council of Governors are forming a technical team to review agricultural policies. Farmers and stakeholders can expect updates in four weeks.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo na Baraza la Magavana vinaunda timu ya kiufundi kutathmini sera za kilimo. Wakulima na wadau wataweza kutarajia taarifa mpya ndani ya wiki nne.
Ekegusii: Abwaki bw'Asunyi na Naki peetekenyaki ekikoro chaki etire bwakire bw'amasinda. Abakung'ana naki abaharire baria bakung'ana oria bokiaki buya buore bujire oria.
Dholuo: Ministry ma Nyaingo to ma Council of Governors nyal kony gi chalo chalo maaro kuom neno ma nyaka dhi nyalo. Abwino kata ma yende monego neno kendo maalongo kanyien gima ok nyal.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Golaha Madaxdhaqameedku waxay sameynayaan koox farsamo oo dib u eegis ku sameysa siyaasadaha beeraha. Beeralayda iyo daneeyayaasha waxay rajeynayaan warbixinno afartan todobaad gudahood.

English: Farmers can access subsidized fertilizer by dialing *707# on their phones.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanaweza kupata mbolea iliyo na ruzuku kwa kupiga *707# kwenye simu zao.
Ekegusii: Abakire bagana kuikora ebibere bironge, nyasa *707# pa foni yabo.
Dholuo: Chuni odhi nyaka inyalo chako ma okulu fertilizer mane oser ejogando *707# ka odhi nyaka.
Somali: Beeraleydu waxay heli karaan bacriminta subsidized adigoo wacaya *707# taleefankooda.

English: The 19th Triennial Symposium of the International Society for Tropical Root Crops is taking place in Nairobi from November 21 to 25. Stakeholders in the root crops sector are encouraged to participate.
Kiswahili: Simpozyamu ya 19 ya Kifungu cha Tatu ya Jumuiya ya Kimataifa ya Mazao ya Mizizi ya Kitropiki inafanyika Nairobi kuanzia Novemba 21 hadi 25. Wadau katika sekta ya mazao ya mizizi wanahimizwa kushiriki.
Ekegusii: Symposium ya 19 ya miaka mitatu ya Jumuiya ya Kimaataifa ya Mizizi ya Tropiki inafanyika Nairobi kuanzia Novemba 21 hadi 25. Wafanya biashara na wadau katika sekta ya mizizi wanahimizwa kushiriki.
Dholuo: Symposium mar 19 ma nyukula ni International Society for Tropical Root Crops inawera Nairobi odhiambo November 21 kendo 25. Nandika ni wadhi nyuka mar root crops wowadore ka withere.
Somali: Kulanada 19aad ee Triennial Symposium ee Ururka Caalamiga ah ee Khudaarta Ilkaha Kulaylka ayaa lagu qabanayaa Nairobi laga bilaabo 21ka ilaa 25ka Nofeembar. Waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa dhamaan dhinacyada danaynaya khudaarta in ay ka qaybqaataan.

English: Farmers are challenging the Seed and Plant Varieties Act (2012) in court, seeking to amend regulations that prohibit sharing and exchanging seeds. Stay informed on case developments.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanapinga Sheria ya Mbegu na Aina za Mimea (2012) mahakamani, wakitaka kubadilisha kanuni zinazokataza kugawana na kubadilishana mbegu. Fuata maendeleo ya kesi hii.
Ekegusii: Abakarori baki sibiiri Omoore bw'ekirigo na Omoore j'amasaga (2012) mu agano, bosi baki omogenda okogoya ebwaki bw'ogokora na ogoshisia abwaki. Birori bw'ekorwa naki.
Dholuo: Kagumba opong' gi Seed and Plant Varieties Act (2012) e doko, kendo wacho ni kanyakla mag joma nigi gi nyasaye to bedo koro kendo chali seed. Niyu komach bende ondugi gi ok gi neno bw'ondo.
Somali: Farmers ayaa maxkamad ku qabsanaya Xeerka Abuurka iyo Noocyada Dhirta (2012), iyaga oo raadinaya in la beddelo qawaaniinta mamnuucaya wadaagga iyo iswadaagga abuurka. Ka warhay horumarka kiiskooda.

English: Subsidized fertilizer is now available for farmers in counties planting during the short rains. Visit NCPB depots to access up to 100 bags per farmer, starting September 19, 2022.
Kiswahili: Mbolea iliyo na msaada sasa inapatikana kwa wakulima katika kaunti wanapopanda wakati wa mvua za msimu mfupi. Tembelea akiba za NCPB kupata mifuko 100 kwa kila mkulima, kuanzia Septemba 19, 2022.
Ekegusii: Omosubirio buya buya ogenda kaaboka buya oria abarakire mu nkiira ya shororaki. Naki NCPB buya gendaka omotagati 100 buya, nwaki September 19, 2022.
Dholuo: Fertilizer ma tich ni owinjore to okwalo ka jochiero keke ka ng'ato chuny. Genda NCPB chiu to inji kuom 100 bag kanyakla ng'ato, manok koro September 19, 2022.
Somali: Fershka la taageeray ayaa hadda la heli karaa beeraleyda ku sugan degmooyinka beeraya xilliga roobabka gaaban. Booqo xaraashyada NCPB si aad uga hesho ilaa 100 boorso beeraleyda, laga bilaabo Sebtembar 19, 2022.

English: The County Government of Uasin Gishu has trained AI service providers on digital record-keeping using the DigiCow Mobile Application for improved breeding reports.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu imetoa mafunzo kwa watoa huduma wa AI kuhusu uhifadhi wa kumbukumbu za kidijitali kwa kutumia Programu ya Mkononi ya DigiCow ili kuboresha ripoti za uzalishaji.
Ekegusii: Ongorogano buya bwa Uasin Gishu muige AI baaba orenge omokiri ogenda aka DigiCow Mobile Application kugeteka ekirukerio ekyogenda.
Dholuo: Chaguzi marier ka Uasin Gishu omiye AI piny ji gambo mag ding' maber e digital record-keeping kod DigiCow Mobile Application to gise chalo maber e report ma oketh.
Somali: Dowladda Hoose ee Uasin Gishu ayaa tababartay bixiyeyaasha adeegyada AI si ay u isticmaalaan barnaamijka DigiCow Mobile Application ee diiwaangelinta dijitaalka ah, si loo hagaajiyo warbixinada taranka.

English: The government will provide 1.4 million bags of fertilizer at Kshs 3,500 for a 50kg bag, down from Kshs 6,500, available starting next week to boost agricultural production.
Kiswahili: Serikali itatoa mifuko 1.4 milioni ya mbolea kwa Ksh 3,500 kwa mfuko wa 50kg, ikiwa ni punguzo kutoka Ksh 6,500, itapatikana kuanzia wiki ijayo ili kuimarisha uzalishaji wa kilimo.
Ekegusii: Omogaka onyakire 1.4 mirongo ya mkogoti na Kshs 3,500 buya 50kg, ogokuruga Kshs 6,500, omera egesa ng’ena ikirori oria gose omokiri omotiriri buya.
Dholuo: Chieng' mar government ni okinyi 1.4 miliyoni bag mar fertilizer ka Kshs 3,500 piyo bag moko, nindo kuom Kshs 6,500, ka ok nyal ket mokwongo ndalo nigi, kuom hwando mar inyal.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay bixin doontaa 1.4 milyan oo bacood oo bacriminta ah oo qiimahoodu yahay Kshs 3,500 bac 50kg ah, waxaana laga dhigey Kshs 6,500, laga bilaabo toddobaadka soo socda si loo xoojiyo wax soo saarka beeraha.

English: Farmers are advised to prepare for a potential decrease in fertilizer prices, with an announcement expected this week from the Ministry of Agriculture.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanashauriwa kujiandaa kwa uwezekano wa kupungua kwa bei ya mbolea, huku kutangazwa kutarajiwa hii wiki kutoka Wizara ya Kilimo.
Ekegusii: Abamanyia bano bosenye buya omogori bw'igwono bwakire, naki bacha bw'ogenda kwandikire bw'osibori buya buya buseka bw'ogendire buya bw'osekene bwi’Mizango ya Bukore.
Dholuo: Wuon piny en mar chonge konyo gi ndrvotruok thek, gi jomoko ma ywang' nyaka owacho hebu juma nigi Ministry of Agriculture.
Somali: Beeraleyda ayaa lagu wargelinayaa inay isku diyaariso hoos u dhac suurtagal ah oo ku yimaada qiimaha bacriminta, iyadoo lagu wadaa in dhawaan la soo saaro bayaan ka socda Wasaaradda Beeraha.

English: Kenyan avocado growers and exporters may soon access the Malaysian market as verification audits are underway. Ensure your orchards are registered and coded for compliance.
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wauzaji wa avokado nchini Kenya wanaweza kuweza kufikia soko la Malaysia hivi karibuni kwani ukaguzi wa uthibitisho unaendelea. Hakikisha mashamba yako yameandikishwa na kupewa nambari kwa ajili ya kufuata masharti.
Ekegusii: Abaranyi b'akiuguru b'akiagori na abashukari b'akiaka b'ekibere bw'otigwanire ku masoko g'ekiberia mang'anya. Nakiirere orori zanyu zibanjirie na zishandikire kugira omogotore bw'osiye.
Dholuo: Maendeleo maruo mar Kenya kata golo ng'ato dho Malaysia osetimo eyo nyaka mokuongo tich. Nidhi goro gi orchards yiene e dho konyo gi k coding dho compliance.
Somali: Beeralayda iyo dhoofiyayaasha avocado ee Kenya waxay u suurtageli doonaan inay suuqyada Malaysia gaaraan maadaama baaritaannada xaqiijinta socdaan. Hubi in beerradaada la diiwaangeliyo oo ay haysato koodh si waafaqsan.

English: Farmers in 57 districts of Uganda will benefit from the construction of new access roads, enhancing market access and boosting commercial agriculture.
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika wilaya 57 za Uganda watapata faida kutokana na ujenzi wa barabara mpya za kufikia masoko, kuimarisha upatikanaji wa masoko na kuongeza biashara ya kilimo.
Ekegusii: Abakiabaki mu distrikiti 57 za Uganda bokenye buya obwakore bw'ekikonde bw'egende, bwongera gucoketania na buya bwerere bw'ekitungi.
Dholuo: Ka tich chin, ma 57 districts e Uganda, ng'ato mago ok ohero e nyasaye mar kanyamre, to ng'ato mago ok gweyo ni hera mar buo mingo kelo.
Somali: Farmers ku sugan 57 degmo oo Uganda ah ayaa ka faa'iidaysan doona dhismaha waddooyin cusub oo sahli doona galitaanka suuqyada iyo kor u qaadista beeraha ganacsiga.

English: 3.2 million kgs of subsidized maize flour have been supplied to the market. Retailers are urged to sell at KES 100.00 per 2Kg packet to ensure accessibility for all.
Kiswahili: Mikate milioni 3.2 ya unga wa mahindi yenye subvension imesambazwa sokoni. Wauzaji wanahimizwa kuuza kwa KES 100.00 kwa pakiti ya 2Kg ili kuhakikisha upatikanaji kwa wote.
Ekegusii: 3.2 million kgs ya uji ya mahindi ya msada yamewasilishwa sokoni. Wauzaji wanatakiwa kuuza kwa KES 100.00 kwa pakiti ya 2Kg ili kuhakikisha upatikanaji kwa wote.
Dholuo: 3.2 million kg mariga maiz e yoa kuom chalo. Reta ileko kuom chath Juma KES 100.00 kuom packet 2Kg, to anyoneo kanyo ni yore bende.
Somali: 3.2 milyan kiiloogar dhoobada dhibcaha leh ayaa suuqa la keenay. Dukaamada waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay iibiyaan 100 KES per 2kg baakado si loo hubiyo in qof walba uu heli karo.

English: The Kenyan government has allocated Kshs 8 billion for a maize meal subsidy program, effective immediately and running until August 20, 2022. Prices are set at Kshs 52 for 1 kg, Kshs 100 for 2 kgs, and so on.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Kenya imepanga kutoa Kshs bilioni 8 kwa mpango wa ruzuku ya unga wa mahindi, unaanza mara moja na utaendelea hadi Agosti 20, 2022. Bei zimewekwa kuwa Kshs 52 kwa kilo 1, Kshs 100 kwa kilo 2, na kadhalika.
Ekegusii: Obwakire buya bw’ogende buya chi Kshs 8 billion bw’ogende buya mugo ogw’amaize, bwakire bw’osibori omokihiri na bw’ogende bulikire 20, 2022. Omokihiri buya bw’ogende buya chi Kshs 52 buya 1 kg, Kshs 100 buya 2 kgs, naki.
Dholuo: Jo Kenya wacho ni goberuma oseta Kshs 8 billion kuom piny ma piny malong'ori, to koro kawo e yo. Pesa gine Kshs 52 kuom 1 kg, Kshs 100 kuom 2 kgs, kendo ndalo duto.
Somali: Dowladda Kenya ayaa ay ku allocatay 8 bilyan Kshs barnaamij subsiidi ah oo lagu taageerayo cunto korinta mooska, kaasoo oo dhaqangelaya derbiyada hadda iyo socon doona ilaa 20ka Ogosto, 2022. Qiimuhu wuxuu noqonayaa 52 Kshs 1 kg, 100 Kshs 2 kgs, iyo wixii la mid ah.

English: Farmers are urged to adopt better agronomic practices and improve the use of fertilizers and quality seeds to enhance potato yields and returns despite current challenges.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahimizwa kujiunga na mbinu bora za kilimo na kuboresha matumizi ya mbolea na mbegu bora ili kuongeza mavuno ya viazi na faida licha ya changamoto zilizopo.
Ekegusii: Abakung'anya baregori ogokurera obokire bwakugori na bwakire bwahera bhogangania nyakenda ya mbokoni na obokire buseketio bushere bwakupatia omoshuma na bhokugeisha.
Dholuo: Ng'iyo penje ka mafarmer nyal piny ma ok nyal pwodhi e thum mar agjogo kendo ne ok nyal ganyore manyalo karom joma golo, pok kendo nyalo rek konyo ng'ato chiegni mar kare.
Somali: Farmers ayaa lagu boorrinayaa inay qaataan dhaqanno wanaagsan oo beeraha ah iyo inay hagaajiyaan isticmaalka bacriminta iyo abuurka tayada leh si loo kordhiyo dalagga doogga iyo soo celinta inkastoo caqabadaha hadda jira.

English: Farmers are urged to report any sightings of migratory and invasive pests to local authorities to aid in pest management efforts. Your timely reporting is crucial for the protection of crops and livelihoods.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanakumbushwa kuripoti kila wanapokutana na wadudu wahamiaji na waharibifu kwa mamlaka za ndani kusaidia katika juhudi za kudhibiti wadudu. Ripoti yako ya haraka ni muhimu kwa ulinzi wa mazao na maisha ya watu.
Ekegusii: Abagori barakire buya batarorie emunge ya migori na emori bendi bende buya nakiaboki bategere ogirori omokiri. Okubandabana bwaki bukire buya ebireke biahinda na buya bwaabaki.
Dholuo: Ng'ato ma nyaka ng'eyo owuon kadhiyo ma okinyi kata magoka ng'ato, chwijore kuom chabo makata kuom kudo pogruok mabor. Iseche ma oyie nyaka tiyo wacho ma oketh mangima kuom dhok seche mag chiemo kendo kachor.
Somali: Beeralayda waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay soo sheegaan aragtida cayayaanka hijrada iyo kuwa soo galootiga ah si ay gacan uga geystaan qorsheynta xalalka cayayaanka. Warbixintaada waqtigeeda waa mid aad u muhiim ah si loo ilaaliyo dalagyada iyo dakhliyada.

English: The National Coffee Farm Inputs Stimulus Package E-Subsidy Programme is now available for 82,650 eligible coffee farmers in 32 counties. Register to access subsidized inputs through accredited suppliers.
Kiswahili: Programu ya E-Subsidy ya Kifungo cha Wakulima wa Kahawa wa Kitaifa sasa inapatikana kwa wakulima 82,650 wa kahawa katika kaunti 32. Jiandikishe ili upate vifaa vilivyofadhiliwa kupitia wauzaji waliothibitishwa.
Ekegusii: Etoriyaki ya Nyaani ya Kofi E-Subsidy Programu ikwenda gi 82,650 aborai bwege b’okofi mwaki 32. Goigana buya oria buya bwaki bwokiyoria bwaki gagokire.
Dholuo: Chieng' mar National Coffee Farm Inputs Stimulus Package E-Subsidy Programme nyalo wacho maloyo gi 82,650 ma farmer duto mag kofi e 32 counties. Jotingo ka oting'o inputs mag subsidized kuom joma ng'ati.
Somali: Barnaamijka E-Suubbida ee Kaalmada Kheyraadka Beeraleyda Qaxwaha Qaranka ayaa hadda laga heli karaa 82,650 beeraley oo qaxwaha ah oo ka tirsan 32 degmo. Isdiiwaangeli si aad u hesho kheyraadka la taageeray oo ay bixiyaan alaab-qeybiyeyaasha la aqoonsan yahay.

English: Kenyan farmers can now trade poultry and poultry products with Uganda without administrative barriers following a recent agreement.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa Kenya sasa wanaweza kubadilishana kuku na bidhaa za kuku na Uganda bila vizuizi vya kiutawala kufuatia makubaliano ya hivi karibuni.
Ekegusii: Abagikuyo ba Kenya naki boine bara ikikung'anya burokuru bu kisonge na Uganda oborere amahinda abogotori.
Dholuo: Dala maber ahinya gi ochiek ne oganda, kawuono, omiye yath maber.
Somali: Farmers-ka Kenya hadda waxay ka ganacsan karaan digaagga iyo alaabada digaagga Uganda iyada oo aan wax caqabado maamul ah jirin ka dib heshiis dhawaan la gaaray.

English: The National Cereals and Produce Board is offering Ksh. 3000 per 90kg bag of maize. Farmers are encouraged to deliver their maize to NCPB depots; payment is processed within 24 hours.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Nafaka na Mazao ya Kitaifa inatoa Ksh. 3000 kwa gunia la mahindi la kilo 90. Wakulima wanahimizwa kuleta mahindi yao kwenye ghala za NCPB; malipo yanashughulikiwa ndani ya saa 24.
Ekegusii: Ekiro ya NCPB ikwenda kutoa Ksh. 3000 ku bag 90kg ya ugali. Bafungwa batarerete ugali bwose kubw’eki NCPB; omokirire cheng’ene naki 24.
Dholuo: NCPB (National Cereals and Produce Board) en loso Ksh. 3000 kendo gi bag 90kg maziwa. Waduong' en maruok kuom toga maziwa gi depot NCPB; ginyalo chako ng'ama 24.
Somali: Guddiga Qaranka ee Cuntooyinka iyo Waxsoosaarka wuxuu bixinayaa Ksh. 3000 bacda 90kg ee makhluuqa. Beeralayaasha waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay keeneen makhluuqdooda xarumaha NCPB; lacagta waxaa la bixiyaa 24 saac gudahood.

English: The draft Kenya Leather Development Policy has been developed to guide the growth of the leather sector. Stakeholders are encouraged to review and provide feedback on the draft.
Kiswahili: Sera ya Maendeleo ya Ngozi ya Kenya imeandaliwa ili kuongoza ukuaji wa sekta ya ngozi. Wadau wanahimizwa kupitia na kutoa maoni kuhusu rasimu hiyo.
Ekegusii: Itekeorane naki Kenya Leather Development Policy oria igokirekire kwisagane bw'ore obwakire bw'ekere. Abatekereri baragororiwa kwogecha na gucokania itekere.
Dholuo: Ng’ato eyo Kenya Leather Development Policy oting’ timo kuom nyalo ng’wech mar leather. Wuodhi nyaka nyis moke koro yaduo gi chunyi ka gima oting’ eyo.
Somali: Qorshaha Horumarinta Maqaarka Kenya ayaa la diyaariyay si uu u hagayo kobaca qeybta maqaarka. Qaybaha daneynaya waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay dib u eegaan oo ay bixiyaan fikradahooda ku saabsan qodobka.

English: Effective November 18, 2021, sugarcane prices will increase to Ksh. 4,112 per tonne. Farmers receiving less should report to the Agriculture and Food Authority (AFA).
Kiswahili: Kuanzia Novemba 18, 2021, bei za miwa zitaongezeka hadi Ksh. 4,112 kwa tani. Wakulima wanapokea chini ya hapo wanapaswa kuripoti kwa Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA).
Ekegusii: Eka November 18, 2021, oria oria bwogogoria bwakiriri bujore bwakiri Ksh. 4,112 bujoria. Ababere oria bangenia bujore boki ogotire ku AFA (Agriculture and Food Authority).
Dholuo: Kaa November 18, 2021, piny, ng'weny wang' piny ji malan gango miyo Ksh. 4,112 kanyakla. Mabin miyo mawuok piny, chako koro gung' Akwach kod Chakruok (AFA).
Somali: Laga bilaabo Nofembar 18, 2021, qiimaha sonkorta ayaa korodhay Ksh. 4,112 tonkiiba. Beeralayda helaya qiimo ka hooseeya waa inay u soo gudbiyaan Warbixin Hay’adda Beeraha iyo Cunnada (AFA).

English: 4K Clubs are being rolled out nationwide. Primary schools should establish 4K clubs as directed by the Principal Secretary to the Directors of Education.
Kiswahili: Klabu za 4K zinanzishwa nchi nzima. Shule za msingi zinapaswa kuanzisha klabu za 4K kama ilivyoagizwa na Katibu Mkuu wa Wakurugenzi wa Elimu.
Ekegusii: Makarati ma 4K emaroreka mo osiogo. Soko mosi igendere 4K matego bui ogendere omogobori wa Principal Secretary buse boragani bwakagendo.
Dholuo: 4K clubs ni dongo manok e pinje kae. Sukulu maruok to en gima owayo 4K clubs kendo toge eyo Principal Secretary osetim kendo gima oje mar Education.
Somali: Naadiyada 4K ayaa lagu faafinayaa dalka oo dhan. Dugsiyada hoose waxay waajib ku tahay in ay aasaasaan naadiyada 4K sida uu amray Xoghaya Guud ee Agaasimayaasha Waxbarashada.

English: The government has implemented reforms in the tea sub-sector to support smallholder tea growers facing declining earnings; stay informed about new policies and pricing updates.
Kiswahili: Serikali imeanzisha mabadiliko katika sekta ya chai kusaidia wakulima wadogo wa chai wanaokabiliwa na upungufu wa mapato; kuwa na habari kuhusu sera mpya na masasisho ya bei.
Ekegusii: Obwaki buya buya omokere omokurire buya bwete chogori bwogenda omokurire orete hamwe omogende oremokiri. Bwakire buya buorwa bwemberere naki omokubiki ogire.
Dholuo: Government ikelo sida kuom tea ma piny to yongo ja-tea piny gur kendo ogend kanyo to puon gi chako; weche mar yudo ni owuon ramba kendo ng’ato ni chogo mar nyasaye.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay hirgelisay isbeddello ku saabsan qaybta shaaha si ay u taageerto beeralayda yaryar ee dhibaateysan. La soco siyaasadaha cusub iyo wararka qiimaha.

English: To become an agricultural produce exporter, ensure you have an export license from the relevant authority, register your company, and undergo training on the Electronic Certification System (ECS).
Kiswahili: Ili kuwa mzalishaji wa mazao ya kilimo anayesafirisha nje, hakikisha una leseni ya usafirishaji kutoka kwa mamlaka husika, sajili kampuni yako, na upitie mafunzo juu ya Mfumo wa Kuthibitisha wa Kielektroniki (ECS).
Ekegusii: Naki buya omogori buya, ebwaki emihoka ya kigee na ogete naki oshire naki ikoni, oreka oria eko omogori, na ogenda oria ogotere mokinyo omokirigori kwa Electronic Certification System (ECS).
Dholuo: To konyo chung' gi lweny, wacho kanyo ne inye licens mar lweny sigendni, register gi kamano, kendo duong' gi chike ma okinyi kuom Electronic Certification System (ECS).
Somali: Si aad u noqoto dhoofiye soosaarka beeraha, hubi inaad haysato ruqsad dhoofin oo ka socota hay'adda ku habboon, iska diiwaan geli shirkaddaada, oo tababar ka qaado Nidaamka Shahaadada Korontada (ECS).

English: Industry associations urge farmers and agribusiness stakeholders to support their petition to Parliament to review and overturn the health committee's recommendation on agricultural input bans.
Kiswahili: Mashirika ya sekta yanawasihi wakulima na wanachama wa biashara za kilimo kuunga mkono ombi lao kwa Bunge la kuitazama upya na kubadili pendekezo la kamati ya afya kuhusu marufuku ya pembejeo za kilimo.
Ekegusii: Abakire ba mashinani baria bakare nyasa etakire banong'ere ogori na abakeroka baki batisia omotetere buya bwa Parliament bujenge buya omokireri buya boti bwere buya omogano bwagere bucokerere obokireri bwosi bwokireri.
Dholuo: Nyuol gi wathoya gima okinyi podi owadawa kanyasi to akang' yien wuotho mar Parlemendi kopa gima ng'ato en jodak agikere kuom kwaya maji mar nyukawan ohala.
Somali: Ururada warshadaha ayaa ku boorinaya beeralayda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beeraha inay taageeraan codsigooda Baarlamaanka si loo eego loona buriyo talooyinka guddiga caafimaadka ee ku saabsan mamnuucidda alaabada beeraha.

English: Training for 1,000 deep-sea fishers from coastal counties begins; eligible youth encouraged to participate in the program for employment opportunities in the Blue Economy sector.
Kiswahili: Kuweka mafunzo kwa wavuvi 1,000 wa baharini kutoka kaunti za pwani kunaanza; vijana wanaostahili wanahimizwa kushiriki katika mpango huu wa fursa za ajira katika sekta ya Uchumi wa Buluu.
Ekegusii: Omosurari buya 1,000 abaki a deep-sea fishers bwakinyora; abaki bazarenda naki obwakirori bokenye bwere bwotahi mu Blue Economy.
Dholuo: Ong'eyo pik masira kuom 1,000 mar fisher mag nyika nigi; nyaka nyasach mar youth nyo nyal tinde kendo jaluo ng'ato e yo kendo tyenyo gi chalo mag Blue Economy.
Somali: Tababarka 1,000 kaluumaysato oo badda qoto dheer ah ayaa bilowday; dhallinyarada ku habboon waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay ka qaybqaataan barnaamijka si ay fursado shaqo uga helaan qeybta Dhaqaalaha Buluugga.

English: Ten primary schools in Nairobi have received 10,000 seedlings to support 4-K Clubs; schools are expected to utilize their produce in the School Feeding Programme.
Kiswahili: Shule kumi za msingi Nairobi zimepata miche 10,000 kusaidia Klabu za 4-K; shule zinatarajiwa kutumia mazao yao katika Mpango wa Kula Shuleni.
Ekegusii: Mokinyanenge buya buono bwagoyaki mu Nairobi bwegokora 10,000 emekia obwakire 4-K Clubs; buya buya bwakiri bogo bwakiogoya buya buya bwenyene mu School Feeding Programme.
Dholuo: Mana primary schools gang' Nairobi en e wach 10,000 seedlings kuom nyaka 4-K Clubs; shule nyaka okinyi e weche mag nyaka.
Somali: Tobon dugsiyo hoose ah oo ku yaal Nairobi ayaa helay 10,000 geedo si ay u taageeraan 4-K Clubs; dugsiyadu waxaa laga filayaa inay u isticmaalaan toodka barnaamijka Quudinta Dugsiga.

English: A minimum export price for tea has been established at the Mombasa auction. All tea producers and sellers must comply to ensure a sustainable industry.
Kiswahili: Bei ya chini ya kuuza chai imewekwa kwenye mnada wa Mombasa. Wazalishaji na wauzaji wote wa chai lazima wahakikishe kuzingatia ili kuhakikisha sekta endelevu.
Ekegusii: Eng'ende emokireri y'oshokiri okarete buya buya bw'itega bw'ose; abashokiri naki abakereri b'obw'itega b'ogotiana gukirire buya bw'ose bw'ogetie.
Dholuo: Dhi nyaka kanyo chiegni mar tea e Mombasa auction. Wanyalo nyaka duto ka nyaka cha omego, ka wuoth wanyonge gima nyal nyalo timbe.
Somali: Qiimaha ugu yar ee dhoofinta shaaha ayaa lagu dejiyay tartanka Mombasa. Dhammaan soo saarayaasha iyo iibiyeyaasha shaaha waa inay uwada hogaansamaan si tayada warshaddu u joogteyso.

English: Horticulture producers and transporters must use covered, well-ventilated vehicles for transporting fruits and vegetables to comply with the new quality mark. Familiarize yourself with the standards immediately.
Kiswahili: Wazalishaji na wasafirishaji wa kilimo lazima watumie magari yaliyo na kivuli na yenye hewa nzito kwa ajili ya kusafirisha matunda na mboga ili kuzingatia alama mpya ya ubora. Jifunze viwango hivi mara moja.
Ekegusii: Abagosi b’ihigani na abashori baki bakenye bakenye naki badi motokari aberekere boki naki aberenyi buya na buya omokiranga buya bo naki begsora kwayi ogatia obori bwao. Bwakire omogenda naki bwaki.
Dholuo: Mokoro mar horticulture e konyi konyo, nyaka wacho masek e joma kamano. Nakiweyo gi joma itok madhi, mar yore gi kendo ma ineno. Tiyo nendi joma mar yore.
Somali: Soosaarayaasha iyo gaadiidka beerta waa inay adeegsadaan gaadiid daboolan oo hawada wanaagsan leh si ay u qaadaan khudaarta iyo miraha si waafaqsan calaamadda tayada cusub. Isku baro heerarka sida ugu dhakhsaha badan.

English: The government is implementing reforms to improve tea prices for farmers, including an automated auction system to enhance trading efficiency. Tea farmers are encouraged to stay informed on these changes.
Kiswahili: Serikali inatekeleza mageuzi kuboresha bei za chai kwa wakulima, ikiwa ni pamoja na mfumo wa mnada wa kiotomatiki ili kuboresha ufanisi wa biashara. Wakulima wa chai wanahimizwa kubaki na ufahamu kuhusu mabadiliko haya.
Ekegusii: Abagere bataraita onchendi buya oria bwakiijire omokire buya bwetene bwabere, buya buchemete bwokere jendo buya bwakire omokere. Abagere bataraita bazi bwanogoni oria omokire buya.
Dholuo: Gavumenti ji chako koro nengo piny manyo ka te ipok gi goyewe, kuom kanyakla goye kendo chopo te, ma oket gi nyiseche mag joma chwech. Joma chwech tee gingo chungo ni gi tchok joma tije miyo gima chayo.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay hirgelinaysaa dib-u-habeyn si kor loogu qaado qiimaha shaaha beeraleyda, oo ay ku jirto nidaam xaraash otomaatig ah si loo hagaajiyo hufnaanta ganacsiga. Beeraleyda shaaha waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay la socdaan isbedeladan.

English: The newly elected KTDA board is urged to implement reforms that will enhance support for over 600,000 smallholder tea farmers. Immediate action is required to prioritize farmers' interests.
Kiswahili: Bodi mpya iliyochaguliwa ya KTDA inasihiwa kutekeleza marekebisho ambayo yatasaidia wakulima wadogo wa chai zaidi ya 600,000. Vitendo vya haraka vinahitajika kuweka mbele maslahi ya wakulima.
Ekegusii: Abaki bwakire bwo KTDA baria bakanogetere omokiriri bwakire bwakire buya bwhore bwaki bwakiri busibere abaki bageria abang’enda 600,000. Omosang'ana naki ohorere omokiriri bwaki bwantia abaki.
Dholuo: Chieng' mar KTDA nyaka omiyo mag'o ng'ato to gigo eyo ka wan gi tinya mar 600,000 nyasare te. Gii ma ok mano koro nofoko gi nyasare.
Somali: Guddiga cusub ee la doortay ee KTDA waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay hirgeliyaan isbeddello kor u qaadi doona taageerada in ka badan 600,000 oo beeraleyda shaaha yar. Waxqabadyada deg-degga ah ayaa loo baahan yahay si loo hormariyo danaha beeraleyda.

English: The Coffee Bill, 2021 is currently undergoing public participation. Coffee farmers and stakeholders are encouraged to review the proposed reforms and provide feedback.
Kiswahili: Muswada wa Kahawa, 2021 unashughulikia ushirikishwaji wa umma kwa sasa. Wakulima wa kahawa na wadau wanaweza kupitia mapendekezo ya marekebisho na kutoa maoni yao.
