Ekegusii: Omoige naki, 2021, okenyagia na omokinyani buya. Abashamba b’ekahero naki abakiikire bategenyi bakiwaki omogoya buya naki bategenyi nyansokere.
Dholuo: Chakre ma Nyasaye, 2021 nyalo be oyuk gi public participation. Jagweya ma konyo kofi kod joma okonyo gin bende bende ni ginyalo weche kuom chalo.
Somali: Xeerka Qaxwaha, 2021 wuxuu hadda marayaa ka-qaybgal dadweyne. Beeralayda qaxwaha iyo daneeyayaashu waxaa la dhiirrigelinayaa inay dib u eegaan isbadallada la soo jeediyay oo ay bixiyaan jawaab-celin.

English: The Nairobi Coffee Exchange remains under the Coffee Directorate's oversight; the Capital Markets Authority is advised to refrain from licensing it as an auction.
Kiswahili: Kubadilishana Kahawa ya Nairobi bado iko chini ya usimamizi wa Idara ya Kahawa; Mamlaka ya Masoko ya Mitaji inashauriwa kuepuka kuipa leseni kama mnada.
Ekegusii: Nairobi Coffee Exchange ikirora naki omokirori wa Coffee Directorate; Capital Markets Authority ite naki miene oborambo omakwanja.
Dholuo: Nairobi Coffee Exchange nigi kendo oduk e gigo ma nigi Coffee Directorate; Capital Markets Authority en joma owinjo koro to nyalu kanyalo luwore kar koro eyo.
Somali: Nairobi Coffee Exchange waxay weli ku jirtaa kormeerka Maamulka Qaxwaha; waxaa la talinayaa Hay'adda Suuqyada Raasamaal inaysan siin shati iibgeyn.

English: Farmers in Uganda, please note the official vanilla harvest date has been declared. Ensure optimal harvesting practices to maintain quality and profitability.
Kiswahili: Wakulima nchini Uganda, tafadhali kumbukeni tarehe rasmi ya mavuno ya vanila imetangazwa. Hakikisheni mbinu za mavuno bora ili kudumisha ubora na faida.
Ekegusii: Abakire b’ewakire Uganda, naki oria oguchengera buya bw’eringo buya botiire. Naki bakore omokiririo ogweeng’anya amahoro na enyakibori.
Dholuo: Wang'ni gi Uganda, naki mar en ng'ato mar vanilla oremo! Kete eyo ka itimre gima omiyo olok, to yie e ng'ama oganda.
Somali: Dhalinyarada Uganda, fadlan ogow in taariikhda rasiidka vaniljada la shaaciyey. Hubi inaad raacdo hababka ugu fiican ee qodista si aad u ilaaliso tayada iyo faa’iidada.

English: East African countries are implementing integrated rice sector development initiatives to reduce imports. Farmers and agribusinesses are encouraged to engage in regional partnerships and investment opportunities.
Kiswahili: Nchi za Afrika Mashariki zinaanzisha mipango ya maendeleo ya sekta ya mchele ili kupunguza uagizaji. Wakulima na biashara za kilimo wanakumbushwa kujiunga katika ushirikiano wa kikanda na fursa za uwekezaji.
Ekegusii: Maki abaki bendi ya East Africa nakiore shingo kuganda omonane wa rice ore osibori. Abakire nakiore bosi buya buya bakanana omokibere emosi nakiire enyange ya bhaki.
Dholuo: Mabii do ng'wech e Kenya nobed ringo mar rice nying' wadhom to gi chako mironji. Joka ng'ato kendo agwamboch en g'eyoji kuom chike magoko mar kit, to kuber e walore mar ringo gi dpuegi kendo piny.
Somali: Dalka Bariga Afrika waxay fulinayaan himilooyin is dhexgal ah oo ku saabsan horumarinta qaybta bariiska si loo yareeyo dhoofinta. Beeralayda iyo ganacsiyada beeraha waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay ka qayb qaataan iskaashiga gobolka iyo fursadaha maalgashi.

English: Apply for the KSh 2.2 billion ENABLE Kenya agribusiness fund to receive interest-free loans and training, designed to empower 10,000 youths in agribusiness.
Kiswahili: Tumia ombi la mfuko wa biashara ya kilimo wa ENABLE Kenya wa KSh 2.2 bilioni ili upate mikopo isiyo na riba na mafunzo, iliyoundwa kusaidia vijana 10,000 katika biashara ya kilimo.
Ekegusii: Naki omokirigania omokoya KSh 2.2 billion ENABLE Kenya buya bwang’ere obwakirori bwebwaki obwakira kondo buya obwakisigana moki, buya bwaki omoshinjaki 10,000 buya boke bweria buya omokirigania.
Dholuo: Nyang'ore ka oremo chalo KSh 2.2 billion ENABLE Kenya ma kochung' ching' gi katek, to ikwongo piny nije maber opiyore, ma omera 10,000 nyasachieng' kuom agribusiness.
Somali: Codso fonka ENABLE Kenya oo ah KSh 2.2 bilyan si aad u hesho amaah aan danayn iyo tababar, oo loogu talagalay in awood lagu siiyo 10,000 dhalinyaro oo ku lammaan ganacsiga beeraleyda.

English: The Kenyan government is reviewing the Plant Protection Act to enhance plant health regulations. Stakeholders are encouraged to provide comments on the Draft Plant Protection Bill, 2021.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Kenya inakagua Sheria ya Ulinzi wa Mimea ili kuboresha kanuni za afya ya mimea. Washiriki wanahimizwa kutoa maoni kuhusu Muswada wa Sheria ya Ulinzi wa Mimea, 2021.
Ekegusii: Abakerere baki Abakuru b'ekibari b'ekibere b'ogenda ogusomoka mu naki bw'ekobori b'ekirembani b'ogenda ogumanya. Ababere baziere omokubaka bw'ogenda ogwechana ebireka bu Gekere, 2021.
Dholuo: Gavana wa Kenya aneno ni kuok gi Plant Protection Act mano ok owiye ng'ato maber. Nyasaye mondo owacho ginyalo dongo mag matut kuom Draft Plant Protection Bill, 2021.
Somali: Dowladda Kenya waxay dib u eegaysaa Sharciga Ilaalinta Dhirta si loo xoojiyo xeerarka caafimaadka dhirta. Codsiyada ka qeybgalayaasha waxaa lagula talinayaa inay soo jeediyaan fikradahooda ku saabsan Qeybta Qorshaha Ilaalinta Dhirta, 2021.

English: New regulations require licensing to keep bees in Kenya. Register as a commercial beekeeper to own a beehive or face penalties. Apply to your local CEC for a one-year certificate.
Kiswahili: Sheria mpya zinahitaji leseni kwa ajili ya kulea nyuki nchini Kenya. Jisajili kama mfugaji nyuki wa kibiashara ili uwe na mzinga wa nyuki au usikose adhabu. Omba cheti cha mwaka mmoja kwa CEC wako wa eneo.
Ekegusii: Amakinyagia matigori maikinyere omogori buya omong’ana Kisii. Orope okore buya buya ogang’ana na ogori gaki omokigo. Bwakire ku CEC ya ino oria omokiri omoka.
Dholuo: Ng'ato ne gin jekelo makelo kuom bee e Kenya. Chako jochung' bee ma kadhok be e chak mwanjore kendo to chiwo mayok. Nyal gamo jochak CEC makiwuok e yo nyaka maber.
Somali: Xeerarka cusub waxay u baahan yihiin in la helo ruqsad si loogu hayo shinbiro Kenya. Isdiiwaangeli sidii beeralay ganacsi si aad u leedahay shinni-guriga ama wajaho ciqaab. Codso shahaadada hal sano ee CEC-da deegaankaaga.

English: A crackdown is ongoing against traders and transporters packaging Irish potatoes in bags exceeding 50 kg. Compliance is mandatory in Nyandarua, Nakuru, Narok, Elgeyo Marakwet, Uasin Gishu, Meru, and West Pokot counties.
Kiswahili: Kukamatwa kunaendelea dhidi ya wafanyabiashara na wasafirishaji wanaopakua viazi vya Kiairi katika mifuko inayozidi kilogramu 50. Kufuata sheria ni lazima katika kaunti za Nyandarua, Nakuru, Narok, Elgeyo Marakwet, Uasin Gishu, Meru, na West Pokot.
Ekegusii: Omosendo oseria mosa ogenda buya naki andori naki oria dusoto irio ga 50 kg. Kiai kiang’anya naki Nyandarua, Nakuru, Narok, Elgeyo Marakwet, Uasin Gishu, Meru, na West Pokot.
Dholuo: Ng'ama kelo chalo kuom traders gi transporters kuom Irish potatoes eh kwaya manok 50 kg. Teko chuth ni kamano ku Nyandarua, Nakuru, Narok, Elgeyo Marakwet, Uasin Gishu, Meru, gi West Pokot.
Somali: Ilaalinta ka dhanka ah ganacsatada iyo gaadiidka ayaa socda kuwaas oo xidhaya baradho Irish ah oo ka badan 50 kg. Raacista sharciga waa mid lagama maarmaan ah oo ka jira degmooyinka Nyandarua, Nakuru, Narok, Elgeyo Marakwet, Uasin Gishu, Meru, iyo West Pokot.

English: The government will assist newly elected officials of smallholder Tea Factories in assuming control from KTDA employees. Enhanced security measures will be implemented immediately.
Kiswahili: Serikali itaunga mkono maafisa wapya waliochaguliwa wa Viwanda Vidogo vya Chai katika kuchukua udhibiti kutoka kwa wafanyakazi wa KTDA. Hatua za usalama za kuongeza zitatekelezwa mara moja.
Ekegusii: Ong'ana katuria bwakire buya na abogendi ba tea bochari buya bwanikumi bwakanya bakirere buya na abaki ba KTDA. Omochere omoshanga bwakire bwakiranani.
Dholuo: Government nying' to reh wendo ma joma e yo wacho kuom kuonde kendo otieno gi joma KTDA. Moko mag nyalo sechego kuom yiengi e tije.
Somali: Dowladda ayaa ka caawin doonta mas'uuliyiinta cusub ee la doortay in ay maamulaan warshadaha shaaha ee ganacsatada yaryar, iyadoo shaqaalaha KTDA laga wareejinayo. Talaabooyin amni oo la xoojiyey ayaa si degdeg ah loo hirgelin doonaa.

English: No actionable information for farmers or agribusiness stakeholders is present in this article.
Kiswahili: Hakuna taarifa ya kitendo kwa wakulima au wadau wa biashara ya kilimo katika makala hii.
Ekegusii: Obwakire bwaki bwaki oreta buya buya bwaki obwakire bwaki buya buya ama.
Dholuo: Okwong' piny ni wach ni okwongo kanyisi ma nyaka momiyo kanyisi ma nyaka mokoro ma kendo kik piny gi nyisachi kendo gik mung' kendo wegegi.
Somali: Maqaalkaan wax macluumaad ah oo dhaqan-dhaqaale ah laguma helin beeraleyda ama daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beeraha.

English: The government is considering revising the Coffee Cherry Fund regulations to better benefit coffee farmers, including potential access to farm inputs on credit.
Kiswahili: Serikali inafikiria kurekebisha kanuni za Mfuko wa Nyanya ya Kahawa ili kuwafaidi wakulima wa kahawa zaidi, ikiwemo uwezekano wa kupata vifaa vya kilimo kwa mkopo.
Ekegusii: Ababere boki nakiore omogori wa Coffee Cherry Fund nakiore bwana bwaki boki omokiyaki, nakiore ogenda omokiyaki buya buore jia oria.
Dholuo: Government nyaka kar tinde ma ok nyal chalo Coffee Cherry Fund ngam yore okul ninde joma chalo, ka nyalo yudo chiemo kuom owete malong'oya.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay tixgelinaysaa in la dib u eegayo xeerarka Fondka Kafeega si ay uga faa'iideystaan beeralayda kafeega, oo ay ku jiraan suurtagalnimada helitaanka agabka beerta oo amaah ah.

English: Smallholder tea factories elections will be held as per the timetable released by CS Munya; all smallholder tea farmers are encouraged to participate.
Kiswahili: Chaguzi za viwanda vidogo vya chai zitaandaliwa kulingana na ratiba iliyotolewa na CS Munya; wakulima wote wa chai wadogo wanahimizwa kushiriki.
Ekegusii: Amakoreo ma tea bwaki burofia buya bwokigana na CS Munya; abarakari b’amatongori ma tea bwaki naki naki bategane buya.
Dholuo: Chik jothurwa magi matindo mabor e yo tielo ma ginyis gi CS Munya; jothurwa magi yotia hera nying' e yo.
Somali: Doorashada warshadaha shaaha ee beeraleyda yaryar ayaa dhacaysa sida uu sheegay jadwalka uu soo saaray CS Munya; dhammaan beeraleyda shaaha yaryar waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay ka qayb qaataan.

English: The Kenya Dairy Industry Regulations, 2021 are now law, establishing a minimum farm gate price of Kshs. 33 per kilogram of milk delivered. Farmers are urged to familiarize themselves with the regulations.
Kiswahili: Sheria za Sekta ya Maziwa za Kenya, 2021 sasa ni sheria, zikitoa bei ya chini ya Kshs. 33 kwa kilogramu ya maziwa inayosambazwa. Wakulima wanahimizwa kujifunza kuhusu sheria hizi.
Ekegusii: Amakara ya Kenya ya Dairi, 2021, nakiia buya, ekerere omokirori ogwere ogire naki Kshs. 33 buya endabaki ya emukiri emu. Abagikosi baria banye bokenyagia na amakara aya.
Dholuo: Sharia ma okinyi kuom buya dhoKenya, 2021 nyaka ahor, omiyo wachni kendo joma ber kachok gigo ilos ma Kshs. 33 kuom kilo mar uji. Joma kendo ochung' giye to ng'ama en joma obiro twok gi sharia pone.
Somali: Sharciyada Warshadaha Caanaha Kenya, 2021 hadda waa sharci, iyadoo la dejiyay qiimaha ugu yar ee farm gate-ka oo ah Kshs. 33 kiilogram caano ah oo la keenay. Beeralayda waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay isbaran la noqdaan shuruucdan.

English: Exporters of maize to Kenya must provide certificates of conformity to confirm compliance with aflatoxin safety standards after recent bans due to contamination concerns.
Kiswahili: Wauzaji wa mahindi nchini Kenya lazima watoe vyeti vya ufuataji ili kuthibitisha kufuata viwango vya usalama wa aflatoksini baada ya marufuku ya hivi karibuni kutokana na wasiwasi wa uchafuzi.
Ekegusii: Abakire beere buya ku Kenya gosi bosi kosi buya ikereria ne bakiragwaniane omokirori bw' aflatoxin after omokirori bw' irera omokiri.
Dholuo: Jokambidi maziwa ku Kenya nyal piny ng’ato dhi konyo choko madwaro ma Jiwo mar aflatoxin kendo nind gi thoth kuom joma ok metal.
Somali: Dhoofiyeyaasha masagada u taga Kenya waa inay bixiyaan shahaadooyin waafaqsan si loo xaqiijiyo in ay u hoggaansamaan heerarka badbaadada aflatoxin ka dib mamnuucidii dhawaan ee sababo la xiriira wasakhowga.

English: The Agriculture & Food Authority (AFA) will begin immediate inspections to ensure food safety across the country. Farmers and vendors must comply with regulations to avoid penalties.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) itaanza ukaguzi wa haraka ili kuhakikisha usalama wa chakula nchi nzima. Wakulima na wauzaji wanapaswa kuzingatia kanuni ili kuepuka adhabu.
Ekegusii: Naki AFA oria omokirigana siana buya bori agekenye emonyokwa osegana. Abaki na abaki oria baria buia oria bioria omokirigana oria biongorera motifs.
Dholuo: Agriculture & Food Authority (AFA) okonyo ng'ato mar wach mar inspections onge mondo gi jwako mar kutik chakruok kanyakla. Gik kidhori kaka owach kuom duto nyaka ginyalo weyo to rung'ri.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraha iyo Cuntooyinka (AFA) waxay bilaabi doontaa kormeer degdeg ah si loo hubiyo amniga cuntada guud ahaan dalka. Beeraleyda iyo ganacsatada waa inay raacaan xeerarka si ay uga fogaadaan ciqaabta.

English: The Agriculture & Food Authority (AFA) has launched the Agriculture Information Management System (AIMS) to facilitate online registration, licensing, and access to information for traders.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kilimo na Chakula (AFA) imezindua Mfumo wa Usimamizi wa Taarifa za Kilimo (AIMS) kurahisisha usajili wa mtandaoni, upatikanaji wa leseni, na taarifa kwa wafanyabiashara.
Ekegusii: Abagere n'Abagabachori ba AFA batang'anya oria Airaguru Ifonga (AIMS) bw'osiogori buya bw'okwisandiika, okwirira oboreri, na oborwa enche buya bu Abataragani.
Dholuo: Agriculture & Food Authority (AFA) ne eyo kuom Agriculture Information Management System (AIMS) e nyaka akwong' gi online, wuoth, kod ndalo kuom chalo mar traders.
Somali: Hay'adda Beeraheeda & Cuntada (AFA) waxay bilowday Nidaamka Maareynta Macluumaadka Beeraha (AIMS) si loo fududeeyo diiwaangelinta khadka tooska ah, ruqsadaha, iyo helitaanka macluumaadka ganacsatada.

English: Attention maize farmers: The Kenyan government has enacted an immediate ban on maize imports due to health concerns regarding mycotoxins. This will help improve local maize prices.
Kiswahili: Tafadhali wakulima wa mahindi: Serikali ya Kenya imeweka marufuku ya haraka juu ya uagizaji wa mahindi kutokana na wasiwasi wa afya kuhusu mykotoksini. Hii itasaidia kuboresha bei za mahindi hapa nchini.
Ekegusii: Abakiriya obori: Omoigowe mwaki wa Kenya omoja ogenda omokinyire oborio bwa obori bubia bwamuriri bwakinyang'ia oborogoro. Ite egesang'ana okogenda ebia obori bwaki.
Dholuo: Wachieng’ mawuoyo: Mwakanya Kenya abiro bende e yo ma ng’ombe marach kuom nyaka nyako ma mycotoxins. Niyi bende nobirongo konyo buo ma ng’ombe marach e owuon gi tinde.
Somali: Digniin beeralayda kaydka: Dowladda Kenya waxay soo rogtay mamnuuc rasmi ah oo ku saabsan soo dejinta kaydka sababo la xiriira caafimaadka oo ku saabsan mycotoxins. Tani waxay ka caawin doontaa kor u qaadista qiimaha kaydka gudaha.

English: Non-deposit taking Saccos must now comply with the Sacco Societies (Non-Deposit Taking Business) Regulations by June 30, 2021. Ensure your operations meet the new requirements.
Kiswahili: Sacco zisizo na amana lazima sasa zifuate Kanuni za Jamii za Sacco (Biashara zisizochukua Amana) kufikia tarehe 30 Juni 2021. Hakikisha shughuli zako zinakidhi mahitaji mapya.
Ekegusii: Saccos abaki bategana ogukorera naki ekontrera ya Sacco Societies (Non-Deposit Taking Business) nyasa na June 30, 2021. Naki omokore mwaki naki omokore oboragani.
Dholuo: Saccos ng'weny ma nyalo koda ndalo oparo maduong' ahinya gi Sacco Societies (Non-Deposit Taking Business) Regulations kendo bende ng'ato mipogore nyalo gi guche midwaro kendo neno gi chalo makati.
Somali: Saccos aan lacag lagu deyn karin waxaa looga baahan yahay inay u hogaansamaan xeerarka ganacsiga Saccada (Sacco Societies (Non-Deposit Taking Business) Regulations) ilaa 30-ka Juun 2021. Hubi in hawlahaagu ay la jaanqaadaan shuruudahan cusub.

English: Coffee farmers are urged to apply for the Kshs. 3 billion Coffee Cherry Advance Fund available through New KPCU. Society officials must sign forms to facilitate access.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa kahawa wanahimizwa kuomba fedha ya awali ya shilingi bilioni 3 ya Kahawa Cherry kupitia New KPCU. Maafisa wa ushirika wanapaswa kusaini fomu ili kuwezesha ufikiaji.
Ekegusii: Abakera buya banochere bige nayo ekirori Kshs. 3 billion ya Coffee Cherry Advance Fund oseria New KPCU. Abakire ba buya banganiana ondokere obwaki bosi.
Dholuo: Ng’ama ji jare kaka gik medho e Kshs. 3 billion neni pa Coffee Cherry Advance Fund ma oting'a e New KPCU. Okwong' mar jo gini to yudhi rejogo kuom nyis.
Somali: Farmayaasha qaxwaha waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay codsadaan Kshs. 3 bilyan oo ah Fondka Horudhaca Kafeega Cherry ee laga heli karo New KPCU. Mas'uuliyiinta ururka waa inay saxeexaan foomamka si loo fududeeyo helitaanka.

English: All tea in Kenya will be sold electronically at the Mombasa Auction starting next month. Organizers must prepare for inspection by ICT experts to ensure compliance with the Tea Act 2020.
Kiswahili: Chai yote nchini Kenya itauzwa kwa njia ya kielektroniki kwenye Mauzo ya Mombasa kuanzia mwezi ujao. Waandaaji wanapaswa kujiandaa kwa ukaguzi na wataalamu wa ICT ili kuhakikisha kufuata Sheria ya Chai ya 2020.
Ekegusii: Tea yako yose mu Kenya itakiri kutendekigwa mu mtandao ku Mombasa Auction ikiangia mwisi egesia. Baaberi baki nyong’ere oboka bwokiri bwokirioria na abakora b’i ICT baki kuchanurira ku getonte kaabaki kosi kiori Tea Act 2020.
Dholuo: Chai wote ku Kenya bende pod yiw dhok e Mombasa Auction nyaka kisumu tich. Bunga mwach ni wawadhi kendo othego kuom kindo nyathi e ICT chike mag nyiso chiemo mar Tea Act 2020.
Somali: Dhammaan shaaha Kenya waxaa lagu iibin doonaa si elektaroonik ah oo ku saabsan Mombasa Auction bilowga bisha soo socota. Qaban-qaabeeyaashu waa inay isu diyaariyaan kormeerka khubarada ICT si loo hubiyo in la raacayo Sharciga Shaaha 2020.

English: The Tea Board of Kenya has been re-established to regulate and promote the tea industry. All tea factories can soon sell their produce; stay tuned for further updates.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Chai ya Kenya imeanzishwa upya ili kudhibiti na kukuza tasnia ya chai. Kiwanda vyote vya chai vinaweza hivi karibuni kuanza kuuza mazao yao; fuatilie kwa taarifa zaidi.
Ekegusii: Omosiranani wa Chai ya Kenya oria ogendire oria gosiore irembe na okwenda bwi chage omotora. Ekarorena ya chagi gechure oria chacha bwananane; miinyankirire oria nyamogoti.
Dholuo: Tea Board of Kenya en gi koro mondo owuoyo maber kod yiegi. Waduogi wa tea nyaka nyalo tinde ni owuonye; no giyawore sini gi weka.
Somali: Guddiga Shaaha ee Kenya ayaa dib loo aasaasay si ay u nidaamiyaan oo u taageeraan warshadaha shaaha. Dhammaan warshadaha shaaha waxay dhawaan bilaabi doonaan inay iibiyaan alaabtooda; la soco warar dheeraad ah.

English: Effective January 1, 2021, smallholder tea farmers under KTDA-managed factories will face a new Minimum Tax that reduces their income by over KShs 754 million annually.
Kiswahili: Kuanzia tarehe 1 Januari 2021, wakulima wadogo wa chai katika viwanda vinavyosimamiwa na KTDA watafungwa kwa kodi mpya ya Chini inayopunguza mapato yao kwa zaidi ya KShs 754 milioni kila mwaka.
Ekegusii: Rokiya 1, 2021, abasheno batega mwaki batesetanga buya mu KTDA bagokoranga ikigori kiong'era omokongi buya bwa kashoka KShs 754 million mwaki.
Dholuo: Kodin January 1, 2021, chalo machon te nyingi mar KTDA bende nyaka gin tax moko manit ma nitie limbe joma chalo kanyakla KShs 754 million piny dar tije.
Somali: Laga bilaabo 1-da Janaayo 2021, beeraleyda shaaha yar yar ee ku hoos jira warshadaha KTDA waxay la kulmi doonaan Canshuurta Ugu Yar ee cusub, taasoo dhimi doonta dakhliga ay helaan in ka badan KShs 754 milyan sanadkiiba.

English: Youth farmers in agriculture face challenges accessing credit. Strategies to improve credit access are crucial for purchasing inputs and investing in agribusiness.
Kiswahili: Wakulima vijana katika kilimo wanakutana na changamoto za kupata mikopo. Mikakati ya kuboresha upatikanaji wa mikopo ni muhimu kwa ajili ya kununua vifaa na kuwekeza katika biashara za kilimo.
Ekegusii: Abana batoro bakiabere mu buya nakiita busegereta bwakienda buya. Ebirori bikwandi bisi ekegusii egere wantatire busegereta bwakienda bwakienda nakienda mu buragari.
Dholuo: Gik ma yath jaluo nyaka weche e yo konyo gik mang'ich. Ngeche mag nyaka to kuom yie konyo gik mang'ich en tich kaka yenye gima oyie ka oyonni e ginyasa.
Somali: Dhalinyarada beeraleyda waxay la kulmaan caqabado ku saabsan helitaanka deyn. Istaraatiijiyadaha lagu hagaajinayo helitaanka deynta waa muhiim si loo iibsado agabka loona maalgeliyo ganacsiga beeraha.

English: The Tea Bill has been passed by the Senate, reintroducing the Tea Board. Stakeholders are advised to prepare for future consultations regarding the Bill's implementation.
Kiswahili: Muswada wa Chai umepitishwa na Seneti, ukirejesha Bodi ya Chai. Washiriki wanashauriwa kujiandaa kwa mashauriano yajayo kuhusu utekelezaji wa muswada huu.
Ekegusii: Eteere ya Chai emosiokire na Seneti, ekeria Chai Oria. Abaki bataragani baabaki buya banzire bungi bwokore ibwaki bwakere chairoya eteere.
Dholuo: Tea Bill oter kanyono ma Senate, kendo oterni Tea Board. Waduong’ mago bende cha okinyi kaka wanyalo yocha nyasaye motegno joma chayo.
Somali: Sharciga Shaaha ayaa la ansixiyay, waxaana dib loo soo celiyey Guddiga Shaaha. Xubnaha saamileyda waxaa lagu talinayaa inay is diyaariyaan kulamada mustaqbalka ee ku saabsan hirgelinta sharciga.

English: The Senate has rejected the Crops (Tea Industry) Regulations, 2020. Stakeholders in the tea industry should stay informed about any forthcoming regulations regarding county roles in agriculture.
Kiswahili: Seneti imekata rufaa kuhusu Kanuni za Mazao (Sekta ya Chai), 2020. Wadau katika sekta ya chai wanapaswa kubaki wazi kuhusu kanuni zozote zitakazokuja zinazohusiana na majukumu ya kaunti katika kilimo.
Ekegusii: Abashere banga batorokere shibori buya bwaki dishamani, 2020. Abashere banga mu shibori shatee nibashorore kwaki banzorie omokireri banye buya bwaki bwokirori bwakirori bangesi.
Dholuo: Seneti omer duto gi Crops (Tea Industry) Regulations, 2020. Jochunge mag te miele gote nyaka ji chopo ng'ato kaka en konyruok motegno konyruok ka bende gi ng'ato chwech mar miri.
Somali: Senatku waxay diideen Sharciga Beeraleyda (Warshadaha Shaaha), 2020. Saamilayda warshadaha shaaha waa inay la socodsiiyaan wax kasta oo shuruuc cusub ah oo ku saabsan doorka dowladaha hoose ee beeraleyda.

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders can soon benefit from the Warehouse Receipt System (WRS), allowing them to deposit commodities in certified warehouses and obtain receipts for financing.
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo hivi karibuni watafaidika na Mfumo wa Risiti za Ghala (WRS), ambao unawawezesha kuweka mizigo katika ghala zilizothibitishwa na kupata risiti za kufadhili.
Ekegusii: Abakore bategana na abatekelani ba ibansia bategana buya na Sistema ya Receiti ya Kutonga (WRS), buya bwaki bwogenda kutehe buse, okaiga emechinge mu meburi amakire na okogeta receiti buya bwogende omonyereri.
Dholuo: Dongo mar nyakwar e odhiambo ma WRS, ma ok joudhi kod dhogi, kuom karuok to e tek ma ochung' nyamre e warehause mang'eny e ndo, kikonyore kamini mag piny.
Somali: Farmers iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beeraleyda ayaa dhowaan ka faa'iideysan kara Nidaamka Qaansheegadka Bakhaarka (WRS), taasoo u oggolaaneysa inay dejiyaan alaabooyinka bakhaarka la shahaado iyo inay helaan rasiidka maalgelinta.

English: The Kenyan government has allocated Kshs 8 billion for maize meal subsidies to support farmers facing challenges.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Kenya imetenga Kshs bilioni 8 kwa ajili ya ruzuku ya unga wa mahindi kusaidia wakulima wanaokabiliwa na changamoto.
Ekegusii: Obwaki bw'ekegena bu na Kshs 8 billion bw'ekiri kiaki bwakireri ogwaki mukia obwakire bw'amaraka.
Dholuo: Gatuongo ka tend gi Kshs 8 billion kuom maziwa ma idhi gi oria ma kosi ombenda kanyoru.
Somali: Dowladda Kenya ayaa qoondeysay Kshs 8 bilyan oo loogu talagalay deeqo cunto ah si ay u taageeraan beeralayda dhibaatooyinka wajahaya.

English: Download the recently launched agriculture reforms bills essential for the sector from the Ministry of Agriculture's website.
Kiswahili: Pakua muswada wa mabadiliko ya kilimo uliozinduliwa hivi karibuni muhimu kwa sekta hiyo kwenye tovuti ya Wizara ya Kilimo.
Ekegusii: Dekia magabi matigori omonchaki oreba oria mensibori kuvwaki enyuero ya Ministry of Agriculture.
Dholuo: Dhi nyaka download milambo ma okethi e ng'ato mar agri-kultura oseyudo to minitri mar agri-kultura.
Somali: Soo deji sharciga wax-soo-saarka beeraleydu oo cusub ee muhiimka u ah waaxda, bogga internetka ee Wasaaradda Beeraha.

English: Coffee factories can now register as autonomous societies under the Co-operative Societies Act. Millers and marketing agents are prohibited from lending to farmers; violations will be penalized.
Kiswahili: Fabriki za kahawa sasa zinaweza kujisajili kama jamii huru chini ya Sheria ya Jamii za Ushirika. Wakamataji na mawakala wa masoko hawaruhusiwi kukopesha wakulima; anayekiuka atachukuliwa hatua.
Ekegusii: Naki omokireri bochekire buya buse bw'anga buya bosi naki omokireri buya buse bw'anga buya bosi. Ababere naki abashang’ira buya bosi babere obwakare buse bwa ngabere; obwakare bwakiri buya bwosetengeka.
Dholuo: Panyuka amadi, magendo ma kuya ng'ato ni konyo kuber kanyakla mo Pako mar Waki. Madiro kod maer ma oket richo kuyet ku mawuo; maler ma ok leka ni oketo.
Somali: Fursadaha qaxwada hadda waxay iska diiwaan gelin karaan ururo madax-bannaan oo ka hooseeya Xeerka Ururada Iskaashatada. Millers iyo wakiilada suuqgeynta ayaa mamnuuc ka ah inay amaahdaan beeraleyda; ku xadgudubku wuxuu keeni doonaa ciqaab.

English: Farmers and stakeholders are invited to submit their views on five new agricultural reform bills within 21 days. Get involved to help shape the future of key crop value-chains.
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wadau wanakaribishwa kuwasilisha maoni yao kuhusu muswada mitano ya mageuzi ya kilimo ndani ya siku 21. Shirikiana ili kusaidia kuunda mustakabali wa minyororo ya thamani ya mazao muhimu.
Ekegusii: Abagengenzi na batisari barakire bwerekane amande yabo ku mirongo mitano y’amategeko g’ emihingo g’ akabuni mu nsi ya buya 21. Naki mu bwonchani mw'ango bunge obuki ya bwega bw'ekimera.
Dholuo: Manji ang'wen kawuono ka abiro chak asekalo e yo mar piw. Kawuono ni hia ma e yo mar kitgi kuom hok bende kendo mach 21. Timbe to gii wuoyo mar juma ma piny.
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha waxaa lagu casuumay inay soo gudbiyaan fikradahooda ku saabsan shan xeer cusub oo dib-u-habeyn beeraha ah 21 maalmood gudahood. Ka qaybqaado si aad uga qayb qaadato hormarinta silsiladaha qiimaha dhirta muhiimka ah.

English: The government will not interfere in the fertilizer market; dealers can plan based on a free market. Farmers are to benefit from affordable prices.
Kiswahili: Serikali haitaz interference katika soko la mbolea; wafanyabiashara wanaweza kupanga kwa msingi wa soko huru. Wakulima watafaidika na bei nafuu.
Ekegusii: Ong'enda ikirongo na ing'enda orego mugetajenda wa fertilizer; abashanga naki kosi bwanire. Abagori boki buya omokiri buya.
Dholuo: Chandruok ohinga to ng'eyo mar fertilizer; ji ma ok oganda keto kanyach maber. Waduong' koro ji gin maler kanyakre.
Somali: Dowladdu kama qeyb qaadan doonto suuqyada bacriminta; ganacsatadu waxay qorsheyn karaan iyagoo ku saleynaya suuq furan. Beeralaydu waxay ka faa'iidi doonaan qiimaha jaban.

English: Tea-growing Counties are urged to stay informed on the ongoing legal dispute over proposed tea regulations as Governors challenge their implementation in court.
Kiswahili: Mikoa inayokua chai inasihiwa kubaki na habari kuhusu mgogoro wa kisheria unaoendelea juu ya kanuni mpya za chai huku Magavana wakipinga utekelezaji wake mahakamani.
Ekegusii: Abakiga tea baria baria baishikane buya buya omogori oko omosi nyaki te amenities naki buya agete ibagani buya vigori mwane omoborere na aogotana na oria buya ibachere egenda.
Dholuo: Dhiroi mar tea e pinje mag tea ni owdhi e neno ma oketi koni e hukum, kendo gweno dhenge gi oking' nyime.
Somali: Gobollada shaaha beeraha ayaa lagu boorinayaa inay la socodsiiyaan muranka sharci ee socda ee ku saabsan xeerarka shaaha la soo jeediyay, maadaama guddoomiyayaasha ay ka dardaarmeen hirgelintooda maxkamadda.

English: Celebrate International Coffee Day on October 1st by supporting fair trade coffee and raising awareness of the challenges faced by coffee growers.
Kiswahili: Sherehekea Siku ya Kimataifa ya Kahawa tarehe 1 Oktoba kwa kusaidia kahawa inayouzwa kwa njia ya haki na kuongeza ufahamu kuhusu changamoto wanazokumbana nazo wakulima wa kahawa.
Ekegusii: Sherehekea Omogori Ogw'oseka ku 1st Okitobara oseria buya bu bajoge bu omogori naki kose ne bature bu omogori.
Dholuo: Naki International Coffee Day ku Oktober 1nd kochung' hiti kod chir gi yore ma okonyo olelo ni kaka gi wendo oboch goyo joma nindo konyo.
Somali: Dabaaldeg Maalinta Caalamiga ah ee Qaxwada bisha Oktoobar 1deeda adigoo taageeraya ganacsiga caddaaladda iyo kor u qaadista wacyiga ku saabsan caqabadaha ay la kulmaan beeraleyda qaxwada.

English: Over 200,000 households are benefiting from the 1 million kitchen gardens initiative. Households are encouraged to participate for fresh produce and a healthy diet.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya nyumba 200,000 zinafaidika na mpango wa mabwawa ya bustani za jikoni milioni 1. Nyumba zinahimizwa kushiriki ili kupata mazao freshi na lishe bora.
Ekegusii: Abaki 200,000 boki biri boke benarire naki 1 million naki yaki. Baki bioria batorerere bokire buya buya na ikirori bwanika.
Dholuo: Abiro 200,000 nyumbani en aduong' e 1 million kitchen gardens initiative. Nyumbani en gin konyre kaka nochako e piny kendo nyalo yudo kanyamo medhe.
Somali: In ka badan 200,000 qoys ayaa ka faa'iidaysanaya ololaha beerta jikada ee 1 million. Qoysaska waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay ka qaybqaataan si ay u helaan wax soo saarka cusub iyo cunto caafimaad leh.

English: By March 2021, all fishing vessels in Kenyan waters must land their catch at Kenyan Ports to avoid license revocation.
Kiswahili: Kwa Machi 2021, vyombo vyote vya uvuvi katika maji ya Kenya lazima vikamilishe samaki zao katika Bandari za Kenya ili kuepuka kufutwa kwa leseni.
Ekegusii: Ogesi buya 2021, obokere bweng'ere buya bungi bw'ochekera mu buya bw'ekichaki bwa Kenya bwakire na buya bw'otoburanya mu buya bwa Kenya buya okuhinda obwakiri bwabukore.
Dholuo: Kula mar 2021, chike mosando konyo got dondi e nyim Kenya nyalo tigwa kuom port mag Kenya, iye to yore moe nyal moneno.
Somali: Bishii Maarso 2021, dhammaan markabada kalluumeysiga ee badda Kenya waa inay ku keensadaan kaluumadooda dekedaha Kenya si looga fogaado in shatiga la joojiyo.

English: Farmers are encouraged to engage with New KPCU for coffee milling, marketing, and warehousing services, as well as to access the Coffee Cherry Advance Revolving Fund.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahimizwa kuungana na New KPCU kwa ajili ya huduma za kukamua kahawa, masoko, na hifadhi, pamoja na kupata ufadhili wa mbele wa Cherry ya Kahawa.
Ekegusii: Abaguli bagarire kweng’ana na New KPCU ku bwang'ania bw’ekoffee, bwang'iana, na bwakiganya, khorugire naki bw’egerebwa bw’ama bwang’ikọmoka bwi’ekoffee.
Dholuo: Odhiambo en ka wacho kuom New KPCU manok gi miling, marketing, to warehousing, kendo kuom wach ni owachok owiwo ka wacho mag Coffee Cherry Advance Revolving Fund.
Somali: Farmers waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay la shaqeeyaan New KPCU si ay u helaan adeegyada korbinta, suuq-geynta, iyo kaydinta kaabayaasha, iyo sidoo kale inay helaan Sanduuqa Wareejinta Hore ee Kafeega.

English: Public participation is open for the new Warehouse Receipt System regulations. Farmers and stakeholders are urged to submit their views to ensure effective implementation.
Kiswahili: Ushirikiano wa umma umefunguliwa kwa sheria mpya za Mfumo wa Risiti za Ghala. Wakulima na wadau wanasisitizwa kuwasilisha maoni yao ili kuhakikisha utekelezaji mzuri.
Ekegusii: Omoigoti buya buya buya bw'ekibung'ane bw'amateka ya Warehouse Receipt System buya. Ababereki n'abakinyag'anyi batoragorwe okuwetai buya bw'ogotang'anya ikinyang'anyi.
Dholuo: Piny kiwuok gi public participation ma oting' goyogi Warehouse Receipt System. Waduong' manono kuom joma ngi jowe nyaka nene ni jodo chiegni.
Somali: Ka qaybgalka dadweynaha ayaa furan sharciga cusub ee Nidaamka Risiidhka Bakhaarka. Farmingayaasha iyo daneeyayaasha ayaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay soo gudbiyaan fikradahood si loo xaqiijiyo hirgelinta waxtarka leh.

English: The Kshs. 16.5 million Urum dam has been launched in Turkana to address water shortages. Communities are urged to participate in ensuring its effective use for peace and development.
Kiswahili: Kiwanda cha Urum chenye gharama ya milioni Kshs. 16.5 kimezinduliwa Turkana ili kushughulikia upungufu wa maji. Jamii zinahimizwa kushiriki katika kuhakikisha matumizi yake bora kwa ajili ya amani na maendeleo.
Ekegusii: Dam ya Urum ya Kshs. 16.5 million imetangazwa Turkana kugana na upungufu wa maji. Jamii zinahimizwa kushiriki kuhakikisha inatumika vyema kwa amani na maendeleo.
Dholuo: Urum dam ya Kshs. 16.5 million ema yienginji e Turkana ng'ato kelo to tich mar ng'ayo. Maber mondo okawo kod wachoni e yo ng'ato marguor e weche, gi koth.
Somali: Biyaha Urum oo qiimihiisu yahay 16.5 milyan Kshs ayaa la furay Turkana si loo xalliyo dhibaatooyinka biyaha. Bulshooyinka waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay ka qeyb qaataan sidii loo xaqiijin lahaa isticmaalkeeda waxtar leh si loo gaaro nabad iyo horumar.

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders are urged to support the implementation of the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA) for improved trade and food security.
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo wanahimizwa kusaidia utekelezaji wa Eneo la Biashara huru la Afrika (AfCFTA) ili kuboresha biashara na usalama wa chakula.
Ekegusii: Abakora mirima nakiiborishe batarane bano bategere igeze miyarang'ana ya African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA) buya buya inyemi nakiendeke.
Dholuo: Owino gi jalruok ma okonya ber e Afika ka achiel (AfCFTA) mondo ubed gi chike mag chogo gi chieng' ma nyal.
Somali: Biyaha iyo shaqaalaha beeraleyda waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay taageeraan hirgelinta Aagga Ganacsiga Xoriyadda Qaaradda Afrika (AfCFTA) si loo hagaajiyo ganacsiga iyo amniga cuntada.

English: Kenya will continue to import fish to address an annual deficit of 350,000 metric tonnes. Stakeholders are encouraged to invest in the aquaculture value chain to boost local production.
Kiswahili: Kenya itaendelea kuagiza samaki ili kukabiliana na upungufu wa tani 350,000 za metrik mwaka. Wadau wanahimizwa kuwekeza katika mnyororo wa thamani wa ufugaji wa samaki ili kuimarisha uzalishaji wa ndani.
Ekegusii: Kenya ikwenda oria guchekane emokire buya 350,000 metric tonnes omokire. Abakire bano bokunyora obori naki obwaki buya oria kukisaki oria omokire.
Dholuo: Kenya bende nijou ng'eyo ore gichako ka orembe chuth 350,000 metric tonnes. Wuoth kata nodak e pinje makinyon gi chikeyo mar aquaculture koda omiyo wakonyo ng'eyo mar juma.
Somali: Kenya waxay sii waday in ay soo dejiso kalluun si ay u xalliso kharashka sanadkiiba ah ee gaadhaya 350,000 metric tonnes. La-taliyayaasha waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa in ay maal-gashadaan silsiladda qiimaha aquaculture si kor loogu qaado soo saarka gudaha.

English: Bamboo is now classified as a scheduled crop under the Crop Act, offering advantages such as reduced regulatory barriers and promoting private investment in agriculture.
Kiswahili: Bamboo sasa imeainishwa kama zao lililo katika orodha ya sheria chini ya Sheria ya Mazao, ikitoa manufaa kama vile kupunguza vizuizi vya kiserikali na kuhamasisha uwekezaji wa kibinafsi katika kilimo.
Ekegusii: Bamboo naki isagusi mokonchori omokirima buya buya bw'Omokirima, buseke banyanirakania busege buya busekonokire buya bw'ogichaki bw'ubusongana omokirima.
Dholuo: Bamboo nigi chieng' mar kar kanyo ma joge kanyo, khinyo ng'ato mar wuoth kende kendo yo mwandu matin goyo lank.
Somali: Bamboo hadda waxaa loo aqoonsaday inay tahay dalag qorsheysan sida ku qoran Sharciga Dalagga, iyadoo bixineysa faa'iidooyin sida dhimista caqabadaha sharciga iyo kor u qaadista maalgashiga gaarka ah ee beeraha.

English: The County Government of Nyandarua has launched a dairy value chain strategic plan to enhance the dairy sector. Farmers are encouraged to participate and maximize production.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Kaunti ya Nyandarua imezindua mpango wa kimkakati wa minyororo ya thamani ya maziwa ili kuimarisha sekta ya maziwa. Wakulima wanahimizwa kushiriki na kuongeza uzalishaji.
Ekegusii: Oboka bw'Nyandarua bwabwaki obwakire bw'ogwokogetitie bw'egirori buya buya bw'ekanyore bwanaki oboranya bw'egirori. Abagikosi batorerere goigana na buiga bw'ogwiria.
Dholuo: Gavana wa County ya Nyandarua okwel dhi kanyadha mar nind gi joma kanyadhagi ma nyori kanyuholi. Jochung' owuon ng'ato yichung' ka igello sigand kanyudo.
Somali: Dowladda degmada Nyandarua waxay bilowday qorshe istiraatiijiyadeed oo loogu talagalay silsiladda qiimaha caanaha si loo koriyo qeybta caanaha. Beeralayda waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay ka qaybqaataan oo ay kordhiyaan wax soo saarka.

English: The Country Agribusiness Partnership Framework (CAP-F) has been launched to enhance agribusiness partnerships and investments in Kenya. Stakeholders are encouraged to engage with this framework for improved collaboration.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Ushirikiano wa Biashara ya Kilimo Nchini (CAP-F) umeanzishwa ili kuboresha ushirikiano na uwekezaji wa biashara ya kilimo nchini Kenya. Wadau wanah encouraged kushiriki na mfuko huu kwa ajili ya ushirikiano bora.
Ekegusii: Nakiire buya bwa Country Agribusiness Partnership Framework (CAP-F) bwakiye bushisire buya bwa agribusiness na utarimbo mu Kenya. Abakinyi baibori abere buya bwiye buya na bwaniga buya kana buya.
Dholuo: Acode mag Ng'wechjore gi Kichung' gi Kanyoni (CAP-F) ne okel ka okonyo nyaka en joma chalo gi buoyo mar agik. Jomoko nyal nyiri gi ng'wechjore yieng' kuom mar yieng' kanyo.
Somali: Qaab-dhismeedka Wada-shaqeynta Ganacsiga Beerta Dalka (CAP-F) ayaa la furay si loo xoojiyo iskaashiga iyo maalgashiga ganacsiga beerta ee Kenya. Hawl-wadeenada waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay la shaqeeyaan qaab-dhismeedkan si loo hagaajiyo iskaashiga.

English: Farmers can now receive 50% of insurance premiums funded by the Government for crop losses, covering farms from ½ to 20 acres. Purchase your insurance to qualify.
Kiswahili: Wakulima sasa wanaweza kupokea asilimia 50 ya ada za bima zinazofadhiliwa na Serikali kwa ajili ya hasara za mazao, ikifunika mashamba kutoka ekari ½ hadi 20. Nunua bima yako ili kufuzu.
Ekegusii: Abagere baretagiye 50% ya biki ya inashoni buya bu naki ogana bw'ogorokire bwanane, bano bw'ogana ½ kugeza 20 acres. Gura inashoni yawe oregi mwene.
Dholuo: Owino gi 50% mar dirigida dhiye mag insurans kata govenoma gidhi chalo gi thum, maok oting' kwaya maneno. Bede insurans ni ukan duto.
Somali: Beeralaydu hadda waxay heli karaan 50% lacagta caymiska oo dowladda maalgelinayso si looga badbaado khasaaraha dalagga, iyadoo la daboolayo beero u dhexeysa ½ illaa 20 acre. Iibsato caymiskaaga si aad u noqoto mid u qalma.

English: The Inter-sectoral Forum on Agrobiodiversity and Agroecology (ISFAA) is now launched to promote collaboration among stakeholders in biodiversity and agriculture. Engage with ISFAA for knowledge sharing and policy influence.
Kiswahili: Jukwaa la Sekta Mbalimbali kuhusu Agrobiodiversiti na Agroekolojia (ISFAA) sasa limezinduliwa ili kukuza ushirikiano kati ya wadau wa biodiverse na kilimo. Jiunge na ISFAA kwa ajili ya kubadilishana maarifa na kuathiri sera.
Ekegusii: Forum ya Inter-sectoral ku Agrobiodiversity na Agroecology (ISFAA) imeanzishwa kuimarisha ushirikiano kati ya wadau katika bioanuwai na kilimo. Jiunge na ISFAA kwa ajili ya kubadilishana maarifa na kuathiri sera.
Dholuo: Inter-sectoral Forum ma Agrobiodiversity kod Agroecology (ISFAA) nyaka owyore, to yawi yiengo kanyakla mag nyiri, gi chandruok. Bende ohinga ISFAA kendo gi piny mar chanya gi ochanda.
Somali: Furaha Isku-xidhka ee Agrobiodiversity iyo Agroecology (ISFAA) waxaa hadda la furay si loo xoojiyo iskaashiga ka dhexeya daneeyayaasha ee dhirta noolaha iyo beeraha. La xiriir ISFAA si aad uga qeyb gasho wadaagidda aqoonta iyo saameynta siyaasadda.

English: All tea factories managed by KTDA must comply with new tea regulations by 31st March 2021 or face penalties, including license suspension or legal charges.
Kiswahili: Fabriki zote za chai zinazodhibitiwa na KTDA lazima zifuate kanuni mpya za chai kufikia tarehe 31 Machi 2021 au zitakabiliwa na adhabu, ikiwemo kusimamishwa kwa leseni au mashtaka ya kisheria.
Ekegusii: Bwakire bwetegero bw'amatiki bu KTDA bwetegere nyanchani moteki bu goibori bw'aitariye bu 31st March 2021, omogori obwane tichu, omokiriga bwe mechakire bwomokugwe naki tichu omokiriga.
Dholuo: Factory zose konyo gi KTDA nyalo poga nyal rapar piny kaka chiegni mag tei kendo nyalo chalo ruk gima 31 March 2021, wanda to anyalo konyo nyamre, ka inyalo chako tuwore, kata dik kendo.
Somali: Dhammaan warshadaha shaaha ee maamula KTDA waa inay u hoggaansamaan xeerarka cusub ee shaaha ka hor 31ka Maarso 2021 ama waxay wajihi doonaan ciqaabo, oo ay ku jiraan joojinta rukhsadda ama dacwado sharciga ah.

English: The newly inaugurated Warehouse Receipt System Council will oversee the Warehouse Receipt System in Kenya, starting with coffee, tea, rice, beans, green grams, and wheat.
Kiswahili: Baraza jipya la Usimamizi wa Risiti za Maghala litakuwa na jukumu la kusimamia Mfumo wa Risiti za Maghala nchini Kenya, kuanzia na kahawa, chai, mchele, maharagwe, mbaazi, na ngano.
Ekegusii: Ekiroto egwaki omokinyia Obwanikia bw'ekiriba ogwe ogwang'ania obwana bw'ekiriba mu Kenya, ekereraki naki omokare, emet, emigori, etag'oti, emakenia, na emetenge.
Dholuo: Wang'ni erk kendo Warehouse Receipt System Council otimre Warehouse Receipt System e Kenya, manok gi kony o odundo, chai, wiri, boro, sirkoy, nik wiri.
Somali: Guddiga Nidaamka Qabashada Bakhaarada ee cusub ayaa maamuli doona Nidaamka Qabashada Bakhaarada ee Kenya, iyadoo lagu bilaabayo kafee, shaah, bariis, digir, beed cagaaran, iyo garoon.

English: Farmers are advised to maintain vigilance as the threat of desert locust re-infestation persists. Monitor for any signs of locust activity and report sightings immediately.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanashauriwa kuwa makini kwani hatari ya kutokea tena kwa nzige wa jangwa inaendelea. Fuatalia dalili zozote za shughuli za nzige na ripoti kutokea mara moja.
Ekegusii: Abagere batarire bategane, omokyendi buya bwa koro orokai buya bwake bosi. Bonyekere ebiitiko bye orokai omogaka na bonyekere abanyabosi nyanya.
Dholuo: Abako gich marach kwayo piny ni joma jaluok nono kaye. Piny marach, ginen, kendo rwak nyigoro.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagu talinayaa inay feejignaadaan maadaama khatarta weerarada cawiyaha duurka ay weli jirto. Kormeer calaamadaha cawiyaha iyo warbixinta dhacdooyinka isla markiiba.

English: Due to the effects of Covid-19, farmers are encouraged to focus on drought-resistant crops like sorghum and millet for better resilience in production.
Kiswahili: Kwa sababu ya athari za Covid-19, wakulima wanashauriwa kuzingatia mazao yanayostahimili ukame kama ulezi na mtama ili kuboresha ustahimilivu katika uzalishaji.
Ekegusii: Maki naki Covid-19, abashori bakiende buya bosi omokang'ogori akorori bwasembe ore soko na masabo omoshere buya oigori buya mu kengesia.
Dholuo: Ma okinyi kuom Covid-19, wanyalo en to gin konyo kuom mich kanyakla, kuom neno tinde machon somo kamoro, kochung' gi mbidi.
Somali: Dhibaatada Covid-19 awgeed, beeralayda waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay diirada saaraan dalagyada adkeysiga abaaraha sida sorghum iyo maraq si wax soo saarkooda u noqdo mid adkeysi leh.

English: Invest in basic infrastructure to enhance employment opportunities for rural youth. Ensure access to all-weather roads and food markets to support inclusive economic growth.
Kiswahili: Wekeza katika miundombinu ya msingi ili kuboresha fursa za ajira kwa vijana wa vijijini. Hakikisha upatikanaji wa barabara za msimu wote na masoko ya chakula ili kusaidia ukuaji wa kiuchumi jumuishi.
Ekegusii: Ekiteganye omogori naki omokirori motendere buya, ore bumachenge bwaki bwaki buya omogosi bwakwomana. Naki obwakire obwakongo buya mu naki omokirori ogwakana naki bukweli buya bwaki bwenyaki bwaki bwaki.
Dholuo: Nyakanyani kanisa duto kuom niwot nidi gi chako manono kendo golo chajo mar vijana e wethe. Wachung' gi tich mara duto to tho ni joma inyal gima gi dhano.
Somali: Maal geliin kaabayaasha aasaasiga ah si aad u kordhiso fursadaha shaqo ee dhallinyarada tuulooyinka. Hubi in la helo waddooyin sugan iyo suuqyada cunto si loo taageero koritaanka dhaqaale ee wadajirka ah.

English: Farmers in Northern Uganda can access the newly opened Regional Agricultural Mechanization Center in Agwata for irrigation and tractor maintenance services.
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika Kaskazini mwa Uganda wanaweza kupata huduma za umwagiliaji na matengenezo ya trekta katika Kituo cha Mifumo ya Kilimo ya Kanda kilichofunguliwa hivi karibuni huko Agwata.
Ekegusii: Abamwe bakiigori buria ba Norther Uganda baria batarangwa Nyang'anya ya Mipango ya Kiboko kuri Agwata eri buyaora bwakiri omagano bwakire na thibori mosi.
Dholuo: Odhiambo mag Odhiambo Uganda nyaka golo gi Regional Agricultural Mechanization Center ka Agwata oketi kuom nyakwar gi ndege ni jiwruok.
Somali: Farmers-ka waqooyiga Uganda waxay heli karaan Xarunta Farsamaynta Beeraha ee cusub ee ka furtay Agwata si ay u helaan adeegyada waraabka iyo dayactirka tracktorada.

English: Nakuru County is implementing a land rehabilitation program to restore degraded land and improve agricultural productivity. Farmers are encouraged to participate in soil management training and tree planting initiatives.
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Nakuru inatekeleza mpango wa urejeleaji wa ardhi ili kurekebisha ardhi iliyoharibika na kuboresha uzalishaji wa kilimo. Wakulima wanahimizwa kushiriki katika mafunzo ya usimamizi wa udongo na mipango ya upandaji miti.
Ekegusii: Omoitokeri wa Nakuru naki oremoka ekiriga osibori naki oria bwakire ekiranga ne omogorori omokere. Abagikikire buya nitwaki okereri bwaki ekikiriani buya na bwaki naki ogotare ogetege.
Dholuo: Nakuru County ne orem maki ji miyan gi kar kanyal kendo onywola chuo chiegni. Wuongi adwaro konyo ihinya mar neno kuon sa miyo no chieng' gi piny.
Somali: Dowladda degmada Nakuru waxay hirgelinaysaa barnaamij dib u habeyn dhul si loo soo nooleeyo dhulka dhaawacmay iyo kor loogu qaado wax soo saarka beeraha. Beeraleyda waxaa laga dhiirrigelinayaa inay ka qeybgalaan tababaro maareynta carrada iyo howlaha dhirta la beero.

English: The High Court has halted the formation of the National Steering Committee on Tea Reforms; affected parties should stay updated on the ongoing legal proceedings.
Kiswahili: Mahakama Kuu imezuia kuundwa kwa Kamati ya Kitaifa ya Kuongoza Mabadiliko ya Chai; wahusika wanapaswa kubaki na taarifa kuhusu mchakato wa kisheria unaoendelea.
Ekegusii: Hii Ikosi ya Juu imesitisha uundaji wa Kamati ya Taifa ya Mabadiliko ya Chai; wahusika wanapaswa kubaki na habari kuhusu mchakato wa kisheria unaoendelea.
Dholuo: Dho Luo mokwongo gi chalo mar National Steering Committee maler kuom Tea Reforms; ji oseyudo to kodhi ok oleyo gi mamoko ma okonino.
Somali: Maxkamadda Sare ayaa joojisay dhisida Guddiga Hagida Qaranka ee Isbedelada Shaaha; dhinacyada ay arrintu khuseyso waa inay la socdaan howlgallada sharciga ee socda.

English: Farmers in Busia County can access free BT cotton seeds and should consider intercropping with legumes to optimize land use. For more information, contact the Busia County Department of Agriculture.
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika Kaunti ya Busia wanaweza kupata mbegu za pamba za BT bure na wanapaswa kuzingatia kupanda pamoja na legumu ili kuboresha matumizi ya ardhi. Kwa maelezo zaidi, wasiliana na Wizara ya Kilimo ya Kaunti ya Busia.
Ekegusii: Abakibori bwi Busia County bwaki omokiriri omotare ogw'inyanya BT na baki nibokire okwegeria na abarakire banga bataru bware okonchengera boko bwi butonde. Bwaki omokiriri oyaki, kontakti Busia County Department of Agriculture.
Dholuo: Okwong' gi piny Busia nolweny mbich BT cotton kendo bende ginyal konyo mang'oya gi legumes kendo konyo mabor. Ka in gi wuon, itiyo kanyoko Busia County Department of Agriculture.
Somali: Beeralayda gobolka Busia waxay heli karaan abuur BT ah oo lacag la'aan ah, waxaana jirta fursad ah inay isku beeraan digir si ay uga faa'iidaystaan dhulka. Macluumaad dheeraad ah, la xiriir Waaxda Beeraha ee gobolka Busia.

English: Farmers and food traders are urged to comply with municipal licensing and regulations to ensure food safety. This is vital to protect public health and sustain urban food security.
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wafanyabiashara wa chakula wanahimizwa kuzingatia leseni za manispaa na kanuni ili kuhakikisha usalama wa chakula. Hii ni muhimu kwa kulinda afya ya umma na kudumisha usalama wa chakula mijini.
Ekegusii: Abagere na abachakanje bagenyeriwe kutenda naki naki ya umuji na mirongo ya kwehuka emooko ya biki toshone bosorori. Iki ni kilamaki bwakugenda kw’ogenda omokiri naki bwachiri omorori.
Dholuo: Gik mang’ere gi wacho ma farmers kod food traders nyalo kamano kanyien ketho ahinya ka konyo goyo mar duto. Nyasaye mago piny to golo e saful.
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo ganacsatada cuntooyinka waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay raacaan shuruucda iyo liisanka degmada si loo hubiyo badbaadada cuntada. Tani waa muhiim si loo ilaaliyo caafimaadka dadweynaha iyo in la taageero amniga cuntada magaalooyinka.

English: The government has approved the leasing of five state-owned sugar factories for at least 20 years to revitalize the sugar sector. Interested parties should prepare for engagement under the new leasing model.
Kiswahili: Serikali imeidhinisha upangaji wa viwanda vitano vya sukari miliki ya serikali kwa kipindi cha angalau miaka 20 ili kuhuisha sekta ya sukari. Wahusika wenye nia wanapaswa kujiandaa kwa ushirikiano chini ya mfano mpya wa upangaji.
Ekegusii: Abagere ba serikali baiti mwaki bwakagore eng'eni shia masika ogendene mirima mitano ya uki mkubwa mu bwakire bwaki bwakabere buya buya omokoro. Abaki bakenye bahenyo bavyake busome busemo bwaki buya buya.
Dholuo: Gavumenti eyo owang' gi leasing mag kendo ng'ato kata 20 mwaka to naki jowi. Kiping' timbe mag jowi odugogo kendo ng'ato nyaka omiyo iweyo podo mar leasing modok.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay oggolaatay in la kireeyo shan warshadood oo sonkor ah oo dowladda leedahay muddo ugu yaraan 20 sano ah si loo kor loogu qaado sektor-ka sonkorta. Qaybaha daneynaya waa inay isu diyaariyaan in ay ka qaybqaataan habka kireynta cusub.

English: The new Finance Act zero rates VAT on maize, cassava, and wheat flour for 6 months, aiming to make unga more affordable for consumers.
Kiswahili: Sheria mpya ya Fedha inapunguza kiwango cha VAT kwa mahindi, muwaha, na unga wa ngano kwa miezi 6, ikilenga kufanya unga iwe rahisi kupatikana kwa watumiaji.
Ekegusii: Omokiriri omogori ogire zero rate buya VAT kirema oboka, masaka, na omokoro omotere oria 6 buya, igaki omosera ung’ato osina ogokire buya.
Dholuo: Finans Act nyaka zero-rate VAT e unga, cassava, kendo flour mar ng'are hekalu 6, nyaka konyo ung' e yo yien.
Somali: Sharciga Maaliyadda cusub wuxuu ka dhigayaa VAT-ta mid eber ah corn, qasac, iyo burka xirfada ah muddo 6 bilood ah, isagoo ujeedkiisu yahay in la dhimmo qiimaha uniga ee dadka isticmaala.

English: The government is supplying 781,800 seedlings, including 40,000 cocoa seedlings, to farmers in 17 counties to promote food security and crop diversification.
Kiswahili: Serikali inatoa miche 781,800, ikiwa ni pamoja na miche 40,000 ya kakao, kwa wakulima katika kaunti 17 ili kukuza usalama wa chakula na utofauti wa mazao.
Ekegusii: Abagere ba serikali b’ogaburia ikirembo 781,800, bikire na ikirembo 40,000 ya cocoa, buya buya bu Bwakire 17 okore buori omokiri buya bu naki abashikori.
Dholuo: Gavana neng'ogi 781,800 ng'oma, kuom 40,000 ng'oma ma okok, to gi jotekwa e 17 gonde kendo to nobaneno kido chiegni kendo mabo kamano.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay bixineysaa 781,800 geed dhir ah, oo ay ku jiraan 40,000 geed dhir ka mid ah, si ay u caawiso beeraleyda 17 degmo si loo xoojiyo amniga cunto iyo kala-duwanaanshaha dalagga.

English: The government has launched the One Million Kitchen Gardens Plan to support households in establishing kitchen gardens. Selected households will receive startup kits including seeds and a water tank.
Kiswahili: Serikali imeanzisha Mpango wa Mabwawa ya Mboga Milioni Moja kusaidia kaya kuanzisha mabwawa ya mboga. Kaya zilizochaguliwa zitapokea vimkakati vya kuanzia ikiwemo mbegu na tanki la maji.
Ekegusii: Egovernment igakora Omo Kegusii Chaki Bwakire kosi otigana obotigo bwaki. Obotigo bwakigani buya bwi naki bosi bwaki buya bwekere na ikiruta.
Dholuo: Gavumenti yore gik ma One Million Kitchen Gardens Plan kuom piny koro dhano lokruok komi ng'ama maber. Dhano lokruok ma oyudo adier okonyo kit mar mago, ka mwakili ng'ato ne ng'ato.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay bilowday Qorshaha Hal Milyan Beero Karis ah si ay guryaha u taageerto in ay sameystaan beero karis. Guryaha la doortay ayaa heli doona qalab bilaash ah oo ay ku jiraan abuur iyo haanta biyaha.

English: Aquaponics technology will be introduced in 35 counties to promote food security and nutrition. Farmers in these counties can anticipate training and support from county governments and the Ministry of Agriculture.
Kiswahili: Teknolojia ya aquaponics itazinduliwa katika kaunti 35 ili kukuza usalama wa chakula na lishe. Wakulima katika kaunti hizi wanaweza kutarajia mafunzo na msaada kutoka kwa serikali za kaunti na Wizara ya Kilimo.
Ekegusii: Tekinolojia ya aquaponics itazungumziwa mumakao 35 kukwenda chifunguo cha chakurya na umwiru. Abagere mune makao aya bwakire buya bwakiita obokire bwokwetegana na bwiikire bwokwetanganya naki Bwaki o Mwaki.
Dholuo: Teknoloji mar aquaponics en dok jaundo 35 boko, nyinge atimogi konyo chieng' na konyo nyalu. Jaluo e boko hizi an giyolo wacha kendo gik ma katieno e boko nogo konyo govana boko gi Minista wa Bondo.
Somali: Teknolojiyadda aquaponics ayaa lagu soo bandhigi doonaa 35 degmo si loo xoojiyo amniga cuntada iyo nafaqada. Beeralayda degmooyinkan waxay filan karaan tababaro iyo taageero laga helo dowladaha deegaanka iyo Wasaaradda Beeraha.

English: The National Livestock Vaccination Program has been launched to combat animal diseases in Kenya. Farmers are encouraged to participate for the health and productivity of their livestock.
Kiswahili: Mpango wa Kitaifa wa Kuwasha Ng'ombe umeanzishwa ili kupambana na magonjwa ya wanyama nchini Kenya. Wakulima wanahimizwa kushiriki kwa ajili ya afya na uzalishaji wa mifugo yao.
Ekegusii: Omoikiri gwang'ona buya bwakireri bwakirete buya bwaki buya bwenyare buya bwabere na Kenya. Aboragani bakunyoria kwang'ona bopwaki bwanene bwabo.
Dholuo: Chik gino ma Kanyakla mag Piny oima kuom nyathi e tieko mar ng'iyo ni e Kenya ne ohering'ore. Wuodhi e kene yathne gi konyo ka ohuero nindet gi mwandg' ni kanyakla.
Somali: Barnaamijka Talaalka Xoolaha Qaranka ayaa la bilaabay si loo la dagaallamo cudurrada xoolaha ee Kenya. Beeralayda waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay ka qayb qaataan si caafimaadka iyo wax soo saarka xoolahooda loo xoojiyo.

English: The WFP is providing 1,050 modern beehives to 260 farmers in 11 counties to enhance beekeeping and boost honey production. Farmers are encouraged to engage in this lucrative industry.
Kiswahili: WFP inatoa mzinga 1,050 wa kisasa kwa wakulima 260 katika kaunti 11 ili kuimarisha ufugaji nyuki na kuongeza uzalishaji wa asali. Wakulima wanahimizwa kushiriki katika sekta hii yenye faida.
Ekegusii: WFP ikoranye 1,050 mwaki mieri go buya b<tag>abiri</tag> 260 abaki mbega 11 buya giyaki chiyaki go gihuma na chire maabe. Abaki bageri buya boki entari naki chishuku chogoti.
Dholuo: WFP en gi 1,050 beehive zise to 260 manono e 11 counties, kuom golo miluok e bee keeping kendo oganda miyo nyok nyoko. Manono nyaka ng'eyo gimonye e ndalamo mane odong' mar yien.
Somali: WFP waxay siineysaa 1,050 qolof dhalaali ah 260 beeraleyda 11 gobol si loo xoojiyo beeraleyda shinnida iyo korodhka soo saarista malabka. Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay ka qeybqaataan warshadan faa'idada leh.

English: All stakeholders in the fisheries sector are urged to adopt sustainable aquaculture practices and effective fisheries management to enhance food security and increase fish production by 2030.
Kiswahili: Wadau wote katika sekta ya uvuvi wanasisitizwa kufuata mbinu endelevu za ufugaji wa samaki na usimamizi mzuri wa uvuvi ili kuboresha usalama wa chakula na kuongeza uzalishaji wa samaki ifikapo mwaka 2030.
Ekegusii: Abakire baki omokiri bioria bakenyaga abazire gukorera mu buryo bwokwerere bwerere omogori na buye bwomokiri buya bungi mu ng'ende buno na kumokirisia umubiri umukiri nyaki 2030.
Dholuo: Ng'ato manoro onywalo e nyasi mag jopiny owadgi, wath machal mang'ongo mar wach jopiny kendo wath ang'wen e makelo, to yore ng'ato owadgi kowiyo kendo gibed gi nyasi mag lweny nyaka 2030.
Somali: Dhammaan daneeyayaasha qaybta kalluumaysiga waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay qaataan dhaqamada kalluumaysiga waara iyo maaraynta kalluumaysiga ee waxtarka leh si loo xoojiyo amniga cunada loona kordhiyo soo saarista kalluunka ilaa sanadka 2030.

English: Bungoma County has allocated significant resources to strengthen its agricultural sector. Farmers in the region should stay informed on upcoming opportunities and support initiatives.
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Bungoma imetenga rasilimali kubwa kuimarisha sekta ya kilimo. Wakulima katika eneo hili wanapaswa kuwa na habari kuhusu fursa na mikakati ya msaada inayokuja.
Ekegusii: Ekiyaki cha Bungoma kirekuria eng'anya nyamabere buya otigana bw'abakirori. Abakirori bakiwe baria buya naki banyosoba omokirere omokiri naki bwere.
Dholuo: Bungoma County awachne manyien maduong' gi chakre maber gi agri. Warumba mokuongo to gi nigi kanyo e ng'ato ni genga mar nyaka.
Somali: Bungoma County waxa ay qoondeysay kheyraad badan si ay u xoojiso qeybta beeraleyda. Beeralayda deegaanka waa inay la socdaan fursadaha imanaya iyo taageerada la heli karo.

English: Coffee farmers can access up to 40% advance payment through the Kshs. 3 billion Coffee Advance Revolving Fund. Sign up for guarantee forms to qualify.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa kahawa wanaweza kupata hadi asilimia 40 ya malipo ya awali kupitia Mfuko wa Kukuza Kahawa wa Kshs. bilioni 3. Jisajili kwa fomu za udhamini ili kuweza kufaulu.
Ekegusii: Abagere b'ekofi bagena kubwaki gotiri guianchani 40% egesereti g'ekofi g'eri Kshs. 3 billion Coffee Advance Revolving Fund. Naki obokisi b'obwaki bw'ababere buari.
Dholuo: Bantu gi piny ohinga en gima 40% e piny piny maromo ma Kshs. 3 billion Coffee Advance Revolving Fund. Nyal masen gi fomu maruok kuom winjruok.
Somali: Beeraleyda qaxwaha waxay heli karaan ilaa 40% lacag horudhac ah iyada oo loo marayo Sanduuqa Kshs. 3 bilyan ee Lacagta Horudhaca Qaxwaha. Isdiiwaangeli foomamka dammaanadda si aad u xaqiijiso.

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders are urged to prepare for impending food shortages as global supply chains face significant disruptions. Take action now to secure resources and plan accordingly.
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo wanahimizwa kujiandaa kwa upungufu wa chakula unaokaribia kutokana na matatizo makubwa katika mnyororo wa usambazaji wa kimataifa. Fanya hatua sasa ili kuhakikisha rasilimali na kupanga ipasavyo.
Ekegusii: Abagori naki aiteka bwakire baretanire bwaninge bwanyanigwa buia mu naki noogradetere ere bwanire buya bwaki. Ekerere buya buya na bwete ogotsire agenga.
Dholuo: Chieng' gi ji kanyalo nono ni olokore nabed gi waduong' mar ma ok nyaloo. Wachni ng'ato to nyal neno mako gichieng' kanyo.
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beerta waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay is diyaariyaan si looga hortago gaabinta cuntada ee imanaysa, maadaama silsilladaha sahayda caalamka ay wajaheen carqalado waaweyn. Tallaabo qaado hadda si aad u xaqiijiso ilahaaga iyo inaad qorsheysato si waafaqsan.

English: Farmers in Eastern Africa are urged to adopt resilient agricultural practices to combat the ongoing food crises, as over 27 million people face acute food insecurity in the region.
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika Afrika Mashariki wanatakiwa kuanzisha mbinu za kilimo zenye uhimilivu ili kukabiliana na matatizo ya chakula yanayoendelea, kwani zaidi ya watu milioni 27 wanakabiliwa na ukosefu wa chakula mkubwa katika eneo hilo.
Ekegusii: Abagabe b abakonyirie buya bensi ya Mashariki Afrika bagakore omokirori ogwenge bw’okwereka obwakana bw’ogetting'ana omokereiro, kubanga abantu 27 mirira baria bakenye kumokirori bwenyene mu duma.
Dholuo: Dhi nyasachgi e East Africa kuom yiwawa manok gi chayo mokuongo, sababi ni nigi 27 million ji nyaka gihuma chigni e ndalo maler.
Somali: Farmers-ka Bariga Afrika waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay qaataan hababka beeraha adkeysiga leh si ay uga hortagaan dhibaatooyinka cuntada ee socda, maadaama in ka badan 27 milyan oo qof ay la kulmaan amni darro cunto oo ba'an gobolka.

English: The government has launched the Shs 2.2bn Empowering Novel Agribusiness-led Employment (ENABLE Kenya) program aimed at boosting agribusiness opportunities and employment in the agriculture sector.
Kiswahili: Serikali imezindua programu ya ENABLE Kenya yenye thamani ya Shs 2.2bilioni, ikilenga kuongeza fursa za biashara za kilimo na ajira katika sekta ya kilimo.
Ekegusii: Abakia bosi bwiere buya Shs 2.2bn Empowering Novel Agribusiness-led Employment (ENABLE Kenya) buya okomokere buya busechi bwiagri na obwaki bwakare mubandaki bwabaki.
Dholuo: Chakruok ma gava jotend gi Shs 2.2bn Empowering Novel Agribusiness-led Employment (ENABLE Kenya) program, ma okonyi gi tich mar agribusiness kendo jopiny kuom tich mar uganga.
Somali: Dowladda waxay bilawday barnaamijka Shs 2.2bn ee Empowering Novel Agribusiness-led Employment (ENABLE Kenya) oo ujeedadiisu tahay in la xoojiyo fursadaha agribusiness iyo shaqooyinka gudaha qaybta beeraha.

English: The Kenyan government will no longer buy maize or farm inputs from farmers. Farmers can now use their produce as collateral for financing from financial organizations.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Kenya haitanunua mahindi au vifaa vya kilimo kutoka kwa wakulima. Wakulima sasa wanaweza kutumia mazao yao kama dhamana kwa ajili ya ufadhili kutoka kwa taasisi za kifedha.
Ekegusii: Omoigoveria wa Kenya ogenda oreka bisi na buya bwebi buya buuri babere. Babere naki bagenyanga ibisi yabo buya buana mosi omoka buya bosi.
Dholuo: Government mar Kanya ok owuok kuom koth maziwa kendo ma inyuol kanyo. Inyalo, ma inyal nyiso mawuok duto mar kanyo mokelo dho finans mara in joma finans.
Somali: Dowladda Kenya ma iibsan doonto galley ama alaabta beeraha ka imaan karta. Beeralayda hadda waxay u isticmaali karaan waxsoosaarkooda sida dammaanad maaliyadeed oo ka timaadda ururada maaliyadeed.

English: Reforms at the National Cereals & Produce Board (NCPB) have begun, focusing on improving grain storage and stabilizing food supply. Stay informed for further updates on these changes.
Kiswahili: Mabadiliko katika Bodi ya Nafaka na Mazao ya Taifa (NCPB) yameanza, yakilenga kuboresha uhifadhi wa nafaka na kutuliza usambazaji wa chakula. Tufuate ili kupata habari zaidi kuhusu mabadiliko haya.
Ekegusii: Ogotore chere misiere ku National Cereals & Produce Board (NCPB) naki, ore emogenda gochendi kubwakire bugori buche na ogotende bwire bwokinyaki. Naki oria kosi omokireri busego bwaki.
Dholuo: Reform mar NCPB en tich, ma otere kuom nyaka ng'eyo chodo kendo ohero kanyano food. Nia bende yudo tich mar yore yore ang'ere koni.
Somali: Isbeddelada Golaha Qaranka ee Faaruqa (NCPB) ayaa bilaabmay, iyadoo diiradda la saarayo hagaajinta keydinta miraha iyo xasilinta sahayda cuntada. La soco wixii warar dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan isbeddeladan.

English: The Ministry of Agriculture will provide seedlings to farmers during the October to December rains. Farmers are encouraged to participate for improved crop production.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Kilimo atatoa miche kwa wakulima wakati wa mvua za Oktoba hadi Desemba. Wakulima wanahimizwa kushiriki ili kuboresha uzalishaji wa mazao.
Ekegusii: Ababiri ba Buhinga bateganire abakerere bataria baabere ibikere bakanana mu mosi wa Okutoba kosi Okudonga. Abakerere barakwiriwe gose ge nyang'anya babere ibikere bataria bataro moshengo.
Dholuo: Ministiri mar Sibuol en owere kanyo ng'ato konyuok e ng'ama kuom jano okoth tooro. Jano oketh e yo owuon kuom kanyo makwongo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha ayaa beeraleyda siin doonta abuurka inta lagu jiro roobabka Oktoobar illaa Diseembar. Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay ka qeyb qaataan si kor loogu qaado soo saarista dalagga.

English: Farmers in Uasin Gishu, Elgeyo Marakwet, Bomet, Nyandarua, Nyeri, and Taita Taveta can access 25 tons of free potato basic seed to produce certified seed.
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika Uasin Gishu, Elgeyo Marakwet, Bomet, Nyandarua, Nyeri, na Taita Taveta wanaweza kupata tani 25 za mbegu za viazi bure ili kuzalisha mbegu zilizothibitishwa.
Ekegusii: Abagibori baki Uasin Gishu, Elgeyo Marakwet, Bomet, Nyandarua, Nyeri, na Taita Taveta baigana 25 tons ya mwaki buya bwa bichi bubere buya mwaki bwose ogotenda mwaki ogokeyi.
Dholuo: Chik kamo i Uasin Gishu, Elgeyo Marakwet, Bomet, Nyandarua, Nyeri, kod Taita Taveta ochung' 25 ton mar sande mag joma tugo to en buo podo.
Somali: Beeraleyda ku sugan Uasin Gishu, Elgeyo Marakwet, Bomet, Nyandarua, Nyeri, iyo Taita Taveta waxay heli karaan 25 tan oo abuurka basal ah oo bilaash ah si ay u soo saaraan abuur la sertifiyey.

English: Seeds are essential commodities; unrestricted movement across borders is critical to prevent food insecurity. Stakeholders must advocate for this change immediately.
Kiswahili: Mbegu ni bidhaa muhimu; usafirishaji bila vizuizi kati ya mipaka ni muhimu ili kuzuia ukosefu wa usalama wa chakula. Wadau lazima wasisitize mabadiliko haya mara moja.
Ekegusii: Ekiya naki omogendekere; obori bwaki buya buya bwokiga oria bwang'ere ogokwakire. Abanyaki bende naki bware oborere ogikiri.
Dholuo: Maduong' gi ng'ato ma ok nyalo githor, kuom joma owang' nyalore gi kachieng' kuom kony dook. Jotegno chike nyaka jomakore duto nolandach dhano.
Somali: ABUURKA waa alaab muhiim ah; dhaqdhaqaaqa xor ah ee xuduudaha waa shardi muhiim ah si loo hortago amni darro cunto. Ka qaybgalayaasha waa in ay si degdeg ah u doortaan isbeddelkan.

English: Farmers are urged to review the proposed Crops (Tea Industry) Regulations 2020, which may negatively impact earnings and increase bureaucracy. Take action by voicing concerns before implementation.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahimizwa kuangalia kanuni zilizopendekezwa za Mazao (Sekta ya Chai) za mwaka 2020, ambazo zinaweza kuathiri mapato na kuongeza urasimu. Chukua hatua kwa kutoa maoni kabla ya utekelezaji.
Ekegusii: Abarakire bakiere omotare ogenda taanya kihariri cha Beeto (Tea Industry) 2020, ekibaki ekiberebuora bwerende buya na bingi bwaki. Naki omokirwe mwakire kinyang'ani buya.
Dholuo: Agrikutu ne okwayi to abiro piny gi Crops (Tea Industry) Regulations 2020, ma en kod joma ok lowo kamano ma ok inyalo nyal gi dhok. Piny gi konyruok ma orengo odiechiene gi dhum.
Somali: Beeralayda waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay dib u eegaan sharciga cusub ee Crops (Tea Industry) Regulations 2020, kaasoo saameyn xun ku yeelan kara dakhliga iyo kordhin kara xeerarka. Qaado talaabo adigoo cabiraya walaac ka hor hirgelinta.

English: Farmers will not be able to sell maize directly to the government as the National Cereals and Produce Board shifts to a trading model. Needy individuals will receive cash transfers to purchase food.
Kiswahili: Wakulima hawataweza kuuza mahindi moja kwa moja serikali kwani Bodi ya Nafaka na Mazao inahamia kwenye mfumo wa biashara. Watu wenye uhitaji watapata fedha za kusaidia kununua chakula.
Ekegusii: Abakire b'ihinda ntibokang'ana kugura omukwe n'amaizi omokanya abashibori b'efoneri ya National Cereals and Produce Board ikainyongera okorwakonya. Abantu abashindanye bazokiraka asomoge okogura emeno.
Dholuo: Dala magi to kata kachieng’ kuom gonyo maiz kendo kanyo ni National Cereals and Produce Board ochiwo nyasach. Miyo gima owuon marach nying’ kuom ndiri kuonde kanyo chak.
Somali: Beeraleydu ma awoodi doonaan inay si toos ah u iibiyaan sariirta dowladda maadaama Golaha Qaranka ee Khudaarta iyo Wax-soo-saarka uu u beddelayo habka ganacsiga. Dadka danyarta ah waxay heli doonaan lacag si ay u iibsadaan cunto.

English: The revised draft of tea regulations has been launched, proposing a complete overhaul of the Kenya Tea Development Authority (KTDA). All stakeholders in the tea sector should stay informed for upcoming changes.
Kiswahili: Rasimu iliyorekebishwa ya kanuni za chai imezinduliwa, ikitoa mapendekezo ya mabadiliko makubwa katika Mamlaka ya Maendeleo ya Chai Kenya (KTDA). Wadau wote katika sekta ya chai wanapaswa kubaki informed kuhusu mabadiliko yajayo.
Ekegusii: Ekitabu chong'ega ekekorendo kosi ya masara kiugo chabwataka, ng'enda ebikire ekokorere otagari ya Kenya Tea Development Authority (KTDA). Abaki baiso b'ekibung'ano bamasara baagane omokere obwakabori obwakiri.
Dholuo: Okwong' go nyalo gi tetet mag tea omiya, kendo en nyalo ng'wonowa Kenya Tea Development Authority (KTDA). Kachielo bende duto gi tea nyaka nigi gimoro yore.
Somali: Qorshaha dib loo eegay ee xeerarka shaaha ayaa la soo bandhigay, oo soo jeedinaya in gebi ahaanba dib loo qaabeeyo Maamulka Horumarinta Shaaha ee Kenya (KTDA). Dhamaan dadka ku lugta leh qaybta shaaha waa in ay la socodsiiyaan isbedelada soo socda.

English: The Ministry of Agriculture invites feedback on proposed tea sector reforms for 14 days. Submit written memorandums via the Ministry's and AFA's websites or call the provided hotline for clarifications.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo inakaribisha maoni juu ya marekebisho yanayopendekezwa katika sekta ya chai kwa siku 14. Tuma maandiko yako kupitia tovuti za Wizara na AFA au piga simu kwenye nambari ya habari iliyotolewa kwa ufafanuzi.
Ekegusii: Ombare iwuori ya buya bw'egere omokirigana ekegusii buya bwanyoni bw'ubwekiri bw'ekegere ng'ogenda 14. Kakiokwa omokuru bw'erebire omororani mw'ikosi ya Ministry na AFA, kana buya bw'endere oishure ogendako.
Dholuo: Ministri mo Ogingenya nigi ng'ato konyo gi weche maler e ndal kendo gweng' tich mabor ma odir ng'ato. Nyisgi weche e yat mar Ministri kendo AFA, kaka joo e tetele buok mar ng'ato.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha waxay kugu martiqaadaysaa inaad soo dirto fikradaha ku aaddan isbeddelada la soo jeediyay ee qaybta shaaha muddo 14 maalmood ah. Fadlan qoraaladaada ku soo dir website-yada Wasaaradda iyo AFA ama wac khadka tooska ah ee la bixiyay si aad u hesho faahfaahin dheeraad ah.

English: Rwandan farmers and agricultural stakeholders are advised to enhance their desert locust preparedness following recent training from FAO. Stay informed on control operations and preventive measures.
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wadau wa kilimo nchini Rwanda wanashauriwa kuboresha maandalizi yao dhidi ya nzige wa jangwa kufuatia mafunzo ya hivi karibuni kutoka FAO. Jiandikishe kuwa na taarifa kuhusu operesheni za kudhibiti na hatua za kujikinga.
Ekegusii: Abasori b’umuheto bw’Urwanda na abashamiri b’ihinga baragirwa inama yo kongerera ubushobozi bwabo ku byerekeye igikoko gikenyerwa mu masaka nyuma yo gutozwa vuba aha na FAO. Mumenye amakuru ku bikorwa byo kugenzura no ku ngamba zo kubikumira.
Dholuo: Mabera marwaki Rwandan gi jomabera marwamba pe wang’ni ng’ato en tore ka okeloka mar locust nyakok. Iwechokore gi chalo chakwero mar konyo mag chon e yamo.
Somali: Farmarada Ruwanda iyo daneeyayaasha beerta waxaa la talinayaa inay xoojiyaan diyaar-garowgooda ka dhanka ah caarada badda kadib tababaradii ugu dambeeyey ee ka dhacay FAO. La soco howlgallada xakamaynta iyo tallaabooyinka ka hortagga.

English: The Ministry of Agriculture has developed guidelines to support the food supply chain during the COVID-19 pandemic. All stakeholders must adhere to these protocols for stability in food availability and accessibility.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo imeandaa mwongozo kusaidia mnyororo wa usambazaji wa chakula wakati wa janga la COVID-19. Washiriki wote wanapaswa kufuata itifaki hizi ili kuhakikisha upatikanaji na upatikaaji wa chakula.
Ekegusii: Gakeri ka Makiagano kabe kire nakiore buya buya bwaki nyaki omogenda bwo COVID-19. Abatindi batagwe bose batarorane buya bwaki bure ke nakiore buya buya bwaki bwatwaki nakiibaritie.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture ong'eyo duong'ni mokwongo ma en katego kuom rembo mar chak le nyaka COVID-19. Wakati wanyiseno ang'ato gima itimrech kamano kendo idhi nyaka joma oher kuom chak.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha waxay soo saartay hageyaal si ay u taageeraan silsiladda sahayda cuntada xiliga dillaaca COVID-19. Dhamaan daneeyayaasha waa in ay raacaan habraacyadan si loo hubiyo joogteynta iyo helitaanka cuntada.

English: Food supply is stable in Kenya. Farmers are advised to continue operations without panic buying, as transport of farm produce is unrestricted.
Kiswahili: Usambazaji wa chakula uko thabiti nchini Kenya. Wakulima wanashauriwa kuendelea na shughuli zao bila kununua kwa hofu, kwani usafirishaji wa mazao ya kilimo haujakataliwa.
Ekegusii: Omosera omokirania omogori mwong'ori. Abakire banekere bakorere buya bakirokore buya, naki naki bosi bakore omogori bataruhanywa.
Dholuo: Chik mag piny nyalo gima timo e Kenya. Abor ni jaluo bedo kanyogi. Kanyo ng'ato nyaka koda, ni konyore konyo nyaluok e yo.
Somali: Sida sahayda cuntadu ugu jirto xasilooni Kenya. Beeraleyda waxaa lagu talinayaa inay sii wadaan hawlahooda iyada oo aan la argagaxin, maadaama gaadiidka wax soo saarka beerta aanu xadidneyn.

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders are urged to ensure food supply chains remain uninterrupted during the COVID-19 pandemic to prevent potential food shortages.
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo wanashauriwa kuhakikisha mnyororo wa usambazaji chakula unabaki kuwa wa kawaida wakati wa janga la COVID-19 ili kuzuia uhaba wa chakula.
Ekegusii: Abagikire na abashandi b'ubuhinzi batarabire omokirigori ogwakire ekiraka ch'amatongo bw'egori bwogokire omong'enda bwayaki na bwasibori bwokira obongera omogori oria oboragire.
Dholuo: Wagwenga okunya gi wanjo mar kanyag' eno gi timo maber ni chiro mar chak malo gichung' e golo COVID-19 manok nin gi chayo malong'.
Somali: Beeralayda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga waraabka waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay hubiyaan in silsiladaha sahayda cunto ay joogto ahaan u wada soconaan inta lagu jiro cudurka COVID-19 si looga hortago suurtagalnimada yaraanshaha cunto.

English: Farmers are urged to report any counterfeit or adulterated agro-inputs to local authorities to support Uganda's initiative in eliminating these harmful products.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahimizwa kuripoti bidhaa za kilimo zilizokandamizwa au zilizochanganywa kwa mamlaka za eneo ili kusaidia mpango wa Uganda wa kuondoa bidhaa hizi hatari.
Ekegusii: Abakore bakenye konyorere bosi bokire bwakinyaki obwakwetebere osibori okwako basaboti buya buya.
Dholuo: Onyalo kuom farmer ji, nigi to report ni onyalo chalo ma adhi nyaka gige ma ochung' to local authorities, ng'ama to support initiative mar Uganda kuom winjruok ji ma oserre gi.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay soo sheegaan wax kasta oo ah agab beereed been-abuur ah ama lacag-la'aan ah maamulka deegaanka si ay u taageeraan hindisaha Uganda ee ka saarista alaabtan waxyeellada leh.

English: Farmers in northern Uganda should remain vigilant as Desert Locust nymphs are hatching and may threaten food security. Report any sightings to local authorities immediately.
Kiswahili: Wakulima kaskazini mwa Uganda wanapaswa kuwa makini kwani konokono wa Jangwa wanataga mayai na wanaweza hatarisha usalama wa chakula. Ripoti yoyote ya kuona konokono hizo kwa mamlaka za eneo mara moja.
Ekegusii: Abagere mu uganda bw'ekimanani bakwenda gukinyiria kwani abunyungi b'ekihango bonyaka, na bwokwangana okubonekeria omogotero. Kiteire ebirande oromi kirebwe kuhenda abateberere b'ewangware.
Dholuo: Oganda gi ng'ato marach e Uganda mabor ma nyaka kelo cing' kaka Desert Locust nyaka kare ok nyalo yope e chipo ma poti. Gikonyo kaka otum mirima kuom owad gi bura.
Somali: Beeraleyda waqooyiga Uganda waa inay feejignaadaan maadaama wiilasha qashinka saxaraha ay dhashaan oo khatar ku keenayaan amniga cuntada. Isla markiiba wax walba oo la arko u sheeg maamulka deegaanka.

English: Farmers in Konyu and Karima wards, Nyeri County, can now register for e-voucher input subsidies; enumerators are being recruited for this initiative.
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika kata za Konyu na Karima, Kaunti ya Nyeri, sasa wanaweza kujiandikisha kwa ajili ya ruzuku ya pembejeo za e-voucher; wapangaji wanaajiriwa kwa ajili ya mpango huu.
Ekegusii: Abagere baki Konyu na Karima, Nyeri, bosi bakenye kuenda kwandika ku e-voucher input subsidies; abarekere baki bwaki bwoya.
Dholuo: Kaginda ku Konyu kod Karima, Nyeri County, ang'iyo chiegni ku register e-voucher input subsidies; enumerators nyaka duto nyalo konyo maok.
Somali: Beeraleyda Konyu iyo Karima, Gobolka Nyeri, hadda waxay is diiwaangelin karaan si ay u helaan qorshaha e-voucher ee taageerada agabka; qorayaasha ayaa la adeegsanayaa fursadan.

English: The Ministry of Agriculture is expanding rabies awareness and vaccination efforts to neighboring districts of Kassanda and Kyegegwa. Engage with local initiatives for vaccinations and education.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo inaongeza juhudi za kuhamasisha kuhusu ugonjwa wa mfipuko wa rabies na chanjo katika wilaya jirani za Kassanda na Kyegegwa. Jihusishe na mipango ya eneo la chanjo na elimu.
Ekegusii: Obwakiongozi bwa Obukungu bwasabaki ing'eyo bw'ekirocho bwetwirire omogoti kisichibori na Kyegegwa. Naki naki mno bwanamwaki bwuche bwakohiri bw'esabaki na obwaki bw'ekirocho.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture nyal oduogo kabila mar rabies kendo ng’eyo nyisogo ma iwinjore gi ruo mar Kassanda kod Kyegegwa. Neter na chiegni ma ok nyalo ng’eyo kod nyisog.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha ayaa kordhineysa wacyigelinta iyo talaalka cudurka rabies ee degmooyinka ku xeeran Kassanda iyo Kyegegwa. La xiriir hawlaha maxalliga ah ee talaalka iyo wacyigelinta.

English: Urgent humanitarian support is needed for 20,000 people facing extreme hunger in Akobo, Duk, and Ayod counties until April. Immediate action is required to address food insecurity in these areas.
Kiswahili: Msaada wa kibinadamu wa dharura unahitajika kwa watu 20,000 wanaokabiliwa na njaa kali katika kaunti za Akobo, Duk, na Ayod hadi Aprili. Hatua za haraka zinahitajika kukabiliana na ukosefu wa chakula katika maeneo haya.
Ekegusii: Naki omokinyani denda buya buya buya nyan 20,000 omokinyanokiyone obwa abantu bakanana omogunda mu Akobo, Duk, na Ayod buya buya buya kiongoti naki Abiri. Naki ikirigo ngutugene obwakire bw’omogunda mu naki emogenda.
Dholuo: Kagumo ka ngʼato ni 20,000 en gi nanga mar adhiambo mwach nyaka kendo sevgi to Akobo, Duk, kod Ayod abantu kwach. Nyasaye oritni gi piny mar ngʼato e kanyo ma okinyi e monde ni Thurwa.
Somali: Caawimo bini'aadantinimo ayaa si deg-deg ah loogu baahan yahay 20,000 qof oo wajahaya gaajo daran oo ku sugan degmooyinka Akobo, Duk, iyo Ayod ilaa bisha Abriil. Tallaabo deg-deg ah ayaa loo baahan yahay si wax looga qabto amni darro cunto oo ka jirta aagaggan.
