English: Farmers in Kiambu County can access training on improved maize production techniques and early-maturing varieties through the Village-Based Advisors program.
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika Kaunti ya Kiambu wanaweza kupata mafunzo juu ya mbinu za uzalishaji wa mahindi bora na aina zinazoiva mapema kupitia mradi wa Washauri wa Kijiji.
Ekegusii: Abakung'ori baki Kiambu batakire oserani kuorokire osibori bwosi bwa emia andieri ebiri naki oria nyansabo buya bu ka nakinyi mu Bwaki bwa Abakung'ori bwenye.
Dholuo: Ng’ato ma ok nyalo ratiro chieko mar kanyo joma kwaya ma ok wayogo mag pori gi tich mar kanyo ma nyaluok chieng' e kanyakla kuom Village-Based Advisors program.
Somali: Beeraleyda ka tirsan Gobolka Kiambu waxay heli karaan tababar ku saabsan farsamooyinka wax soo saarka maize-ka ee la hagaajiyey iyo noocyada deg-degga ah iyada oo loo marayo barnaamijka Lataliyayaasha Ku Saleysan Deegaanka.

English: Farmers are encouraged to adopt nutrition-sensitive agricultural practices to improve food production, income, and women's empowerment in order to tackle malnutrition in their communities.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanatakiwa kukubali mbinu za kilimo zinazozingatia lishe ili kuboresha uzalishaji wa chakula, kupata kipato, na kukuza uwezo wa wanawake katika kukabiliana na ushirikina katika jamii zao.
Ekegusii: Aborori bakorere buya eng'eyo ya bikira bwebisi omokiyaki bwaki kikibori, omogogori, naki aba abwaki abateka buya bokiriba bwaki buya.
Dholuo: Abwaki machon e yien mar ng'ato koro wuok ji auwora kido, tinde, gi wuon joma okinyi e weche mar bura kuom to miyo ma chik e ng'wech.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay qaataan dhaqammo beereed oo xasaasi u ah nafaqada si ay u hagaajiyaan soo saarida cuntada, dakhliga, iyo awoodda haweenka si ay uga hortagaan nafaqo darrooyinka bulshada ay ku nool yihiin.

English: Farmers in Uganda: The Ministry of Agriculture will support key commodities this season, including tea, fruits, livestock, and seeds. Engage with local agricultural offices for details on available resources.
Kiswahili: Wakulima nchini Uganda: Wizara ya Kilimo itaunga mkono mazao muhimu msimu huu, ikiwa ni pamoja na chai, matunda, mifugo, na mbegu. Wasiliana na ofisi za kilimo za mtaa kwa maelezo kuhusu rasilimali zilizopo.
Ekegusii: Abakiri mugo Uganda: Obwaki bw’Ekibuga busubira ekigegyegwa ky'ekitanda kyo, akang'ani, emihigo, n'ekiraga. Kwenya n'ama office ya buya mubire okorarira ku bisakaza obugororere.
Dholuo: Roko e Uganda: Dala me Bondo e Lwero mana nyadenda duto kendo tij no chalo, ich, nyasae, gi mbaka. Konyo okele e ofisi mar bonda mokuoro mondo ugwe mashinno.
Somali: Beeraleyda Ugaandha: Wasaaradda Beeraha waxay taageeri doontaa alaabo muhiim ah xilli ciyaareedkan, oo ay ku jiraan shaaha, khudradda, xoolaha, iyo abuurka. La xidhiidh xafiisyada beeraha ee deegaanka si aad u hesho faahfaahinta agabyada la heli karo.

English: The Kenya National Trading Corporation is buying excess rice from Kano Plains and Mwea Irrigation Schemes. Farmers are encouraged to sell their surplus to avoid post-harvest losses.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Biashara ya Taifa ya Kenya inanunua ziada ya mchele kutoka Uwanjani wa Kano na Miradi ya Umwagiliaji ya Mwea. Wakulima wanahimizwa kuuza ziada yao ili kuepuka hasara za baada ya mavuno.
Ekegusii: Kenyatta National Trading Corporation inakiingiria omokiri omoo buya buya baga Kano Plains na Mwea Irrigation Schemes. Abakireri barekerere okuruya ibire buya bwabo ohotanga omobori bogi.
Dholuo: Kenya National Trading Corporation ng'eyo kuom dhok mar rice ma opogore gi Kano Plains kod Mwea Irrigation Schemes. Jomoko nonyisna madhi gigi e piny kony omer, ng'ato okan gi’ udongo mar ohinga.
Somali: Hay'adda Ganacsiga Qaranka Soomaaliya waxay iibsaneysaa bariis dheeri ah oo ka yimaada Kano Plains iyo Mashaariicda Fiirooyinka ee Mwea. Beeralayda waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay iibiyaan wax soo saarkooda dheeraadka ah si ay uga fogaadaan khasaaraha ka dhasha goosashada.

English: Smallholder tea farmers are urged to stay informed about potential changes in the Kenya Tea Development Agency as the President calls for its overhaul to enhance their welfare.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wadogo wa chai wanahimizwa kubaki informed kuhusu mabadiliko yanayoweza kufanyika katika Chama cha Maendeleo ya Chai Kenya huku Rais akilitaka kuboreshwa ili kuongeza ustawi wao.
Ekegusii: Abasuri batega tea baragani bakenyanya buya bwaki mabereri omokiri, obwakire bwaki buya bwakire ogenda omotegori go Kenya Tea Development Agency omokiri we Omosheria asubati obwakire bwabo.
Dholuo: Ng'ato mogenyo mar tea ma bura nyaka golo chalo ma jienyo malong'o kuom Kenya Tea Development Agency, ka President ohinga gi nyisore magi ng'ato iwinjore.
Somali: Farmers-yada shaaha ee yaryar waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay la socdaan isbadallada suurtagalka ah ee Hay’adda Horumarinta Shaaha Kenya iyadoo Madaxweynaha uu codsanayo dib u habayn si kor loogu qaado dantaada.

English: Farmers in Kenya are warned of an imminent locust invasion, with swarms rapidly spreading across various counties. Take immediate action to protect crops and monitor developments.
Kiswahili: Wakulima nchini Kenya wanakumbushwa kuhusu uvamizi wa nzige unaokaribia, ambapo majeshi yanaenea haraka katika kaunti mbalimbali. Chukua hatua mara moja kulinda mazao na fuatilia maendeleo.
Ekegusii: Abagere baki Kenya baragorani omokiri bwateke bwabaki, buki soronchi omokanya buya naki ogokoba. Berekengania ekinyora magunda na tuganyenana omokiri.
Dholuo: Gik mang'ere e Kenya ne wawacho maber odhiere lokust, ma okelo riwre e buera duto. Nying' nyoro otere kuom joma ogend kaluwore marach ka udhi nyuka.
Somali: Beeralayda Kenya waxaa lagu wargelinayaa inay khatar ugu jiraan duullaanka cuncunka, kooxo baaxad leh oo si dhaqso ah u faafaya gobalo kala duwan. Qaado tallaabooyin degdeg ah si aad u ilaaliso dalagyadaada islamarkaana la soco horumarka.

English: The new board of the Kenya Planters Cooperative Union is operational and will manage the Coffee Cherry Advance Revolving Fund to support Kenyan coffee farmers.
Kiswahili: Bodi mpya ya Shirikisho la Wakulima wa Kahawa Kenya imeanza kazi na itasimamia Mfuko wa Mizunguko wa Mapema wa Cherries za Kahawa kusaidia wakulima wa kahawa wa Kenya.
Ekegusii: Omochi buya buya bw'Abagondo ba Kenya Planters Cooperative Union buina bwaki na boki mwaki buya bwa Coffee Cherry Advance Revolving Fund buya bwachikora buya bwaki boki abanyagengo.
Dholuo: Board nyaka duto machielo mar Kenya Planters Cooperative Union notimo, kendo echier timbe Coffee Cherry Advance Revolving Fund mamoko oriti manono mar bwogima Kenya.
Somali: Guddiga cusub ee Kenya Planters Cooperative Union wuu howlgalaa waxaana uu maamuli doonaa Sanduuqa Wareegga Lacagta Kafeega ee Coffee Cherry Advance si uu u taageero beeralayda kafeega ee Kiinya.

English: The Kshs. 3 Billion Cherry Advance Revolving Fund regulations have been approved. Coffee stakeholders are invited to submit written feedback by January 15, 2020.
Kiswahili: Kanuni za Mfuko wa Mzunguko wa Cherry Advance wa Kshs. 3 Bilioni zimeidhinishwa. Wadau wa kahawa wanakaribishwa kutoa mrejeo kwa maandiko kabla ya tarehe 15 Januari 2020.
Ekegusii: Amakiri ya Kshs. 3 Billion Cherry Advance Revolving Fund agakirebwire. Abakongosi bacha chai baria bana ugenzi bwaki bora buya kera nyaki ya 15, 2020.
Dholuo: Machielo mar Kshs. 3 Billion Cherry Advance Revolving Fund ayomore. Wuonngo mar coffee inying' kuom weche magi mar anyang' kuom Janari 15, 2020.
Somali: Sharciga Koorso Ku Dhisan Kshs. 3 Bilyan ee Muruq-Maashinka ayaa la ansixiyay. Qaybaha ka shaqeeya kafee waxaa lagu martiqaaday inay soo gudbiyaan jawaab qoraal ah ilaa Janaayo 15, 2020.

English: Attention youth in agriculture: Engage with FAO's Hand-in-Hand initiative to access resources and support aimed at achieving food security and Sustainable Development Goal 2.
Kiswahili: Kumbuka vijana katika kilimo: Jihusishe na mpango wa FAO wa Hand-in-Hand ili kupata rasilimali na msaada wa kufikia usalama wa chakula na Malengo ya Maendeleo Endelevu ya 2.
Ekegusii: Abaki bwakireri mu busekereri: Naki na Hand-in-Hand ya FAO kusa na obonori naki ne okubetere mwena oria bwaki bukireri bu busekereri bu Gonga 2.
Dholuo: Joka gi chon kanyamu: Wang'ni gi FAO Hand-in-Hand initiative nyaka miyo chando ka ochenjore chier kuom ber mokuoch e osiepe mang'wenne gi Sustainable Development Goal 2.
Somali: Dhalinyarada ku howlan beeraha: Ku hawlan barnaamijka Gacan-gacanta ee FAO si aad u heshaan kheyraad iyo taageero lagu gaadhayo amniga cuntada iyo Hadafka Horumarinta Waara ee 2.

English: All livestock in Kenya must be registered under new proposed regulations, requiring identification devices for each animal before entering slaughterhouses.
Kiswahili: Mifugo yote nchini Kenya inapaswa kuandikishwa chini ya kanuni mpya zinazopendekezwa, zinazoitaji vifaa vya kitambulisho kwa kila mnyama kabla ya kuingia machinjioni.
Ekegusii: Busii bw'ose bwaki Kenya buya bwegana na mabwaki abw'ekusuma, buya bibori bware buja buya abwaki bosi bujogere buya omokariga.
Dholuo: Nyumba mar nyaruok e Kenya to ok oting' e giedhi gi ng'ato mag lwedo, mane odhiambo ochiko ng'ato mar nyaruok kendo ng'ato mag ieach.
Somali: Dhammaan xoolaha Kenya waa in lagu diiwaan geliyo shuruucda cusub ee la soo jeediyay, oo dalbanaya qalab aqoonsi ah xayawaanka kasta ka hor inta aanay gelin goobaha dhinacyada.

English: Attention farmers and agribusiness stakeholders: World food prices have risen significantly as of November, impacting costs for meat and vegetable oils. Monitor pricing trends closely to adjust strategies.
Kiswahili: Tahadhari wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo: Bei za chakula duniani zimepanda kwa kiasi kikubwa tangu Novemba, kuathiri gharama za nyama na mafuta ya mboga. Fuata mwenendo wa bei kwa karibu ili kubadilisha mikakati.
Ekegusii: Abagere buya na abakere buya bamenye: Abwaki bwokirori baje bwereke buya buya bwoterekingori naki, bwona buya bwaburore buchani. Naki buya bwereche buya ore na buya bwaburori.
Dholuo: Ng'ama nanga, chiegni magoyo gi duka: Piny neni e tich mar chakre gi nyasi pinyok nene mag piny, mane owuok chamo mar piny gi nyasi. Kanyo ng'ama chong' bura to ogendini e ng'ato to nyal ng'eyo.
Somali: Dhiirrigelin u diridda beeralayda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beeraha: Qiimaha cuntada adduunka ayaa siyaado ku baxay bishii Nofeembar, taasoo saameyn ku yeelatay kharashyada hilibka iyo saliidda khudradda. Si dhow ula soco isbeddellada qiimaha si aad u hagaajisid istaraatijiyaddaada.

English: Countries are collaborating to enhance access to agricultural mechanization services. Farmers in Kenya, Tanzania, Ethiopia, Zambia, Ghana, and Uganda may benefit from this initiative.
Kiswahili: Nchi zinashirikiana kuboresha upatikanaji wa huduma za mitambo ya kilimo. Wakulima nchini Kenya, Tanzania, Ethiopia, Zambia, Ghana, na Uganda wanaweza kunufaika na mpango huu.
Ekegusii: Abananchi bataria hamwe n'ogokore bwaki bwocherekeria buya bw'ogokore. Abakuku b'ekegusii, Tanzania, Ethiopia, Zambia, Ghana, na Uganda babwogomokire bwiini.
Dholuo: Wuon nyaka ochiko gi ugeni kuom nyaka mar megi. Anyuola mag Kenya, Tanzania, Ethiopia, Zambia, Ghana, kod Uganda nyaka to golo e yo maruru.
Somali: Dalalka ayaa iskaashanaya si kor loogu qaado helitaanka adeegyada mashiinnada beeraha. Beeralayda Kenya, Tanzania, Itoobiya, Zambiya, Gana, iyo Ugaandha ayaa ka faa’iidaysan kara ololahan.

English: Turkana County is implementing flood-based farming to combat food insecurity. Farmers in the area should engage with the Kakong'u project to improve agricultural productivity.
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Turkana inatekeleza kilimo kinachotegemea mafuriko kupambana na uhaba wa chakula. Wakulima katika eneo hilo wanapaswa kushiriki katika mradi wa Kakong'u ili kuboresha uzalishaji wa kilimo.
Ekegusii: Naki County ya Turkana igetereki omokore burokire bukiire bwaki bwogekorera. Abakiro buibori bateganye naki omokango wa Kakong'u bokogotere ogenda bwaki.
Dholuo: Turkana County nigi nyakogo joma otenge gi higa mar ji yieng' e piny. Jotwara kuom joma chenro ok nyis thuolo Kakong'u, kendo piny iwinj gima aneno.
Somali: Gobolka Turkana wuxuu hirgelinayaa beero ku tiirsan fatahaadaha si looga hortago amniga cuntada. Beeralayda deegaankan waxaa lagula talinayaa inay la shuraakoobaan mashruuca Kakong'u si loo hagaajiyo wax soo saarka beeralayda.

English: The Ugandan Government has established milk checkpoints along major highways to ensure quality assurance for milk products. Consumers are encouraged to utilize these checkpoints for quality verification.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Uganda imeanzisha vituo vya ukaguzi wa maziwa kwenye barabara kuu ili kuhakikisha ubora wa bidhaa za maziwa. Watumiaji wanahimizwa kutumia vituo hivi kwa ajili ya uthibitishaji wa ubora.
Ekegusii: Okwenendo kwa Obwenje bu Abaganga ba Uganda buoka bucheche bwaki bweng'endo bwanigana buse-bwaki buya bu emochinji. Ababere bakenchura bakenyagia bucheche buya bu kechikire omoka.
Dholuo: Gavana wa Uganda abiro ni kuom milik checkpoint e piny mar nyumba to ihor kanyo mwandani e milik. Waduong’ e nyiri puonj moker gi kuom in kwaya kwaya.
Somali: Dowladda Uganda waxay dhistay meelaha hubinta caanaha ee wadooyinka waaweyn si loo hubiyo tayada alaabada caanaha. Isticmaalayaasha waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay ka faa’iideystaan meelahaan si loo xaqiijiyo tayada.

English: The Ministry of Agriculture, Animal Industry and Fisheries (MAAIF) is creating a National Veterinary Medicine Authority to regulate veterinary medicine in Uganda. Stakeholders are invited to participate in the ongoing engagement process.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Kilimo, Sekta ya Mifugo na Uvuvi inaunda Mamlaka ya Taifa ya Dawa za Mifugo ili kudhibiti dawa za mifugo nchini Uganda. Wadau wanakaribishwa kushiriki katika mchakato wa ushirikiano unaoendelea.
Ekegusii: Ombokire ya Ageria, Oboranga bw'Akaburi n'Oburima (MAAIF) oria ore okogena Obwakanyiri bw'Enyabaki n'Oboranga bw'Enyabaki ki otorire omokima ogw'obwakanyiri bw'onyonge. Abakiri baki omokima botoshure mu omoborwaki bw'ekigunyetete.
Dholuo: Ministry of Agriculture, Animal Industry and Fisheries (MAAIF) oyudo kanyo National Veterinary Medicine Authority ma ok omiya veterinary medicine e Uganda. Kido gi pinje mihakalo chunyruok e yore maler.
Somali: Wasaaradda Beeraha, Warshadaha Xoolaha iyo Kaluumeysiga (MAAIF) waxay sameynaysaa Hay'adda Qaranka ee Dawooyinka Xoolaha si ay u nidaamiso daawada xoolaha ee Uganda. Waxaa la casuumayaa daneeyayaasha inay ka qaybqaataan geeddi-socodka wada-shaqeynta ee socda.

English: Avocado farmers in Nyeri County are encouraged to form farmer groups to enhance sustainability and improve feedback from extension officers. Join a group today for better support!
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa avokado katika Kaunti ya Nyeri wanahimizwa kuunda vikundi vya wakulima ili kuboresha uendelevu na kupata mrejesho mzuri kutoka kwa maafisa wa upanuzi. Jiunge na kundi leo kwa msaada bora!
Ekegusii: Abashoki be avocado bu Nyeri baretwa bano batii bokiobori abashoki baki bengi mwaki omeria buya na obokire bwogero bu bataratagi. Gena boko boti buya!
Dholuo: Abari mar avocado joma nyaka Nyeri County ne gikuru kuom gima joma dhaker ma okonyruok gi chwanya mar extension. Jotie kuom grupo nandruok mar nyingi!
Somali: Beeralayda avokaadada ee ka tirsan Gobolka Nyeri waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay sameystaan kooxo beeraley ah si ay u xoojiyaan joogteynta iyo hagaajinta jawaab celinta ka timaadda saraakiisha kordhinta. Ku biir koox maanta si aad u hesho taageero wanaagsan!

English: Attention farmers and agribusiness stakeholders: The Multi-Sectoral Food Security and Nutrition Project is launching awareness competitions in 1,500 schools to promote nutrition through arts. Participate to enhance community awareness.
Kiswahili: Tajiriba wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo: Mradi wa Usalama wa Chakula na Lishe wa Sekta nyingi unaanzisha mashindano ya uhamasishaji katika shule 1,500 ili kuhamasisha lishe kupitia sanaa. Shiriki ili kuimarisha uelewa wa jamii.
Ekegusii: Naki omokiruma naki omocheraabaki bwakireri: Bwakiriri bwa Multi-Sectoral Food Security and Nutrition bwakiokwa omokosi buya buya mu masomo 1,500 okucheka buya bwakiriri bwokugirango buya. Osibori okokanya buya bwaki bwakianga omokiri.
Dholuo: Ng'ato e yo moko, dira mar jodhaki gi joma okonya: Jotieno maneno mar chiegni e komiti 1,500 kod joma chuny godo ka nyaka yo maber kuom chiegni. Ne onge ni kik me jopiny kuom chiegni mar joma.
Somali: Digniintooda beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beeraha: Mashruuca Amniga Cuntada iyo Nafaqada ee Multi-Sectoral wuxuu furi doonaa tartamada wacyigelinta iskuulada 1,500 si kor loogu qaado nafaqada iyadoo la adeegsanayo farshaxanka. Ka qaybqaado si aad u xoojiso wacyiga bulshada.

English: The Horticultural Crops Directorate has closed the Hass and Fuerte avocado harvesting season from November 15 to March 15, 2020. Notify the directorate in writing within 7 days if harvesting off-season avocados.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Mazao ya Bustani imefunga msimu wa mavuno ya avocado za Hass na Fuerte kuanzia Novemba 15 hadi Machi 15, 2020. Tajirisha idara hiyo kwa maandiko ndani ya siku 7 iwapo unakusanya avocado za msimu usiofaa.
Ekegusii: Omisorori w'Abana b'ibikere b'eguruma atwanikire enyang'endi ya Hass na Fuerte omoganda mwa 15 Novemba naki 15 Marto 2020. Naki ibere omoganda omokiriri emokinyerete mu naki 7.
Dholuo: Luanyag' Dhokruok Nyao gi Dioje mag Horticultural Crops Directorate nyal ni chweyo jii remod kuom Hass to Fuerte avocado odong' timo mag November 15 ng'ato March 15, 2020. Timo Dhokruok nigi konyo kendo bedo ni vine ka ochem avocado kuom chweyo jii.
Somali: Waaxda Xoolaha Beeraha ayaa xiray xilliga goosashada avokadooyinka Hass iyo Fuerte laga bilaabo Noofembar 15 ilaa Maarso 15, 2020. Fadlan qoraal u dir waaxda gudaheeda 7 maalmood gudahood haddii aad goosanayso avokadoo xilli ka baxsan.

English: Vanilla farmers in registered farmer groups are reminded to harvest within 9 months of pollination, starting from the official harvest date of January 15, 2020, for optimal quality.
Kiswahili: Wuunda wa vanilaa katika vikundi vya wakulima waliosajiliwa wanakumbushwa kuvuna ndani ya miezi 9 ya uchavushaji, kuanzia tarehe rasmi ya kuvuna ya Januari 15, 2020, ili kupata ubora bora.
Ekegusii: Abakina ba vanilla baki boti buya bw’erekia a’eauka bwakore bori naki 9, bwi mioro gose buya bwanokiri bwokwongo bw’erekia bnationi bw’erekia bwamogora 15, 2020, buya bwanokiri bwokwangoya.
Dholuo: Bangi ang'wen gi omena ma ng'ato wachwagi to kelo koseketo pako e 9 mwakni gi wend pako ma ng'ato ruoth e January 15, 2020, moimwe koro to gi wacho kanyoni.
Somali: Siyaasiyiin vanilj ah oo ku jira kooxaha beeraleyda la diiwaangeliyay waxaa lagu xasuusinayaa inay goostaan iyadoo la raacayo 9 bilood ka dib abuurka, laga bilaabo taariikhda rasmiga ah ee goosashada 15-ka Janaayo, 2020, si loo helo tayo wanaagsan.

English: Nakuru County is promoting Climate Smart Agriculture. Farmers are encouraged to attend sensitization sessions for new technologies and practices, focusing on soil testing and weather data.
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Nakuru inakuza Kilimo cha Hali ya Hewa Kijali. Wakulima wanahimizwa kuhudhuria vikao vya ufahamu kuhusu teknolojia na tabia mpya, wakilenga mtihani wa udongo na data za hali ya hewa.
Ekegusii: Nakuru County ikorereanga Omoogo buya bwa Masanja Bwaki. Abashamba barakiire omobochi boki bwaki bwogeire omokiriri, bwachire buya buki bwokoshagia omogenda na ng'anya.
Dholuo: Nakuru County en gi miyo Climate Smart Agriculture. Abor mg'we en dhak konyo e tich mar sensitisasi kuom teknologia kod bich, nyal oying' gi chielo kendo data mar chik.
Somali: Degmada Nakuru waxay dhiirigelinaysaa Beerta Caqliga Leh ee Cimilada. Beeraleyda waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay ka qayb qaataan kulamada wacyigelinta ee teknoolojiyada iyo dhaqamada cusub, oo diiradda la saarayo tijaabada carrada iyo macluumaadka cimilada.

English: Rwanda aims to eradicate food insecurity by 2025, focusing on healthy diets and inclusive food security initiatives. Stay informed about agricultural policies and practices that support this goal.
Kiswahili: Rwanda inalenga kuondoa ukosefu wa chakulaifiki ifikapo mwaka 2025, ikizingatia lishe bora na mipango ya usalama wa chakula inayo jumuisha. Weka taarifa kuhusu sera na mbinu za kilimo zinazounga mkono lengo hili.
Ekegusii: Rwanda ikareka oria orembieke bang'ana buya 2025, onyakireri oria buya na edare ko oria obwaki bwose. Naki omokirori buya oria obwakire baagri ikinyang'ane oria bosibegbe naki.
Dholuo: Rwanda ineno ka okony gi nyime mar chieng’ to 2025, ohero ka nol nyime mag nyasaye, gi okony mar chaygore. Tugo ka unyis mar bende ma okony gi nyime mag chiyu.
Somali: Rwanda waxay hiigsaneysaa in ay baabi'iso amniyaad cunnada sanadka 2025, iyadoo diiradda saareysa cunto caafimaad leh iyo barnaamijyo amni cunto oo wadajir ah. La soco siyaasadaha iyo dhaqamada beeraha ee taageeraya ujeedadan.

English: The Committee on World Food Security (CFS) continues to promote food security and nutrition for all. All stakeholders are encouraged to participate in this multistakeholder platform.
Kiswahili: Kamati ya Usalama wa Chakula Duniani (CFS) inaendelea kuhamasisha usalama wa chakula na lishe kwa wote. Wadau wote wanahimizwa kushiriki katika منصة hii ya wadau wengi.
Ekegusii: Komiti ya Usalama wa Chakula Duniani (CFS) ikarokere omokere naki edugie omogenda naki okirongi bw'akiibori. Bwakire bweenyenye bora kwendete naki obokibori buno bw'ogotera.
Dholuo: Komiti mar Dhi Weng' Rach Dhogruok (CFS) oywete kuom dhogruok mag wana kanyo gi nyasem. Wang'ni wachung' manok ginyal nyalni ka timo uduogo ma ji gi ji e yo.
Somali: Guddiga Badbaadada Cuntada Adduunka (CFS) ayaa sii wadaya horumarinta badbaadada cuntada iyo nafaqada dhamaan. Dhamaan daneeyayaasha waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa in ay ka qayb qaataan madashan badan dhexdhexaadinta ah.

English: FAO and FMO are launching a partnership to enhance agricultural financing in Kenya, focusing on small-scale producers and SMEs. Engage with this initiative for better access to finance and management practices.
Kiswahili: FAO na FMO wanaanzisha ushirikiano kuboresha ufadhili wa kilimo nchini Kenya, wakilenga wazalishaji wadogo na SMEs. Shiriki katika mpango huu kwa upatikanaji mzuri wa fedha na mbinu za usimamizi.
Ekegusii: FAO naki FMO bagena bwire kumanyanania buya bwogekibori mu Kenya, busome omokere omogendi na SMEs. Naki oikire na bwire buya obwakiri na buya bwokiraki.
Dholuo: FAO miyo FMO nitie partnership to dhok mar kiwuon gi jowetruok maruok e Kenya, nigi kuom jowetruok noto gi SMEs. Jochung' to gik moko to oketigi kuni gi puoch mar pi konyo kod jachiek.
Somali: FAO iyo FMO ayaa bilaabayaan iskaashi si kor loogu qaado maalgelinta beeraha ee Kenya, iyadoo la diiradda saarayo soo saareyaasha yaryar iyo SMEs. Ka qayb qaado qorshahan si aad u hesho fursado fiican oo maalgelin ah iyo hababka maareynta.

English: FAO and the World Union of Wholesale Markets are enhancing efforts to reduce food loss and waste globally. Stakeholders in agriculture should engage with local wholesale markets to improve food distribution.
Kiswahili: FAO na Umoja wa Soko la Jumla wanajitahidi kuboresha juhudi za kupunguza kupoteza chakula na taka duniani kote. Wadau katika sekta ya kilimo wanapaswa kushiriki na masoko ya jumla ya hapa ili kuboresha usambazaji wa chakula.
Ekegusii: FAO na Umoja wa Dunia wa Masoko ya Wajumuishaji wanaendeleza juhudi za kupunguza upotevu wa chakula duniani. Washirika katika kilimo wanapaswa kuhusika na masoko ya wajumuishaji ya eneo lao ili kuboresha usambazaji wa chakula.
Dholuo: FAO kod World Union of Wholesale Markets nene kawinyo ng'ato e kanyakla mag nyasaye kendo mado. Nitieka e nyasaye to oik mar kanyakla mag nyasaye kuom udhi kanyakla.
Somali: FAO iyo Midowga Caalamiga ee Suuqyada Waraaqda waxay kordhinayaan dadaalada lagu yareynayo khasaaraha iyo qashinka cuntada adduunka. Dadka ka shaqeeya beeraha waa inay la xiriiraan suuqyada jumlada ee maxalliga ah si ay u hagaajiyaan qaybinta cuntada.

English: Farmers in Uganda can benefit from the new nucleus farmer model, connecting them to mechanization, financing, and markets. Contact your local District Agricultural Extension Officer for more information.
Kiswahili: Wakulima nchini Uganda wanaweza kufaidika na mfano mpya wa mkulima wa msingi, unaowaunganisha na uanzishaji wa mitambo, ufadhili, na masoko. Wasiliana na Afisa wa Mkulima wa Wilaya wako kwa maelezo zaidi.
Ekegusii: Abagiri b'Uganda bova obogogeteng'ana munda na mooki omoka omoshokere, baburaga ku bwanjana, omosimba, na masoko. Bwakire omoshokere omonene jia bisi b'ogakire b'Abagiri buya buya.
Dholuo: Mawindwa mar Uganda ka dholu fwara e nindo mar nucleus, to eyo nyalo tit yudo maen, timbe, e mamilori. Kony ng'ato ma nyalo yudo kwa ng'ata magi e walosi kendo oremo jombo okwongo.
Somali: Beeralayda Uganda waxay ka faa'iidaysan karaan qaabka beeralayda cusub, oo ka dhigaya inay helaan mashiinno, maalgelin, iyo suuqyo. La xidhiidh Xafiiska Horumarinta Beeralayda degmadaada si aad u hesho macluumaad dheeri ah.

English: Farmers and stakeholders in the potato value chain are encouraged to familiarize themselves with the recently passed potato regulations by the National Potato Council of Kenya (NPCK).
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wadau katika mnyororo wa thamani wa viazi wanahimizwa kujifahamu na kanuni mpya za viazi zilizopita na Baraza la Viazi la Kitaifa nchini Kenya (NPCK).
Ekegusii: Abagikosi na abakiibori mu bumong'ere bw'abatunya bakenyaki ebire nyakira bente baria bwakiobori na aborani bwabere bu National Potato Council of Kenya (NPCK).
Dholuo: Wagwok mag loyo gi nyaka mondo wachako kendo omako ruoth mar potato momiyo e nyasaye ng'ato mar potato ng'wonje, manoo National Potato Council of Kenya (NPCK).
Somali: Beeralayda iyo qaybaha danaystayaal ee silsiladda qiimaha iliga ayaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay isbaran sahamiyaan sharciga iliga ee cusub ee ay soo saartay Golaha Q национальная Potato ee Kenya (NPCK).

English: Tea farmers are encouraged to stay informed about fluctuating tea prices and market trends to make better farming decisions. Please monitor local updates for support and resources available.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa chai wanahimizwa kubaki na ufahamu kuhusu mabadiliko ya bei za chai na mwelekeo wa soko ili kufanya maamuzi bora ya kilimo. Tafadhali fuatilia taarifa za eneo lako kwa msaada na rasilimali zinazopatikana.
Ekegusii: Abakora tea baria mbere bamenye bwakire bw'ibihinga na bahanura bw'ekihinga, borangane bakore ibitei buno. Naki bamanye baturia buseke na yetunga ze baria mirang'ana.
Dholuo: Ng'ato ma koro tek tea nindo yudo orem gi ka weche mag tei e nyithindo ka oting'o yudo ng'ato ma nyalo bende ringo dhako. Wachok duma ono gi ya yie e liwoju maduong'.
Somali: Beeraleyda shaaha waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay la socdaan isbeddelada qiimaha shaaha iyo isbeddelada suuqa si ay go'aano wanaagsan uga gaaraan beerta. Fadlan la soco wararka deegaanka si aad u hesho taageero iyo kheyraad la heli karo.

English: Agricultural Extension Service Providers in Uganda are encouraged to adopt the new Ethical Code of Conduct to enhance service delivery. Access the code here: http://agriculture.go.ug/…/Ethical-Code-of-Conduct-for-Agri…
Kiswahili: Watoza huduma za upanuzi wa kilimo nchini Uganda wanahimizwa kuzingatia Kanuni Mpya ya Maadili ili kuboresha utoaji wa huduma. Pata kanuni hiyo hapa: http://agriculture.go.ug/…/Ethical-Code-of-Conduct-for-Agri…
Ekegusii: Abagasi b'ekarari eUganda baravunjire kukorere ikireri nakipecha  ya buya buya kuti bwereke oboragani. Ria iteka naki: http://agriculture.go.ug/…/Ethical-Code-of-Conduct-for-Agri…
Dholuo: Wang'ni gi chike mar dhok mag maer e Uganda bar iwacho ng'ato konyo chike nyaka tich gi chike dako. Winj kod chike ni: http://agriculture.go.ug/…/Ethical-Code-of-Conduct-for-Agri…
Somali: Bixiyeyaasha Adeegga Koritaanka Beeraleyda ee Uganda waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay qaataan Xeerka cusub ee Anshaxa si loo hagaajiyo bixinta adeegyada. Halkan ka hel xeerka: http://agriculture.go.ug/…/Ethical-Code-of-Conduct-for-Agri…

English: The Aquaculture Business Development Programme is set to launch in 15 counties, starting with pilot projects in Nyeri, Meru, Kirinyaga, Kakamega, Homa Bay, and Migori. Engage with local agricultural offices for participation details.
Kiswahili: Programu ya Maendeleo ya Biashara ya Ufugaji wa Samaki itazinduliwa katika kaunti 15, ikianza na miradi ya majaribio katika Nyeri, Meru, Kirinyaga, Kakamega, Homa Bay, na Migori. Wasiliana na ofisi za kilimo za mkoa wako kwa maelezo zaidi kuhusu ushiriki.
Ekegusii: Makiaro ya Bouguo bw’amasoko ekiyeje okogokania mu nkenye 15, ikiraki buya mu nkenye za Nyeri, Meru, Kirinyaga, Kakamega, Homa Bay, na Migori. Naki naki omokore obogokania buya na migana ya abamaki b’akaranga.
Dholuo: Kapro gram mokuot kanyiko kuom nyaka chier 15, tich kendo ng'ama kama chakre piloti e Nyeri, Meru, Kirinyaga, Kakamega, Homa Bay, kod Migori. Wang'ni konyo e ofisi mar agik e kanyim to wacho yore.
Somali: Barnaamijka Horumarinta Ganacsiga Kaluunka wuxuu ka bilaabanayaa 15 degmo, isagoo ku bilaabanaya mashruucyo tijaabo ah oo ka dhacaya Nyeri, Meru, Kirinyaga, Kakamega, Homa Bay, iyo Migori. La xiriir xafiisyada beeraha ee deegaanka si aad u hesho faahfaahinta ka qeybgalka.

English: The Kenyan government will construct three dams in West Pokot, Turkana, and Marsabit to address water scarcity. Counties must identify suitable sites for the dams by next week. Completion is expected by June 2020.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Kenya itaandika mabwawa matatu katika West Pokot, Turkana, na Marsabit ili kukabili uhaba wa maji. Kaunti zinapaswa kutafuta maeneo yafaa kwa mabwawa ifikapo wiki ijayo. Kumalizika kunatarajiwa kufanyika mwezi Juni 2020.
Ekegusii: Abantu baki Kenyan baragire kubora ebire mbaire kusi West Pokot, Turkana, na Marsabit gutia iyo emashuga atukore omokogoti. Abantu ba kisii baigire kutikire tuondi buya bw'emashuga bwaki bakira ekiro tosari. Omogoti waki gotera by'June 2020.
Dholuo: Serikali ya Kenya en odiso madam thom jotend wakonyo e West Pokot, Turkana, kendo Marsabit kuom nyiso ma okel ruoth. Kauti to kod okonyo ogend joma yie ka madam no koro jiiwan. Okelo ni nyaka ne ng'ato gi June 2020.
Somali: Dowladda Kenya waxay dhisi doontaa saddex biyo-xireen oo ku yaal West Pokot, Turkana, iyo Marsabit si loo xalliyo yaraanta biyaha. Degmooyinka waa inay baadi-goobaan meelaha ku habboon ee biyo-xireennada dhismaha toddobaadka soo socda. Dhameystirka waxaa la filayaa inuu dhacdo  bishii Juun 2020.

English: Import, export, and transit of live animals and animal products in Uganda requires authorization from the Commissioner for Animal Health. Ensure compliance with disease control guidelines.
Kiswahili: Importation, usafirishaji, na mtiririko wa wanyama waishi na bidhaa za wanyama nchini Uganda unahitaji kibali kutoka kwa Kamishna wa Afya ya Wanyama. Hakikisha unafuata mwongozo wa kudhibiti magonjwa.
Ekegusii: Omo ni okiria, omokiri na oria oria buya buya mwaki Uganda, ong'enda omosi omogenda bw'oshane Obwakirori buya. Osakire buya buya buya bw'okkia oria oria.
Dholuo: Kiporo, kanyakla, gi mowuok ma kanyakla e Uganda owuon chalo mar Commissioner for Animal Health. Golo nyalo nyise chike mang'weny.
Somali: Dhoofinta, soo dejinta, iyo marinka xoolaha nool iyo alaabooyinka xoolaha ee Ugaandha waxay u baahan yihiin ogolaansho ka timid Madaxa Caafimaadka Xoolaha. Hubi in la raaco tilmaamaha xakamaynta cudurrada.

English: The 2019 Africa Food Prize recognizes exceptional farmers and advocates for innovative and sustainable agricultural practices. Learn from winners like Dr. Emma Naluyima and Baba Dioum to enhance your farming methods.
Kiswahili: Tuzo ya Chakula ya Afrika ya 2019 inatambua wakulima bora na wafuasi wa mbinu za kilimo za ubunifu na endelevu. Jifunze kutoka kwa washindi kama Dr. Emma Naluyima na Baba Dioum ili kuboresha mbinu zako za kilimo.
Ekegusii: Omosangu mwaki 2019 wa Africa, osing'ana abaki bakanisa batarera naki naki buya boka bwere na bokiriri bw'ogucha. Naki omoborere abaki bakanisa ba Dr. Emma Naluyima na Baba Dioum okogerere oria buya bw'ogucha bwemaki.
Dholuo: 2019 Africa Food Prize n$o nyal nind gi chike mang’ich kanyal mokuongo ma nyaliek e ndalo maber. Konyo kuom kido mang’ich dhiambo ng'wechni ni Dr. Emma Naluyima gi Baba Dioum, to gichande lokere ma ok oting'ni.
Somali: Abaalmarinta Cuntada Afrika 2019 waxay aqoonsan tahay beeraleyda iyo kuwa u ololeeya hababka cusub oo waara ee beeralayda. Ka baro guuleystayaasha sida Dr. Emma Naluyima iyo Baba Dioum si aad u horumariso hababkaaga beeralayda.

English: The African Green Revolution Forum (AGRF) is taking place in Accra, Ghana from September 3-6. Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders are encouraged to engage in discussions on digital transformation in agriculture.
Kiswahili: Mkutano wa Jihada ya Kijani wa Afrika (AGRF) unafanyika Accra, Ghana kuanzia Septemba 3-6. Wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo wanahimizwa kushiriki katika majadiliano kuhusu mabadiliko ya kidijitali katika kilimo.
Ekegusii: Forum ya African Green Revolution (AGRF) ikorori moki naki Accra, Ghana buya September 3-6. Abagiri ba mboga na bakireri bariosagari baria ohoro kutang'ana mwene nyancha buya mwandiko mwaki.
Dholuo: African Green Revolution Forum (AGRF) idhi e Accra, Ghana kuyiero September 3-6. Juma ma okonyo e kendo ma nyaka bende yudo jodak e ng'eyo mar digital kuom juma.
Somali: Axdiga Horumarinta Cagaaran ee Afrika (AGRF) wuxuu ka dhacayaa Accra, Ghana laga bilaabo Sebtembar 3-6. Beeralayda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beeraha waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay ka qeybqaataan doodaha ku saabsan isbeddelka dijitaalka ah ee beeraha.

English: Farmers in Muranga County can access a stable market for milk through 45 co-operatives and sell to Muranga County Creameries at Kshs. 35 per liter.
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika Kaunti ya Muranga wanaweza kupata soko thabiti la maziwa kupitia vyama 45 na kuuza kwa Viwanda vya Maziwa ya Muranga kwa Kshs. 35 kwa lita.
Ekegusii: Abashanga baki Muranga baria na ikagori oria naki bosi buya bw’aki mboka bwire 45 buya na bacha bosi buya Muranga County Creameries na Kshs. 35 per liter.
Dholuo: Dhadho mar Muranga en gige ka inyuongo miliki maber kuom 45 co-operative, kendo ing'eyo ku Muranga County Creameries e Kshs. 35 kwa litre.
Somali: Farmers-ka Muranga County waxay heli karaan suuq xasilloon oo caanaha iyadoo loo marayo 45 is-kaashato iyo inay ka iibiyaan Caano-mareenada Muranga County Kshs. 35 litirkiiba.

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders are encouraged to engage in discussions and share knowledge about potato and sweet potato production for sustainable food systems.
Kiswahili: Wakulima na washikadau wa biashara ya kilimo wanahimizwa kujihusisha katika majadiliano na kubadilishana maarifa kuhusu uzalishaji wa viazi na viazi mviringo kwa ajili ya mifumo endelevu ya chakula.
Ekegusii: Abaragori naki abaki buya bosi omokirori boki abaki bosi naki ngoje buya buya ore bosi orokirori bwendo naki omotangari buya.
Dholuo: Nanga bende e waduong' gi jochunge e kendo ubiro konyo mar jogwedhi kendo jogwedhi mar pompa gi pompa marach kuom inji gi jalok mag wuonera.
Somali: Ayaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa beeralayda iyo dhinacyada ganacsiga beeraha inay ka wada hadlaan oo ay iska xog-wareystaan wax soo saarka baratuda iyo baratootiga macaan si loo sugo nidaamka cuntada waara.

English: Eligible youth in Uganda can access opportunities under the new National Strategy for Youth Employment in Agriculture. Engage with the Ministry of Agriculture for details on participation.
Kiswahili: Vijana wanaostahili nchini Uganda wanaweza kupata fursa chini ya Mkakati Mpya wa Kitaifa wa Ajira kwa Vijana katika Kilimo. Wasiliana na Wizara ya Kilimo kwa maelezo kuhusu ushiriki.
Ekegusii: Abaki bateganire mu Uganda baria bakanjoka omokirigo bw'ogokora eng'anya bwarangire bu'Nyakabanda bu'Kigunda mu Bucungani. Wenda orokire Ombokiti ya Bucungani omokuboka omotembe.
Dholuo: Jong'wech madhi e Uganda nyalo kanyo nyura kata goyo ng'ato e ng'ato ma yudi chiegni ma Cheng' Kaka. Konyo kaka gi Ministry of Agriculture kuom mako yomok.
Somali: Dhallinyarada u qalma ee Uganda waxay heli karaan fursado hoos yimaada Istaraatiijiyadda Qaran ee Shaqaaleynta Dhallinyarada ee Beerta. La xiriir Wasaaradda Beeraha si aad u hesho faahfaahin ku saabsan ka qeybgalka.

English: The Agriculture Cluster Development Project (ACDP) has been expanded to 19 new districts in Uganda, enabling registered farmers to access subsidized farm inputs. Farmers must contribute 33% of the input cost.
Kiswahili: Mradi wa Maendeleo ya Kikundi cha Kilimo (ACDP) umepanuliwa hadi katika wilaya 19 mpya nchini Uganda, ukiwezesha wakulima waliosajiliwa kupata pembejeo za kilimo zilizopunguziliwa bei. Wakulima wanapaswa kuchangia 33% ya gharama za pembejeo.
Ekegusii: Project ya Agriculture Cluster Development (ACDP) yongerewonje mu districts 19 ogendani Uganda, ikinyora abarozi abakatigana ku getera obuhingi bwekutonga. Abarozi bakenye gupanga 33% y'iko ono.
Dholuo: Agriculture Cluster Development Project (ACDP) remiye ku 19 diko mar Uganda, ma en machiegni ruothi duto kuom wach veryo gi farm inputs. Ruothi nogech gi 33% mar input cost.
Somali: Mashruuca Horumarinta Klustarada Beeraha (ACDP) ayaa la ballaariyey ilaa 19 degmo cusub oo ku yaal Uganda, taasoo u oggolaaneysa beeralayda diiwaangashan inay helaan agab beeraha oo hoos loo dhigay. Beeralaydu waxay tahay inay qayb ka qaataan 33% kharashka agabka.

English: Farmers can now access agricultural guidance via the new Kilimo Call Centre's toll-free line. Youth groups and ICT experts are encouraged to utilize this initiative for job creation in agriculture.
Kiswahili: Wakulima sasa wanaweza kupata mwongozo wa kilimo kupitia laini bila malipo ya Kituo cha Simu cha Kilimo. Vikundi vya vijana na wataalam wa ICT wanahimizwa kutumia mpango huu kuunda ajira katika kilimo.
Ekegusii: Abakirori batarera korera amaki ekirugendo bw'ogetenge ekitanga kilimo Call Centre ng'otagorokire. Abagene n'amasoko eICT bategereili korera ejogorokero kegsikrigana ereri mu kilimo.
Dholuo: Ng'ato maber, chieyo kanyam, owang' miyo wadh kakodegi weche duto mag Kilimo Call Centre. Wang'ni mar joduma mar youth nyalo yeng' yoregi nyaka watinda hiyo kendo wadh kakodegi k'agriculture.
Somali: Farmers-ka ayaa hadda heli kara talooyin ku saabsan beeraha iyada oo loo marayo xarunta wicitaanka Kilimo oo lacag la’aan ah. Kooxaha dhallinyarada iyo khubarada ICT waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay ka faa'iidaystaan hindisahan si ay shaqooyin uga abuuraan beeraha.

English: The Agricultural Sector Transformation and Growth Strategy 2019-2029 is now in effect, guiding farmers and agribusiness stakeholders to align with national agricultural policies.
Kiswahili: Mkakati wa Mabadiliko na Ukuaji wa Sekta ya Kilimo 2019-2029 sasa umeanza kutumika, ukiongoza wakulima na wadau wa biashara za kilimo ili kuendana na sera za kilimo za kitaifa.
Ekegusii: Omosera okenye naki okiyaki bukirori bw'ogotore naki bw'ogotere 2019-2029 buñai bwagwaki, buyaire omosera na abarandi ba buyaire bataroria hamwe na maakarani bw'ogotore bw'ogotere.
Dholuo: Strategi mar ginyamre e tich mamoko bang’ gino 2019-2029 ne nyalo chako, omiya wuod kanyamre kod wotieno mar ginyamre to anyalo konyo kaka bende pok owacho mag ginyamre mar Kenya.
Somali: Istaraatiijiyadda Isbedelka iyo Kordhinta Beeraha 2019-2029 ayaa hadda dhaqan gal ah, waxayna gacan qabataa beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beeraha si ay ula jaanqaadaan siyaasadaha qaranka ee beeraha.

English: Farmers in the Netherlands must register all livestock and obtain a Unique Business Number (UBN) for compliance. Ensure proper tagging and on-farm records.
Kiswahili: Wakulima nchini Uholanzi wanapaswa kujisajili wanyama wote na kupata Nambari Mahususi ya Biashara (UBN) ili kutimiza sheria. Hakikisha kuweka alama sahihi na rekodi za shamba.
Ekegusii: Abanyoreri bano na Netherlands bategere omokiri waki na bakore Obwonchori buya (UBN) oserera. Naki omoka omobori bwaki na enbenge za buya.
Dholuo: Dhi nyaka farmer mokuongo ma Nyandusia timo chuth chon piny ka ogend ndalo e iwoneno gi Unique Business Number (UBN) maler. Nyalo joma chuth gi chike kod onger konyo.
Somali: Beeraleyda Nederland waa in ay iska diiwaan geliyaan dhammaan xoolaha oo ay helaan Lambarka Ganacsi Gaarka ah (UBN) si ay u waafaqaan. Hubi inay si sax ah u calaamadayaan xoolaha iyo in ay haystaan diiwaannada beerta.

English: Small-scale tea farmers are encouraged to enhance the quality of their produce to secure better prices.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wadogo wa chai wanahimizwa kuboresha ubora wa mazao yao ili kupata bei bora zaidi.
Ekegusii: Abogaki baki bori batichire buya bwaki bwane buya buori buno boci.
Dholuo: Gik ma nyalo chako matind tamarind gi ng'wino pwodhi to iwinj kod maber.
Somali: Farmerada shaaha ee yaryar waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay kor u qaadaan tayada alaabtooda si ay u helaan qiimo wanaagsan.

English: Bungoma County has established a Sh230 million Agriculture Institutions Development Corporation to modernize and finance key agricultural institutions. Farmers are encouraged to engage with this new body for support in agricultural development.
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Bungoma imeanzisha Shirika la Maendeleo ya Taasisi za Kilimo la Sh230 milioni ili kuboresha na kufadhili taasisi muhimu za kilimo. Wakulima wanahimizwa kushirikiana na shirika hili jipya kwa msaada katika maendeleo ya kilimo.
Ekegusii: Bungoma Kaunti yakiendeleze Sh230 miriyoni Oria Ikanya Ibara Ikitwe moke oria ogetane naki mwaki na oborori. Abagori baramachire okere omokwege buaganya oria buororiete.
Dholuo: Bungoma County nyalor Sh230 million Agriculture Institutions Development Corporation ok nyalogi modhiere to kod jomok. Jomok nyaka pwodhi kuom nyaka ginyal chuny mar dhano.
Somali: Bungoma County waxay dhisatay Sh230 million Hay'adda Horumarinta Dhaqaalaha Beeraleyda si loo casriyeeyo loona maalgeliyo hay'adaha muhiimka ah ee beeraleyda. Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay la xiriiraan hay'addan cusub si ay u helaan taageero horumarinta beeraleynta.

English: Kenyan coffee growers can benefit from direct sales, which yielded USD 49.24 million this season — an average of USD 406 per 50-kg bag, nearly 20% more than auction prices. Consider selling directly for better earnings.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa kahawa nchini Kenya wanaweza kunufaika na mauzo ya moja kwa moja, yaliyotoa USD 49.24 milioni msimu huu — wastani wa USD 406 kwa mfuko wa kilo 50, karibu asilimia 20 zaidi ya bei za mnada. Fikiria kuuza moja kwa moja kwa faida bora.
Ekegusii: Abagire buya baki mugumu bwakikonyire bakinyega mimitu, bu kayogo USD 49.24 miliyoni bu bwakirage — abaki bu USD 406 bu 50-kg buye, bugera 20% bu naki bwekire bu auction. Naki oria oria buya bu konyere bu kinyegere.
Dholuo: Ababaki ma kopi Kenya oting' e kita chalo maler, ka ochung' USD 49.24 million e mwaka osee — joma odhiero piny, USD 406 piny 50-kg bag, yore ni 20% ka tich miyo. Tingo ni owachia kita chalo maler kuom weche puonj.
Somali: Beeralayda kafee ee Kenya waxay ka faa'iidaysan karaan iibka tooska ah, taas oo keentay USD 49.24 milyan xilli ciyaareedkan — celcelis ahaan USD 406 bacda 50-kg ah, oo ku dhowaad 20% ka badan qiimaha madaxa. Ka fiirso inaad si toos ah u iibiso si aad u hesho faa'iidooyin ka fiican.

English: SACCO members are assured that their savings are not at risk; claims about government access to these funds for infrastructure projects are false and legally unfounded.
Kiswahili: Wajumbe wa SACCO wanahakikishiwa kwamba akiba zao ziko salama; madai kuhusu serikali kupata ufikiaji wa fedha hizo kwa miradi ya miundombinu si ya kweli na hayana msingi wa kisheria.
Ekegusii: Abaki ba SACCO baigori omokiruo bw'ogoomo bwabo; eromoshonchaki kera orejoore oryaki okebwatunyi omokiri bw'ogoomo buno bw'embu mw'igenje na obwakire.
Dholuo: Membere maler gi SACCO wacho ni thum gi dako; kamano miyo gi chier ma ok timo kanyo kuom nyiso ma kwom serikali e magero mar infrastructure ne en owuon gi ng'ato.
Somali: Xubnaha SACCO-da waxaa la xaqiijinayaa in kaydka ay leeyihiin aan halis ku jirin; sheegashada ah in dowladda ay heli karto lacagahaan mashaariicda kaabayaasha waa been abuur iyo mid sharci darro ah.

English: Uasin Gishu entrepreneurs can now engage with proposed policy reforms and financing opportunities. Stay informed on the Draft MSME Policy 2025 and the MSE Amendment Bill 2025.
Kiswahili: Wajasiriamali wa Uasin Gishu sasa wanaweza kushiriki katika mapendekezo ya marekebisho ya sera na fursa za ufadhili. Kuwa na habari kuhusu Rasimu ya Sera ya MSME 2025 na Muswada wa Marekebisho ya MSE 2025.
Ekegusii: Abakire bu Uasin Gishu bategere eng'enda boki bori bwaki bwatia na masinana. Bwakire oria Bwakere bwa Draft MSME Policy 2025 na MSE Amendment Bill 2025.
Dholuo: Wana biashara ku Uasin Gishu karie nyaka kueng' ng'iyo maenyo mawuok gi ndiri mar policy to golo manoch. Adek yore nyaka kar kanyakre gi Draft MSME Policy 2025 to MSE Amendment Bill 2025.
Somali: Ganacsatada Uasin Gishu hadda waxay ka qaybqaadan karaan isbeddellada siyaasadeed la soo jeediyay iyo fursadaha maalgelinta. La soco Qorshaha MSME ee 2025 iyo Xeerka Wax-ka-beddelka MSE ee 2025.

English: The Nairobi Coffee Exchange reports that the recent auction sold 412 tonnes of coffee, translating to a gross return of KES 129 per kilogram of cherry.
Kiswahili: Mbenki ya Kahawa ya Nairobi inaripoti kwamba oksijeni ya hivi karibuni iliuza tani 412 za kahawa, ikitoa faida ya jumla ya KES 129 kwa kila kilogramu ya cheriy.
Ekegusii: Nairobi Coffee Exchange ikinyegetereka oria auction ya atuma 412 tonnes ya kahawa, ikagendereka omokiri KES 129 naki kilogram ya cherry.
Dholuo: Nairobi Coffee Exchange oseth gi chako ni aoro 412 tonnes ma ikatigo ka auction, kendo ogendini to kod KES 129 kwa kilogram mar cherry.
Somali: Nairobi Coffee Exchange ayaa soo diyaarisay in iibkii ugu dambeeyay uu siiyey 412 tan oo bun ah, taasoo u dhiganta dakhli guud oo gaadhaya KES 129 kiilogaraamkiiba cherry.

English: Murang'a County is offering commercial mango farming support, including contracts with juice manufacturers and cooperative formation. Farmers are encouraged to participate for improved income.
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Murang'a inatoa msaada wa kilimo cha maua ya embe, ikiwa ni pamoja na mikataba na watengenezaji wa juisi na uundaji wa ushirika. Wakulima wanahimizwa kushiriki ili kuboresha mapato yao.
Ekegusii: Nya Murang'a ekorenda oboragori bwenge bwaberebwe, kuse agedera akorori naki chichogenda kiibire. Aboragori barambiire kuja mwaki bwogokaraki obokire.
Dholuo: Murang'a kouth nyaka pengine kuom mango mar kanyal, ka kanyakre manoni kanyakre ne juice manufacturers to kanyal mar cooperatives. Agolo ma konyo to gima osing'or.
Somali: Degmada Murang'a waxay bixisaa taageero beero xareed ah, oo ay ku jiraan qandaraasyo la leh wax-soo-saareyaasha casiirka iyo sameynta iskaashatada. Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay ka qaybqaataan si ay dakhliga u hagaajiyaan.

English: The government has authorized the duty-free importation of 500,000 metric tonnes of rice, impacting local farmers. Urgent action is needed to clear unsold rice stock before imports begin.
Kiswahili: Serikali imeidhinisha uagizaji wa pishi 500,000 bila kodi, ambao utaathiri wakulima wa ndani. Hatua za haraka zinahitajika kufungua akiba ya mchele usiouseka kabla ya kuanza kwa uagizaji.
Ekegusii: Obwaki bwakirire bwong'ende emokiri oria 500,000 metric tonnes ya chonga, bwaki inogere buya buya buya bwono boki. Naki bwakire buya bwanjoge omogori bwanasi omogori oria buya buya bwaki.
Dholuo: Chik kendo govenomen olera mabor ma 500,000 metric tonnes mar chako, ne okonyo jok masira. Tich mosomo owinjo ewi chako kendo osiep goyo mar chako to nyalo mwandu.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay oggolaatay in la keeno 500,000 oo tan oo bariis ah oo canshuur la’aan ah, arrintan waxay saameyn ku yeelaneysaa beeraleyda maxalliga ah. Waxay lagama maarmaan tahay in la qaado tallaabo degdeg ah si loo nadiifiyo kaydka bariiska aan la iibin ka hor intaan la bilaabin soo deynta.

English: Farmers are facing increased costs due to high animal feed prices driven by a concentrated market. Stay informed about market changes and seek alternative suppliers to manage costs effectively.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanakumbana na ongezeko la gharama kutokana na bei za malisho ya wanyama zinazoenda juu kwa sababu ya soko lililo na washindani wachache. Kuwa na maarifa kuhusu mabadiliko ya soko na tafuta wauzaji mbadala ili kudhibiti gharama kwa ufanisi.
Ekegusii: Abashamba bataria buya buya bwachukire bwabi omogori ogwakubetereka na buya bwogenda bwana bwabwaki. Naki ekirenda bogenagire ebichenga na konyorera abaki bazuri boti no kugonza buya bwabwaki.
Dholuo: Jodongo gi tich manoyo keth e makelo mar tich manok gi jit mar nyasaye. Rii kuom tich maber kuom nyaka adhi konyo piny mondo uthero keth.
Somali: Beeralaydu waxay la kulmaan koror ku yimaada kharashyada sababta oo ah qiimaha cuntooyinka xoolaha oo sareeya, waxayna sabab u tahay suuqa diirran. La soco isbedellada suuqa oo raadi alaab-qeybiyeyaal kale si aad si hufan u maareyso kharashyada.

English: Tanzanian and Malawian trade in agricultural products will resume on May 2, 2025. Stakeholders should prepare for this reopening of commercial ties.
Kiswahili: Biashara ya bidhaa za kilimo kati ya Tanzania na Malawi itaanza tena tarehe 2 Mei, 2025. Washikadau wanapaswa kujiandaa kwa kufungua tena uhusiano wa kibiashara.
Ekegusii: Omosang'ana na Malawina bori buya kekenye bw'ogigenya buya, May 2, 2025. Abashandiri batarakore buya boibori bw'ogigenya buya.
Dholuo: Katrina mar Taanzania kod Malawi mango mag ndalo maber kanyakla kuom May 2, 2025. Wabiro nying' ma wan kendo wanigi chiegni iduogo mar kachien.
Somali: Ganacsiga Alaabta Beeraha ee Tanzaniya iyo Malawi wuxuu dib u bilaabm doonaa May 2, 2025. Qaybaha daneynaya waa in ay is diyaariyaan furitaanka xiriirka ganacsi.

English: Tanzania warns of an impending ban on all agricultural imports from Malawi and South Africa if their current trade restrictions are not lifted by Wednesday next week.
Kiswahili: Tanzania inatoa onyo kuhusu marufuku inayokuja ya uagizaji wa mazao yote kutoka Malawi na Afrika Kusini ikiwa vizuizi vya biashara havitafutwa kufikia Jumatano ijayo.
Ekegusii: Tanzania ikiriga buya bw'ekiwilliria bw'enzanika ya bwenyisho bwose okuva ku Malawi na Afrika Kusini buya bw'ekiraga bwaki bwing'eri bworagwe buki ye upweke rwaki ng'osi esaiwa.
Dholuo: Tanzania oyiero kuom yawe mar nyiso gi piny ok odeso ni malo nyise mag agik e piny Malawi kod piny South Africa ka nyise mag kido ma ok anyalo timo.
Somali: Tansaaniya waxay ka digeysaa in ay sooni doonto mamnuucid ku saabsan dhammaan soo dejinta dalagyada ee Malawi iyo Koonfur Afrika haddii xayiraadaha ganacsi ee hadda jira aan la qaadayyn Arbacada todobaadka soo socda.

English: The COMESA Court of Justice has ruled on the use of safeguard measures, emphasizing that countries must avoid arbitrary trade barriers. Stakeholders should stay informed on trade regulations to ensure compliance.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Haki ya COMESA imetoa uamuzi kuhusu matumizi ya hatua za kinga, ikisisitiza kwamba nchi zinapaswa kuepuka vizuizi vya biashara visivyokuwa na msingi. Wahusika wanapaswa kuendelea kupata taarifa kuhusu kanuni za biashara ili kuhakikisha kufuata sheria.
Ekegusii: Inyang'ana ya COMESA mosi ogenda kworeri omokireri bwakire, ikabere omokireri oremokire oigana buya emere omokireri. Abashandi nabo bochidunedha omokireri bwakire okwabere omorori.
Dholuo: COMESA Court of Justice osemiyo ching' koni ma gima bende otere trade barriers mar lweny. Wadhodhi drok kama wacho nyaka gorie e ching' trade koro konyo compliance.
Somali: Maxkamadda Cadaaladda ee COMESA ayaa go'aan ka gaartay isticmaalka tallaabooyinka ilaaliya, iyadoo sheegtay in dalalka ay tahay in ay ka fogaadaan caqabadaha ganacsi ee aan cadaalad ahayn. Ka qaybgalayaasha waa in ay la socodsiiyaan xeerarka ganacsiga si loo hubiyo in la raaco.

English: Chege Kirundi has been elected as the new Chairman of KTDA Holdings Board. Tea farmers should stay informed of any upcoming changes in policies or operations.
Kiswahili: Chege Kirundi amechaguliwa kuwa Mwenyekiti mpya wa Bodi ya KTDA Holdings. Wakulima wa chai wanapaswa kuendelea kuwa na taarifa juu ya mabadiliko yoyote yanayoweza kuja katika sera au operesheni.
Ekegusii: Chege Kirundi omogori omokiri osiba omosherele wa KTDA Holdings. Abakung'anya cha omokiri basibori omokiri konyaki bw'ogenda bw'ogotego.
Dholuo: Chege Kirundi nuo gi ugeni mar Chairman ma KTDA Holdings Board. Abwaki maber ka wath e young mar kit keth gi nyiso kendo chalo mar ng’ama.
Somali: Chege Kirundi ayaa loo doortay Guddoomiyaha cusub ee Guddiga KTDA Holdings. Beeralayda shaaha waa inay xog ka helaan isbeddel kasta oo dhici kara siyaasadaha ama hawlgallada.

English: Farmers are encouraged to adopt the new Waithera bean variety, which offers higher yields and resilience to climate change. Contact KALRO for more information on seed availability.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahimizwa kupitisha aina mpya ya maharagwe ya Waithera, ambayo inatoa mavuno makubwa na kustahimili mabadiliko ya tabianchi. Wasiliana na KALRO kwa maelezo zaidi kuhusu upatikanaji wa mbegu.
Ekegusii: Abagosi baragori omogori bw'Waithera, ekiri omogori oguhana na omogori bwaki naki obokibori bw'ogere. Moiga KALRO omokinyang'ania iboncho oria bwakire bw'egeni.
Dholuo: Nanga buwayi kuom Waithera bean, kaka en bura manyien e gonde kendo maoketo kod chanje mar nyasa. Golo KALRO kod more information e yo ng'eyo.
Somali: Dalagga waxaa loogu baaqay inay qaataan nooca cusub ee digirta Waithera, oo bixiya wax-soosaar sare iyo adkaysi aanay cimiladu saameyn. La xidhiidh KALRO si aad u hesho macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan helitaanka abuurka.

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders are encouraged to adopt research-driven technologies to improve livelihoods and achieve food security. Stay informed on innovations following the KALRO conference.
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wadau wa biashara za kilimo wanahimizwa kukubali teknolojia zinazotokana na utafiti ili kuboresha maisha na kufikia usalama wa chakula. Endelea kufuatilia uvumbuzi baada ya mkutano wa KALRO.
Ekegusii: Abagere buya na abashoka b’egikonyo barereriwe kugana n'ekoreri okwong'ere omogendori naki osokire buya. Naki obwaki bigezani bw'ogendirie kosi nyandogo ogenda KALRO.
Dholuo: Owino ni jowegi mag buse ne gichako ka nopwore chung' neno machielo kendo ni nyasi. Ikonyo piny kamano kuom nanga mar KALRO.
Somali: Beeralayda iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beerta waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay qaataan teknoolojiyada cilmi-baarista si ay u hagaajiyaan noloshooda iyo gaarista amniga cuntada. La soco hal-abuurka ka dhalanaya shirka KALRO.

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders are encouraged to adopt climate-smart water and soil management practices to enhance agricultural resilience against climate change impacts.
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo wanak encouraged kubadili mbinu za usimamizi wa maji na udongo zinazozingatia mabadiliko ya tabianchi ili kuongeza uwezo wa kilimo kukabiliana na athari za mabadiliko ya tabianchi.
Ekegusii: Abagabandi nakiwaki ba agri-business baria naki ekibiri omokiraita ebiona bise abakire bwang'ira eng'endo naki ohunia oria omokiraita bwaki.
Dholuo: Oberni kata ma nyaka, timo mar joma ngete, to jochakoyo nyaka konyo dhoromo ma duto goyo, kendo nyaka chako tich mar thuran gigo e yo, yore ma jowete e wach mar somo.
Somali: Farmers iyo daneeyayaasha ganacsiga beeraha waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay qaataan hababka maaraynta biyaha iyo ciidda ee ku habboon cimilada si ay u xoojiyaan adkeysiga berri ee saamaynta isbeddelka cimilada.

English: Farmers in Uganda can now access a locally developed anti-tick vaccine to combat tick-borne livestock diseases. Visit the National Livestock Resources Research Institute for more information.
Kiswahili: Wakulima nchini Uganda sasa wanaweza kupata chanjo ya kupambana na mbu wa ng'ombe iliyotengenezwa hapa nchini ili kukabiliana na magonjwa ya mifugo yanayosababishwa na mbu. Tembelea Taasisi ya Utafiti wa Rasilimali za Mifugo ya Taifa kwa taarifa zaidi.
Ekegusii: Abashokoti b'Uganda bakenye bikhang'ane oegana oirokoro buya buya bwakare buya omokile buya bwanienyangi. Naki buya kika ekirangi ya National Livestock Resources Research Institute.
Dholuo: Kanye oganda nyaka tere vacine mar tik ka ohero nyithindo mar nyasaye. Konyo Nyanja mar Nyasaye kuom golo moe.
Somali: Farmers-ka Uganda hadda waxay heli karaan tallaalka ka dhanka ah xanuunada xoolaha ee ka yimaada caarada, oo si maxalli ah loo horumariyey. Booqa Machadka Cilmi-baarista Kheyraadka Xoolaha Qaranka si aad u hesho macluumaad dheeraad ah.

English: Farmers can cultivate high-yielding cassava and other GMOs if they choose; however, regulatory oversight and ongoing legal challenges are in place.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanaweza kulima mihogo yenye mavuno mengi na GMO zingine wanapochagua; hata hivyo, kuna usimamizi wa kisheria na changamoto za kisheria zinazoendelea.
Ekegusii: Abakera baria banao batege omokireri omokerenda omokireri bw’aki, nyasa naki abarere omogori naki ki? Naki omoreri orinde naki abari ba buya.
Dholuo: Wang' dudi en ragwe gi cassava nabich mwul oher GMO, pero miyo kak dipoch gi joma gogo dhok.
Somali: Beeraleydu waxay beeri karaan cawska miraha badan iyo GMO kale haddii ay doortaan; si kastaba ha ahaatee, ilaalinta xeerarka iyo caqabadaha sharciga ah ayaa jirta.

English: Murang'a County has launched a pilot digital system for distributing certified maize seeds and fertilizer. Approximately 135,000 registered farmers will benefit from this initiative.
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Murang'a imeanzisha mfumo wa kidijitali wa kupeleka mbegu za mahindi zilizothibitishwa na mbolea. Takriban wakulima 135,000 waliosajiliwa watanufaika na mpango huu.
Ekegusii: Obwaki bwa Murang'a bujapanga omogori bw'ogenda buseke buoringo bw'ere ebindori ekegana na fertilizer. Bwakireri bwa 135,000 busekeranyi buori na obwakireri bu!
Dholuo: Murang'a County egey reg gi system mar digital to omera mar tieke kuonde mag maize kaka gi fertilizer. Kaka 135,000 farmers mamor eyo ni osetimo gi choch.
Somali: Degmada Murang'a waxay bilaabatay nidaam dhijitaal ah oo tijaabo ah oo loogu talagalay qaybinta abuurka geedka masagada ah ee la xaqiijiyey iyo bacriminta. Ku dhawaad 135,000 oo beeraleydi la diiwaan geliyey ayaa ka faa'iideysan doona hindisahan.

English: Kiawamururu Farmers Cooperative is now offering a payout of Ksh 142.30 per kilogram of cherry and Ksh 470.50 for Mbuni for the 2025/2026 season.
Kiswahili: Kiawamururu Farmers Cooperative sasa inatoa malipo ya Ksh 142.30 kwa kila kilogram ya cherry na Ksh 470.50 kwa Mbuni kwa msimu wa 2025/2026.
Ekegusii: Kiawamururu Farmers Cooperative ikinyasa omotiri Ksh 142.30 ku kilogram ya cherry na Ksh 470.50 kubi Mbuni osikii 2025/2026.
Dholuo: Kiawamururu Farmers Cooperative en gite kaluwore Ksh 142.30 nyaka kilo mar cherry kendo Ksh 470.50 e Mbuni kwan 2025/2026.
Somali: Kiawamururu Farmers Cooperative hadda waxay bixineysaa lacag dhan Ksh 142.30 kiilogramkiiba cherry iyo Ksh 470.50 Mbuni loogu talagalay xilli ciyaareedka 2025/2026.

English: Farmers in coffee-growing regions are encouraged to maintain their coffee trees as the 2025/2026 season is marked by strong market performance and robust demand for Kenyan coffee.
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika maeneo ya kilimo cha kahawa wanahimizwa kudumisha miti yao ya kahawa kwani msimu wa 2025/2026 unatarajiwa kuwa na utendaji mzuri wa soko na mahitaji makubwa ya kahawa ya Kenya.
Ekegusii: Abagore bamisomo baryokere emaita yabo ya kahawa, ore omokonyanaki bw’amasomo 2025/2026 karuga okariyaki maishe olia omanye boki okorore naki kahawa ya Kenya.
Dholuo: Ng'ati mar konyruok ahinya kuom kisumu en ng'ato konyruok, kendo roho nyalo bedo chiegni kuom kuwal konyruok ma ginyalo chayo.
Somali: Beeraleyda ku nool gobollada kafeega waxaa lagula talinayaa inay ilaaliyaan geedaha kafeega maadaama xilliga 2025/2026 uu ka muuqdo suuq xooggan iyo dalab weyn oo ku saabsan kafeega Kenyan.

English: The Nairobi Coffee Exchange held Sale 29, trading 14,284 bags of coffee before July recess; trading resumes in July.
Kiswahili: Benki ya Kahawa ya Nairobi ilifanya Mauzo ya 29, ikifanya biashara ya mabegi 14,284 ya kahawa kabla ya mapumziko ya Julai; biashara itaendelea mnamo Julai.
Ekegusii: Nairobi Coffee Exchange yagana Sale 29, ikabere 14,284 ibagi z’café mbere ya mwezi wa Julai; ikabere buya mu mwezi wa Julai.
Dholuo: Nairobi Coffee Exchange nwelore Sale 29, nokworo 14,284 baggi mollo mbere mag Juli; nolokore mag Juli.
Somali: Nairobi Coffee Exchange waxay qabatay Iibka 29, iyadoo la ganacsanayo 14,284 boorsooyin oo kafee ah ka hor fasaxa Luulyo; ganacsigu wuxuu dib u bilaabanayaa Luulyo.

English: Kenyan farmers are encouraged to continue exporting coffee, as over 1 million kilograms were shipped in March 2026, with strong demand and prices from the U.S. and other international markets.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa Kenya wanahimizwa kuendelea kusafirisha kahawa, kwani zaidi ya kilogramu milioni moja zilisafirishwa mnamo Machi 2026, huku kukiwa na mahitaji makubwa na bei kutoka Marekani na masoko mengine ya kimataifa.
Ekegusii: Abakire buya bano bakiendereje kuteka ikawa, naki ekikumi mirongo 1 obokirire mu mwakano wa 2026, na omokirima ogwendani naki eng'enso ebwakire buya na emokeya buya ngabokire mubandu.
Dholuo: Ng'ato mar Kenya gyele kuom timo export kofi, ohingo 1 million kilograms ne okinyi e boma mar March 2026, kod dhok kuom eng'edi mana nadi gi piny U.S. e mondo en mwandu mar gi.
Somali: Farmers-ka Kenya waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay sii wadaan dhoofsiga qaxwaha, maadaama in ka badan 1 milyan kiilogram la dhoofsaday bishii Maarso 2026, iyadoo dalab xooggan iyo qiimo fiican laga helay Maraykanka iyo suuqyo kale oo caalami ah.

English: Tomato prices in Kisumu have nearly doubled due to heavy rains disrupting supply chains. Expect prices at Kibuye Market to range between Sh15 and Sh30 per piece.
Kiswahili: Bei za nyanya mjini Kisumu zimekaribia kuongezeka maradufu kutokana na mvua nyingi zinazosababisha usumbufu katika mnyororo wa usambazaji. Tarajia bei kwenye Soko la Kibuye kuwa kati ya Sh15 na Sh30 kwa kipande.
Ekegusii: Makiya aya matomato Kisumu akaranga ayaragani shirori kosi nyaki associates. Otigana hinyanya maki ya Kibuye Market akoranga oreri Sh15 na Sh30.
Dholuo: Kakwang' gi magi mar nyasi i Kisumu ok odwogo mudho magero e yo ragi. Nyasaye okbedo e Kibuye Market thag' e Sh15 kod Sh30 per koth.
Somali: Qiimaha yaanyooyinka ee Kisumu ayaa ku dhawaad labalaabmay sababtoo ah roobabka culus oo carqaladeeyay silsiladaha sahayda. Qiimuhu wuxuu ku kala jiri doonaa Suuqa Kibuye intbetween Sh15 iyo Sh30 xabbo.

English: Farmers in Nyakach are encouraged to participate in the Agoro East Aggregated Farm initiative to restore land and improve livelihoods. Join the collective effort for better farming practices.
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika Nyakach wanahimizwa kushiriki katika mpango wa Agoro East Aggregated Farm ili kurejesha ardhi na kuboresha maisha. Jiunge na juhudi za pamoja za kuboresha mbinu za kilimo.
Ekegusii: Abakire mu Nyakach baragwirani omokanya omogori wa Agoro East Aggregated Farm okobororeha boti na okokere omokirori. Ikireni obwaki bwakire bwogogori.
Dholuo: Ogingo mag Nyakach anyalo lweny kuom to its agoro east aggregated farm initiative kuom nyaka duto adhi chogo kelo gi jombo. Omedo ka ochung' e piny mariech mag joma odhiere.
Somali: Beeraleyda Nyakach waxaa Lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay ka qeybqaataan mashruuca Agoro East Aggregated Farm si loo soo celiyo dhulka loona hagaajiyo nolol-maalmeedka. Ku biir dadaalka guud ee hababka beeraleyda wanaagsan.

English: Flower exporters are urged to implement enhanced pest control measures against the false codling moth (FCM) to avoid shipment rejections and financial losses.
Kiswahili: Wasafirishaji wa maua wanasisitizwa kuimarisha hatua za kudhibiti wadudu dhidi ya nondo wa kudanganya (FCM) ili kuepuka kukataliwa kwa shehena na hasara za kifedha.
Ekegusii: Abakinyaki ba matunda bategereje nyamaki nyabaki kushirikiana na gucokere buya buya bwotere bwogegeri bwaki bwokiga (FCM) buya buya owaki omokireri no omogori bwaki buya buya ogokora.
Dholuo: Mok kila mwala oter kod gima chalo piny giwacho kuom dudu mag nyuol mar FCM, koro maki jomuok ng'eyo gi tinde tich.
Somali: Dhoofiyeyaasha ubaxyada waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay qaadaan tallaabooyin kordhin ah oo ka dhan ah kashka beenta ah (FCM) si looga fogaado diidmada rarka iyo khasaare dhaqaale.

English: The Kenya Agricultural Livestock Research Organization (KALRO) is launching a program to develop new pest management technologies and practices to help farmers reduce crop losses.
Kiswahili: Shirika la Utafiti wa Kilimo na Mifugo la Kenya (KALRO) linaanzisha mpango wa kuendeleza teknolojia na mbinu mpya za kudhibiti wadudu ili kuwasaidia wakulima kupunguza hasara za mazao.
Ekegusii: Ishinda ya Kenya Agricultural Livestock Research Organization (KALRO) iriaja bw'ogori obw'ekisumo buya bogogotere omogaka bokierekere aboragani bosi boberia bw'ogori.
Dholuo: Kenya Agricultural Livestock Research Organization (KALRO) orit gi program mane ni nyaka konyo nyawi mang'ongo mi kadi e kinde gi dhohok puonyo ng'ato to to ng'ato loso dho luth.
Somali: Hay'adda Cilmi-baarista Xoolaha iyo Beeraha ee Kenya (KALRO) waxay bilaabeysaa barnaamij si loo horumariyo teknoolojiyada cusub ee maaraynta cayayaanka iyo dhaqamada si ay uga caawiyaan beeraleyda inay yareeyaan khasaaraha dalagga.

English: Farmers affected by maize lethal necrosis disease (MLND) in Bomet County are encouraged to seek information on crop rotation and planting in new areas to prevent further losses.
Kiswahili: Wakulima waliathiriwa na ugonjwa wa kuua mahindi (MLND) katika Kaunti ya Bomet wanahimizwa kutafuta taarifa kuhusu mzunguko wa mazao na kupanda katika maeneo mapya ili kuzuia hasara zaidi.
Ekegusii: Abagere bamakororani buya bw'ogendete bw'ekisukari bwi Bomet batagaka buya oseria buya buya bwokwegererera buya buse bw'otange ko bware ogwaki bwogendete.
Dholuo: Wuon gi yieng' mamoko kendo ng'eyo weche mag maiz lethal necrosis disease (MLND) e Bomet County, to konyo e weche ma okonyo ohera kendo chwech ma pwodhi e ndalo nyalo yore.
Somali: Beeraleyda uu saameeyay cudurka maqaar jilicsan ee mooska (MLND) ee gobolka Bomet waxaa lagu dhiirigalinayaa inay raadsadaan macluumaad ku saabsan wareegga dalagga iyo beerista meelaha cusub si loo yareeyo khasaaraha dheeraadka ah.

English: Farmers are urged to advocate for the timely adoption of biotech maize, cotton, and potato varieties to avoid losses estimated at KSh 20.4 billion and improve food security.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahimizwa kutetea upokeaji wa haraka wa mbegu za mahindi, pamba, na viazi za bioteknolojia ili kuepuka hasara ambazo zinakadiria kuwa KSh 20.4 bilioni na kuboresha usalama wa chakula.
Ekegusii: Abanyakere baria naki bosi bwebwaki bwetere buiga buharia bwa biotech bwa oria, bumbati na mirenda kuibaki naki bwakire bwachieng' osorai buhagire bwebwaki bwasigwa bosi KSh 20.4 billion na bwegane omogenda bwankore.
Dholuo: Abor tedo kuom farmer kanyo ma oketh ne kend ji thoth gin biotech maize, cotton, to gin poteto ma ok giyamo ng'ato ok mar KSh 20.4 billion to omiya ichal mar chak.
Somali: Beeralayda waxaa lagu boorinayaa in ay taageeraan qaadashada waqtiga ku habboon noocyada dhirta bayootik ah ee ayaa, suuf, iyo baradhada si looga fogaado khasaarooyin lagu qiyaasay KSh 20.4 bilyan iyo si loo hagaajiyo amniga cuntada.

English: The CGIAR Africa Agricultural Adaptation (AAA) Atlas is now available as an open-access tool for policymakers and researchers to develop climate-resilient strategies. Utilize this resource to strengthen decision-making in your agricultural projects.
Kiswahili: Atlas ya Uadaptishaji wa Kilimo Barani Afrika (AAA) ya CGIAR sasa inapatikana kama chombo huru kwa wanasiasa na watafiti kuunda mikakati ya kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya tabianchi. Tumia rasilimali hii kuboresha uamuzi katika miradi yako ya kilimo.
Ekegusii: Atlas ya CGIAR Africa Agricultural Adaptation (AAA) yoreka buya gochung'ana na bure mo makiyego omogicha. Naki bwogori buya bwakire buya bwakorere omoshang'ani buya mo ibori yenyu.
Dholuo: CGIAR Africa Agricultural Adaptation (AAA) Atlas ni ng'ato otieno kendo bura marach ma okel micho marach kuom golo chogo gi wan gi deloo. Wachone oyudo golo gi kido duto ma okel e yo mar chiegni nyaka omiyo wende.
Somali: Atlas-ka CGIAR Africa Agricultural Adaptation (AAA) waxa uu hadda diyaar u yahay sidii qalab furan oo ay isticmaali karaan siyaasiyiinta iyo cilmi-baadhayaasha si ay u horumariyaan istaraatiijiyado adkeysan kara cimilada. Ka faa’iidayso kheyraadkan si aad u xoojiso go'aan-qaadashada mashaariicdaada beeraha.

English: Farmers and agribusiness stakeholders are reminded to ensure compliance with safety and quality standards for pest control products. Stay informed on regulations from the Pest Control Products Board (PCPB).
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wadau wa biashara ya kilimo wanakumbushwa kuhakiki kuzingatia viwango vya usalama na ubora wa bidhaa za kudhibiti wadudu. Endelea kujua kuhusu sheria kutoka Bodi ya Bidhaa za Kudhibiti Wadudu (PCPB).
Ekegusii: Abakori naki omokireri baki bakiore omoshanga ore mbokori na ng'otoore omote. Naki boki omosenda amaki naki oria abaki batigana Buya ya Mbokori (Pest Control Products Board - PCPB).
Dholuo: Abwaki gi dakoro kendo gi chuth ginyalo nyal marenjo e yo ni omiyo wujjogi kik ejakore kendo yore magero ma joro maler. Nyaru kuom konyo marach kobor kendo jabiro gi jopiny manonyo e Pest Control Products Board (PCPB).
Somali: Beeraleyda iyo daneeyayaasha beeraleydu waxa lagu xusuusinayaa inay hubiyaan u hoggaansanaanta heerarka badbaadada iyo tayada ee alaabada xakameynta cayayaanka. La soco xeerarka ka yimaada Guddiga Alaabooyinka Xakameynta Cayayaanka (PCPB).

English: National Plant Protection Organizations in 12 African countries are being equipped with tools and training to combat Potato Cyst Nematodes. Early detection is crucial for protecting potato crops and livelihoods.
Kiswahili: Taasisi za Ulinzi wa Mimea za Kitaifa katika nchi 12 za Afrika zimepewa vifaa na mafunzo ya kupambana na Nematodi wa Fukwe za Viazi. Ugunduzi wa mapema ni muhimu katika kulinda mazao ya viazi na maisha ya watu.
Ekegusii: Abakire baki na Nyancha ya Bwakire buere bwana geared with tools naki training buere bushikire Potato Cyst Nematodes. Gutokirania bui gire naki okwama buinokiga naki buiasibori bwaki.
Dholuo: National Plant Protection Organizations e 12 gi chwe mar Africa nyalo piny gi lutruok kod mawuon e nitiere kuom Potato Cyst Nematodes. Koro kendo uwang' ne adhiero nyalo nyal e yo piny gi mawuon e nyadhi.
Somali: Hay'adaha Qaran ee Ilaalinta Dhirta ee 12 dal oo Afrikaan ah ayaa lagu qalabaynayaa aaladaha iyo tababar si loola dagaallamo Cysto Nematodes-ka Baradho. Ogaanshaha hore ayaa muhiim u ah ilaalinta dalagyada baradhada iyo nolosha.

English: The new Waithera bean variety is now available for farmers, offering higher yields, drought tolerance, and improved taste. Contact KALRO for seed distribution details.
Kiswahili: Aina mpya ya maharagwe ya Waithera sasa inapatikana kwa wakulima, ikitoa mavuno makubwa, uvumilivu wa ukame, na ladha bora. Wasiliana na KALRO kwa maelezo ya usambazaji wa mbegu.
Ekegusii: Obokiri bwa Waithera buse buya buria buera abagere, bujire buse bwire buya, bwikire bweni ne bwokiri buse bubi. Bwakorire KALRO buse buya bwobogire bwokore bwaki.
Dholuo: Nang'eyo Waithera kanyad gima omiye ng'ato madhi, oketi yiye, anyalo kayogni, gi mabor. Fweny KALRO kuom namba ma okethi kanyakla.
Somali: Noocyada cusub ee digirta Waithera ayaa hadda la heli karaa beeralayda, waxayna bixisaa wax-soo-saar sare, adkaysi abaaro, iyo dhadhan wanaagsan. La xiriir KALRO si aad u hesho faahfaahinta qaybinta abuurka.

English: Farmers in Nakuru County are invited to participate in the aak-GROW's Stewardship Mashinani initiative to improve safe pesticide usage. Engage with local community efforts for better practices.
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika Kaunti ya Nakuru wanakaribishwa kushiriki katika mpango wa aak-GROW wa Stewardship Mashinani ili kuboresha matumizi salama ya viuatilifu. Shirikiana na juhudi za jamii za ndani kwa ajili ya mbinu bora.
Ekegusii: Abakorera baki Nakuru barabaki kugana omogogoti wa aak-GROW's Stewardship Mashinani ekirenge omokeyo bwaki bwakire. Keganye naki obokire buya omogusi bwakoya.
Dholuo: Mawegi e Nakuru County omed e duto gi aak-GROW's Stewardship Mashinani nyi ng'wonye kanyo yien piny. Wuoyi gi joma en duong' kuom ng'wonye makare.
Somali: Beeralayda Kaakoori ee Nakuru County waxaa lagu martiqaaday inay ka qeybqaataan mashruuca aak-GROW's Stewardship Mashinani si loo hagaajiyo isticmaalka sunta badbaadada. La shaqeyso dadaallada bulshada maxalliga si kor loogu qaado dhaqamada wanaagsan.

English: Farmers are encouraged to adopt ratooning technology in rice production to cut costs and increase yields by up to 80%. For more information, contact KALRO.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanashauriwa kutumia teknolojia ya ratooning katika uzalishaji wa mchele ili kupunguza gharama na kuongeza mavuno hadi asilimia 80. Kwa maelezo zaidi, wasiliana na KALRO.
Ekegusii: Abagabiranyi bariananiwaki kugarane technologia ya ratooning mu muganga omoka omokinyore ogwete okunyanya mbegakire na okwiseka gusibori 80%. Koro omokinya bwakire, gakarangane na KALRO.
Dholuo: Wachung' ka odefne chiegore gi ratooning kumeyogo e chungo mar rice bang' to otieno maler lowo kod nyaka 80%. Nakiwru ketho KALRO.
Somali: Beeraleyda waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa in ay qaataan teknoolojiyada ratooning ee soo saarista bariiska si ay u yareeyaan kharashka isla markaana u kordhiyaan wax soo saarka ilaa 80%. Wixii macluumaad dheeraad ah, la xiriir KALRO.

English: The Kenyan government, in partnership with UNIDO and FAO, is creating pathways to transform the coffee value chain. Stakeholders are encouraged to collaborate and share knowledge for project development.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Kenya, kwa kushirikiana na UNIDO na FAO, inaunda njia za kubadilisha mnyororo wa thamani wa kahawa. Washirika wanahimizwa kushirikiana na kubadilishana maarifa kwa ajili ya ukuzaji wa mradi.
Ekegusii: Ekiya ki Kenya, mwaki na UNIDO na FAO, kireka mirango yose eyokoroga omogori. Abaki baziinjo bakarigana na guchocheka buya bwakore bwabaki.
Dholuo: Gavana wa Kenya, ka kanyalo gi UNIDO kod FAO, oting'o chuto duto kuom gige mar coffee. Nindgi monyalo konyo golo buo gi wuoth ka timo gede mar gi.
Somali: Dowladda Kenya, oo la kaashaneysa UNIDO iyo FAO, ayaa sameyneysa waddooyin lagu beddelayo silsiladda qiimaha bunka. Qaybaha daneynaya waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay iska kaashadaan oo ay wadaagaan aqoonta si loo horumariyo mashruuca.

English: KALRO invites stakeholders to engage in socio-economic and policy research to enhance the impact of agricultural innovations. For collaboration opportunities, contact KALRO directly.
Kiswahili: KALRO inakaribisha wadau kushiriki katika utafiti wa kiuchumi na sera ili kuboresha matokeo ya mbinu za kilimo. Kwa fursa za ushirikiano, wasiliana na KALRO moja kwa moja.
Ekegusii: KALRO ikorere ekere naki omokirongo ryaki buya naki orogoto bw'ogechanda omokiriga omokirigania. Naki orogoto, waki KALRO.
Dholuo: KALRO owinjore nyasaye kuom oritore mar socio-economic e yoji mar policy kuom mondo okel tich mar bunge. Kendo ma ociyo, khanga KALRO piny.
Somali: KALRO waxay martiqaadaysaa daneeyayaasha inay ka qayb qaataan cilmi-baarista dhaqan-dhaqaale iyo siyaasadeed si loo xoojiyo saameynta hal-abuurka beeraha. Fadlan la xidhiidh KALRO si aad u hesho fursado iskaashi.

English: Kenyan coffee growers are encouraged to explore innovative coffee processing methods, including natural, carbonic maceration, anaerobic fermentation, and honey processing, to meet evolving market demands.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wa kahawa Kenya wanahimizwa kuchunguza njia bunifu za kutengeneza kahawa, ikiwa ni pamoja na usindikaji wa asili, uhamasishaji wa kaboni, fermentation isiyo na oksijeni, na usindikaji wa asali, ili kukabiliana na mahitaji yanayobadilika ya soko.
Ekegusii: Abagori b'ekahawa b'Kenya barerire buya banye obwakire bweng'ere bw'ekahawa, hamwe na bendi, carbonic maceration, anaerobic fermentation, na honey processing, buya bwakorire obwena buya bw'ekiburi bw'amasoko.
Dholuo: Ababran gi Ndogo kosingo molos gi konyo mar ndong' ni, kendo owuon gi nindo ma okony otond, kuom luor, carbonic maceration, anaerobic fermentation, kendo honey processing, nyaka madhi kendo chier giwacho.
Somali: Beeralayda bunka Kenya waxaa la dhiirrigelinayaa inay baadhaan habab cusub oo habeyn bunka ah, oo ay ku jiraan habka dabiiciga ah, maceration-ka kaarboon, fermantashanka anaerobic, iyo habeynta malabka, si ay u la kulmaan baahiyaha suuqa ee isbeddelaya.

English: The National Biosafety Authority will host its 13th Annual Biosafety Conference in two and a half weeks to discuss GMOs and biotechnology safety. All stakeholders are encouraged to participate.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Taifa ya Usalama wa Biolojia itafanya Mkutano wa 13 wa Mwaka wa Usalama wa Biolojia katikawiki mbili na nusu zijazo kujadili GMOs na usalama wa bioteknolojia. Wadau wote wanahamasishwa kushiriki.
Ekegusii: Abwaki Bwaki Bwaki bw'Enyamwaki b'Abagwasi b'Abantu b'Enyadina b'Abagwasi, bugeza kinyanara k'egeri, bw'enda bw'oka buwaki bw'aberera naki? Bwakurya naki bw'abakwagasi go lesi boragire b'ouronchori, na bw'enyashia buwang'oga bo.
Dholuo: National Biosafety Authority be timo chuo ma 13 ka ng'ato gi dino mar Biosafety e piny kendo chiemo ma ng'ato duto magok gi GMOs kod biotechnology. Ogingo oyaka ka okonyo.
Somali: Hay'adda Qaranka ee Badbaadada Cunnada waxay qabanqaabin doontaa shirkeedii 13aad ee sanadkan oo ku saabsan badbaadada GMO-yada iyo teknolojiyada biyoolojiga laba todobaad iyo badh ka dib. Dhamaan daneeyayaasha waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay ka qeybqaataan.

English: Farmers in Kenya's Arid and Semi-Arid Lands are encouraged to adopt cassava cultivation as a resilient solution to food insecurity and climate change challenges.
Kiswahili: Wakulima katika maeneo ya njaa na kavu ya Kenya wanahimizwa kukumbatia kilimo cha muhogo kama suluhisho thabiti kwa changamoto za ukosefu wa chakula na mabadiliko ya tabianchi.
Ekegusii: Abaribori baki Kenya buya Abariga na Abariga Bwakere bagenyire omokiri buya bwaki busebu okuwaki buya bwakiri buya bwaki abogenda na obokoranya.
Dholuo: Nakiwoj maber e Kenya, kendo wacho ka ogend thuolo cassava mondo oting'o jotto manok nyaka ng'ato kingu gi ngima k'odhi.
Somali: Beeraleyda ku nool dhulka qallalan iyo kuwa qallalan ee Kenya waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay qaataan beerto kaabashka si ay uga jawaabaan baahida cunto iyo caqabadaha isbeddelka cimilada.

English: Farmers and livestock producers can engage with the $27.4 million global initiative aimed at reducing livestock methane emissions through improved genetics and nutrition. For more information, please visit ILRI's website.
Kiswahili: Wakulima na wazalishaji wa mifugo wanaweza kushiriki katika mpango wa kimataifa wa dola milioni 27.4 unaolenga kupunguza uzalishaji wa methane kutoka kwa mifugo kupitia uboreshaji wa urithi na lishe. Kwa maelezo zaidi, tafadhali tembelea tovuti ya ILRI.
Ekegusii: Abaguria naki bakurumani bakanang’ana omokiri bw’aki $27.4 mirio êmokibaki oria botigoria oremokori bw’aki obw’enyaki buhonyekire mu maarimori na kubota. Naki mwigire mayaka e website ya ILRI.
Dholuo: Wang'ni kanyono kendo nyaka tedi kanyakla 27.4 million dala kwayo golo chogo tokgni mafuta magwe kelo buodo kinsegi kendo kuonde. Nanga note e saito ma ILRI.
Somali: Farmers-yada iyo soo-saareyaasha xoolaha waxay ka qaybqaadan karaan hindisaha caalami ah ee $27.4 milyon oo loogu talagalay in la yareeyo qiiqa methane ee xoolaha iyada oo loo marayo hagaajinta hiddo-wadaha iyo nafaqada. Macluumaad dheeraad ah, fadlan booqo website-ka ILRI.
